stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags pa 'byung bar shugs la grub bo// gnyis pa la gsum las/ chos can rang la rang rig mngon sum gyis grub la/ gzhan la lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur khyad par can las grub bo// bsgrub bya'i chos ni/ goms rkyen dang ma bral zhing gegs med na gsal snang 'byung nges pa sgrub bo// rtags la/ phyogs chos dang khyab pa sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ rten brtan pa ni/ rig pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa thug med du sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyes ma thag pa'i sems chos can/ nyer len gyi rgyu sems snga ma sngon du song ste/ rig pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ da ltar gyi rig pa bzhin no// de'ang sems la nyer len sems snga ma dgos/ de la'ang sems snga ma dgos pa'i phyir ro// rnam 'grel las/ rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi// nyer len min pa'i phyir yang 'grub// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi kha'i sems chos can/ sems phyi ma bskyed par nges te/ sems phyi ma skyed pa la rgyu tshang zhing gegs med pa'i phyir ro// gegs med cing tshogs pa tshang ba'i sa bon bzhin no// 'o na/ gnyid log kha'i mig shes sogs rig pa phyi ma mi bskyed pas bsal zhe na/ ma grub ste/ mig shes phyi ma mi bskyed kyang spyir rig pa phyi ma bskyed de/ tshogs bdun thams cad kun gzhi'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas pa na rig pa rgyun chad pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i ye shes bzhi yod pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs sku bem po 'ba' zhig par thal bas so// goms pa ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur bar bsgoms par rang rig gis grub bo// (52) gnyis pa dpe 'dod 'jigs goms pa'i steng du goms pa yongs su rdzogs na goms bya gsal snang 'byung bar mthong bas grub ste/ rnam nges las/ de phyir yang dag yang dag min// gang gang shin tu bsgoms gyur pas// sgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa na// de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras bu// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid sras gsum gyi yum byed pas tshul gsum pa can gyi ngo bo sher phyin chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i yum yin te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa nyan rang byang sems kyi zag med kyi phung po skyed cing bzhed don mtha' dag skrun par mdzad pa ni/ gdon mi za bar srid pa nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes nges par bzung ste'o// gnyis pa la/ gus par byed do zhes drang ngo*// rgyu gang las na/ yum de la rab tu dang ba'i rgyu las so// kyang ni/ dang bar ma zad gus pa'o// gang na/ yum de'i yon tan nyer zhi sogs mngon par thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po rno rtul gnyis ka yang ngo*// gang la na/ brjod bya mkhyen gsum de dang*/ de la brten pa'i gsung rab rjod byed la'o// dgos pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad du tshig gzung ba dang*/ sogs pa don kun chub pa la sogs pa'i don du'o// ngo bo ji ltar na/ shin tu'o// gsum pa ni/ gus par byas pa'i rjes de nas ming la dmigs pa thos pa'i shes rab/ sogs pa ming don gnyis ka la dmigs pa bsam pa/ don la dmigs pa bsgoms pa'i shes pa skye bas rim gyis 'jug go /bzhi pa ni/ zhugs pas legs pa'i mchog byang chub gsum thob par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dang ba'i dad pa ni chos can/ legs pa thams cad thob pa'i thog ma'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no// dang ba las gus/ gus pa las 'jug zhugs pas legs pa'i mchog thob pa de'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ bstod do zhes drang ngo*// gang la na/ sher phyin (53) la'o// gang gi sgo nas na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas so// de la rtsod spang ni/ ci/ yum mtha' dag la bstod dam/ phyogs gcig la bstod/ dang po ltar na/ sbyor bzhi dang chos sku la ma bstod pas nyung ngo*// gnyis pa ltar na/ mkhyen pa gang rung gcig la bstod pas chog pas mang ngo*// zhe na/

mtha' dag la bstod pas mang skyon med de/ don brgyad po de dag kyang sher phyin mtha' dag yin zhing*/ de la bstod pa'i phyir ma grub pa min te/ mchod brjod des/ mkhyen gsum la bstod cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis don mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus pa'i phyir ro// ji ltar bsdus na/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang po bcu drug byang phyogs so bdun/ mtshan nyid nyer gsum/ spyod pa bkag pa'i shugs bstan gyi sbyor lam/ lam shes kyi nyan thos kyi sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ gzhi shes kyi shugs bstan gyi mthong lam rnams ni/ nyan thos kyi gzhi shes so// gzhi shes kyi rnam pa lhag ma bcu gcig dang*/ lam shes kyi rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam/ mthong lam rnams ni/ rang rgyal gyi gzhi shes so// yang rnam mkhyen gyi sems bskyed dang po gsum/ gdams ngag go sgrub/ rnam kun gyi mthar pa cha mthun/ lam shes kyi yul nges pa sogs ni/ tshogs lam/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor lam/ 'jug pa/ tshogs sgrub bcu bzhi/ rnam kun gyi sbyor lam gnyis/ rtse sbyor gyi sbyor lam rnams ni/ sbyor lam mo// lam shes kyi mthong lam/ gzhi shes kyi mthong lam dngos bstan/ rtse sbyor gyi mthong lam rnams mthong lam/ lam shes kyi sgom lam/ rtse sbyor gyi sgom lam/ tshogs dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor rnams sgom lam/ mthong sgom gnyis kyi rnam pa/ mtshan nyid/ rtags/ spang bya spong ba rnams de gnyis su

(54) 'dus so// sems bskyed dang*/ gdams ngag dang*/ rigs dang*/ dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ yon tan/ skyon/ mthar gyis pa rnams/ lam de dag ci rigs su 'dus te/ de dag lam shes so// rnam mkhyen ni/ rgyu dang bcas pa yin pas chos sku ni/ ched du bya ba sems bskyed tha ma gsum mam gnyis kyis bsdus la/ gzhan drug lhag ma rnams spang bya dang bcas pas bsdus so// kha cig de dag bstod pa'i yul min zhes pa ni/ bab col te/ de dag bor nas mkhyen gsum gang du btsal/ yang*/ 'o na/ rnam mkhyen gyis thams cad bsdus pas de gcig bu la bstod par rigs so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ mkhyen pa gsum po des kyang 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis 'phags pa bzhi'i bzhed pa'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par sgrub nus pas gsum gyis chog la/ rnam mkhyen gyis rang don nyer zhi mi sgrub pas gsum dgos pa yin no// zhes de ltar byams pas thugs la bzhag nas bstod do// gsum pa la/ gang zag gsum gyi bzhed don sgrub pa dang*/ don bsdus te sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi yum du bsgrubs pas phyag 'tshal ba gnyis so// dang po la/ rtsa ba bzhi na gsum las/ dang po ni/ thob par mdzad ces drang ngo*// gang zag gang gis na/ nyan thos dang*/ nyan thos de'i phyogs su bslan pa gzung rtog spangs shing gzung med rtogs pas nyan thos pas rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam gyis lhag pa/ gang zag theg dman/ bsam pa rang don rtogs pa gzhi shes su gcig pas rim pa gcig gis bstan pa rang sangs rgyas kyang ste/ rang don mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams so// thabs gang gis na/ dmigs yul gzhi thams cad/ rnam pa gang zag dang gzung ba skye ba med par yongs su shes pa nyid kyis so// 'bras bu gang na/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung spangs kyang duḥkha'i phung po dang bcas (55) pa dang*/ duḥkha'i phung po med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi las nyon gyi 'bras bu'i me zhi ba'i myang 'das thob par mdzad pa gang yin pa de la bstod do// gnyis pa la/

sgrub par mdzad ces drang ngo*// gang zag gang gis na/ byang sems gdul bya'i 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don byed pa rnams so// thabs ni/ dmigs yul lam gsum po thams cad/ rnam pa skye ba med par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis so// 'bras bu gang na/ gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa mdzad pa gang yin pa la bstod do// gsum pa la/ bskor bar mdzad ces drang ngo*// thabs gang las na/ dmigs yul rnam pa rdzas rigs ma lus pa thams cad/ rnam pa skye ba med par thugs su chud pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes gang dang ldan na ste/ ldan pas so// gang zag gang gis na/ sangs rgyas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yang dag par bsdams pa ste/ spangs pa'i sku can/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas ches lhag pas rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug ste/ nyan rang dang byang sems kyi gtso bo gtsug gi nor bu lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams so// 'bras bu gang na/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug de gsum cha mnyam pa ste/ rtsa ba bzhi re re la nyi khri chig stong ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ bshad pas gdul bya'i rgyud la 'pho bar snang ba'am/ mi mthun phyogs gcod pa ste/ mthong lam la sogs pa'o// ma lus pa ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad do// chos kyi phung po'i tshad ni/ sh+lau ka stong phrag gcig gam/ drug gam/ phung po la sogs chos can re ston pa'i gtam gyi tshogs su bzhed pa yod la/ theg chen gyi lugs kyis/ glang po che rab brtan gyis bkur bar 'os pa'i snag tshas chos kyi phung po gcig 'bri (56) bar nus so// zhes phal chen nas gsungs/ pa ltar ro// mdzod du/ chos kyi 'khor lo mthong ba'i lam// zhes bzhed la/ chos bshes tshogs sbyor sogs ci rigs par 'dod de/ dang por bden pa bzhi'i 'khor lo/

bar du mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo/ tha mar don dam rnam par nges pa'i 'khor lo gsum rnam pa thams cad du bskor bar mdzad do// chos bshes ni/ de ltar rim gyis ma yin gyi/ skad cig kho na la bskor kyang gdul bya'i dbang gis dus tha dad du snang bar 'dod do// mdo sde dgongs 'grel gyi rjes 'brang kha cig 'khor lo bar pa ni/ drang don/ tha ma ni/ nges don du smra ba ni/ rnam par 'khrugs pa ste/ rigs pas gnod pa 'bab pa'i don nges don dang*/ lung rigs kyis grub pa'i don drang don du ci la 'gyur/ mdzod du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang dag thub pas gsungs de dag /ming ngam tshig yin de dag kyang*// gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus// kha cig bstan bcos chad ces zer// phung po la sogs gtam re yin// spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo sangs rgyas dang*/ 'khor nyan thos dang*/ sogs pa byang sems dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba de sgrub par byed pa nyid kyi yum de la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhi pa ni/ bstan bcos brtsam pa'i phyir bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'tshal nas ci byed ce na/ bstan bcos rtsom zhes shugs la bstan no// de la dgos pa med do// zhe na/ yod par dgos 'brel gyis ston no// dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos gang zhe na/ de man chad kyis ston no// de lta na'ang mchod brjod kyi brjod bya mkhyen gsum go rim 'chol bar 'gyur te/ dang por gzhi shes bshad pas so// zhe na/ bod rnams gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa yin pas skyon med zer ba ni/ 'khrul te/ rgya 'grel dri ma med pa (57) rnams su gleng gzhi'i 'grel par bshad pa gcig kyang med cing*/ chos bshes kyis gleng gzhi dang byams rtag mngon rtogs rgyan gyis ma bsdus par bshad pa dang 'gal bas so// rin chen sgron ma ni/

bod kyis byas par rigs ral smra ste/ mthar gyis pa dngos po drug tu 'dod pa sogs mngon rtogs rgyan dang 'gal ba du ma yod pa'i phyir legs pa nyid do// des na 'di ni/ dman pa dang mchog gi rim pa ste/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang sems dang*/ sangs rgyas zhes pa lta bu'o// gzhan ni/ mchog dang dman pa'i rim pa ste/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang zhes pa lta bu'o// des na/ 'dir theg pa gsum la rim gyis gzhug pa'i phyir dang por gzhi shes bstan la/ 'og tu 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen dang por bstan te/ gnyis ka'ang skyon med pa nyid do// lnga pa la/ brgal ba dang*/ lan gnyis so// dang po la/ sngar bshad pa de ltar mkhyen gsum la phyag bstod sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum ston pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom na/ gzhi dang gnyen po dang rnam pa rnams las gang yang rung ba zhig brjod byar bsdus pa mdzad na/ phyogs dang po gzhi tsam brjod byar bsdus pa ltar na ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ de rtsom pa la 'bad pa don med par thal bar 'gyur te/ de'i brjod bya mngon pas bstan zin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan 'di las ni/ chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ston byed kyi mngon pa'i bstan bcos dag las ma smos pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de brjod byar 'byung zhing bstan pa ni med do// khyab pa yod de/ de ltar na mngon pa dang zlos pas so// gnyis pa gnyen po tsam brjod byar bsdus pa ltar na yang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ kun nas nyon mongs pa sgrib gnyis kyi dngos po brjod byar ma (58) bsdus par thal/ gnyen po rnam par byang ba lam gsum gyi dngos po tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bstan bcos chos can/ de la brten nas lam gsum po 'di spang bya gang gi gnyen po yin par khong du chud par mi 'gyur te/

spang bya ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtsom pa don med do// gsum pa rnam pa tsam brjod byar bsdus pa ltar na yang*/ rnam pa gzhi las tha dad med pa zhig bsdus sam/ tha dad pa zhig bsdus/ dang po ltar na/ gzhi la bkod pa'i nyes pas reg go /gnyis pa ltar na/ bstan bcos chos can/ skyes bu la mkho ba'i don cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ rnam pa gzhi dang 'brel pa med pa rtogs pa sprul pa tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ khyab pa yod de/ bsgoms kyang gzhi'i don cung zad rtogs shing thob pa med pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ bstan bcos brtsams pa la don nam dgos pa med pa yin no// snyam du blo dman pa gzhan dag sems shing dogs par 'gyur ba ma yin nam ste/ yin no// zhe na/ gnyis pa la/ rtags dgod/ khyab pa sgrub/ don bsdu gsum mo// dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan de ni chos can/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gang rung re re brjod byar bsdus pa'i skyon yod pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum char brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir ro// rtags grub ste/ gzhi gzugs sogs dang*/ spang bya rtog pa dang*/ gnyen po lam dang*/ rnam pa stong nyid sogs bstan pas so// gnyis pa la/ khyab pa grub tshul/ de'i shes byed drang*/ drangs pa'i don bsdus te bshad pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ yul phyogs gsum char gyis kyang yul can mkhyen gsum bsdus la/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags pa bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus so// de dag go rim ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mngon mtha' dang*/ thams (59) cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi nang nas gzhi shes kyis bsdus/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag lam shes kyis bsdus/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pas na'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bar ma dang*/ bsdus pa dang*/

rgyas pa'i lung drang pa'o// dang po la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus tshul 'di ltar rgyal ba'i yum bar ma nyi khri lnga stong pa las/ nyan thos nyon mongs pa med pa rnams kyi nang na mdzes shing mchog tu gyur pas rab/ 'byor pa sems kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod pas 'byor/ zhes bos nas/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ gang zag nyan rang rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// lam shes nyid ni/ gang zag byang sems rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ gang zag chos phyin ci ma log par ston pas gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i dgra bcom pa/ phun sum tshogs pa gnyis thob par byed pa'i lam thugs su chud pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang dang*/ lam shes kyis byang sems dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs bsdus tshul lo// dang po la/ dris lan gnyis las/ dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ni/ 'bod pa'o// gzhi thams cad 'tshal ba ste/ shes pa nyid/ rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du gang zag nyan rang rnams kyi mngon rtogs la sogs zhes so// lan ni/ rab 'byor/ thams cad ni/ gzugs sogs phyi dang*/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched kyi chos rnams (60) ji snyed pa 'di tsam yin la/ dmigs yul de dag kyang gang zag nyan rang rnams kyis bdag dang gzung bas stong par shes pa gzhi shes yin gyi/ byang chub gsum gyi lam thams cad yon tan yar ldan gyis kyang shes pa ma yin pas lam shes kyang min/ rnam pa rdzas rigs ma lus pa thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa yang ma yin pas rnam mkhyen min no// kyang yang gnyis ni/ phan chun bsdu ba'am/ tshig gi rgyan no// nyan rang rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/

thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o// mkhyen pa yin la lam shes dang rnam mkhyen min pa de'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du dmigs yul lam gsum gyi rnam pa rang bzhin med par 'tshal ba ste/ shes pa nyid/ gang zag byang sems rnams kyi mngon rtogs lags zhes zhus so// lan ni/ rab 'byor/ gang zag byang sems kyis ni dmigs yul gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa nyan thos kyi dang*/ gzung med rtogs pa rang sangs rgyas kyi dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam gsum po thams cad sbyor lam du bskyed par bya zhing*/ lam gsum po thams cad mthong sgom du rang bzhin med par mngon sum du shes par bya'o// lam gsum po de dag gi spangs rtogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs sa dang por rdzogs te/ 'phags pas/ rgyun du zhugs pa nas rang sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi shes pa dang spangs pa gang yin pa de ni/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa yin no// bzod pa gang yin zhe na/ duḥkha la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o// zhes so// zla grags ni/ rgyal bu gzhon nu blon po rgan po zil gyis gnon pa ltar rigs dang sems bskyed kyi lhag bsam gyi mthus (61) zil gyis gnon gyi/ sa bdun pa ma thob bar du rtogs pas zil gyis gnon mi nus la/ sa bdun pa nas rtogs pa'i mthus kyang zil gyis gnon no// des/ rang sangs rgyas rnams thub dbang dbyangs skyes bcas// rdzogs pa'i byang sems dang po la gnas pas// bsod nams dbang gis thul zhing rnam par 'phel// ring du song bar de ni zlos kyang lhag /ces so// theg chen gyi ngo bo sa dang por rdzogs la/ spangs rtogs yon tan ma lus pa rgyun mthar rdzogs pa yin no// zhing ni/ bsdu ba'o// lam gsum po de dag gi lam gyi bya ba sems can gyi don dang spang bya spong ba gnyis po yang bya la/

lam gsum po de dag gi yang dag pa'i mtha' chos nyid dri bral gyi 'gog pa mngon du mi bya'o// byas na/ gzhan don rgyun chad pas myang 'das kyi mthar lhung bas so// gtan nas mi bya'am zhe na/ dmigs bsal ni/ rang nyid kyis gzhan don rlabs po che sgrub nus pa'i smon lam sogs dang*/ ji ltar rma dang zas la de dag gi /zag dang spyad du rung ba smin 'dod ltar// de bzhin rten 'dir phyogs gnyis zhi ba dang*// yongs su spyad pa smin pa nyid du bstan// zhes pa ltar gdul bya sems can rnams sgrib pa spang rung dang*/ gnyen po skye rung du yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ bdag nyid ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i snod bcud kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par mi bya'i/ de dag byas nas mngon du byed kyang skyon med do// de dag bsdu na/ byang sems rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/ lam shes nyid ces bya'o// lam gsum rang bzhin med par shes pa lam gsum gyi bya ba byed kyang rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa de'i phyir ro// gsum pa la gnyis las/ dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du rnam mkhyen nyid/ gang zag

(62) de bzhin nyid rtogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa/ mchod par 'os pas dgra bcom pa/ tshogs gnyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs lags zhes so// lan ni/ rab 'byor/ rnam pa ste/ me lce'i dmar ba dang zlum pa lta bu ngo bo gang dag gis/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams brjod pa ste/ mtshon pa'am rtogs par 'gyur ba'i rnam pa de dag dang*/ mtshon par byed pa'i rtags te/ 'bras bu du ba lta bu gang dag gis chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rtags dang de dag dang*/ mtshan ma ste/ rgyu bud shing lta bu gang dag gis chos rnams brjod pa'i mtshan ma ste/ chos re re'i rnam rtags mtshan ma de dag ma lus par de bzhin gshegs pas mngon sum gyis thugs su chud de'o// de ni/ gzhan 'dren pa'o// bsdu na/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/ rnam mkhyen nyid ces bya'o// chos thams cad kyi rnam rtags mtshan ma lus pa mngon sum gyis mkhyen pa de'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gsungs zhes drang ngo*// gang las na/ yum gyi tshig mdor bsdus pa brgyad stong pa las kyang ngo*// gang na/ bar ma las gsungs pa de bzhin du mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'o// ji ltar na/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang yum la bslab par bya'o// sogs pa rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang yum la bslab par bya'o// zhes gsungs te/ sa ni/ mkhyen gsum du slob dpon gyis bshad do// gsum pa ni/ rgyas pa 'bum las kyang zhib tu rgya cher gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ mkhyen pa gsum bstan pa de la/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ dmigs pa/ gzugs dang tshor ba sogs phung po lnga/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ khams bco brgyad la sogs pa'i chos la'o// 'og tu'ang dmigs (63) gsal med pa rnams kyi sogs kyi sgra 'di ltar bshad do// rnam pa/

mi rtag pa dang*/ sogs pa duḥkha la sogs pa rnam pa bcu drug gi rten can te/ yul can/ bral ba'i 'bras bu/ gang zag gi bdag gam bdag phyed dang gnyis su rmongs pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu can yin no// lam shes nyid ni/ dmigs pa/ rgyu'i theg pa lam gsum po thams cad kyi rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung ba la dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa/ de dag rang bzhin med par shes shing bya ba byed kyang de kho na nyid myang 'das mngon du mi byed pa'i rten can/ bdag po'i 'bras bu/ sems can ma bsdus pa 'khor du sdud cing tshogs lam bskyed/ sogs pa sbyor lam gyis smin pa dang*/ mthong sgom gyis grol bar byed pa can yin no// rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ dmigs pa/ chos thams cad/ rnam pa/ gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i rten can te/ de dag mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can/ 'bras bu gnyis las/ gzhan don rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par sems can gyi don rtag tu rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba dang*/ rang don la/ rtogs pa'i khyad par/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' chos nyid dri ma ma lus pas dag pa rtogs pa dang*/ spangs pa'i khyad par/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis yang srid pa nying mtshams sbyor ba nyid spangs pa can yin no// de dag rang bzhin yin pas 'bras bur mi 'thad do// zhe na/ rang bzhin yin yang phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga ma'i 'bras bu yin pa la dgongs pas skyon med do// gsum pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs ril rdzogs par bstan pa yin no// zhes bya ba ni/ 'thad pa yin no// yul gzhi gnyen rnam pa mtha' dag brjod byar bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ yul gsum gyis yul can mkhyen gsum bsdus la/ (64) mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus par bstan pa de lta bas na'o// rtsod lan 'di/ 'phags pa dang 'grel chen gyis dgos 'brel gyi 'og tu bstan la/

'dir mchod brjod las 'phros pa'i rtsod par gser gling pa dang*/ chos bshes dang*/ sher 'byung blo gros dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba rnams bzhed do// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gsungs te zhes drang ngo*// gang gsungs pa brjod bya dang*/ gang gi don du gsungs pa dgos pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ byams pa rang gi bstan bcos rgyal ba'i yum gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i brjod par bya ba yum gsum gyis don dang*/ 'di la brten nas yum de dag gi don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i dgos pa dang*/ rtogs pa ltar bsgrubs pas sa dang po nas sangs rgyas kyi bar thob pa'i dgos pa'i yang dgos pa dang*/ rjod byed bstan bcos rgyu dang*/ brjod bya yum gyi don rtogs shing thob pa'i dgos pa gnyis 'bras bur 'brel pa/ dngos su ma bstan pa khong na yod pa rnams so// gnyis pa la/ dgos pa dang*/ nying dgos gnyis las/ dang po la/ rnam bcad dang*/ yongs gcod kyi dgos pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i gegs dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir gsungs so// dogs zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ skye bo blo gros dman pa shes rab chung ba dag go /gang la na/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba ste/ rgyal dka' ba'i spang bya las rgyal ba byams pas/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs bzhin du yang yum gyi don de bstan pa la'o// ji ltar na/ de la don dam dgos pa ci zhig yod de/ med do// snyam du'o// de'i rgyu mtshan/ gsal bar mdzad pa ma yin nam ste/ gsal bar mdzad zin pa'i phyir zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ bcom ldan 'das/ rgyas pa la dad pa dbang rtul dang*/ 'bring la dad pa dbang 'bring dang*/ mdor bsdus (65) pa la dad pa'i sems can dbang rnon la chos rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyis lan 'dogs par bzhed pa'i thugs rje can nyid kyis so// gang las na/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa de dang*/ 'bring dang*/

bsdus pa de las so// gang na/ mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i yum gyi don mtha' dag go /gnyis pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i don la dgos pa la sogs shas cher yod snyam pa'i don 'gyur the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyi phyir du'o// gnyis pa ni/ don 'gyur the tshom skyes pas rtog ldan rnams nyan pa la sogs la 'jug pa ni/ nying dgos yin pas de'i yan lag tu'o// rtsa ba la dgos bsdus tshig gsum mo// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos 'brel de la brten nas bstan bcos kyi dgos pa tshad mas shes pa'am nges pa skyes pa yin no// zhe na/ dgos 'brel ngag la brten nas bstan bcos la dgos pa phal cher yod snyam pa'i the tshom chos can/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa yin mi srid par thal/ bstan bcos kyi dgos pa tshad mas shes pa'am nges pa min pa'i phyir ro// kha cig 'dod de/ the tshom ngang gis skye ba'i phyir ro// zhe na/ don 'gyur the tshom de chos can/ dgos 'brel ngag gi gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa'i yan lag ma yin par thal/ dgos 'brel ngag kyang ma yin la/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos 'brel bzhi gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyed khas blangs/ phyed tshad mas grub/ khyab pa tshad ma/ 'dod na/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ gang phyir don gnyer lo ka na// the tshom las kyang 'jug phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// dul lha na re/ bstan bcos 'di brtsam par bya ba ma yin te/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro// zhes bstan bcos rtsom pa'i skabs 'gog pa'i log rtog bzlog pa (66) dgos pa yin no// zhe na/ de'ang dgos par 'dod na skyon med la/ de kho na dgos par 'dod na/ brjod bya dang 'brel pa dang nying dgos med par 'dzin pa'i log rtog bzlog pa chos can/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa ma yin par thal/ dgos med log rtog bzlog pa min pa'i phyir/

lo tsā na re/ gzhung mdzes pa bskyed pa kho na'o// zhe na/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag chos can/ des bstan bcos la dgos med log rtog bkag pa ma yin par thal/ gzhung mdzes pa bskyed pa kho na de'i dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ don ci zhig yod snyam du dogs pa bsal pa'i phyir zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ dgos pa dang*/ nying dgos so// dang po la/ yongs gcod kyi dgos pa/ dgos 'brel ngag las rgyan dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur rtogs pa yin la/ rtogs tshul dbang rtul gyis rgyu yin nges snyam pa'i sgo nas rtogs la/ dbang rnon gyis yin las che zhes don 'gyur the tshom gyis rtogs so// rnam bcad kyi dgos pa ni/ ngag gis gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa'i gegs gzhung dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur ma rtogs log rtog the tshom rnams bcad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyan dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur rtogs pa las dgos pa gnyis don gnyer gyi rtog ldan gus pas rgyan la 'jug pa yin te/ 'grel chen las/ mdo sde'i thog mar dgos pa brjod pa ni/ mdo la gzhan gzhug pa'i don du yin gyi zhes so// gsum pa la/ rnam bcad dang yongs gcod kyi dgos pa la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis so// dang po la/ log rtog bcad pa dgos pa yin na/ ci/ blun po'am/ rtog ldan gyis log rtog bcad pa dgos pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ log rtog bcad pa la dgos pa med par 'gyur te/ chod kyang gzhung la gzhug mi nus pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ mi rigs te/ rtog ldan la log rtog med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag (67) brjod na/ rgyan dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur shes nas 'jug gi ma brjod na/ mi 'jug pas dgos 'brel ngag gi gdul bya'i log rtog gcod pas skyon med do// 'o na/ ngag gis log rtog gcod nus sam/ mi nus/ nus na/ phung po bdag med do zhes brjod pas kyang bdag 'dzin bzlog par 'gyur ro// mi nus na/

ngag dang log rtog bcad pa rgyu 'bras yin pa nyams so// zhe na/ ngag de'i brjod bya rtogs na/ log rtog gcod nus la/ brjod bya ma rtogs na/ ngag de'i gdul bya ma yin pas skyon med do// gnyis pa la/ nges pa bskyed mi nus pa dang*/ the tshom bskyed mi dgos pa'i rtsod spang ngo*// dang po la/ ngag chos can/ don la nges pa bskyed mi nus par thal/ don la 'brel pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nges pa bskyed pa dgos pa yin pa nyams so// zhe na/ de ci/ dbang rnon la dngos su nges pa bskyed mi nus par thal ba 'dod/ dbang rtul la rtags ma grub ste/ 'di lung khyad par can yin pa'i phyir ro// khyab pa'ang med de/ rig byed kyi bstan bcos la bden par zhen pa bzhin no// yang*/ 'chad pa pos rgyan dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur bshad pas nyan pa po la nges pa skye'am mi skye/ skye na/ rtsom pa pos brtsams pa don med par thal lo// mi skye na/ rtsom pa po las kyang nges pa mi skye bar mtshungs so// zhe na/ dbang rnon la nges pa dngos su mi skye zhing dbang rtul la skye'ang*/ brtsams pa don med par thal bas ma khyab ste/ brtsams pa'i don bshad pas nyan pa po la nges pa skyes pa de brtsams pa'i dgos pa yin pas so// gnyis pa la/ the tshom bskyed pa la ngag mi dgos par thal/ ngag med kyang the tshom ngang gis skye ba'i phyir zhe na/ dbang rtul la 'dod/ dbang rnon la don 'gyur the tshom bskyed pa la ngag mi dgos par thal zer ram/ de las gzhan pa'i the tshom bskyed pa la ngag mi (68) dgos par thal zer/ gnyis pa la 'dod cing*/ dang po la don 'gyur the tshom ngang gis skye ba'i rtags ma grub/ de las gzhan pa'i the tshom ngang gis skye ba'i phyir zer na/ ma nges so// yang the tshom de ngag gi dgos pa min te/ ngag gi don rtogs pa min pa'i phyir zhe na/ ci/ nges pa'i sgo nas sam/ gtan nas ma rtogs gang zer/ dang po ma nges/ gnyis pa rtags ma grub bo// ngag med kyang the tshom skye bar rang rig gis grub bo// zhe na/

de ni/ ngag de'i gdul bya ma yin pas skyon med do// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bstan bya dgos 'brel bzhi ngos gzung*/ de ngag gis bstan tshul/ bstan pa bzhir grangs nges pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ dgos 'grel ngag gi dgos 'brel dang*/ rgyan gyi dgos 'brel lo// dang po la bzhi las/ ngag 'dis bstan par bya ba rgyan gyi dgos 'brel bzhi ni/ brjod bya'o// ngag de las brjod bya nges pa'am don 'gyur the tshom gyis rtogs pa ni/ dgos pa'o// de las dgos pa gnyis don gnyer gyi gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ nying dgos so// dgos pa gnyis po ngag gi 'bras bur 'brel pa ni/ 'brel pa ste/ shugs bstan no// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ brjod bya ni/ rgyan gyis bstan par bya ba yul gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa/ yul can mkhyen gsum/ de las phye ba mngon rtogs brgyad ngos 'dzin gyi thabs don bdun cu dbye ba dang bcas pa ste/ mdor na/ mdo gsum gyi don no// gnyis pa dgos pa ni/ rgyan las gdul bya rnams kyis brjod bya bde blag tu rtogs pa'o// gsum pa nying dgos ni/ rtogs pa las nyan thos sogs kyis ma myangs pa'i zab mo rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes thos bsam sgom gsum las mngon du byed pa'o// bzhi pa 'brel pa ni/ dgos pa gnyis thabs kyi bsgrub bya/ bstan bcos sgrub byed kyi thabs su 'brel pa'o// gnyis pa la/ ci/ dgos 'brel ngag gis brjod bya de dag (69) dngos su bstan nam/ shugs la bstan zhe na/ 'di la lugs gnyis las/ sgras zin ma zin la dngos bstan dang shugs bstan du byed pa ltar na/ dgos pa gnyis dang brjod bya dngos su bstan te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes brjod bya bstan/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// zhes dgos pa bstan/ blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// zhes nying dgos bstan/ 'brel pa sgras ma zin pas shugs bstan te/ dper na/

sgrub ngag dngos su brjod pas phyogs shugs kyis bstan pa bzhin no// ka ma la shī las/ 'brel pa ston par byed pa'i sgra// dngos su yod pa ma yin mod// 'on kyang de ni rnam 'byed las// don gyis thob par bya ba yin// zhes so// gnyis pa don du gnyer bya'i gtso bor bstan pa la dngos bstan/ phal par bstan pa la shugs bstan du byed pa ltar na/ dgos pa gnyis dngos su bstan pa yin te/ don du gnyer bya'i gtso bor bstan pa'i phyir/ brjod bya ni/ gang rtogs na/ mdo don rtogs zhes/ dgos pa ngos 'dzin gyi thabs su bstan pas shugs bstan no// 'brel pa ni/ de gsum gyi zhar la go ba'o// gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig rgyan 'di la 'jug par mi bya ste/ dgos pa med/ yod kyang sgrub mi nus/ nus kyang 'di la ma 'brel/ 'brel kyang 'dis bsgrub pa'i dgos pa bdag gi 'dod bya ma yin no// zhes log par rtog pa la/ dgos pa bstan pas dgos med log rtog khegs/ brjod bya bstan pas sgrub mi nus kyi log rtog khegs lo// bstan bcos brjod bya dang ldan par rtogs pa'i gang zag chos can/ rgyu mtshan gzhan gyi sgo nas bdag gi dgos pa sgrub mi nus zhes 'dzin pa'i log rtog mi srid par thal/ brjod bya bden pa bstan pas dgos pa sgrub mi nus kyi log rtog khegs

(70) pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshad mas bsal lo// kha cig na re/ rgyan la dgos pa med de/ dgos pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ spyod 'jug tu/ gal te rgyu la 'bras gnas na// zan za mi gtsang za bar 'gyur// zhes pas so// ngag gis kyang rgyan la dgos pa med par bstan no// zhe na/ gzhi brtan pa chos can/ de la chu yod mi srid par thal/ chu'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ rnam nges las/ chu yi bdag nyid de 'dra ba// gzhi las mngon par grub pa'i phyir// de yi 'bras yin zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gzhan yang*/ nyi ma dang sgron me la 'od med par thal ba dang*/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la longs spyod dang*/ bde 'gro'i 'bras bu med par thal ba sogs rgya cher sbyar ro// yang*/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag chos can/ dgos pa don gnyer gyi gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa'i thabs skyon med min par thal/ gzhung la dgos pa med par bstan pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ chu don gnyer gyi rtog ldan chu med par mi 'jug pa bzhin no// 'dod na/ 'jug pa'i lan lag tu zhes pa dang 'gal lo// lung de ni/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo gcig pa 'gog pa yin gyi/ spyir yod tsam 'gog pa min no// yod pa la ngo bo gcig pas khyab pa yin na/ bu ram gyi gong bu chos can/ de mig gis mthong ba na ro mthong bar thal/ ro yod pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ ro gzugs tshogs pa gcig tu yod pas so// khyab pa khas blangs/ 'dod na/ ro mig gis mthong bar 'gal lo// lho pa na re/ ngag gsum du nges kyi/ 'brel pa ston pa'i ngag med do// zhe na/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag 'di chos can/ dgos 'brel bzhi tshad par ma gsungs la/ 'brel pa ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'brel ba khong na yod pa rnams gsungs te/ zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa ni/ dgos 'brel ngag gi gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa'i gegs kyi blo (71) bzhi ru nges pas/ sel byed dgos 'brel gyi ngag bzhir nges so// de gang zhe na/

dang po rtog ldan/ ngas rgyan 'di la 'jug par mi bya ste/ brjod bya bden pa dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ bya rog so rtog gi bstan bcos bzhin/ zhes brjod bya ma rtogs sogs kyi blo de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes brjod bya bstan pas sel/ yang brjod bya dang ldan yang 'di bde blag tu rtogs pa'i dgos pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ nor bu len pa'i bstan bcos bzhin/ zhes dgos pa ma rtogs sogs kyi blo de/ bde blag tu ni rtogs zhes/ dgos pa bstan pas sel/ dgos pa yod kyang zab mo mngon sum du mthong ba'i nying dgos med pa'i phyir/ sog po par sig pa'i ma bag mar len pa'i bstan bcos bzhin/ zhes nying dgos ma rtogs sogs kyi blo de/ blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// zhes nying dgos bstan pas sel/ de dag dang ldan yang dgos pa gnyis po bstan bcos 'di la ma 'brel ba'i phyir/ mtho ris kyi don du srog gcod pa bzhin/ zhes 'brel pa ma rtogs sogs kyi blo de dag snga ma gsum dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la dgos pa gnyis po rgyan la 'brel par bstan pas sel lo// sel tshul yang*/ de dag las rang gi brjod bya la dbang rtul la nges pa skye zhing dbang rnon la don 'gyur the tshom skye bas/ de ltar ma rtogs sogs ldog ste/ de gnyis lhan cig mi gnas pa'i phyir/ snang mun bzhin no// gsum pa la gsum ste/ bsal bya blo dang*/ bsal ba'i gzhi dang*/ sel ba'i tshul la rtsod spang ngo*// dang po ni/ bsal bya blo'i dbang gis sel byed ngag gi grangs nges 'jog na/ blo skye nges pas sam/ skye srid pas 'jog dang po ltar na/ ngag bzhi mi dgos par 'gyur te/ blo bzhi skye bar nges pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ltar (72) na/ ngag bzhi bas mang ba dgos par 'gyur te/ blo bzhi bas mang ba skye srid pa'i phyir te/ rgyan la zhugs na/ dus yun ring po 'gor ba dang*/ gnas skabs bde ba'i gegs dang*/

mthar thug phan pa'i rgyu min pa dang*/ dbang po ma tshang ba dang*/ tshang yang gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sgo nas dgos pa gnyis mi srid par dogs pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ dgos 'grel ngag gi gdul bya la bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i gegs kyi blo skye srid pas 'jog pas skyon dang po med la/ gnyis pa'ang med de/ dus cung zad 'da' ba dang gnas skabs bde ba'i gegs su dogs pa/ rtog ldan gzhung la 'jug pa'i gegs min/ dus ha cang ring ba dang mthar thug mi phan par 'dzin pa/ dgos pa dang nying dgos med par 'dzin par 'dus so// bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis gdul bya gzhung la 'jug pa'i gegs kyi blo min no// gnyis pa ni/ dogs pa de dag shes bya la sel lam/ bstan bcos la sel/ dang po bsal mi nus te/ shes bya la dgos med du ma yod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ltar na/ bsal mi dgos te/ bstan bcos la 'brel med kyi log rtog med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ dogs pa de dag bstan bcos gzhir byas la sel te/ dngos su brjod bya dang dgos pa/ brgyud nas nying dgos don du gnyer bas bstan bcos la 'jug dgos so zhes bstan pas so// shes bya tsam la sel ba mi 'thad de/ shes bya tsam la dgos pa yod par rtogs kyang gzhung la 'jug pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur zhing*/ bstan bcos la dgos pa yod par grub na/ shes bya la'ang yod pa grub pas so// gsum pa ni/ nges pa skyes pas blo gsum sel ba bden yang the tshom gyis sel ba mi 'thad do// zhe na/ skyon med de/ bsal bya cha mnyam mam/ don du mi 'gyur ba'i the tshom yin la/ sel byed don 'gyur the tshom yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ brjod bya/ dgos (73) pa/ nying dgos gsum mo// dang po ni/ bshad ces drang ngo*/ gang na/ mngon rtogs bdun nang du 'dus pa'i rnam mkhyen rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa nyid lam ste/ 'bras bu ni/ 'di btsal bar bya bas lam yin la/ rgyu ni/ 'dis tshol bas lam ste/

de'o// gang gis na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis so// gang las na/ mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus pa 'di las ste/ sgra'i brjod bya ni/ mdo dang*/ don gyi brjod bya ni/ de las bshad pa gang yin pa'i rnam mkhyen rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rtogs zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i phar phyin bcu'i sgrub pa'i chos spyod bcu'am/ don drug cu nang du 'dus pa'i chos spyod rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo don/ 'dir chos spyod bcu la shān+tis/ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang*// zhes sogs la 'dod/ kha cig ni/ dge ba bcu la 'dod de/ brtag go /gang gis na/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ byang sems rnams kyis te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni// rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*// rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang*// ded dpon dang ni grags mchog dang*// snying rje can dang bsod nams can// dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan// zhes ming gi rnam grangs su gsungs so// ji ltar na/ don rgya chen po tshig nyung ngus 'bad pa med par rtogs pas na/ bde blag tu rtogs pa ste zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu ni/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ mthong bar 'gyur zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ mu stegs nyan rang la sogs pa byang sems las gzhan gyis myong ba ste/ rtogs pa ma yin pa'i don zab mo de'o// gang gis na/ blo dang ldan pas so// thabs gang las na/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi yum gyi (74) mdo don thos pa'i shes rab kyis rtogs pa bzhin du dran pa la bzhag ste/ bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyis bsgrubs pa la brten nas so// phyir zhes pa dang*/ rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin zhes dngos su bstan pas/ 'brel pa shugs la rtogs so// ji skad du/

bstan bcos dang ni dgos pa'i don// 'brel pa'i gzhi ni gnyis la gnas// de bstan 'dus pa de yi phyir// dgos las logs shig ma bstan no// zhes so// 'grel pa la bzhi ste/ brjod bya/ 'brel pa/ nying dgos/ dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ bstan zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ skabs dang po'i brjod bya rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi lam ste/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste/ mngon par rtogs pa gzhan bdun po thams cad des nye bar mtshon cing nang du 'dus pa lhur len pa yin no// gang gis na/ ji skad du/ bdud bcom 'jigs med skal ba bzang po dang*// srid par 'gro las 'das dang shes rab dang*// 'khrul dang bral zhing yon tan dpag med snod// yon tan 'di dag rab rgyas bcom ldan 'das// zhes pa'i nges pa'i tshig gi tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das so// sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul nam mkha' la 'gro ba sogs sna tshogs pas dad par mdzad/ thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis gdul bya'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal mkhyen nas smin par mdzad/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis theg pa gsum gyis gdul ba'i sems can la rjes su mthun pa'i chos bstan pas grol bar mdzad pas na/ cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la gdams ngag rjes su ston par mdzad pa de nyid kyis so// gang las na/ bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yum rnam pa gsum char las kyang*/ ji ltar na/ brjod par bya ba nyid du bstan pa gang yin pa de 'dir brjod bya'i gtso bo'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'brel par mdzad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ rjod par byed pa rgyan dang (75) brjod par bya ba rnam mkhyen rgyu dang bcas pa dag go /ji ltar na/ rgyan de sgrub pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i thabs dang*/ brjod bya thabs kyis bsgrub par bya ba 'bras bu'i tshul gyis so// de mi 'thad de/ dgos pa gnyis dang 'brel pa ma bstan pas so// zhe na/ ma grub ste/

brjod bya rnam mkhyen rgyu dang bcas pa sgrub nus par bstan pas dgos pa gnyis kyang de'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir sgrub nus par bstan no// gsum pa ni/ mngon du byed par 'gyur zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ ma myangs zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ seng ge dang 'phrog byed la sogs pa phyi rol pa dang*/ de las gcig shos kyi khams gsum las 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom/ sogs pa nyan rang slob pa ste/ lo ka'i spyi bor gyur pa gzhan don du chos thams cad bdag med pa la goms par ma byas pa rnams kyis so// ji ltar na/ thos pa las byung ba dang*/ sogs pa bsam pa dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes pa skye ba'i lce dbang gis rim gyis ma myangs pa yang dag pa'i bdud rtsi yum de'o// ji skad du/ khyab dang dbang la sogs ma myong*// dpag tu med par gnas pa'i rgyu// lo ka'i spyi bor gyur pas kyang*// myong par gyur pa ma yin pa// yang dag bdud rtsi dag pa 'di// zhes so// gang gis na/ byang chub sems dpa' rigs la gnas pa/ rang dang gzhan gyi mngon mtho nges legs kyi don phun sum tshogs par sgrub pa/ gzhan ci la yang ma rag par te/ rag ma las par chas pa ste/ phyir mi ldog par go cha brtan par byas pa dag kho nas so// thabs gang la brten nas na bzhag ces drang ngo*// gang la na/ sngar gyi thos bsam gyis chos kyi ming don nyams su myong ba sems la shin tu gsal bar byas pas kun gzhi la bag chags bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i sngar gyi don ma brjed pa'i dran pa'i shes pa (76) la'o// yang na/ bag chags ni/ yang yang goms pas sems de'i rnam par 'byung ba'o// gang na/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i don ma lus pa'i gtso bo mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de dang ldan pa'i sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa rnams so// ji ltar na/ tshe rabs gzhan du yang rjes su 'brang zhing mi brjed par legs par bzhag ste/

de la brten nas so// ji ltar na/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i chos gzugs sogs thams cad kyi dbyings rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ bdag gzhan thams cad la kun tu 'gro bar rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa dang por rab tu dga' ba dang*/ sogs pa dri ma med pa la sogs pa rtogs shing thob pa'i rim pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pas na/ rnam pa thams cad mngon du byed pa'o zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu ni/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ rtogs par 'gyur zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sngar bstan pa'i nying dgos kyi ched du rtogs shing thob par mngon par 'dod pa'i sher phyin gyi don smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa phar phyin bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa/ sogs pa chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid do// gang gis na/ gdul bya rnams kyis so// ji ltar na/ bde blag tu ste/ go sla bar rtogs par 'gyur ba ste/ de ni/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no// gsum pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyan gyi tshig gis mdo'i don ma lus pa bsdus sam ma bsdus zhe na/ ma bsdus te/ gleng gzhi ni/ yum 'di ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la sogs pa ston pas go sla ba'i phyir ro// rtag tu ngu dang chos 'phags kyi le'u ni/ chos tshol tshul dang bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul te/ go sla'o// yongs su gtad pa ni/ gzhung nye bar bsdu ba'am bka' bsdu bar bskos pa ste/ go (77) sla ba'i phyir ma bsdus so// bar bar du gang zag lung bstan pa dang*/ sngon rabs la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ma bsdus so// rgyan na yod pa'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa mngon ma tshang ba ni/ mdo'i yi ge nyams par shes par bya'o// 'o na/ 'phags pas/ 'di skad ces bya ba la sogs pa skabs 'byed pa nas brtsams te yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar gyi dngos po rnams gcig tu bsdus na/ rnam mkhyen nyid la sogs pa chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i mthar thug pa dngos po brgyad du 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/

brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po brgyad du 'dus pa la dgongs te/ gleng gzhir sangs rgyas mang pos skyes bskur ba dang*/ byang sems mang po 'khor du 'dus pa la sogs pa ni/ yum bshad pa rdzogs kyi bar du lo ka'i khams thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa dang de na yod pa'i sems can la dmigs te/ sems bskyed par shes par bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas mang por shes pa sogs kyi don yin par 'phags pas bzhed do// 'dir gleng gzhi cung zad bshad pa la gnyis te/ sdud pa pos gleng bslang ba dang*/ gleng gzhi dngos so// dang po ni/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ phyag na rdo rjes byams pa la sogs pa rnams la 'di skad bdag gis thos zhes brjod par bzhed de/ slob dpon gyi bzhed pas/ ston pa zhi bar gshegs nas lha ma yin gyi phug tu bstan pa sgro skur med cing yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dgra bcom pa bzhi brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i bla gos gdan du byas pa la kun dga' bo bzhugs te/ 'od srung chen pos/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdo// bcom ldan 'das kyis gang du gsungs// shes rab chen po khyod kyis smros// bde gshegs sras po khyod smros shig /ces gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su ston pa'i yon tan dran pas bzhin mchi ma can du

(78) byas te thams cad du khyab pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes gsungs so// de la 'di skad ces pas/ mdo de ni/ 'di ltar yin no// zhes phyin ci ma log par bstan no// bdag gis zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la dngos su thos par bstan no// de mi 'thad de/ yul gzhan du gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan las thos pa'ang yod pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs kyis gzhan gyis bstan pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa yin pa ltar/ de'i mthus gzhan las thos pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pa las thos pa yin no// thos pa ni/ rna ba'i rnam shes kyis thos kyi/ don rtogs pa med ces pa'o// gzhan ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas ston pa mi 'thad pas bshad pa'i tshe zhes mi brjod/ thos pa zhes sbyar ro zer ro// 'o na/ bka' la bka' min bsres pa'i skyon yod de/ 'di skad dang gsol pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pas ma gsungs pa rnams bcug pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' yin pas so// chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes gyis la dam pa'i chos bsdu bar bya'o// zhes sogs dang*/ 'brel pa dang go rim bstan par bya'o zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la mdo thun mong gi dang*/ khyad par yum gyi gleng gzhi'o// dang po ni/ gang gi tshe/ gang las/ gang du/ su dang lhan cig tu/ mdo 'di thos dris pa na/ rang nyid tshad ma'i skyes bur bstan pa'i phyir dus dang*/ ston pa dang*/ yul dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa gsungs te/ phyogs glang gis/ ston pa dbang po 'khor dang ni// yul dang dus kyang nges bstan pa// dad ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag tu// sdud po rang nyid tshad mar ni// rab bsgrub phyir yin 'jig rten na// yul dang dus sogs kyis mtshon (79) zhing*// dbang por bcas tshig smra ba yis// smra 'o tshad mar rab tu rtogs// zhes so// des na/

dus dang*/ ston pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'khor bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dus gcig na zhes pa ste/ tshig snga ma dang sbyar na/ dus gcig gi tshe na mdo 'di thos zhes/ chos la sbyar bas yum 'di rnyed dka' bar bstan no// dus gcig gi tshe na bdag gis 'di thos kyi/ gzhan du gzhan thos zhes/ zur gyis smos pas sdud pa po thos pa mang bar bstan no// yang*/ 'di dus skad cig la thos shing brjed pa med do zhes bdag nyid tshad ma'i skyes bur bstan no// tshig phyi ma dang sbyar na/ dus gcig gi tshe na bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs zhes pas gzhan na gzhan du gshegs par bstan no// gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das so// gsum pa ni/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i phyogs gnyis bsdu ba dang*/ sku gnyis kyis phan gdags pa'i phyir rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la zhes gnas gnyis smos/ ma ga dha'i grong khyer gzugs can snying po'i khab ni/ rgyal po'i khab bo// dag pa'i zhing ltar 'jigs pa med pa sangs rgyas mang po'i bzhugs gnas/ 'dod bya rin po che sna tshogs kyi phung po yod pas bya rgod phung po/ lha la sogs pa bsod nams 'dod pa rnams tshes brgyad la sogs pa'i dus tshigs su 'du ba rgya cher byed pas/ ri bo'o// bzhugs pa ni/ skus spyod lam dang*/ gsung gis chos 'chad pa dang*/ sems can dang chos la dmigs pa'i thugs kyis snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ nang du yang dag par 'jog pa ste/ bzhis bzhugs pa'o// bzhi pa la/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi 'khor ro// dang po la/ dge slong bzhi/ ngo bo gsol bzhi'am tshur shog sogs kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i dge slong ngo*// skyabs gnas dang dbye bar mi (80) nus pas dge 'dun no// zla grags kyis/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams// bdud rnams bye ba brgya yis kyang*// gang phyir dbye bar mi nus pa// de phyir dge 'dun zhes brjod do// zhes so// chen po ni/

grangs dang yon tan che bas so// grangs che ba ni/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu la sogs pa'o// yon tan che ba ni/ thams cad kyang dgra sgrib pa dang gnod pa bcom pa/ 'dod pa dang srid pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa dang las dang skye ba'i nyon mongs pa med pa/ 'ching ba dang bral zhing rang dbang thob pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul dang dbang po dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab la dbang bas dbang du gyur pa/ sred pa'i phyogs kyi nyon mongs pa spangs pas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ ma rig pa'i phyogs kyi nyon mongs spangs pas dgra bcom gyi ye shes shes rab rnam par grol ba/ duḥkha dang 'jigs pa dang lo ka'i chos dang mi shes pa'i 'jigs pa med pas cang shes pa/ rig pa gsum la sogs pa thob pas glang po chen po/ nges par bya dgos pa duḥkha las thar pa la sogs byas pas bya ba byas pa/ zhor bya sbyangs pa'i yon tan sogs byas pas byed pa byas pa/ phung po dang nyon mongs pa dang dam bca' dang brtson pa'i khur bor ba/ thob bya dang spang bya bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su mthun par thob cing spangs pas rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ khong khro sogs dgus skyes bu 'khor bar sbyor la/ de med pas srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ de kho na nyid shes pas 'ching ba thams cad dang bral bas yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgus sems thams cad la dbang ba mthar thug thob pas sems thams cad kyi dbang dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// dmigs bsal ni/ kun dga' bo la yon tan de dag med ces pa/ gang zag gcig ma gtogs (81) pa 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo zhes so// dge slong ma ni/ grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa lnga brgya tsam mo// dge bsnyen gzugs can snying po la sogs pa dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma la sogs pa ste/ kun kyang chos mthong ba mthong lam thob pa sha stag go

/gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems bzang skyong la sogs pa grangs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong*/ yon tan/ thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa la sogs pa'o// thabs cig pa ni/ lhan cig pa ste/ yongs su bskor ba'o// gnyis pa la/ gdan dang bzhugs pa bsham/ bzhugs nas cho 'phrul mdzad/ mdzad nas chos gsung ba'i dus gzigs pa gsum mo// dang po la gnyis las/ gdan bsham pa ni/ chos thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod 'os chen por bstan pa dang*/ 'dod pa med pa dang*/ phyi rabs kyi skye bo'i zhum pa bsal ba dang*/ 'khor gdul ba'i phyir de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas zhes so// bzhugs pa bsham pa ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i spyod lam gyis mdo 'di rtogs par bya'o// zhes bstan pa'i phyir sku drang por bsrang ste/ dgongs pa sngon du bzhag nas skyil mo krung mdzad nas bzhugs so// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ chos snang ba'i cho 'phrul lo// dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ seng ge rnam rol gyi cho 'phrul lo// dang po la/ rgyu mnyam par bzhag ste gzigs pa dang*/ 'bras bu 'od zer dgye ba'o// dang po ni/ der bzhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad khong du chud pas 'du ba dang rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ lha'i (82) spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la rnam par gzigs so// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ yan lag dang nying lag nas dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dang*/ ljags las 'od zer dgye ba'o// dang po ni/ de ltar gzigs nas sku thams cad nas 'od rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis 'khor lo'i rtsibs stong dang ldan pa las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo*// zhes so// 'od zer ni/

nang gi ye shes rnam par 'phro ba las byung ba'o// 'od ni/ phyi'i pags pa'am/ kha dog rnam par 'phro ba las byung ba'o// 'od zer dang gdul bya dang dgos pa mang bas bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong ngo*// sngo ser dmar dkar leb rgan dang 'od gsal ba ste/ drug po phyogs bcur 'phros pas drug cu'o// lte ba/ thugs ka mgul/ zhal/ mdzod spu/ gtsug tor ma gtogs pa rnams la gnas gnyis gnyis yod pas drug cu gnyis smos so// 'od zer des las gnyis byed de/ lo ka snang bar byed pa dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis gdul bya rnams byang chub las phyir mi ldog par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ba spu'i sgo nas 'od zer rab tu dgye bar mdzad de sogs so// gsum pa ni/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od gang yin pa la sogs so// bzhi pa ni/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste zhes sogs te/ stong gsum khyab pa'i ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rtse la pad+ma la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pas sems can gyi don byed do// de'ang chos ston pa'i ltas su ljags las 'od zer 'byung*/ byang sems rnams skyon med par 'jug pa'i ltas su pad+ma 'byung*/ de dag sangs rgyas nas chos ston pa'i ltas su sangs rgyas kyi chos ston pa (83) 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa la/ rgyu mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ 'bras bu zhing sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin mthu ldan 'jigs pa med pa ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag ste zhes so// gnyis pa la/ snod dang bcud kyi zhing sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ de lta bu'i gzugs kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do// ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams 'di rnam par 'gyur pa drug tu g.yos so// zhes sogs te/

de la phyogs gcig ldeg pa/ g.yo ba/ shing ljon pa ltar thams cad 'gul ba/ mgal me ltar 'khor bas ldeg pa/ sgra skad ring du 'byung ba chem chem/ rnam par 'khrugs pas 'khrugs 'khrugs/ sgra ber ber po ni/ 'ur 'ur po/ re re la che 'bring gsum gyis ltas bco brgyad du 'gyur ro// yang na/ sa ni/ g.yos/ shing 'gul/ ri ldeg lha'i rnga po che chem chem/ rgya mtsho 'khrugs/ 'brug 'ur 'ur ro// gnyis pa ni/ mtho ris dang*/ mtho ris nyes pa med pa dang*/ spyod pa dag pa dang*/ bsam pa khyad par can dang*/ bde ldan dang*/ shes ldan la dgod pa drug go /dang po ni/ de nas de'i tshe skad cig yud tsam thang gcig de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams 'di na mi khom pa thams cad zad par 'gyur to// zhes so// de bzhin du gnyis pa ni/ dmus long ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang mig gis gzugs mthong bar gyur to// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba mi dge ba ma spangs pa rnams kyis kyang de dag spangs par gyur to// bzhi pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la dper na pha ma dang*/ phu nu dang*/ (84) sring mo dang*/ mdza' bo dang*/ gnyen dang*/ grogs po dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyis phan tshun sems mnyam pa nyid du gyur to// lnga pa ni/ dper na/ dge slong bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba de lta bu'i bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur te// drug pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis/ dul ba ni/ legs so// zhi ba ni legs so// yang dag par sdom pa ni/ legs so// yun ring du tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa ni/ legs so// srog chags su gyur pa rnams la mi 'tshe ba ni legs so// zhes ched du brjod pas ched du brjod par gyur to// zhes so// de'ang thub pas sngon dul ba la sogs pa la bslab pa'i dbang gis da ltar gdul bya rnams kyi mi khom pa la sogs pa spangs nas yum la spyod pa'i skal ba can du gyur pa ngo mtshar zhes brjod pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/

sprul pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul lo// dang po la/ sprul skus gzhan zil gyis mnan/ rang bzhin gyi skus zhum pa bsal/ de lha dang mis mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs pas/ gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa 'di zil gyis mnan te bzhugs nas 'od dang sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nge'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi rang bzhin gyi sku ji 'dra ba de bzhin du bstan no// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na lha gang ji snyed yod pa zhes pa nas mchod pa byed par gyur to'i bar te/ lha mi rnams kyis lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang me tog rnams mdun du gtor/ phyogs bzhir mngon par gtor/ phyogs bcur rgya cher mngon par gtor ba'o// gnyis pa la/ de byin (85) gyis brlabs pa dang sku mnyam du bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ba dan de dag kyang de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyi rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog la sogs pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams tsam du red de gnas pa gyur to// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams kyi mi thams cad dang lha thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo// zhes so// gsum pa la/ lo ka'i khams bstan pa dang*/ 'khor bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas dang chos la brnyas pa spang ba dang*/ zhing gzhan na gnas pa 'khor du bsdu ba la sogs pa'i don du zhing 'di dang zhing gzhan phan tshun snang bar byas pa ste/

de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes pa nas mthong bar gyur to'i bar ro// gnyis pa la/ ltas kyi rgyu zhus pa bstan pa dang*/ zhus pa gnang ba dang*/ gsum bsgrubs nas 'khod pa'o// dang po la/ zhus pa dang bstan pa gnyis las/ zhus pa ni/ 'di nas shar phyogs logs su zhes pa nas rkyen ci lags zhes pa'i bar te/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa ni/ srog dbang gi rgyud kyis bzhugs so// sku las byung ba'i snyun med pas 'tshe'o// glo bur gyi snyun med pas skyong ba'am/ yang na sku gsum dang sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di nas nub phyogs zhes pa nas 'di 'dra ba de ni/ de'i mthu yin no'i bar ro// gnyis pa la/ 'gro bar zhu ba dang*/ gnang ba spyin pa'o// dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas bdag kyang blta ba'i slad du mchi'o zhes ba'i bar du ste/ bla ma la ma zhus par 'gro ba mi rigs pas zhus pa'o// gzhon nur

(86) gyur pa ni/ tshangs spyod kyis phye ba sems dang po bskyed pa yan chad dang*/ sas phye ba sa brgyad pa yan chad de/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ 'gro bar gnang ba ni/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis de ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song zhig ces pa'o// skyes gnang ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur te'i bar te/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog med pa dang*/ chos la gus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mang por shes pa sogs kyi don du yin no// 'phrin gnang ba ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nas smros shig gi bar ro// gdams ngag gnang ba ni/ rigs kyi bu/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig nas der nyams par gyur ta re'i bar te/ zhing de na nyon mongs dang dus dang tshe dang lta ba dang sems can gyi snyigs ma ste/ lnga yod pas ma nyams par gyis shig go /bsten par dka' ba ni/ zhing la smad kyi/ byang sems la smad pa ma yin no// gsum pa ni/ de nas byang sems zhes pa nas byang chub tu nges par gyur to'i bar ro// byang sems 'khor mang po dang bcas pas bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod nas rang rang gi gnas su 'khod de snyun gsol zhing pad+ma phul ba dang*/ thub pas zhing ma dag par 'khrungs kyang de'i nyes pas ma gos par bstan pa dang*/ chos la mchod pa'i phyir pad+ma skyes lan du gtor bas pad+ma la de bzhin gshegs pa re bzhugs nas chos ston par byung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ snod dag cing 'khor 'dus par gzigs pa ste/ de nas skad cig nas byang sems chen po gzhon nur gyur pa rnams kyang 'dus par gzigs par gyur to'i bar ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyas pa la dad pa la brgyad/ bar pa la dad pa la drug bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du dbye ba'o// dang po la/ bsdus don lus rnam gzhag tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis so// dang po la bzhi ste/ dgos pa bstan pas mtshams sbyar/ dgos ldan

(87) lus bshad/ bshad pa'i bsdus don bstan/ ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la/ gsungs te zhes drang ngo*// dus nam gyi tshe na/ sngar bshad pa de dang 'brel pa dang*/ sogs pa brjod bya la sogs pa bsnyad pa ste/ bshad zin nas de'i rjes su'o// gang na/ sher phyin gyi lus rnam gzhag go /yum ni/ brjod bya mngon rtogs brgyad dang rjod byed skabs brgyad do// lus ni/ rjod byed tshig gi lus dang*/ brjod bya don gyi lus so// de'ang tshig don gyi yan lag du ma 'dus pa'am/ cha shas du ma bsags pa'am/ yan lag la khyab par byed/ rten byed pas lus so// gang gis na/ tshig le'ur byas pa bco lngas so// ji ltar na/ dang po gnyis kyis mdor bstan dang*/ lhag ma bcu gsum gyis rgyas par bstan pas so// dgos pa ci'i don du na/ dkyus sa bstan pa'i rta thogs med du rgyug nus pa ltar/ gdul bya nyan pa po rnams kyis yan lag rgyas bshad rnams ma 'khrugs par bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dkyus sa mthong ba'i kha lo pa sems stobs che zhing rta tshar gcod nus pa ltar/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyis bstan bcos kyi don lus rnam gzhag mdo tsam du rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang 'chad pa po rnams kyis bshad par bya sla ba'i don te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ bstan bcos ma 'dzings shing ma 'khrugs par rtogs par 'gyur pa nyid kyis so// dgos pa de gnyis gzigs nas gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ lus mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ yum dngos brgyad kyis bshad par bstan/ 'chad byed dngos brgyad gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la/ bshad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ lam dang 'bras bu'i sher phyin ni'o// gang gis na/ dngos po brgyad kyis so// 'o na/ dngos po dang mngon rtogs dang skabs brgyad la khyad yod dam med ce na/ 'bres/ mkhyen gsum (88) mngon rtogs min zhes pa dang*/ shān+tis/ chos sku mngon rtogs btags pa ba'o// zhes pa mi 'thad de/

'phags pas/ thams cad shes pa nyid dang lam shes pa nyid dang rnam mkhyen nyid kyis mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang*/ 'grel chen las/ shes phyin gyi don bsdus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad mdor bsdus pa'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// des na dngos po brgyad ni/ tshig gi don mngon rtogs brgyad yin la/ skabs brgyad ni/ le'u brgyad de/ de'i rjod byed yin no// de la ji ltar na/ yang dag par te/ don ma lus par bshad do// mdo ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bkal stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la zhes pa nas sems can tshad med pa dag gis bla med byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to'i bar rab 'byor gyi le'us rnam mkhyen bshad/ de'i tshe yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams 'di na rgyal po chen po ji snyed yod pa zhes pa nas lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyi phyir rab 'byor 'di ni/ byang sems kyi yum mo'i bar mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'us lam shes bshad/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems kyi yum ni/ tshu rol gyi mthar ma lags zhes pa nas su yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ma mchis so'i bar spyod pa khyad par gyi le'us gzhi shes bshad/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das/ 'di lta ste/ yum ni/ ma mchis pa'i phar phyin no// zhes pa nas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i lo kas mi 'phrog pa yin no'i bar de bzhin nyid kyi le'us rnam kun bshad/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor/ gal te byang sems kyi rmi lam na yang zhes pa nas sems can rnams kyang phung po gsum (89) du lung bstan to'i bar bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'us rtse sbyor bshad/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das/

de lta de ltar byang sems chen po chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid la bsam gtan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas na zhes pa nas bdud kyi rigs kyis tshugs par dka' ba yin no'i bar rim gyis 'jug pa la bslab pa'i le'us mthar gyis pa bshad/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe ji ltar sems bskyed pa gcig gis phar phyin drug yongs su 'dzin pa la sogs zhes pa nas mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis yum la bslab par bya'o 'i bar bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'us skad cig ma bstan/ rab 'byor/ gzhan yang zag pa med pa'i chos rmi lam lta bu zhes pa nas stong pa nyid ces bya ba lta yod par 'gyur re skan gyi bar bslab pa'i 'bras bu'i le'us chos sku bshad do// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos brgyad so so'i don dang*/ nges pa bsam pa'o// dang po la brgyad las/ rnam mkhyen la dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la/ 'dul dkar ni/ rnam pa skye med mngon sum du rtogs pa'am/ dkar chung ring mo dang zhang ston e pa/ skye med rtogs tsam mo// zhe na/ slob lam na chos can/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa yod par thal/ rnam pa skye med mngon sum du rtogs pa'am skye med rtogs tsam yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ 'dod pa yin te/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gcig gi rgyud la mkhyen pa gsum ga mtshan nyid pa yod pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ slob lam na chos can/ yang (90) dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du byas shing bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba spangs pa yod par thal/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ 'phags pas/ rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pa dang yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa dang bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba spangs pa'i 'bras bu can yin no// zhes pas so// 'dod na/

slob lam par 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi/ ngo bo/ sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa don gnyis mthar thug pa'o// de la gzhan don/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ rang don/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du byas pa'o// sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob// rin chen snod ni phye ba ltar// sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag bstan// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa dang rtags dang mtshan ma ma lus pa kun ji lta ji snyed par mngon sum gyis mkhyen pa nyid do// mdo las/ rab 'byor/ rnam pa gang dag sogs so// gsum pa ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i mnyam gzhag dang*/ chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rjes thob gnyis yin te/ bden gnyis las/ gang tshe shes dang shes bya dag /bdag nyid rjes su mi mthong ba// de tshe mtshan ma mi 'byung phyir// gnas pa brtan phyir mi bzhengs so// zhes pa dang*/ brtags pa'i don gyis dben pa yi// ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na// brten te skyes pa thams cad ni// thams cad mkhyen pas mngon sum gzigs// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ sangs rgyas la ye shes yod med dang*/ snang bcas yod med dang*/ skabs don ngo bo gtan la dbab pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ zla grags kyis chos kyi sku rnam pa thams cad du sems dang (91) sems las byung ba rnams 'gog pa la de'i yul rnams 'jug pa med pa'i phyir lus kho nas mngon sum du byed pa kun rdzob tu rnam par bzhag la/ lus gang gis chos kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du byed pa de yang zhi ba'i rang bzhin du 'dod de/ sems dang sems las byung ba dang bral ba'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rgyun mtha'i rjes su de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur nas rang snang la ye shes med do// sku dang ye shes kyi rnam gzhag thams cad gzhan snang la yin no zhes dza ya ā nan+ta la sogs pa/

smra'o// de la chos bshes kyis dgag pa brjod pa/ de bzhin nyid chos can/ chos can la gtan ma brten pa yod par thal/ bem rig gang la'ang ma brten pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dgongs 'grel las/ gal te don dam pa'i bden pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa las gzhan yin na/ de'i tshe don dam pa chos rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid du mi 'gyur zhing*/ don dam pa de mthong bas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyon mongs pa spong bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i skyon 'byung chos bshes kyi thugs bsam/ ngo*// yang sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang de la khyad yod na/ chos nyid cha shas gnyis su 'gyur la/ med na/ sangs rgyas dang sems can khyad med par 'gyur ro// glo bur gyi dri mas dag pa'i khyad yod ce na/ ye shes med na/ dri mas dag par gang gis bzhag des na/ don dam par ye shes med la kun rdzob tu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu yod ces pa ni/ slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa'o// gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas la kun rdzob snang bcas kyi ye shes mnga' 'am/ mi mnga' zhe na/ kha cig na zhi lha/ re/ kun rdzob snang ba la 'khrul pas khyab pas snang bcas kyi ye shes med la/ don dam pa cir yang ma grub pa la cir yang mi mthong ba nyid don dam pa mthong ba'i ye shes yin cing*/ (92) de yod do// sems can gyi don byed pa ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'am nam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong ltar sngon gyi smon lam la sogs pa'i rten 'brel las byung bar smra'o// de legs na'ang slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun te/ sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag nyid du snang ba'i blo zhes pas so// des na/ chos can ji snyed pa sgro btags pa dang bral ba'i sgyu ma lta bu lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar gsal bar mkhyen te/ de bzhin shes bya thams cad la// sangs rgyas ye shes gcig car snang*// zhes pas so// de lta na'ang 'khrul par mi 'gyur te/

bskal pa mang por gnyen po bsgoms pas sgrib gnyis kyi sa bon spangs shing phyin ci log tu zhen pa med pa'i phyir ro// spyod 'jug tu/ ji ltar mthong thos shes pa dag /'dir ni dgag par bya min te// 'dir ni sdug bsngal rgyur 1$0000220dpal sbas/ dul lha/ rngog lo la sogs sangs rgyas 'khrul bcas su 'dod pa yod kyang*/ rang lugs kyis/ tshad nad can gyi sems can mngon shes can gyis bltas pa bzhin/ 1$0000270gyur pa// bden par rtog pa bzlog bya yin// zhes so// gal te ji snyed pa ma mkhyen na/ rnam mkhyen du mi 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni/ nyan thos pa bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug shes pa la 'dod kyang*/ 'dir chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid la dmigs pa/ bdag po rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa mang du bsgoms pa'i dran pa la brten pa/ rnam pa dngos po 'gag pa'i zhi ba min par rang bzhin gyis zhi ba'i ye shes mthar thug ste/ mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di'i dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med pa'o// bdag po ni/ dran pa'o// rnam pa ni/ zhi ba ste/ mtshan nyid med pa'o// zhes so// sgrib pa spangs pa'i gzhi la 'dod pa dang*/ shes bya'i gnas bcu mkhyen pa la 'dod pa'ang 'dir 'dus so// lnga pa ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod de/ mdo las/ rnam mkhyen nyid (93) ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yin no// zhes pa dang*/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// ces so// rjes mthun pa byang sems kyi lam bzhi dang*/ nyan rang la'ang yod de/ lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun pa// sum cu bdun dang sum cu bzhi// zhes so// mtshan nyid pa med de/ mdo las/ ji srid du rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob par ma gyur gyi bar du rnam mkhyen nyid thob par mi byed do// zhes pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du yang ma yin no// zhes so// gsum pa la/

mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ ngo bo/ sa mtshams la rtsod spang dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos sku chos can/ rnam mkhyen du thal/ chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa don gnyis mthar thug pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ khyed 'jig pa mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod pa la/ byas pa chos can/ mi rtag par thal zhes mgo mtshungs bya'o// gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas la rjes thob yod na/ thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ mnyam gzhag dang ngo bo tha dad pa'i rjes thob med pa la dgongs te/ sangs rgyas sa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab/ rjes thob shes bya thams cad la 'jug pa'i ye shes/ de gnyis ka'i rten sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par grol ba'i dbyings dang gsum po ngo bo tha dad med par yod de/ rgyud blar/ shes rab ye shes rnam grol rnams// gsal dang 'phro dang dag phyir dang*// tha dad med phyir 'od dang zer// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang mtshungs// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes don dam du med na/ mdo las/ gcig kho na don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ ma rmongs pa'i chos can gyi mya ngan las 'das pa'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ mdo de ni/ gzhug pa la ldem

(94) dgongs yin gyi/ nges don min no// mdo las/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ rmi lam lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu ste/ ci ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa las ches lhag pa'i chos 'ga' zhig yod na/ de'ang sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu'o zhes nga smra'o// zhes gsungs pas so// gal te gnyis med kyi ye shes don dam du med na/ chad ltar 'gyur ro// zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ kun rdzob tu rten 'brel ji ltar snang ba tsam zhig khas len pa'i phyir dang*/ don dam par yod med gang yang mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro// gal te yod pa bkag na/ med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ 'o na/ med pa bkag pas yod par yang ci'i phyir mi 'gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ slob lam na chos can/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa med par thal/ rnam mkhyen med pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi sgra bshad du rung gi mtshan nyid du mi rung bas so// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// zhes sogs slob lam na rnam mkhyen yod par bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ rjes mthun pa yod pa la dgongs te/ stobs sogs yod par bshad pa bzhin no// thub dgongs su/ rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ dngos sangs rgyas yin la/ de ni/ skyes bu'i don gyi mchog go /de kho na brgyad pa chos sku'i mngon rtogs te/ gang gi phyir mngon rtogs bdun rnams kyis mngon sum par rtogs par bya zhing thob par bya bas so// de'i don nyid kyi phyir de'i lam ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid btags pa ba ste/ mngon rtogs bdun gyi bdag nyid do// zhes so// gnyis pa lam shes la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lam thams cad rang bzhin med par mngon sum gyis rtogs pa yin la/ dbye na/ byang sems kyi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gnyis yin no// zhe na/ (95) sangs rgyas chos can/

yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ma byas par thal/ lam shes mtshan nyid pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ 'phags pas/ lam shes pa nyid ni/ theg pa ji lta ba bzhin du nges par 'byung ba dang*/ de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa'i rten can zhes so// 'dod na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa dang zhes pa dang 'gal lo// lam shes mtshan nyid pa chos can/ byang sems kho na'i mngon rtogs min par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi'ang mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'grel chen las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kho na'i chos nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong min pa lam shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid do zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du shes shing*/ smin rdzogs ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'o// 'phags pas/ lam shes pa nyid kyis ni/ gnyen po ma lus pa yang dag par 'grub par byed do// zhes so// lam shes pa nyid ni/ theg pa thams cad kyis nges par 'byung ba dang sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad rang bzhin med par mngon sum du shes pa/ lam thams cad kyi bya ba byed pa nyid do// nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang sogs so// gsum pa la/ thun mong gi dbye ba dang*/ phye ba'i sa mtshams so// dang po la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi lam shes tsam mo// dbye ngo mtshan nyid pa dang*/ btags pa ba gnyis so// mtshan nyid pa la yang ji lta ba mkhyen pa mnyam gzhag dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa rjes thob gnyis so// mnyam gzhag la/ spyir lo ka pa'i mnyam gzhag bsam gtan sogs dang*/ lo ka las 'das pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa gnyis so// rjes thob la/ bsam (96) gtan las langs pa'i 'dod sems sogs lo ka pa'i rjes thob/ lo ka las 'das pa'i mnyam gzhag gi dmigs rnam ma brjed par dran pas zin pa mnyam gzhag gis zin pa'i rjes thob/

mnyam gzhag gi dmigs rnam brjed pa'i dus kyi rjes thob rgya yan pa/ sangs rgyas sa'i ji snyed pa mkhyen pa sogs mnyam gzhag dang ngo bo gcig pa'i rjes thob/ tha mal gyi dbang shes sogs mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis ka min pa'o// lo ka pa'i mnyam gzhag kha cig dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang lo ka las 'das pa'i rjes thob ste/ mngon 'grel las/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ni/ lo ka las 'das pa ste/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi rjes la thob pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// mnyam gzhag ye shes kyis zin pa'i rjes thob dag pa lo ka pa'i ye shes ni/ lam shes mtshan nyid pa yin no// tha dad ni/ mtshan btags gnyis ngo bo mi gcig la mnyam rjes kyang phal cher tha dad de/ theg bsdus su/ rnam rtog med pa'i shes de ni// nam mkha' bzhin du shes par bya// de la gzugs ni snang ba ltar// de rjes thob pa'i shes de 'dra// zhes so// grangs nges ni/ lam shes su brjod tsam la mtshan nyid dang ldan mi ldan gnyis yod pas/ mtshan btags gnyis su nges la/ mtshan nyid pa la yang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i spangs pa dang rtogs pa sgrub byed mnyam rjes gnyis su nges so// rgyud blar/ chu mtsho sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs// glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni// mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyi// 'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa// de ni rjes la thob pa yi// ye shes 'bras bu yin par bstan// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lam shes mtshan nyid pa mthong lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// zhes pa dang*/ skad cig ma'i mdor/ lam gyi shes pa nyid la spyod cing chos (97) thams cad kyi yongs su rdzogs pa thob nas rnam mkhyen nyid rjes su thob par byed do// zhes so// sangs rgyas la med de/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du byas pas so// tshogs sbyor na med de/

lam bden mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir ro// btags pa ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang*/ tshogs sbyor dang*/ nyan rang la'ang yod de/ lam skye med du rtogs tsam yod pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ sbyor bzhi dang gnyen po gzhi shes lam shes su thal zhe na/ khyed la'ang rnam mkhyen chos skur thal zhes bsgre'o// mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ lam shes mtshan nyid pa min par thal/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du shes pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs lam shes kyis bsdus par bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ ye shes kyis zin pa'i snyoms 'jug la zer na/ rtags ma grub/ ma zin pa'i snyoms 'jug la zer na/ 'dod pa yin no// lung dang mi 'gal te/ byang sems kyi lo ka las 'das pa'i mngon rtogs rnams lam shes mtshan nyid pas bsdus/ byang sems kyi lo ka pa'i mngon rtogs rnams lam shes rjes mthun pas bsdus par bshad pa yin no// sa brgyad yan chad na chos can/ rjes thob yod par thal/ chos sku'i rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyud blar/ bya ba sgrub la rtag tu blo// me bzhin du ni 'bar ba dang*// zhi ba'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug la// rtag tu snyoms par zhugs pa yin// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ 'dod pa yin te/ de nyid las/ shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos// thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni// sems can thams cad la yod pa// mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid// ces ji snyed pa mkhyen par bshad pas so// lung snga ma ni/ mnyam gzhag gi ye shes kyis ma zin pa'i rjes thob med pa la dgongs so// tshogs sbyor (98) na lam med na/ myang 'das su phyin byed med par thal zhing*/ sa yang med par mtshungs so// zhe na/ myang 'das su phyin byed tsam gyis lam bden mtshan nyid par sgrub mi nus te/ tshogs sbyor na/ nges 'byin dang rigs pa mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir/ gal te lam bden mtshan nyid pa yod na/

thar pa dang nges 'byed mtshan nyid pa yod par mtshungs so// 'o na/ thar pa dang nges 'byed cha mthun du bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la lam yang med/ lam rnam par 'god pa yang med na/ lam gyi 'bras bu lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa'i mdo dang 'gal lo// skyon med de/ 'phags pa'i lam med pa la dgongs so// zhe na/ 'dir yang 'phags pa'i thar pa dang nges 'byed med pa la dgongs zhes mtshungs so// sa yang mtshan nyid pa med pa 'dod pa yin te/ dad sogs sa la 'jug pa ste/ zhes pa dang*/ blo ldan ma zhugs zhugs pa dang*/ zhes so// rjes mthun pa med na/ sa thob pa ni mos pa dang*// spyod pa dag la 'jug pa dang*// rtogs pa'i phyir na sa rnams ni// 'grub pa'i sgo nas rnam pa bzhi// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gsum pa gzhi shes la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la gnyis te/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med shes pa yod med dpyad/ skabs don gzhi shes la log par rtog pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ klu sgrub dang*/ zla grags la sogs pas nyan rang la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa yod de/ sa bcu pa las/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di mi rtog rtag tu 'dug /sa 'di rgyal ba nyan thos rang rgyal kun gyi ste// des ni 'jig rten dag tu stobs bcur mi brjod de// zhes pas so// chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa med na/ phung po don dam du bzung nas de mi rtag la sogs par bsgoms pas bdag lta lhan skyes spang mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon gyur (99) spangs kyang lo ka pa'i chags bral ltar slar ldog pa'i phyir ro// klu sgrub kyis/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod// ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te// de las yang ni skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs par// khyod kyis thar pa med par gsungs// zhes so// spyod 'jug tu/ bstan rtsa dge slong nyid yin na// dge slong nyid kyang dka' bar gnas// sems ni dmigs pa bcas rnams kyis// mya ngan 'das pa dka' bar gnas// zhes so// de lta min na/
