sa dang po pas blo'i stobs kyis zil gyis non par 'gyur te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ sa bcu par/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa'i bdag nyid chen pos zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang bzhin gyi blo'i rnam par dpyod pa'i stobs kyis ni ma yin no// zhes pas bsal lo// 'on kyang chos kyi bdag med yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa med pas shes sgrib mi spong la/ thabs mkhas med pas shes rab yod kyang byang sems su mi 'gyur te/ klu sgrub kyis/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes so// gang zag gi bdag med tsam bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa spong bar bshad pa ni/ drang don yin te/ dge slong dag khur yang yod/ khur 'khyer ba'ang yod de zhes pa'i mdo lta bu'o// zhes zer ro// 'dir byams pas nyan rang la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa med par bshad de/ rgyud blar/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa rnams kyis rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pas ni mthong ba med// ces pa'i 'grel par/ gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni/ de bzhin (100) gshegs pa'i snying po mthong ba la mig dang mi ldan par rnam par gzhag ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ so so'i skye bo dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang sems te/ zhes so// 'dir yang*/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes sogs mang du gsal bar gsungs la/ sems bskyed med pa la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa med de/ cher 'os sems bskyed spangs pa'i skye bo dag /gzhan don sems dang de yi thabs rnyed dang*// dgongs chen don dang de nyid mchog mthong ba'i// bde ba de spangs zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes so// sdud par/

thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes sogs yum gyi mdo du ma nas gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir phyogs snga ma btang snyoms su bzhag la spyir btang du 'di khas blang ngo*// dmigs bsal byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang du ltung ba la de yod do// gnyis pa la/ kha cig na re/ gzhi rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ dbye na/ nyan rang gi dang*/ byang sems kyi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dang gsum mo// zhe na/ mtshan 'dzin gzhi shes chos can/ gzhi shes min par thal/ gzhi rang bzhin med rtogs min pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa yin te/ gzhi shes su bshad pa drang don yin gyi/ nges don la nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod do// zhe na/ nyan thos dgra bcom chos can/ shes sgrib spangs par thal/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mi slob pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ mdo las/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med pa mthong bas rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// shes bya'i sgrib pa ni/ chos kyi bdag med pa mthong bas rnam par dag par 'gyur/ zhes pas so// sangs rgyas chos can/ spang bya dang bcas par thal/ skabs gsum pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa yod pa'i phyir/ (101) khyab pa med na/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ 'di man chad ni/ byang chub gzhan shes par byas nas spang bar bya dgos pas thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid ces pa dang 'gal lo// byang sems kyi mngon rtogs chos can/ lam shes kyis bsdus pas ma khyab par thal/ lam shes su ma 'dus pa'i gzhi shes kyang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'phags pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag dang*/ byang sems dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin thams cad shes pa nyid dang lam shes nyid dang rnam mkhyen nyid kyis mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// de bzhin du sangs rgyas la'ang brjod do// gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang*/

mtshon bya dang*/ mtshan gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhi bdag med mngon sum gyis rtogs pa gang zhig spangs rtogs nyi tshe bar gyur pa'o// de la spangs pa nyi tshe ba ni/ nyon sgrib tsam mam gzung rtog gi gnyen po ste/ 'phags pas/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis ni/ nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa tsam sel bar byed ces pa dang*/ 'bras bu bdag tu rmongs pa spangs pa can yin no// zhes so// rtogs pa nyi tshe ba ni/ thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba'am/ khyab pa'i stong nyid ma rtogs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi phung po khams dang skye med thams cad mi rtag pa sogs su'am/ bdag phyed dang gnyis kyi stong par shes pa nyid do// mdo las/ rab 'byor/ thams cad ces bya ba ni sogs so// gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba gnyis so// de gnyis kyi sa mtshams la/ slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel du sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar gzhi shes lam shes mtshan nyid par bzhag pa dang*/ a bh+yas/ sems bskyed dang po lnga gzhi shes mtshan nyid par bshad pa ni/ 'thad par ma mthong ste/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ mthong lam (102) du thams cad shes pa nyid la shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' ba min par thal/ gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa sa bdun pa'i bar na yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdo las/ thams cad shes pa nyid la shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' bar 'dod pas yum la bslab par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pas/ mthong bas 'da' ba ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dag la ste/ de la byang sems kyi sgom pa'i lam med pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// sa brgyad yan chad na lam shes med na/ sngar gyi lung rnams dang 'gal zhing*/ thogs med kyis/ byang sems kyis mi g.yo ba la rnam par mi rtog pa skyon med pa rgyun mi chad par rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i lam shes pa la brten nas shes pa dang 'gal te/ zhar la byung bas chog go /gnyis pa la'ang dkon mchog sprin las/ mos pa spyod pa'i sar byang sems nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las 'da' bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// des na/

gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa nyan rang 'phags pa kho na la yod de/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces pa dang*/ thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// zhes so// btags pa ba ni/ theg chen lam lnga dang nyan rang tshogs sbyor na'ang yod de/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa yod pas so// gsum pa ni/ byang sems kyi gnyen po gzhi shes gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa min par thal zhe na/ 'dod pa yin te/ spang bya'i ming gis btags pa ste/ 'dod khams kyi lam bden bzhin no// nyan thos la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa med na/ sngar gyi lung dang 'gal zhe na/ de ni/ lugs gzhan yin pa'am/ yang na dgongs pa can te/ thub dgongs su/ sa bcu par bshad pa ni/ gzhan du yang 'thad de/ skad cig tsam bdag med par shes pa yang lo ka'i 'dod

(103) chags dang bral ba dang*/ phyi rol pa rnams las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir dang*/ bag la nyal spong ba ni/ bdag gi bdag med par rtogs pa las kyang 'gyur ro// rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa rnams kyang kha cig skad cig ma'i bdag med dang*/ kha cig chos kyi bdag med du sbyor te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi rigs rnams kyi thun mong du gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// zhes drangs pas so// bzhi pa rnam kun la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel du rnam kun sa brgyad pa na yod do// zhe na/ rnam kun gyi mthong lam la gnas pa chos can/ nyan rang du ltung mi srid par thal/ sa brgyad pa thob pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'phags pas/ duḥkha la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa'i skad cig la ni rjes su shes pa dang 'brel bas nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltung ba srid de/ de ni khams gsum pa'i gnyen por 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gzhan yang*/ gal ba mang po yod mod kyi/ mang bas 'jigs pas mi bri'o// kha cig na re/ rgyun mtha' na rnam kun med do// zhe na/ rgyun mtha' na chos can/ zhing dag sbyor med par thal/ rnam kun med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis/ zhing dag pa ni/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir 'dir smos sbyor ba ni/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus te sgom pa yin la/ bye brag rnam kun ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gang zhig dbang du bya ba'i phyir sgom pa ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa ni/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam pa ste/ bye brag kun te/ mkhyen gsum ma lus pa'i rnam pa (104) mngon du phyogs pas yongs su rdzogs pa'am/

yang dag par rtogs pa ste/ bsgoms pas shes pa'o// dbye ba ni/ lam bzhi'am/ nyi shu'o// de'i sa mtshams ni/ tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de/ thar pa cha mthun dang*/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs dka'i sbyor ba tshogs lam na yod la/ zhing dag pa/ srid zhi mnyam nyid dag pa/ mthar thug pa'i sbyor ba rnams rgyun mtha' na'ang yod do// 'dir a bh+yas/ rnam kun mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba gnyis las/ chos sku ni/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa mtshan nyid pa/ de'i lam ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ste/ btags pa bar bzhed do// rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa btags pa ba ni/ sbyor ba ste/ mtshan nyid pa ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid chos sku'i nang du 'dus pa srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid kyi bdag nyid 'bras bu kho na'o// zhes gsungs pa ni/ mdo gzhan dang mthun te/ dgongs 'grel las/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo spangs pa las shes bya la ma chags ma thogs pa rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa nye bar bzung nas bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sar brjod ces so// gsum pa la/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba slob lam na yod na/ 'phags pa dang 'grel chen nas/ mi slob pa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ba'i phyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa mnyam pa nyid brjod par bya ba zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ srid zhi mnyam nyid mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas la yod/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba slob lam na yod pa mi 'gal te/ sangs rgyas nyid thob par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan zhes 'byung bas so// sa brgyad pa yan chad na chos can/ 'bad pa yod par thal/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir sgom pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyud blar/ sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang dang ni// rnam rtog thams cad bral ba'i phyir// (105) de ni lus can smin pa yi// don du 'bad pa byed ma yin// zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/

'dod pa yin te/ sa bcu'i sa brgyad par/ 'dir ni bde gshegs dbang bskur bzod pa dam pa ste// nged kyi ye shes stobs yangs sangs rgyas chos kyi rnams// de dag khyed la med kyi de la brtson 'grus rtsoms// zhes pa dang*/ rmi lam bstan pa las/ sa brgyad pa la mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa la rtsol ba dang bcas so// dgu pa la spyod pa la rtsol ba dang bcas so// bcu pa la tshad med pa la rtsol ba dang bcas so// zhes so// lung de ni/ sa bcu par gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung bar bshad pa yin la/ sa brgyad par rtsol bral du bshad pa rnams kyang mtshan ma yod med kyi rtsol bral lam/ rtsol ba chung ba la dgongs so// tshogs sbyor na chos can/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom med par thal/ bsdu bya mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ khyab pa med de/ mkhyen gsum rgyu 'bras blang dor du thos bsam gyis legs par shes nas thos bsam mi brtan zhing dbang du ma gyur pas dbang thob pa'i bsgoms byung bskyed pa'i phyir yul gzhi lam rnam pa dang*/ yul can mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom pa la mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom du brjod kyi/ mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid pa bsdus pa'o zhes mi smra'o// rnam kun chos can/ rtse sbyor gyi ched du sgom pas ma khyab par thal/ rgyun mtha' na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rab ces pa dang 'gal zhe na/ 'dod pa yin yang lung dang mi 'gal te/ gtso che ba la dgongs so// de lta min na/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi rjes la'ang mthar gyis pa skye bar mtshungs te/ de yi go rim dang zhes pas so// lnga pa rtse sbyor la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos bshes dang sdud 'grel gyis/ rtse sbyor sa dgu pa dang bcu (106) pas bsdus so// zhe na/ brtan pa la gnas pa chos can/ myang 'das su ltung ba spang mi dgos par thal/ sa dgu pa thob pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ 'phags pas/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i gnas skabs su mya ngan las 'das par ltung ba spang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa dang 'gal lo// mthong lam rtse sbyor chos can/ mthong spang rtog pa brgya rtsa spong ba'i gnyen po min par thal/ sa dgu pa na yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgom spang rtog pa brgya rtsa'i gnyen por thal lo// 'dod na/ de spong ba la sgom lam rtse sbyor don med par thal lo// a bh+ya dang*/ 'jam gsar na re/ tshogs lam na rtse sbyor yod do// zhe na/ de mi 'thad de/ tshogs lam na chos can/ 'jug sgrub yod par thal/ rtse sbyor yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa med na/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i bdag nyid rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes bya rab kyi sbyor ba'o// zhes pa dang 'gal la/ sangs rgyas dang*/ rje btsun dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ slob dpon la sogs pas ma bshad pa'i phyir su zhig de la yid ches par 'gyur/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'o// de rab ces pa dang*/ 'phags pas/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rab tu gyur pa dang ldan pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gyi rtogs pa/ rnam kun las rtse mo ste/ rab kyi mthar phyin pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bdun yod la/ sa mtshams drod nas rgyun ma'i bar na yod de/ rtags ni/ drod yin la/ bar chad med rtse ni/ rgyun mtha' na yod pa'i phyir ro// tshogs lam na med de/ de na thos bsam gtso che bas bsgoms byung la dbang thob pa med pa'i phyir ro// drod nas yod de/ rmi lam du'ang sgom pa'i phyir te/ rmi lam na'ang chos rnams kun// rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs// zhes pas so// gsum pa la/ rab tu gyur pa de brtan pa thob pa yin nam min/ yin na/ de (107) brtan par bya ba'i phyir mthar gyis pa mi dgos par thal lo// min na/ brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// ces pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/

skyon med de/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom la brtan pa ma thob pa'ang yod pas/ brten byed mthar gyis pa dgos pa'ang yod/ bar chad med rtse lta bu mi dgos pa'ang yod do// lung de ni/ rnam 'phel rab tu gyur pas mkhyen gsum gyi chos yongs su rdzogs par bsngos shing gzhan don gyi bsam pa brtan pa la dgongs so// drug pa mthar gyis pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sdud 'grel du bar chad med lam du thob ces zer la/ chos bshes kyis dga' ldan na gnas pa nas bzung ste bdud btul ba'i bar na yod ces zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'phags pas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rnam pa lnga'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa'o// bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtse sbyor thob pas mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom go rim du sgom pa'o// 'grel chen nas/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa thob pa ni/ so so ba dang bsdus pa nyid du rtogs pa'i don rnams rim par bkod nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir sgom zhes pa dang*/ de yi go rim dang zhes pas so// 'phags pa'i rjes su 'brangs na rtse sbyor thob pas zhes pa dor bya nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ bsdus sgom mthar gyis te/ snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'brel par rim gyis bsgom pa dang ldan pas mthar gyis ba'i mngon rtogs so// gsum pa ni/ bya ba bslab pa sgrub pa gsum mo// sa mtshams ni/ drod nas rgyun ma'i snga logs bar na yod do// rgyun mtha' na med de/ der brtan pa thob pas gcig car sgom pa'i phyir rim sgom med ces gsungs so// tshogs lam na rtse mo ma thob pa'i phyir med do// 'phags pa'i rjes su 'brangs na tshogs lam (108) yan chad na yod de/ 'phags pas/ bgyi ba smos pas ni/ sems bskyed pa gzung ba'i don du'o// bslab pa smos pas ni/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa shes pa'i don du'o// sgrub pa smos pas ni/

mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam shes pa'i don du'o// zhes pas so// 'di shin tu legs te/ mdo las/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste zhes pas so// rgyun mtha' na'ang yod par bzhed par mngon te/ 'phags pas/ rnam mkhyen nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar gyis ni sgom pa'i lam yin zhes pas so// gsum pa la/ tshogs lam na chos can/ mthar gyis pa med par thal/ rtse sbyor ma thob pa'i phyir zhe na/ phyogs dang po ltar na/ 'dod pa yin te/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ sbyor ba'i gnas skabs nas bzung ste rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la thug gi bar mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i lus sgrub pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas so// lung de nyid kyis rgyun mtha' na med pa la gnod do// zhe na/ mi gnod de/ mthar thug gi bar zhes pa/ snga logs tshun chad kyi don yin pas sangs rgyas kyi bar zhes pa bzhin no// phyogs gnyis pa ltar na/ khyab pa med do// bdun pa skad cig ma la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ lo tsā na re/ skad cig ma bzhi po/ sa bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa/ bcu par rim pa bzhin thob ce na/ shān+tis kyang*/ gnas skabs de ni sa brgyad pa la sogs pa'o// zhes bshad pas sa brgyad pa na yod par bzhed do// skad cig sbyor chos can/ bsdus sgom mthar thug pa min par thal/ sa dgu pa man chad na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'phags pas/ skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni/ mthar thug pa'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// skad cig ma gsum par sems can yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas skad cig gcig dang (109) ldan pa'i shes rab kyis rnam mkhyen nyid thob par byed do// zhes pas kyang bsal lo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom mthar thug pa'o// de mtha' zhes pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs yin no// zhes pas so// gnyis pa ni/

sems kyi skad cig ma gcig kho na la byang chub la mngon du phyogs pas chos thams cad rdzogs pa ste/ ma lus pa'am/ yang dag par rtogs pa'am/ byang chub pa ste/ sangs rgyas thob pa'o// gsum pa la/ spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis phye ba bzhi yod cing*/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na na yod de/ 'grel chen nas/ ldog pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bzhir ci zhig ltar bstan zhes pa dang*/ skad cig ma ni/ sems kyi skad cig ma kho nas rnam pa bzhir mngon du byed ces so// gsum pa ni/ skad cig ma gang*/ dus mtha'i skad cig rdul phran gnas 'phos pa'i yun tsam la byed dam/ grub mtha' la grags pa se gol gtogs pa la sum brgya drug cu rtsa brgyad du bgos pa'i cha la byed dam/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma/ skyes bu'i 'dod pa'i don grub pa'i dus skad cig de la bdag gi bya ba rdzogs so// zhes pa lta bu la byed/ dang po gnyis ltar na/ ha cang yang yun thung bas blos nges pa dang sgras brjod par mi nus so// gsum pa ltar na/ dus nges pa med de/ bya ba rdzogs pa'i dus mi shes pas so// zhe na/ phyogs dang po gnyis ltar na'ang nyes pa med de/ dus mtha' gcig tu bden pa med cing rang gi bsam pa'i dbang la rag pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang thob pa rnams kyis skad cig kyang bskal par byin gyis rlob nus pa'i phyir ro// 'dir phyogs gsum pa gzung ste/ bdud btul nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de skad cig sbyor yin la/ de'i dus la gdul bya'i dbang gis nges pa (110) med do// kho bo cag gi ston pas srod la bdud btul ba'i tho rangs sangs rgyas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par shes pa'i ye shes chen pos bdud bcom nas bar bskal bcu nas sangs rgyas pas so// 'o na/ skad cig ma bzhi po gcig car rtogs sam/ rim gyis rtogs/ dang po ltar na/ dang po dang gnyis pa sogs su mi rung la/ gnyis pa ltar na/

skad cig ma gcig par mi rung bzhi par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ gcig car rtogs te/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ de ltar rim gyis phar phyin dag la goms pa las gcig car phar phyin thams cad kyi rang gi ngo bo nyid rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ste zhes so// 'on kyang dang po dang gnyis pa sogs ni/ bshad pa'i grangs kyi rim pa yin gyi/ don gyi skye rim min pas so// gnyis pa ltar yin du chug na'ang nyes pa med de/ byis pa rnams kyi skad cig de/ dbang thob pa'i mang por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// brgyad pa chos sku la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gyi 'bras bu sku phun sum tshogs pa'i pha rol du phyin pa chos sku'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa mi 'thad de/ rang ldog mtshon byas khyad par byas pa'i phyir/ ba lang gi mtshan nyid du ba lang gi nag po sogs bkod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug zag med kyi chos kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'o// de yi rnam smin ni zhes pa dang*/ chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni/ zhes pas so// rgyud blar/ bla med thugs rje che sogs yon tan gyi// pha rol phyin pas rgyal ba bsam mi khyab// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i chos ma lus pa'i yan lag bsags pa'i lus yin pas sku/ yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i rten byed pas sku/ rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i thob bya'am/ rtogs bya'i ngo bo yin

(111) pas sku// 'gro ba thams cad de'i ngo bo las ma 'das pas sku ste/ bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir// yon tan phun tshogs bsam yas phyir// rigs pa'i rjes 'brang ngo bo'i phyir// skyob pa rnams kyi chos skur 'dod// ces so// gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid pa dang*/ rjes mthun pa gnyis so// dang po la/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ sku gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ lngar dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyud blar/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes pas/ chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ de'i rgyu mthun pa gzugs sku'o// de la'ang zab mo byang sems kyi sde snod ston pa longs sku dang*/ chos sna tshogs ston pa sprul sku'o// rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs gnas gyur pas dang po/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs las phyi ma 'byung ste/ rgyud blar/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin// dang pos sku ni dang po ste// gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis// zhes so// yang*/ ye shes dang bsod nams kyi tshogs gnyis las sku gnyis thob ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces pa'am/ chos kyi sku de mdor bsdus na// rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs// zhes so// de la dang po ni/ don dam pa'i sku ste/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa ste/ kun rdzob kyi sku'o// rgyud blar/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni// de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de// bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'o// zhes so// des na/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa mthong na/ sangs rgyas mthong bar brjod kyi/

mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs mthong bas (112) don dam pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ba min te/ rdo rje gcod par/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang dag nga la sgrar rtogs pa// log pas bcom par skyes pa yi// skye bo des ni nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku// chos nyid sangs rgyas blta bar bya// chos nyid rnam par shes pa'ang min// de ni rnam par shes mi nus// zhes so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku gsum yi ngo bo/ rgyu/ rnam gzhag dpyad pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ mtshan nyid lnga dang*/ yon tan lnga dang ldan pa ste/ skye 'jig gnas gsum dang bral bas 'dus ma byas pa/ yon tan gyi chos rnams dbyer med pas tha mi dad pa/ mtha' gnyis spangs pas phyin ci ma log pa/ nyon mongs pa dang snyoms 'jug dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gyi sgrib pa dang bral ba/ rtog pas dmigs bya ma yin pa/ mnyam gzhag so so rang gis rig pa'i yul yin pa gsum/ chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o// yon tan lnga ni/ rgya che ba/ grangs mang ba/ rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa/ thun mong min pa/ sgrib pas dag pa mthar phyin pa ste/ rgyud blar/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med// gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med// chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong*// gzhal med gaṅgā'i bye ma las 'das pa// bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni// bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa rnam spangs pa// zhes so// gnyis pa longs sku ni/ gsung brjod pa dang*/ sku snang ba dang mdzad pa sgrub pa rgyun mi chad pa gsum dang*/ de rnams lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang*/ sku dang gsung dang mdzad pa du mar ston yang de'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ lnga'o// rgyud blar/

sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i sku// 'gro ba'i rnam grol don (113) sgrub la brtson pa// mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te// sna tshogs dngos kyang de yi rang bzhin min// zhes so// gsum pa sprul sku ni/ 'bras bu gsum gyi rgyu ste/ srid pa la skyo ba bskyed nas myang 'das la 'dun par mdzad pa/ nyan thos lam la zhugs pa bzlog nas theg chen gyis smin par byed pa/ byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pas rnam grol thob par brjod pa ste/ gsum gyi rgyu'i gzugs srid pa ji srid pa mkha' la gzugs gnas pa ltar chos sku la rtag tu gnas pa ste/ rgyud blar/ lo ka zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang*// rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs// gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te// nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi rnam pa bzhin// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ phal cher bshad zin la/ gnas gyur pa'i rgyu ni/ kun gzhi/ nyon yid/ 'jug shes gsum ste/ gser 'od las/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa yongs su gyur pa ni/ chos kyi sku'o// kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid yongs su gyur pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o// dngos po la 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa yongs su gyur pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ mnyam pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang*/ rtag pa'i khyad par dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ de dag rten dang dgongs pa dang*// 'phrin las kyis ni mnyam pa nyid// ces pas/ chos sku ni/ rten chos dbyings tha dad med pa dang*/ dgongs pa tha dad med pa dang*/ 'phrin las tha dad med pa'i phyir mnyam pa nyid do// longs sku sprul sku gnyis ni/ dgongs pa dang 'phrin las kyis mnyam pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'phrin las thogs med/ thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir ro// yang na/ dbyig gnyen go rim bzhin sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ longs sku ni/ lo ka'i khams thams cad du 'khor dang*/

zhing dang*/ mtshan dang*/ sku mdog dang*/ chos kyi longs spyod dang*/ mdzad pa drug gis tha (114) dad de/ longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu// 'khor yongs bsdu dang zhing dang mtshan// sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang*// mdzad pa dag gis tha dad do// zhes so// ngo bo nyid ni/ chos nyid kyis mnyam pa/ rtogs dka' bas phra ba/ longs sku dang 'brel bas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur pa yin te/ rang bzhin sku ni mnyam pa dang*// phra zhing de dang 'brel pa dang*// dge rgur longs spyod bstan pa dang*// longs spyod rdzogs 'byor rgyur 'dod do// zhes so// sprul sku ni/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa ste// bzo dang skye dang byang chub che// mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pas// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni// rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi chad// rgyun gyis de dag rtag pa yin// zhes te/ rgyu gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rtag par brjod de/ rgyu mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang*// brtse dang 'phrul dang mkhyen dang phun tshogs dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang*// ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag /ces so// ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ mi 'jig pa'i phyir rtag go /longs sku ni/ thog ma yod kyang tha ma med cing rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir rtag go /sprul sku ni/ mi snang bar byas nas yang dang yang sprul pa ston pas rtag go /gsum pa ni/ sngar gyi chos sku nyid la gnyis su phye ste/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/ glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus kyis kyang dag pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ de ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu ni/ chos sku zhes slob dpon 'di bzhed do// chos sku nyid la cha gnyis su dbye mar mi rigs she na/ skyon yod de/

gser 'od las/ de kho na nyid dang*/ yang dag pa'i ye shes yid tsam du gnas pa de ni/ chos sku zhes bya'o// zhes so// sku snga ma gnyis ni/ btags pa tsam mo// chos sku ni/ yang dag pa ste/ sku de gnyis kyi gzhi byed do// zhes pa dang*/ dbyig (115) gnyen gyis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku rnam pa gsum ste/ chos dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ sprul pa'o// de la chos kyi sku rnam pa gnyis te/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas so// zhes chos sku nyid la cha gnyis su phye bas na/ 'dir yang ldog pa'i sgo nas gnyis su 'byed pa yin te/ rgyas par 'og tu'o// bzhi pa ni/ mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can// zhes pa la/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ sngar gyi steng du ye shes kyi sku dang lnga zer ba'ang brtag bzod pa ma yin te/ chos sku las gzhan pa'i ye shes med pa'i phyir ro// gser gling pas/ bzhi po'i dbye gzhi chos sku dang lnga zhes pa mi 'thad de/ dbye gzhi dbye ba'i ya gyal du 'gal ba'i phyir ro// des na/ longs sku la/ byang sems sa bcu pa la gnas pa kho na la snang ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa chen po dang*/ sa dang po yan chad kyi byang sems kho na la snang ba sprul sku la longs skur btags pa dang*/ sprul sku phal pa ste/ lnga'am/ sprul sku la/ rnam par smin pa yin min gyis dbye bas lang gshegs las/ chos ldan rgyu dang 'dra ba dang*// rgyu dang 'dra bas gang sprul pa// de dag ngo bo sangs rgyas yin// lhag ma sprul pa'i sku yin no// zhes so// lnga'o// gnyis pa la/ rgyu ngo bo dbye ba gsum las/ rgyu ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom man chad nas sems can ma lus pa'i bsod nams bcur bsgres pas sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig ba spu'i bu ga thams cad 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyas dpe byad bzang po gcig dpe byad brgyad cu 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyas mtshan sum cu'i gcig go

/mtshan sum cu 'grub pa'i bsod nams stong gis mdzod spu/ de 'bum gyis dbu'i gtsug tor/ de bye ba grangs med bcus sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'grub par rin chen phreng bar bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ grags stong gnyis med de/ lha'i rnga bo che/ chos (116) kyi sgra dbyangs dang rnam pa bzhis mtshungs te/ rnga ni/ bag med pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad bskul ba dang de'i dus las mi 'da' ba ltar/ gang zag dang dus la khyab pas nyi tshe ba ma yin pa dang*/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing bag yod pa'i gnas la sbyor ba ltar/ 'di dang phyi ma la mi phan pa spong bas phan pa dang*/ dam pa min pa'i dga' ba sel cing chos kyi kun dga'i dga' bde nye bar sgrub pa ltar/ phyin ci log gi bde ba sel la yang dag pa'i bde ba sgrub pas bde ba dang*/ chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrog cing 'tshe ba zhi bar byed pa ltar phyin ci log gi sgrib pa dang gnod pa'i duḥkha sel bas 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'o// rgyud blar/ de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang*// bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa// sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de/ 1$0000220gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa na yod pa'i don/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi// sngon gyi dkar po'i mthu yis ni// 'bad dang gnas dang yid gzugs dang*// rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du// mi rtag duḥkha bdag med dang*// zhi ba'i sgra yis bag med pa'i// lha rnams thams cad yang nas yang*// chos kyi rgyur ni skul byed ltar/ 1$0000270/skal ldan rnams la chos ston no// zhes sogs so// de lta na'ang sa 'og gi so skye'i rna bar 'gro ba/ 'dod pa'i me zhi bar byed pa/ ting nge 'dzin la sems gtod par byed pa/ phan bde ma lus pa'i rgyu byed pa dang bzhis lha'i rnga las khyad par 'phags te/ rgyud blar/ gang phyir skye kun ba nyid dang*// phan bde cho 'phrul gsum ldan pa// de phyir thub dbyangs lha rdzas kyi// sil snyan rnams las khyad par 'phags// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

mdo sde rgyan/ bde gshegs gsung ni mtha' yas te// yan lag drug cu bsam mi khyab// ces pas/ yan lag drug cu po mdor bsdu na/ mnyen dang 'jam dang yid du 'ong*// yid du 'thad dang dag pa dang*// dri med gsal dang snyan cing 'jebs// mnyan 'os mi tshugs snyan pa dang*// dul dang mi rtsub mi brlang (117) ba// rab dul rnar snyan lus sim byed// sems sim snying dga' dga' bde skyid// gdung med kun shes rnam rig bya// rnam gsal dga' byed mngon dga' byed// kun shes rnam rig byed rigs pa// 'brel dang mi zlos seng ge'i shugs// glang chen 'brug dang klu dbang dang*// dri za ka la piṅka tshangs// shang shang sgra dbyangs grags pa bdun// lha dbyangs rnga sgra ma khengs pa// mi dma' sgra kun rjes su zhugs// tshig zur ma chags ma tshang med// ma zhum mi zhan rab tu dga'// khyab dang tha ba med rgyun chags// 'brel dang sgra kun rdzogs par byed// dbang po sim byed ma smad pa// mi 'gyur ma rtabs 'khor kun grags// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// yan lag drug cu'i gsung yin no// bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad do// gsum pa ni/ ye shes bzhi ste/ 'di la/ rgyu ngo bo byed las so// dang po la/ gnas gyur pa'i rgyu ni/ kun gzhi/ nyon yid/ yid shes/ dbang shes bzhi gnas gyur pa las ye shes bzhi 'byung ste/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ kun gzhi rnam shes gang yin pa'ang*// me long ye shes nyid gyur pa// de yang chos kyi dbyings kyi ni// ngo bo nyid du 'ga' zhig 'dod// ces pa dang*/ nyon mongs can yid gnas gyur pa// mnyam nyid ye shes brjod par bya// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// yid kyi rnam shes nyid de'o// de dag longs spyod rdzogs sku nyid// ces pa dang*/ dbang po lnga yi rnam shes gang*// de ni don kun yongs 'dzin phyir// sems can kun gyi don du ni// bya ba sgrub pa tsam nyid thob// ces so// bdag po'i rgyu ni/

thos bsam gyis sde snod kyi chos 'dzin pa/ sems can thams cad la bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ gzhan la chos yang dag par ston pa/ sems can dang dkon mchog gi bya ba sgrub pa ste/ bzhi'o// 'dzin pa'i phyir dang sems mnyam phyir// yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang*// bya ba sgrub pa'i phyir yang ste// ye shes bzhi po (118) yang dag 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ rtag tu nga yir 'dzin pa med pa// bem rig gi dngos po thams cad la thag nye ring gi yul gyi sgo nas yongs su ma chad pa/ dus gsum gyi shes bya thams cad la 'jug cing dus thams cad du 'byung bas rtag tu ldan pa/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral bas shes bya thams cad la ma rmongs pa/ yul gyi rnam pa med pas mngon du ma phyogs bzhin du me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal bar snang ba'o// me long ye shes nga yi med// yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan// shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa// rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min// zhes so// mnyam nyid ye shes ni/ byang sems kyi dus su bdag gzhan mnyam par bsgoms pas gzugs brnyan lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams gang zag dang chos la bdag med par mnyam par rtogs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la zhugs pa'i byams snying rje gnyis dang mtshungs ldan no// mnyam nyid ye shes sems can la// sgom pa dag pa las 'dod de// mi gnas zhi bar zhugs pa ni// mnyam nyid ye shes yin par 'dod// dus rnams kun tu byams pa dang*// thugs rje chen po dag dang ldan// zhes so// so sor rtog pa ni/ rtog pa med bzhin du shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med par so sor rtog par mdzad pa/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs// ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi// gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin// zhes so// ye shes de gnyis longs sku ste/

tsan+d+ra go mis/ de dag longs spyod rdzogs sku nyid// chos la rdzogs longs spyod ston phyir// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// chos la rdzogs longs spyod phyir yang*// zhes so// bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes ni/ lo ka'i khams thams cad du sna tshogs su sprul pas/ sems can gyi bya ba sgrub pa ste/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes ni// khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs shing*// dpag

(119) med bsam yas sprul pa yis// sems can don kun sgrub pa'o// zhes so// de nyid sprul sku ste/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ de yang rtag par thams cad du// dus ji bzhin dang bsam ji bzhin// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul sku ste/ sprul pa kun gyi rgyu yin phyir// zhes so// yang sangs rgyas sa'i mdo las/ shin tu 'dus/ chos lngas sangs rgyas kyis bsdus te/ lnga gang zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so// zhes pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni/ bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa gnyis rnam par grol ba/ shes rab dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i spangs ba dang rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin gnas yongs su gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings so// de la ye shes lngar 'dod pa ni/ sku bzhir 'dod pa dang mthun te/ chos dbyings ye shes ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ me long lta bu ni/ rtogs pa chos sku'o// ye shes bzhir 'dod na/ sku gsum dang mthun te/ me long lta bus chos dbyings dang chos thams cad dmigs la/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pas de gnyis gcig tu bsdus te/ kha cig tu ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ kha cig tu chos sku'i sgrar brjod do// gsum pa la/ ye shes bzhi'i dang pos ye shes phyi ma gsum gyi rgyu byed de/ ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir// ye shes 'byung gnas chen po 'dra// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ye shes gzugs brnyan 'byung phyir ro// de'ang longs sku'i rgyu yin pas longs skur brjod do// tsan+d+ra go mis/ kha cig me long ye shes kyang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru rtog /de yang de la rgyu nyid phyir// nye bar btags las de bzhin gzhan// zhes so// ye shes kyi gzugs brnyan 'byung bas me long lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/

byams snying rje gnyis kyis gdul bya'i (120) mos pa dang 'tsham par sku ston pa ste/ sems can rnams la mos pa bzhin// sangs rgyas sku ni nges par ston// zhes so// gsum pas ni/ byang sems kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa'i dga' bde'i 'byor ba ston cing chos kyi char 'bebs te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni// 'byor pa thams cad ston mdzad pa// the tshom thams cad gcod pa yi// chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs// zhes so// bzhi pas ni/ sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ sangs rgyas sprul pa de rtag tu// mdzad pa sgrub pa'i bye brag dang*// grangs dang zhing gi rnam kun tu// bsam mi khyab par shes par bya// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ni/ bral ba'i yon tan so gnyis so// mtshan so gnyis ni/ ldan pa'i yon tan so gnyis te/ rgyud blar/ bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor pa'i gnas// dam pa'i don gyi sku yin te// drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku// pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas// dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs// bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan// gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan// rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan// zhes so// yang na/ tshad med pa bzhi nas phyin drug gi bar yon tan mdo sde rgyan las 'byung ba bzhin blta'o// lnga pa ni/ bsdu na/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rgyun mi chad pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ gdul bya sems can gyi rgyud dang*/ rang bzhin gyi khams dang*/ zhi drag la sogs pa'i 'dul byed kyi thabs dang*/ gdul bya la bsgrub dgos pa'i bya ba mngon mtho nges legs dang*/ de'i gdul ba'i yul dus te/ lnga la cir yang rnam par mi rtog bzhin du sgrub pa lhun grub ste/ rgyud blar/ gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul ba'i thabs dang ni// gdul bya'i khams kyi 'dul ba'i bya ba dang*// de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la// khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug

/ces so// gnyis pa ni/ yon tan gyi rin chen dang ldan la ye shes kyi chu rgyas pa'i mtsho nges par (121) 'byin byed sa bcu dang*/ sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'i nyi ma nye bar ston pa/ tshogs gnyis dang gnyis kyis theg pa la bsrubs pas zab cing rgya che ba'i nam mkha'i 'bras bu byang chub thob ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dri ma med pa/ de bdag nyid dang 'dra bar sems can thams cad la gter bzhin khyad med du yod par gzigs nas/ glo bur du 'byung zhing sgrib cing khyab par byed pa/ rang bzhin du yongs su ma grub pa'i sprin sgrib gnyis kyis byang chub kyi nam mkha' bsgribs pa de/ 'joms pa'i rkyen thugs rje chen pos 'thor bar byed pas rlung lta bu ste/ rgyud blar/ yon tan rin chen mchog tshogs dang ldan ye shes chu mtsho bsod nams ye shes nyi 'od can// theg pa ma lus nges par bsrubs te mtha' dang dbus med rgya che nam mkha' ltar khyab pa// sangs rgyas nyid ni yon tan dri ma med gter sems can kun la khyad med rnam gzigs nas// nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin gyi drwa ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rlung gis rnam par gtor// zhes so// de la/ dang po sa dang tshogs gnyis kyis gzhan don gyi dbang gis 'byung bar bstan la/ byang chub dang sems can gnyis kyis bdag gzhan mnyam par rig nas zhi ba'i mthar mi gnas shing*/ sgrib pa dang thugs rje gnyis kyis sgrib pa ma zad bar du thugs rje'i mdzad pa mi rdzogs pas 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa yin te/ rgyud bla mar/ gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang*// bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang*// mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir// 'khor ba srid du mdzad mi 'chad// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam na sku med cing*/ sbyor lam du chos nyid kyi rnam pa gsal bar rtogs pas sku dang bcas so// sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du sgrib gnyis sa bon 'ga' zhig spangs la chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas sku thob bo// sa brgyad yan chad du mi

(122) rtog pa'i ye shes rgyun chad med pas sku rdzogs pa ste/ sku med pa dang bcas dang sku thob dang*// sku yongs rdzogs dang nga rgyal mang ba dang*// nga rgyal phra dang nga rgyal med par 'dod// ces so// de bzhin du gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi rjes su mthun pa tsam zhig slob lam na yod kyi/ mtshan nyid pa med do// gsum pa la/ ngo bo nyid sku sbyor ba'i 'bras bu min te/ 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ skyon med de/ bskyed 'bras min yang bral 'bras yin pas so// ngo bo nyid sku ye shes kyi yul du byas na/ spros bcas su 'gyur ro// ma byas na/ ma mkhyen pa'am ye shes yul med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ yongs gcod la ye shes kyi yul du ma byas la/ rnam bcad la 'ga' yang mthong ba med pa'i tshul gyis mthong bas ma mkhyen pa'i skyon med do// gzugs sku la ye shes yod na/ rgyud du mar 'gyur te/ gzugs sku du ma yod pa'i phyir/ med na/ mdo las/ bdag gis dngos po'i sku 'di brnyes pa yang yum dang thabs mkhas pa las byung ba ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi rten du gyur pa'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ ye shes yod kyang rgyud du mar mi 'gyur te/ ri tha dad pa'i dbang gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no// ye shes yod tshul la 'ga' zhig ye shes kyi rgyu las longs sku sprul sku 'byung bar 'dod/ chos bshes la sogs pa/ ye shes nyid gdul bya'i dbang gis longs sku sprul sku dang sku gdung ring bsrel du snang gi sha khrag gi lus min te/ gser 'od las/ drang srong chen po de la ni// sku la rus pa khrag med na// zhes pas so// yang*/ gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rnams chos sku'i dbye bar mi rigs so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ sku du mar phye ba'i ya gyal gyi chos sku yin pas ma khyab kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad chos sku zhes gcig tu bsdus pa'i chos sku'i dbye bar 'dod pas so// gsung la sogs pa sku nyid du mi rigs

(123) so// zhe na/ ma yin te/ gsung ni/ gzhan du longs skur bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ shān+tis/ sngags kyi tshul la bzhi yang rnam pa gzhan nyid du yin te/ sku dang gsung dang thugs ni/ sku gsum yin la/ bzhi pa ni/ de dag gi las sam mnyam pa nyid do// zhes so// thugs ye shes bzhi ni/ sku gsum du sngar bshad zin la/ yon tan stobs sogs 'dir chos skur brjod cing*/ 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i sku bzhi chos skur brjod pa'i phyir ro// shān+tis/ ji ltar na/ sku gsum po chos kyi sku yin zhe na/ gzhes shing nam yang 'jig par mi 'gyur bas chos so// chos kyang 'di yin la/ sku yang 'di yin pas chos kyi sku ste/ lus nyid yin pa'i phyir ro zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar mdzad pa chos kyi sku yin zhe na/ mdzad pa dang mdzad pa po tha dad med pa'i phyir zhes so// 'o na/ zlos so zhe na/ mi zlos te/ dbye ba la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir ming dang ldog pa tha dad pa'i sgo nas bstan pa yin no// 'phrin las mtshan nyid pa slob lam na med na/ rgyud blar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni// rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// sems can yang dag sgrol ba la// lo ka na ni mnyam pa nyid// ces pa dang 'gal zhe na/ cung zad tsam gyis 'dra ba yin gyi/ mnyam pa lta ga la ste/ rgyud blar/ de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang*// rgya mtsho ba lang rmig rjes kyi// khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid// ces so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ tha dad dang*/ go rim dang*/ grangs nges dang*/ zlos pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid pa ni/ dngos po tha dad de/ gang zag so so'i rgyud dang 'brel pas so// rjes mthun pa ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad dang*/ dngos po tha dad pa ci rigs pa'o// sbyor bzhi ni/ lam shes dang ngo bo gcig cing*/ nang phan tshun ni/ phal cher dngos po tha dad pa ste/ sa mtshams tha dad pa'i phyir

(124) sa mtshams mtshungs pa rnams/ ltos sa tha dad la ltos te ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de/ rgyun mtha' na rnam kun rtse sbyor skad cig ma rnams ngo bo gcig tu yod pa bzhin no// chos sku dang rnam mkhyen ngo bo gcig cing gzhan dang dngos po tha dad do// thams cad kyang ldog pa tha dad kho na'o// gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsum 'jug yul yin la/ sbyor ba ni/ 'jug pa yin zhing*/ chos sku ni/ zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yin pas don gyi rim pa yin no// mkhyen gsum la/ 'bras bu la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen dang por bstan/ de nyid lam goms pa las byung bas de nas lam shes bstan/ de nyid spang bya'i gnyen po yin pas spang bya shes par bya ba'i phyir de nas gzhi shes bstan te/ bshad pa'i rim pa'o// mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa de dbang du bya dgos pas de'i thabs rnam kun bstan/ de las dbang thob pa 'byung bas rtse sbyor bstan/ de brtan par byed cing nyams na gso ba'i phyir mthar gyis pa bstan/ de mthar thug pa na brtan pa thob pas skad cig ma bstan te/ phal cher don gyi rim pa'o// de rnams kyi mthar thug gi 'bras bur chos sku bstan te/ don gyi rim pa ste/ de nas kyi sgras bstan pa'o// gsum pa la/ 'jug yul/ 'jug pa/ zhugs 'bras gsum du nges la/ 'jug yul yang rgyu 'bras blang dor gsum du nges pas mkhyen gsum du mtha' chod la/ 'jug pa sbyor ba'ang dbang thob pa'i don du sgom pa rgyu 'bras gnyis dang*/ brtan pa thob pa'i don du sgom pa rgyu 'bras gnyis su nges pas rnam rtse gnyis/ mthar skad gnyis su nges te/ chos skur rgyu'i rnal 'byor thams cad de tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro// zhugs pa'i 'bras bu chos skur nges te/ de tsam gyis 'dod pa'i don thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir ro// des na/ mngon rtogs yum de ni rnam pa brgyad du nges so// dang ni/ rdzogs tshig go

/yang na/ de nas chos sku dang zhes sogs dbye ba'o// bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ mkhyen gsum dang rnam kun la dang*/ rnam mkhyen (125) dang lam shes la dang*/ lam shes dang gzhi shes la dang*/ rnam mkhyen dang chos sku la zlos ba spang ba'o// dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum dang rnam kun ston pa'i gzhung zlos par 'gyur te/ rnam kun tu mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ skyon med de/ mkhyen gsum ni/ rnam pa tha dad kyi yul can/ rnam kun ni/ rnam pa bsdus pa'i yul can gyi khyad dam/ mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bstan la/ rnam kun nyams len sbyor ba'i sgo nas bstan no// yang na/ rnam kun spang bya zhi ba'i don du sgom pa/ zhi ba mkhyen pa yin pas mi zlos te/ 'phags pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ni/ rnam pa so sor nges pa'i yul can te/ rnam pa so sor nges pa ji skad bshad pas so// rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ rnam pa ma lus pa'i yul can yin no// zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyad par ro// yang na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum du rnam par gzhag pa ni/ mtshan nyid pa yin la/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ sbyor ba pa yin no// yang na/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ mi mthun pa dang gnyen por rnam par gnas pas rab tu phye ba yin la/ rnam mkhyen nyid ni/ de lta ma yin te/ rang bzhin gyis zhi ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen dang lam shes ston pa'i gzhung zlos par 'gyur te/ gnyis kas rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu ston pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ rgyu dang 'bras bu ma lus pa shes pa rnam mkhyen du rtogs pa'i don du skabs dang por de'i rgyu bstan/ de rnam mkhyen yin pas lam shes min no zhes dogs pa bsal ba dang*/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs thun mong min pa bstan pa'i phyir lam shes bstan te/

'grel chen nas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu ma lus par thugs su chud pa la ltos te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rnam mkhyen (126) nyid ces brjod pa yin pas rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi lam ni/ de las gsungs pa ma yin no// zhes dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir de nyid las rgyu tsam zhig drangs nas/ byang sems rnams kyi mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam gyi bdag nyid can lam shes pa nyid logs shig tu bzhag pa yin no// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ lam shes dang gzhi shes ston pa'i gzhung zlos te/ lam shes su yang nyan rang gi lam bstan pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ mi zlos te/ lam shes su nyan rang gi lam byang sems kyi yon tan yar ldan du shes par bya ba'i phyir bstan la/ gzhi shes ni/ gzhi ma shes na lam mi shes pas gzhi ma lus pa shes pa'i phyir ram/ spang bya ma shes na/ gnyen po mi shes pas spang bya shes par bya ba'i phyir bstan no// 'grel chen nas/ de bas na/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pas 'phangs pa rnams kyi gzhi ma lus pa yongs su shes pa'i don du thams cad shes pa nyid logs shig tu bshad par gzung ngo*// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rnam mkhyen dang chos sku ston pa'i gzhung zlos te/ gnyis kas sangs rgyas kyi sa ston pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ mi zlos te/ rnam mkhyen 'jug yul gyi cha nas bstan/ chos sku zhugs 'bras kyi cha nas bstan pa'o// sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ yang na/ rnam mkhyen nyid la sogs pa gsum ni/ yul gyi sgo nas so// de'i 'og ma bzhi ni/ rgyu'i sgo nas so// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa ni/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan par rig par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ don bdun bcu bshad pa dang*/ zlos pa spang pa gnyis so// dang po la brgyad las/ rnam mkhyen gyi dngos po bcu bshad pa la bzhi las/ lam gyi rang bzhin sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi ngo bo rig pa gang zhig gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba'o// de la/
ngo bo rig pas sems byung dang rig pa min pa

(127) sel te/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ don tsam 'dzin pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'o// don gyi khyad par 'dzin pa ni/ sems las byung ba ste zhes so// bar pa gnyis kyis gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems su mtshon te/ shān+tis/ gzhan gyi don gyi ched du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes so// 'byung bas bskyed par mtshon te/ ngo bo nyid med pas 'byung ba dang bskyed pa zhes bya ba ni/ don tha dad pa ma yin no// zhes so// dbye na/ las dang po pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar la nyer gnyis so// gnyis pa smin cing dag par byed pa'i gdams ngag la gnyis te/ gdams ngag rnyed pa'i tshul/ rnyed nas nyams su len tshul lo// dang po ni/ gang zag gang gis/ dus nam gyi tshe/ rgyu gang las/ ston pa gang la/ dgos pa ci'i don du/ don gang rnyed pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir gdams ngag phal pa ni/ nyan rang dang tha mal pa la'ang yod pas/ ston pa po phal pas kyang chog pa yin no// gdams ngag khyad par can ni/ de dag la med cing tshogs lam chen po yan chad kyi byang sems kyis nyan pa yin no// bskal pa grangs med nges 'byung zhing*// mos pa rnam par 'phel byed pa// ji ltar chu yis rgya mtsho bzhin// dge chos rnams kyis yang dag rdzogs// de bzhin du ni tshogs bsags pa'i// rgyal sras gdod nas dag pa'o// legs par shes shing sems dge ba// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes pas/ bskal pa grangs med dang por byang sems kyi spyod pa spyad pa/ mos pa chen po'i gnas skabs su phyin par byed pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa/ byang sems kyi sdom pa dang theg chen gyi lta ba dag pa/ mang du thos shing sgrib pa dang bral ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi bsgom pa la gnas pa des so// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam chen po yan chad do// gsum pa ni/ chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu las

(128) so// 'di la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ brtags pa'i dngos po la sems rtse gcig pa/ chos 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang mtshungs ldan no// gnyis pa ni/ gsung rab dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos rnams kyi tshig dang don 'dzin pas chos kyi rgyun sems mnyam par gnas pas ting nge 'dzin no// 'grel chen nas/ gang zhig thob pas tshig dang don 'dzin par nus pa/ chos kyi rgyun ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob ces so// gsum pa ni/ ngo bo nyid med pas chos mchog la zer yang*/ 'dir tshogs lam chen po nas gzung ste/ 'grel chen nas/ tshogs kyi sa nyid du sems las su rung par gyur pa na zhes pas so// bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas la nyan to// lnga pa ni/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rgya chen po thob par bya ba'i phyir du'o// drug pa ni/ nyan thos sogs kyi gdams ngag ma yin pa'i theg chen gyi gdams ngag rgya chen po'o// 'di'i mtshan nyid ni/ sems bskyed kyis don du gnyer ba'i don rtogs shing thob par byed pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyis dngos su 'doms pa'o// de la gnyis las/ gdams pa ni/ gang zhig thob zin pa'i yon tan mi nyams par skyong ba'i don du 'doms pa'o// rjes su bstan pa ni/ gang zhig yon tan ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir 'doms pa'o// 'phags pas/ don du gnyer ba'i don thob pa'i bya ba nye bar ston pa ni/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa yin te zhes so// shān+tis/ khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir brjod pa ni/ gdams ngag ste zhes so// dbye na/ ngo bo gcig la yul gyis phye bas bcu'o// de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni// sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang*// ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir// gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dmigs pa/ yid la byed pa/ sems gnas pa'i thabs/ de dag las sems las su rung ba thob tshul lo// dang po ni/ sems drug ste/

rtsa ba'i sems/ rjes su dpyod pa'i sems/ rnam par dpyod pa'i (129) sems/ nges par 'dzin pa'i sems/ sdom pa'i sems/ smon pa'i sems so// dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi don 'byed pa'i mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa la sogs pa'i chos rnams kyi ming la dmigs pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings mi 'phel ba'i mdo las de nas dang por sdom brtson de// mdo yi sde la sogs pa'i chos// gnyis med don ni rnam 'byed pa// mdo sogs ming la sems 'jog go /zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mdo la sogs pa'i tshig rab tu 'byed pa la dpyod pa ste/ de nas de ni rim bzhin du// tshig rab dbye la dpyod byed cing*// zhes so// gsum pa la/ don dang yi ge dpyod pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ bgrang ba/ 'jal ba/ rtog pa/ so sor rtog pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzugs ni/ gnyis sam nyi shu zhes sogs grangs 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ grangs dang ldan pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid la sgro skur med par 'dzin pa/ gsum pa ni/ de tshad mas gtan la 'bebs pa/ bzhi pa ni/ bgrangs gzhal brtags pa'i don la lta ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ yi ge tshogs pa don dang bcas pa dang*// sil bu rnams don med par dpyod pa ste// so so'i nang la tshul bzhin du// de yi don yang rnam par dpyod// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ rjes su dpyod pa dang*/ rnam par dpyod pa'i rgyu mtshan nges par 'dzin pa'o// don de dag ni nges bzung nas// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ ji ltar rnam par dpyad pa'i don rnams rtsa ba'i sems la bsdus te 'dzin pa ste/ chos la kun nas sdom par byed// ces so// drug pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don nam/ de yongs su rdzogs pa'i don nam/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu'i don nam/ sa la 'jug pa'i don nam/ khyad par du 'gro ba'i don yang rung ste/ gang gi don du brtson pa de la 'dun pa dang bcas par 'byung ba ste/ de yis don ni thob bya'i phyir// de nas de ni smon par byed// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

yid la byed pa bcu gcig ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po'i rgyu/ 'dod khams (130) rags so// dang po zhi'o// zhes yid kyis brjod cing bsam nas rgyun chags su ngo bo kun tu tshol ba ni/ rtog pa yin la/ de la dpyod pas khyab pas na/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi rgyu/ 'dod pa ni/ tshe thung*/ las dang nyon mongs shas che bas rags la/ gong ma de las ldog pas zhi'o// zhes khyad par zhib mo so sor rtog pa ni/ rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam mo// gnyis pa yan chad kyi rgyu/ yid kyi brjod pa rtog dpyod med par zhi gnas ro gcig tu dpyod pa/ rtog pa'ang med/ dpyod pa'ang med pa'o// chos kyi ming sdom pa la sems gtod pa/ zhi gnas yid la byed pa'o// ming de'i don bgrang ba dang 'jal ba sogs kyis ma nor bar dpyod pa ni/ lhag mthong yid la byed pa'o// blo gcig gis ming tshig sdom pa dang don so sor dpyod pa sdom nas byed pa/ zung du 'brel ba yid la byed pa'o// zhum na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yid la byed pa la sogs kyis bying ba bsal te/ dmigs pa la sems rab tu gtod pa ni/ rab tu 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan yid la byed pa'o// rgod na/ mi rtag pa sogs yid la byas nas spong ba ni/ zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan yid la byed pa'o// bying rgod zhi ba na/ gnyen po rtsol ba rnam g.yeng yin pas de'i gnyen por btang snyoms sgom pa ni/ btang snyoms kyi rgyu mtshan yid la byed pa'o// yid byed de dag bar ma chad par sgom pa ni/ rtag tu bya ba yid la byed pa'o// de dag le lo dang yid mi ches pa la sogs pa med par spro ba dang bcas te sgom pa/ gus par bya ba yid la byed pa'o// de la dang po gsum/ lam gyi rgyu/ de 'og gsum/ lam gyi ngo bo/ de 'og gsum/ lam mi nyams par byed pa/ tha ma gnyis/ spyi'i chos su sbyar ro// yid kyi brjod pa rgyun chags su// btsal bya so sor brtag par bya// yid la byed pa brjod med pa// ro gcig pas kyang dpyad par bya// chos kyi ming ni sdom pa'ang 'dir// zhi gnas lam du shes par bya// lhag

(131) mthong lam ni de don rnams// rnam par dpyod par shes par bya// zung du 'brel ba'i lam ni de// sdom pa yin par shes par bya// zhum pa'i sems ni rab bzung ste// rgod pa yang ni zhi bar bya// de nas dmigs pa de la ni// mnyam par gyur na btang snyoms gzhag /de la rtag tu bya ba dang*// gus par byas te sbyar bar bya// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu ste/ dang po nyid du phyi'i dmigs pa las sems bkug nas nang du dmigs pa la gtod pa ni/ 'jog par byed pa'o// de nyid la rgyun bsrings te/ phra mor byed pas sems sdud pa ni/ kun tu 'jog pa'o// brjed nas phyi rol du yengs na slar nang du bkug pa ni/ nges par 'jog pa'o// sems phyir mi 'phro bar bya ba'i phyir dang po nas dran pas bzung ste sgrim pa ni/ nye bar 'jog pa'o// ting nge 'dzin la yon tan mthong zhing g.yeng ba'i rgyu gzugs sogs kyi nyes dmigs shes pas sems phyir 'phror mi ster ba ni/ 'dul bar byed pa'o// rnam g.yeng rtog pa'i nyes pa shes pas phyir 'phror mi ster ba ni/ zhi bar byed pa'o// brjed nas brnab sems la sogs langs na/ dang du mi len pa ni/ nye bar zhi bar byed pa'o// mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pas rgyun chad med par rang shugs kyis nang du gnas pa ni/ rgyud gcig tu byed pa'o// de shin tu goms pa na/ 'du byed pa med par lhun grub tu ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun g.yeng ba med par 'byung ba ni/ mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yang mi byed// rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas// de la slar ni glan par bya// blo ldan gong nas gong du yang*// sems ni nang du bsdu bar bya// de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir// ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo// rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir// de la mi dga' zhi bar bya// brnab sems yid mi bde ba sogs//

(132) langs pa de bzhin zhi bar bya// de nas sdom brtson can gyis ni// sems la mngon par 'du byed bcas// rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob// de goms pa las 'du mi byed// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ de nas lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba thob pa na/ yid la byed pa thob pa zhes bya la/ yid la byed pa bcu gcig po 'phel bas nyer bsdogs las ring du song ste/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob/ de sbyangs pas de las su rung ba thob ste/ de las mngon shes bsgrubs nas sangs rgyas mang po la mchod pa dang chos nyan pa'i phyir zhing gzhan du 'gro zhing*/ sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byas pas sems las su rung ba'i mchog thob par 'gyur ro// de nas de yis lus dang sems// shin tu sbyangs pa de thob nas// yid la byed dang bcas zhes bya// de yis de ni 'phel byas nas// 'phel ba ring du 'gro ba yis// dngos gzhi gnas pa de thob bo// mngon shes don du gnyer bas de// sbyangs nas las su rung ba'i mchog /bsam gtan la thob mngon par shes// mngon par bsgrubs pa'i sgo nas te// sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la// mchod pa'i phyir dang mnyan pa'i phyir// lo ka khams ni rnams su 'gro// 'dis ni sangs rgyas dpag med la// bskal pa dpag med bsnyen bkur byas// de la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i phyir// sems ni las rung mchog tu 'gyur// zhes so// 'di ni/ 'grel chen du gdams ngag gi rgyur gsungs kyang rgyan du gdams ngag gi rjes la bshad do// gsum pa gdams ngag gi don bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pas mthong spangs las nges par 'byed pa mthong lam gyi yan lag ste/ rgyur gyur pa ni/ thar pa cha mthun gyi rjes kyi lo ka pa'i bsgoms byung gi rtogs pa/ bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun pa ste/ dbye na/ khyad par lnga lnga dang ldan pa'i drod rtse bzod mchog rnam pa bzhi'o// bzhi pa la/

sems bskyed du dam bcas shing gdams (133) ngag nod pa'i don sgrub pa la bzhi las/ dang po sgrub pa yi ni rten nam rgyur gyur pa'i rigs ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ sgrub pa'i nye bar rten par gyur pa ste/ dbye na/ chos nyid ngo bo gcig la/ brten pa tha dad pas phye ba bcu gsum mo// gnyis pa la/ de la brten nas sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dag ni/ rang bzhin dang tha mi dad pa'i rnam 'gyur/ sgrub pa po'i shes byar gyur pa ste/ dbye na/ bcu gcig go /gsum pa de la dmigs nas sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba dag ni/ de'i dbang du byas nas sgrub par byed par 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu mthar thug ste/ dbye na/ gzhan don spangs rtogs gsum mo// bzhi pa ni/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i ngo bo la/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo dang*/ khyad par gyi dbye ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ sems bskyed la gnas nas rang gzhan gyi don rtsom pa/ byang chub chen po'i rgyur gyur pa ni/ sgrub pa ste/ sems can thams cad dang du len pa/ duḥkha thams cad dang du len pa/ sems can mang po'i don bsgrub pa'i bya ba ste/ gnas rtsom 'bras bu 'byung ba che bdag nyid// rgyal sras rnams kyi sgrub pa yin par 'dod// rtag tu len pa che dang bzod pa che// don chen yang dag bsgrub pa'i bya ba byed// ces so// de nyid zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ myang 'das dang*/ yon tan dang*/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba'i che ba bzhi ldan te/ sgrub pa 'dis ni srid dang zhi ba kun// zil gyis mnan 'gro zhi ba mchog dang ldan// yon tan sna tshogs tshogs kyis rnam par 'phel// byams pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba rtag tu sdud// ces so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba rtsod spang gsum las/ dang po la/ spyir 'dir smos sgrub pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ gdams ngag thob pas rigs la brten nas dmigs pa rim gyis rtogs te chen po gsum gyi ched du brtson pa'i bya ba'o// sgrub pa'i gdams ngag

sgrub pa'i rten/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba zhes zer ba'i (134) phyir dang*/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo brtson 'grus yin pa'i phyir ro// bye brag tu mi mthun phyogs kyi mtshon gyis mi tshugs pa'i go cha'i sgrub pa ni/ gang zhig bsam pa'i brtson 'grus kyi bya ba ste/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste bsam pa rgya che bar bsten pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ de la go cha ni/ smon pa'o// zhes so// dbye na/ drug gam/ so drug go /go bgos nas theg chen gyi g.yul du 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni/ gang zhig sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi bya ba'o// dbye na/ dgu'o// zhugs te dpung gi tshogs gsog pa'i sgrub pa ni/ gang zhig byang chub chen po dngos su bskyed pa'i bya ba ste/ dbye na/ bcu bdun no// dpung gi tshogs bsags pas rgyal dka' ba'i dgra las rgyal ba thob pa'i nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ni/ gang zhig nges par 'byung sa mthar thug gdon mi za bar 'byin pa'i brtson 'grus te/ dbye na/ brgyad do// 'phags pas/ go bgos pas ni/ 'jug go /zhugs pas ni/ dpung gi tshogs gsog go /dpung gi tshogs bsags pa ni/ ma rgyal ba las rgyal pa thob pas nges par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi ni/ sgrub pa tsam mo// dbye ngo la bzhi'o// tha dad ni/ dang por thob pa na rim can du thob pas snga ma rnams la phyi ma rnams ngo bo gcig pas ma khyab la/ phyi ma la snga ma ngo bo gcig go /grangs nges ni/ sgrub pa la brtson 'grus lnga yod pas/ go cha'i brtson 'grus go sgrub/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus 'jug sgrub/ ma zhum pa dang mi 'khrugs pa'i brtson 'grus gnyis tshogs sgrub/ chog mi shes pa'i brtson 'grus nges 'byung sgrub par nges so// thog mar go cha'i brtson 'grus de nas ni// tshul bzhin rab zhugs sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus te// ma zhum mi 'khrugs chog mi shes brtson 'grus// zhes so// gsum pa ni/
tshogs sgrub kyi byang chub de/ gnas skabs kyi yin na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces pa dang 'gal la/

(135) mthar thug gi yin na/ chos mchog na med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ 'ga' zhig gnas skabs kyi/ 'ga' zhig mthar thug gi yin pas skyon med do// nges par 'byung ba de/ dngos su yin na/ byams pa la med par 'gyur la/ brgyud nas yin na/ tshogs lam na'ang yod par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad du phyir mi ldog par nges par 'byung bas skyon med do// sgrub pa dang sbyor ba bzhi'i khyad par ni/ lo tsā na re/ rnal 'byor gyi rang bzhin sbyor ba/ spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa sgrub pa zhes so// des na sgrub pa ni/ brtson 'grus te/ sgrub pa'i skabs su brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo nyid ces pa dang*/ rten can gyi bya ba zhes pas so// sbyor bzhi ni/ bsam gtan te/ thams cad la sgom pa zhes sbyar bas so// 'on kyang ngo bo gcig go /de lta bu dang bcas pa'i chos bcu po rnams kyis/ lus ngag yid gsum thub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid bstan no// de mi rigs te/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs sems bskyed sogs bshad pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ rgyu'am yul gyi sgo nas mtshon te bstan pa yin no/ shān+ti rgyus mtshon/ slob dpon yul gyis mtshon// gnyis pa la/ lam shes kyi dngos po bcu gcig la/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gnyis las/ dang po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por te/ gzi med par byed pa ni/ nga rgyal bcom nas lam shes skye rung gi rten du byas pa'o// sogs pa skye ba'i yul sems bskyed dang ldan pa/ rgyu rkyen rigs kyis khyab pa/ 'khor ba mi 'dor ba'i rang bzhin can/ gzhan don byed pa'i las can rnams so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ nyan thos kyi lam shes ni/ byang chub thob pa nges par slob dpon la ltos pas na/ slob ma ste/ nyan thos de'i lam yar ldan du mngon sum du shes pa ste/ de la rgyu 'bras gnyis so// gnyis pa

(136) gcig pur gnas pa bse ru lta bus mtshon pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes ni/ rang rgyal gyi lam gang yin pa yon tan yar ldan du mi dmigs par mngon sum du shes pa'o// de la khyad par ngo bo rgyu gsum mo// gsum pa byang sems kyi lam shes la gnyis las/ tshe 'di'i yon tan nad med pa sogs dang*/ skye ba gzhan pa'i yon tan phyir mi ldog pa la sogs pa'i phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong ba'i lam ni/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi lo ka las 'das pa'i ye shes/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye bshul 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste/ de la skad cig bcu drug yod la/ sbyor lam skabs dang por bstan pas/ 'dir mi ston no// gnyis pa sgom lam la gnyis las/ sgom lam gyi byed pa ni/ sgom lam gyi 'bras bu'i khyad par te/ de la drug yod cing*/ shān+tis/ zag med sgom lam gyir 'chad do// gnyis pa byed pa'i rgyu sgom lam la/ shes sgrib kyi zag pa yod med gnyis las/ dang po la gsum las/ dge ba gsog byed mos pa yid la 'byed pa ni/ zag bcas kyi sgom lam/ yum la yon tan can du nges pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa ste/ de la nyer bdun no// de'i 'bras bu rang don mos pa la bstod pa dang*/ gnyis don la bkur ba dang*/ gzhan don la bsngags pa rnams ni/ mos pa'i yon tan gyi che ba ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i cha ste/ ngag ma yin no// de la'ang nyer bdun no// dge ba mi zad par byed pa bsngo ba yid byed ni/ zag bcas sgom lam/ dge ba gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa ste/ de la bcu gnyis so// dge ba 'phel byed rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla med ni/ zag bcas kyi sgom lam/ gzhan gyi dge ba la dga' ba yang dag par sgom pa ste/ de la bden gnyis kyi yi rang gnyis so// zag med sgom lam la gnyis las/ sgrub pa sgom lam ni/ zag med sgom lam/

rtogs pa phun tshogs te/ de la lnga'o// shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya (137) ba'i sgom lam 'di ni/ zag med kyi sgom lam/ spangs pa phun tshogs te/ de la dgu'o// byang sems theg pa gsum ga'i lam la mkhas pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs lam shes nyid ni/ lam gsum shes pa de 'drar yul lam/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad do// gsum pa gzhi shes kyi dngos po dgu las/ dang po dus gsum mnyam nyid du shes pas srid pa la mi gnas pa ni/ chos thams cad skye med du shes pas tshu rol gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes so// gnyis pa snying rjes zhi ba myang 'das la mi gnas pa ni/ gzhan don gyi bsam pas pha rol gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes so// gsum pa la/ 'bras bu'i yum skyed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa min pas 'bras bu'i yum la ring ba ni/ ming dang dngos po'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzhi shes so// bzhi pa 'bras bu'i yum skyed pa'i thabs mkhas kyis de la ring ba ma yin pa nyid ni/ thabs shes khyad par can dang ldan pa'i gzhi shes so// lnga pa mi mthun phyogs kyi ni/ byang sems kyi lam gyi spang byar gyur pa'i gzhi shes so// de la dbye na/ gzhi lam 'bras bu la chags pa gsum mo// drug pa gnyen po'i phyogs kyi ni/ chags pa'i mtha' ma lus pa 'gog pa'i gzhi shes so// de la'ang gsum mo// bdun pa sbyor ba ni/ gzugs sogs la zhen pa bkag nas sgom pa/ nyan rang gi sbyor ba shugs la 'phen byed de/ de la bcu'o// shān+tis bcu gnyis su bzhed do// brgyad pa sbyor ba de'i mnyam pa nyid ni/ sbyor ba de dag yul dang yul can du rlom pa mi dmigs par mtshungs par sgom pa ste/ de la bzhi'o// dgu pa gzhi shes kyi mthong lam gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad zin la/ khyad par gyi chos sbyor ba 'di'i 'bras bu nyan thos kyi mthong lam shugs la 'phen par byed do// de la skad cig bcu drug go /sogs pa rang rgyal dang byang sems te/

nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang shugs bstan gyi mthong lam la sogs pa de 'dra ba ni/ kun (138) shes mtshan nyid pa nyid du 'dod do// byang sems kyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa ni/ gnyen po kun shes so// bzhi pa rnam kun gyi dngos po bcu gcig las/ dang po rnam pa ni/ gzhi dang*/ ye shes kyi bye brag sbyor ba'i bsgom byar gyur pa ste/ de la mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa gsum mam/ brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum mo// gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir rnam pa rnams bsdus te sgom pa ste/ de la nyi shu'o// bcas pa ste/ de dang lhan cig pa sbyor ba po ni/ tshogs bsags pas nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod du gyur pa ste/ de la nyan pa/ 'dzin pa/ mi brjed pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod bzhi'o// gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ni/ sbyor ba'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu thob pa'i phan yon te/ de la bcu bzhi'o// bzhi pa sbyor ba'i skyon ni/ sbyor ba la bar du gcod pa'i las so// de la zhe drug go /lnga pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang bcas pa ste/ ldan pa ni/ sbyor ba'i nus pa mtshon byed kyi 'bras bu ste/ de la go gcig go /drug pa bstan pa la 'jug pa thar pa cha mthun la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ spyir thar pa cha mthun tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ nges 'byed cha mthun ma skyes gong gi byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba/ dran pa nyer gzhag gis bsdus pa'o// theg chen gyi ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba/ dbang po'i ngo bor ma gyur pa'o// 'phags pas/ dad pa la sogs pa 'di dag la dbang por ni brjod par mi bya ste/ dbang po'i don med pa'i phyir ro zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ las dang nyon mongs pa ches rags pa mi khom pa la sogs par 'phen par byed pa las thar pa sbyor lam/ de'i cha ste/ phyogs gcig la mthun pa ste/ phan 'dogs shing bskyed pa'o// yang na/

thar pa nyon mongs pa'i sa bon dang bral ba yin la/ de'i cha la phan 'dogs pas thar pa cha mthun te/ 'phags pas/ thar pa ni/ bral ba'i khyad par yin la/ de'i cha la phan pas na// thar pa'i cha dang mthun (139) pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab ste/ lnga'o// yang na/ chung 'bring che gsum ste/ slob dpon gyis/ nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems dang rim bzhin sbyar ro// 'phags pas/ theg dman gyi rigs su nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs su nges pa ste/ gsum la bzhed par gsal lo// yang na/ tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum ste/ 'dis sa mtshams kyang bstan la/ chos bshes kyis tshogs lam phal pa thar pa cha mthun min par 'dod pa bkag go /'di thob nas dge ba'i sa bon chad pa mi srid do// bdun pa de yongs su smin pa nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i rnam pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i lo ka pa'i rtogs pa ste/ de la bzhi'am/ bcu gnyis so// brgyad pa rten bslab par bya ba yod pas slob pa/ byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs te/ dge 'dun ni/ theg dman du mi ltung bar nges pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i byang sems rnams te/ de la sbyor mthong sgom gsum pa gsum mo// dgu pa yan lag srid pa 'khor ba dang*/ zhi ba myang 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ gang zhig 'khor 'das rang bzhin med par mtshungs par sgom pa'o// de la dngos dang klan ka spang ba gnyis so// bcu pa nye ba'i yan lag sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa bla na med pa ste/ mchog tu gyur pa'i sbyor ba ni/ gang zhig snod bcud kyi lo ka nyes pa med cing yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir sgom pa ste/ de la snod bcud dag pa gnyis so// bcu gcig pa sems can yongs su smin pa'i yan lag thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba ni/ gang zhig yul bcu la dus dang dus ma yin pa shes pas 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa ste/

de la bcu'o// thabs mkhas dang bcas pa'i dngos po bcu gcig po 'di ni/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa (140) yin no// lnga pa rtse sbyor gyi dngos po brgyad las/ dang po sngar rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes bshad pa de'i rtags ni/ bsdus sgom rab tu gyur par mtshon par byed pa'i drod de/ de la bcu gnyis so// gnyis pa rnam par 'phel ba ni/ bsdus sgom la dbang thob pa'i rtse mo/ bsod nams phul du byung ba dang ldan pa ste/ de la bcu drug go /gsum pa nges par brtan pa ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi chos dang sems can gyi don mi gtong ba'i bzod pa rnam 'phel rang dbang du gyur pa ste/ de la gnyis so// bzhi pa sems kun du gnas pa ni/ bsod nams mang po dang ldan pa'i chos mchog de kho na nyid la rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste/ de la che 'bring chung gsum mo// lnga pa mthong lam spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad zin la/ khyad chos bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'o// drug pa sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam ni/ bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa sgom spang rtog pa spong ba'i gnyen po/ byang chub chen por bgrod pa'i go skabs phye bshul lo// lam gnyis po so so ste/ re re la/ rnam par rtog pa 'jug pa gzung rtog ldog pa gzung rtog rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ btags 'dzin rtog pa ste/ rnam pa bzhi bzhi yod pas de'i gnyen po sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi lam dang*/ 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis te/ rnam pa bzhi re re la'ang dgu dgu ste/ sum cu rtsa drug drug go /bdun pa sangs rgyas la lam gzhan gyi bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi dngos rgyu bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa ste/ de la dngos dang khyad par gnyis so// brgyad pa bsal bya log par sgrub pa ni/ sgro skur du smra bya'i log rtog rnam mkhyen la dmigs pa/ bar chad med rtse bskyed pa'i sngon du spang bar bya ba'o// de la nye ba la ltos pa'i bcu drug go

/'di bar chad med rtse'i spang bya ma yin gyi/ rnam mkhyen la dngos smra ba rnams kyis rtsod pa'i log rtog yin pas bden gnyis la mkhas lan gyis spang bar bya ba'o// de lta bu dang bcas pa'i dngos po brgyad ni/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs (141) so// drug pa mthar gyis pa'i dngos po bcu gsum ni/ sbyin pa'i mthar gyis pa ni/ gang zhig 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i sbyin pa rim gyis sgom pa ste/ phar phyin gzhan lnga la'ang de ltar sbyar ro// sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa ni/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan don dam par mi dmigs par kun rdzob tu phyin ci ma log par rim gyis sgom pa'o// de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan zhes pa'i gnas su dge mi dge lung ma bstan pa'i chos dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs dang*/ sdom pa gsum dang*/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ lha'i gnas su skyes pa'i 'phags pa zhes sbyar bas/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'o// dngos med ngo bo nyid du shes pa'i mthar gyis pa ni/ gang zhig chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pas rim gyis sgom pa'o// de ltar dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ lhag ma rnam pa bcu ni/ mthar gyis pa'o// bdun pa skad cig ma'i dngos po bzhi ni/ rnam smin min pa dang*/ rnam smin dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa ste/ bzhi ni/ gang zhig zag med rnam par smin pa min pa'i chos thams cad bya rdzogs skad cig la rtogs pa dang*/ de bzhin rnam smin dge ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ kun byang mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par ro// de dag kyang dngos po tha dad kyis phye ba min par spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis phye ba rnam pa bzhi ni/ skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'o// brgyad pa chos sku'i dngos po bzhi la bzhi las/

dbye gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la chos skur brjod pa tsam zhig go /dbye ba'i ngo bo ni/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag par te/ phyin ci ma log par brjod do// 'di la/ 'phags pa la sogs pa sku gsum (142) mdzad pa dang bcas pa bzhi'o// zhes 'dod de/ legs so// slob dpon gyis/ mdzad pa ni/ chos sku'i zhar la bstan pa yin pas sku bzhi'o// zhes bzhed la/ 'di dag gi dgag sgrub 'og tu 'chad do// 'dir sku bzhi'i lugs bkod na/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ gang zhig zag med ye shes kyi bdag nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba la glo bur gyi dri ma kun gyis dag pa ste/ rgyud blar/ chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni// dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba// zhes pa dang*/ nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te// zhes so// gnyis pa chos la yang dag par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ gang zhig bar ma chad par mchog tu dag pa'i 'gro ba 'dul byed do// de'ang nges pa lnga ldan te/ gnas nges pa 'og min te/ de la 'ga' zhig ka shī/ 'og min phal pa'i gong na yod par 'dod la/ 'ga' zhig bka' 'chad/ de nyid kyi logs shig na yod zer ro// ngo bo nges pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor nges pa la/ a bh+ya dang*/ seng bzang shān+ti ngag dbang grags pa/ ni/ sa bcu'i byang sems kyis bskor bar 'dod/ chos bshes sa bcu pa'i byang sems kho nas bskor bar 'dod do// dus nges pa rtag tu rgyun mi chad par ro// longs spyod nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos kyi longs spyod bla na med pa'i dga' bde la rdzogs par longs spyod pa ste/ zla grags kyis/ skyabs gsum bdun bcu pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku ni// mtshan dang dpe byad rab 'bar zhing*// skye bo rnams la sna tshogs gzugs// rang mos dbang gis 'dzin par byed// bsod nams tshogs ni dpag med las// byung ba de ni rgyal ba'i sras// sa bcu la ni gnas rnams kyis// de lta bu yi skur gzigs so// 'di de chos rdzogs longs spyod pas// rgyal sras rnams kyis spyad bya'o// chos rnams rang bzhin kho na la// gnas pa'i blo la sangs rgyas brjod// 'og min gzhal yas khang du ni// de nyid mngon sum bya bar bzhed//

(143) ces so// bcas pa ni/ ldan pa ste/ sdeb sbyor gyi dbang ngam/ ye shes dang ldan pa'o// sku bzhir 'dod pa'i lugs kyis/ de bzhin gzhan ni sprul pa dang*// zhes bshad na sla bas/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pa de bzhin du de las gzhan pa'i sku gnyis kyang ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin no// gsum pa sprul pa'i sku ni/ gang zhig dag ma dag sna tshogs 'dul byed do// dbye na/ bzo dang*/ skye ba dang*/ byang chub mchog gi sprul pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'da' bar ston pa ste/ bzhi'o// mchog gi sprul pa ni/ 'og min du sangs rgyas nas 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa ste/ rgyud blar/ dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang*// zhes so// de la'ang mtshan dang dpe byad yod de/ rgyud blar/ sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes bya ba// sprul pa chos la rdzogs par ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis la brten// dag pas nye dang ring rnams la// lo ka rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// chu dang nam mkha' zla gzugs bzhin// zhes so// bzhi pa chos sku ni/ gang zhig gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes so// dbye na/ nyer gcig go /de'i mdzad pa ni/ chos sku'i bdag rkyen las rgyun mi chad cing lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i las te/ dbye na/ nyer bdun no// bcas pa ni/ ldan pa'am bskor ba ste/ zhar byung ngo*// tha dad ni/ ngo bo nyid sku sku gzhan dang de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med la/ lhag ma gsum po ngo bo tha dad do// grangs nges ni/ sku bzhir byas pas chos nyid chos can gnyis yod pa'i dang po ngo bo nyid sku/ chos can la sangs rgyas kho na'i yul/ byang sems 'phags pa yan chad kho na'i yul/ so skye dang nyan thos kyi yul gsum yod pas lhag ma gsum du nges so// de ltar don bdun cus dngos po brgyad ma tshang ba med par bshad cing rdzogs pas mang mi dgos la/ gang ma tshang yang dngos po brgyad mi rdzogs pas nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir grangs nges

(144) so// go rim yang kha cig bshad pa'i rim pa/ kha cig don gyi rim pas legs par bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa la drug ste/ sgrub pa dang*/ sbyor ba lan gnyis dang*/ sgom lam lan gsum dang*/ gang zag lan bzhi dang*/ rtog pa lan bzhi dang*/ mthong lam lan lnga dang*/ sbyor lam lan drug ston pa la zlos pa spang ba'o// dang po gdams ngag gi skabs su sgrub dang zhes pa dang*/ sgrub pa bzhi ston pa zlos par 'gyur te/ sgrub pa khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ skyon med de/ dang po ni/ gdams ngag gi brjod bya'i khyad par du bshad la/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba ston pa'i phyir ro// yang gzhi shes kyi sbyor dang zhes pa dang*/ rnam kun gyi sbyor ba gnyis zlos te/ sbyor ba gcig lan gnyis bstan pa'i phyir zhe na/ mi zlos te/ dang po nyan rang gi sbyor ba shugs la 'phen byed nyan rang gi sbyor ba'i gnyen po'i cha bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam pa rnams bsdus te sgom pa rnam kun gyi sbyor ba yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ lam shes su sgrub dang shin tu dag pa'i sgom lam/ rnam kun tu/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zhes pa dang*/ rtse sbyor du/ sgom lam zhes bya ba'i lam zhes pa rnams zlos te/ sgom lam khyad med yang yang bstan pas so// zhe na/ ma grub ste/ dang po mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i sgom lam/ gnyis pa slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i sgom lam/ gsum pa sgom spang rtog pa spong ba'i gnyen po'i sgom lam yin pas so// gsum pa ni/ rnam mkhyen du/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// zhes pa dang*/ lam shes su/ mog mog por byed ces pa dang*/ rnam kun tu/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// zhes pa dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes pa rnams zlos te/ lam sgom pa'i gang zag tu khyad med pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ dang po rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs mtshon byed/
