gnyis pa gegs nga rgyal dang bral ba'i cha/ gsum pa sngon du (145) bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bzhi pa nyan rang du mi ltung nges pa'i rtags thob pa'i cha yin pas so// bzhi pa ni/ rnam mkhyen du/ rnam rtog bzhi po ldan brten pa// zhes pa dang*/ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// zhes pa dang*/ rtse sbyor du/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa dang*// zhes pa dang*/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi// zhes pa rnams zlos te/ rtog par khyad med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ ma nges te/ dang po ni/ theg chen sbyor lam nyan rang sbyor lam las khyad par du byed pa'i dgag rtog gnyis pa gnyen po'i tshogs shes pa'i don du de'i spang bya bstan/ gsum pa mthong lam rtse mo'i spang bya/ bzhi pa sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir ro// lnga pa ni/ lam shes su/ phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa dang*/ gzhi shes su/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa dang*/ rnam kun tu/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// zhes pa dang*/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// zhes pa dang*/ rtse sbyor du/ bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa rnams zlos te/ mthong lam yang yang bstan pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ dang po 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i lam/ gnyis pa theg dman las yang dag par 'da' ba'i lam/ gsum pa theg dman mthong lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam/ bzhi pa slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi lam/ lnga pa mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya rtog pa spong ba'i gnyen po'i lam yin pas so// zhes 'phags pa grol sde gsung ngo*// drug pa ni/ rnam mkhyen du/ nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*// zhes pa dang*/ lam shes su/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// zhes pa dang*/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar// zhes pa dang*/ rnam kun tu/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// zhes pa dang*// drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*// zhes pa dang*/

de yi rtags (146) dang rnam 'phel dang*// zhes sogs zlos te/ sbyor lam du khyad par med pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ dang po byang chub sems dpa'i sbyor lam nyan rang sbyor lam las khyad par lngas khyad par 'phags pa/ gnyis pa nyan thos kyi sbyor lam las dmigs rnam gyis khyad par 'phags pa/ gsum pa rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam las dmigs rnam gyis khyad par 'phags pa/ yang na/ de gnyis kyi lam snga ma rnams las dmigs rnam gyis khyad par 'phags pa/ bzhi pa sems can thams cad la brten pa'i sbyor lam rjes thob kyi dmigs rnam/ lnga pa sbyor lam la gnas pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ drug pa sbyor lam rtse sbyor yin pas so// chos bshes kyis/ sbyor lam lan bcu gsum bstan zer ba ni/ de dag gi steng du sems bskyed bzhi pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos drug gi dang po bzhi dang*/ go 'jug dang*/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga dang*/ sbyor ba nyi shu'i kha cig dang*/ mthar gyis bya ba rnams bsnan pa ste/ de rnams kyang kha cig don tha dad/ kha cig tshig tha dad/ la la rgyu'i sgo nas/ la la 'bras bu'am rtags kyi sgo nas/ la la mdor bstan/ la la rgyas bshad/ thams cad la dgos pa tha dad re yod pas zlos pa'i nyes pa med do// ji skad du/ smra ba'i dam pa khyod kyi bka'// rnam grangs du ma nyid mchis shing*// zlos bu yang ni ma mchis la// sbyor ba'i lugs kyi rigs pa lags// zhes so// phyogs glang gis/ shes rab pha rol phyin la brten// mdor bsdus don ni 'di dag yin// slar yang don gzhan la brten nas// don de nyid ni bzlas pa yin// zhes so// gsum pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ legs bshad du bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ tshigs bcad bco lnga yod pa de la/ shes nas brgyad kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis ni chos can/ yum gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/

brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po brgyad kyi don bsdus (147) nas dang por bstan pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa sems bskyed nas brjod kyi bar tshigs bcad lhag ma bcu gsum gyis ni chos can/ yum gyi lus rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ tshigs bcad dang po de dag nyid kyi don bsdus nas bshad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ tshigs bcad bco lnga chos can/ yum gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ lngar bstan pa de ltar na dang po gnyis kyis mdor bsdus pa dang lhag ma bcu gsum gyis rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ rnam par ma bkrol zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ bstan bcos kyi bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lus rnam gzhag rnams ni'o// gang gis na/ seng bzang bdag gis so// de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bkrol mi dgos shing*/ bkrol na nyes pa yod pa'i phyir ro// dang po ni/ bstan bcos mdzad pa po rje btsun nyid kyis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes bya ba dang*/ sogs pa 'phrin las kyi bar 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis lus rnam gzhag 'di 'chad pas/ yan lag rgyas bshad de dag rnam par bshad pas lus rnam gzhag bshad par bsam ste'o// gnyis pa gong 'og gnyis kar bkrol na/ zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas so// dngos brgyad lus mdzes rgyan bzang bdun cus spras// grangs dang go rim nges pa'i gos bzang can// zlos pa'i dri ma kun dang rnam bral ba'i// lus 'di mthong na mkhas rnams chags par 'gyur// bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad do// //gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'jug yul mkhyen gsum/ 'jug pa sbyor bzhi/ zhugs 'bras chos sku'i yan lag rgyas bshad do// dang po la/ 'bras bu thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen/ rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes/ rgyu'i blang dor thun mong ma yin pa gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas bshad gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/

brjod bya chos bcu bshad/ skabs bsdu ba'o// dang po la/ bshad par (148) bzhed de zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rnam mkhyen nyid de brjod byar bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i don no// gang gi sgo nas na/ sems bskyed la sogs pa'i rnam par te/ bye brag tu bshad cing gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas so// gang gi tshe na/ sngar bshad pa de ltar sher phyin gyis bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag kun bstan nas de'i rjes su'o// gang du na/ skabs brgyad kyi dang por ro// der ston pa ci ste zhe na/ thob par bya dgos pa'i 'jug yul yin pa'i phyir zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rnam mkhyen nyid do// gang gis na/ shes rab kyi stobs kyi byang chub la dmigs pas byang chub kyang yin la/ snying rje'i bsam pas sems can la dmigs pas sems dpa' yang yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' ste/ mi gtsang ba la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mi gtsang ba zhes zer ba bzhin no// de'ang byang chub chen po sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su thob par 'dod pas so// de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ched du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ lam gyi rang bzhin byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ de rnam par dag byed gdams ngag nod pa/ de bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag gdams pa'i don phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'o// dang po la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la gnyis te/ sems bskyed sdom pa'i rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa dang*/ de yang dag par blangs te bslab pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin/ sdom pa'i rang bzhin/ de dag gi khyad par ro// dang po la/ rgyu ngo bo 'bras bu gsum mo// rgyu la gnyis te/ skye ba'i dang*/ ldog pa'i rgyu'o// dang po la/ byang sems kyi sa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul mthong ba'am/ gzhan las thos pa/ theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa/

byang chub sems dpa'i chos nub tu nye bar mthong ba/ snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs par mthong (149) ba ste/ rkyen bzhi dang*/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa/ snying rje che ba/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mi 'jigs pa ste/ rgyu bzhi dang*/ rang dang*/ gzhan dang*/ rgyu dang*/ sbyor ba'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi ste/ bcu gnyis po so so'am/ tshogs pa la brten nas skye bar bshad do// 'on kyang 'dir bsdus na gsum ste/ sems bskyed chags pa'i rten/ nyer len gyi rgyu/ de'i rkyen no// dang po la/ lus dang*/ bsam pa'i rten gnyis las/ dang po lam shes skye rung gi gang zag lha dang mi la sogs pa'o// mdo las/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo yis// chos kyi sgron ma 'di bshad pa// de tshe lha mi stong phrag brgya// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can te/ dze ta ris skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhes 'byung bas so// gnyis pa la/ snying rje/ dad pa/ 'dod pa gsum las/ dang po ched du bya ba'i yul sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir ba la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po ste/ ji skad du/ de la thog mar rigs nus pas// snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing*// sbyor dang bsam pa phun tshogs las// byang chub sems ni rab tu gzung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ched du bya ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la yon tan can du shes pa'i dad pa ste/ dkon mchog sgron ma las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa// byang chub bla na med la dad gyur nas// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o// zhes sogs so// gsum pa ched du byed pa po rang gi ngang tshul legs par shes pas sangs rgyas la 'dod pa'i smon pa brtson 'grus dang bcas pa ste/

gang phyir sems can mir gyur pa// tshad med skad cig re re la// rdzogs pa'i byang chub de yi phyir// zhum pa dang du blang mi bya// zhes pa dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ byang chub tu smon (150) pa'i sems ni/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bya'o// zhes sems smon pa las skyes pa yin no// zhes so// 'jug pa sems bskyed la/ de'i steng du byang chub kyi rgyu la bslab par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dgos te/ rgyus 'bras bu bstan zhes pas so// gsum pa bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa dgos te/ sdud par/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungs// zhes so// 'o na/ de bzhin rigs dang ldan pa yang*// byang chub sems ni tshol bar byed// ces dkon brtsegs las bshad do// zhe na/ de ni/ sngar brjod pa'i nang du 'dus pas so// cho ga rgyur mi dgos sam zhe na/ sems bskyed la cho ga med kyang skye ba yang yod pas ma smros so// gnyis pa la/ sngar gyi rgyu rkyen de dag ma tshang na/ skye ba ldog go /'gal rkyen mi dgos pa dang*/ mi nus pa dang*/ skrag pa dang*/ sgyid lug pa ste/ smon pa'i mi mthun phyogs 'dzin pa dang*/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa slu ba dang*/ gzhan 'gyod pa bskyed pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ theg chen la zhugs pa'i sems can rnams la mi bsngags pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang*/ sgyu dang g.yos gzhan la nye bar spyod kyi/ lhag pa'i bsam pas ma yin pa ste/ nag po'i chos bzhi dang*/ log lta skyes pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ rigs dang mi ldan pa/ sdigs grogs kyis zin pa/ snying rje chung ba/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis skrag pa ste/ bzhi ldog pa'i rgyur bshad do// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi gtan la dbab pa dang gsum mo// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/

dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ gzhan don phun tshogs dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ngo bo snang ba can gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pas bskyed pa'i dam bca'o// zhe na/ so so skye bo chos can/ sems bskyed med par thal/ rdzogs pa'i

(151) byang chub kyi ngo bo snang ba med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zhi ba lhas/ so so'i skye bo la yang byang chub kyi sems skye ste zhes pa dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i/ mdo las/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ri rab dang mnyam pa bskyed kyang byang chub kyi sems skye zhing de las sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skye'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// rtags ma grub ste/ ngo bo rang mtshan pa mi snang yang rnam pa snang bas so// zhe na/ rnam pa snang bas ngo bo snang bar mi 'gyur te/ sgra rtag pa'i rnam pa snang yang ngo bo snang bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ don gyi ngo bo rig pa gang zhig gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba'o// spro ba che dang rtsom pa che// don che ba dang 'byung ba che// byang chub sems dpa'i sems pa che// don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba// zhes skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu go cha dang sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gnyis dang*/ don byed pa'i yon tan rang gzhan la phan pa'i che ba dang*/ 'bras bu yongs su 'dzin pa'i yon tan byang chub chen po 'grub pa dang ldan pa/ dmigs yul byang chub chen po dang sems can gyi don bya ba la dmigs pa'i sems pa 'byung ba/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bshad pa dang mthun no// gsum pa la/ gnyal zhig nas/ mtshan nyid des sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed la ma khyab bo// zhe na/ khyed rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par can sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod pa la'ang sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma khyab pa mtshungs so// bsgrub bya la sgrub par ming btags pas skyon med do// zhe na/ 'o na/ 'dir yang 'dod pa'i sgra/ 'dod pa po dang 'dod par byas zin pa gnyis ka la 'jug pas skyon med do// thub dgongs su/ 'o na/ don du gnyer ba ni/ rtog pa ste/ de dang lhan cig gyur pa'i sems de ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi yin zhe na/

bden te/ don du gnyer ba ni/ don du (152) gnyer bar byed pa po nyid de/ byed pa po'i chos sngon gyi sems so so dang*/ don du gnyer bar byas zin pa nyid de/ las kyi chos phyi ma'i sems so so yang ngo*// de'i phyir don du gnyer ba byas zin pa'i sems rnam par rtog pa med pa kho na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ste/ de yang mngon par 'dod pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ shes bya thams cad khong du chud pas byang chub/ de'i rgyur dge ba rgya chen po gsog pa'am bsags pas sems/ de rgyu phun sum tshogs pa las 'byung ba'am byung bas bskyed pa'o// gsum pa la/ ngo bo ngos gzung*/ de gtan la dbab/ de'i rab tu dbye ba gsum mo// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig sbyong phyogs mdzad pa zhang chog na re/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan gzhi smon lam yin te/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mchog ni/ sems bskyed pa'o// zhes pas so// zhe na/ de la rtogs pa phan tshun brten pa'i skyon yod de/ de rtogs pa sems bskyed rtogs pa la ltos pas so// gnyis pa ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis byang chub la dmigs/ snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa'i stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi yid shes dge ba/ 'khor sems byung ci rigs pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ 'phags pas/ sems ni/ rnam par shes pa ste/ rnam par rig pa'o// rnam par shes pa gang yin zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa de ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas so// de yang gnas ma gyur pa'i rnam gzhag yin gyi gnas gyur pa na ye shes nyid mtshan gzhir rtogs par bya'o// de las gzhan pa ni/ sgo lnga'i shes pa/ yul gzugs sogs la dmigs kyi/ gzhan don dang byang chub la mi dmigs/ kun gzhi dang nyon yid/ rtag tu lung ma bstan yin pas sems bskyed kyi mtshan gzhi min no// gsum pa ni/

byang sems 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs (153) dus na chos can/ sems bskyed med par thal/ yid shes med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems min par thal/ sems bskyed med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ gnas ma gyur pa'i dbang du byas nas de dus na sems bskyed mngon gyur med par thal par 'dod pa yin yang byang sems su mi 'gal te/ byang sems gnyid kyis log pa'i dus bzhin no// gnas gyur pa la ye shes yod pas khyab pa med do// gnyis pa ni/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod// rtag tu sems can phan par sems// chos la mos dang de bzhin de'i// ye shes tshol bar dmigs pa'o// gong du 'dun pa 'gro ba ste// sdom pa rgya chen de yi rten// lam 'gog pa ni mi mthun phyogs// slong zhing dang du len pa'o// bsod nams ye shes rang bzhin gyi// dge ba 'phel ba de phan yon// pha rol phyin la rtag sbyor ba// 'di yi nges par 'byung bar brjod// de yi mthar thug pa yin te// so so rang gi de sbyor bas// byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa// rnam par nges par shes par bya// zhes pa ltar bcu ste/ rtsa ba snying rje chen po/ bsam pa rtag tu sems can thams cad la phan par sems pa/ mos pa theg chen gyi chos la mos pa/ dmigs pa theg chen de'i ye shes tshol ba'i rnam par dmigs pa/ 'gro ba gong nas gong du 'dun pa/ rten byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa/ nyes dmigs mi mthun phyogs theg pa gzhan gyi sems slong zhing dang du len pas theg chen gyi lam gcod pa/ phan yon tshogs gnyis kyi dge ba 'phel ba/ nges par 'byung ba rtag tu phar phyin la goms pa/ mthar thug sa so so'i rang gi sa la sbyor bas/ gang zhig sa gang la zhugs pa'i sa de ni/ de'i mthar thug pa'o// gsum pa la/ ngo bo dang*/ skye tshul dang*/ sa mtshams dang*/ grogs dang*/ bzhed tshul gyis dbye ba ste/ lnga'o// dang po ni/ smon 'jug gnyis te/

'di la/ lo tsā ba na re/ byang chub ma thob pa na thob par smon pa (154) smon pa sems bskyed/ byang chub thob nas phar phyin drug la 'jug pa 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pas so so skye bo la med do// zhe'o// sangs rgyas ye shes kyis kyang*/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi yin la/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ rab tu dga' ba nas brtsams te'o// zhes bshad do// gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos 'di bzhed mod/ 'thad par ma mthong ste/ so so skye bo la chos can/ byang chub kyi lam nas 'gro ba lta bu'i sems bskyed med par thal/ 'jug pa sems bskyed med pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang rgya mtsho sprin gyis so so skye bo la yod pa bshad pa dang yang 'gal lo// 'jug pa sems bskyed chos can/ cho ga la brten nas thob pa mi srid par thal/ so so skye bo la med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ spyod 'jug tu/ mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur na// de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs// rgyun mi chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*// zhes sogs dang 'gal lo// yang slob dpon skal ldan na re/ 'dun sogs gsum gyis dbye ba las// smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum// 'jug pa zhes bya'i sems rnams ni// bcu dgu rnams su 'dod pa yin// zhes sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi dang po gsum smon pa/ lhag ma bcu dgu 'jug pa yin pas tshogs lam na med do// zhes zer ba la'ang skyon snga mas reg go /des na lam du 'gro 'dod pa ltar/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par smon pa smon pa sems bskyed dam/ 'gro bzhin pa ltar/ sgrub pa la slob 'dod pa 'jug pa sems bskyed do// spyod 'jug tu/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi// bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// chos bshes kyis/

smon pa tsam cho gas ma blangs pa de smon pa/ cho gas blangs nas (155) bar chad med lam gyi bar 'jug par bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ blangs pa brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed/ chos nyid kyis thob pa don dam pa'i sems bskyed gnyis so// dang po ni/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad// ces gzhan gyis bstan cing rnam par rig byed las sems bskyed pa ni/ brda las byung ba ste/ de la grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs dang*/ rgyu rigs kyi stobs dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rigs rgyas pa'i stobs dang*/ theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa'i stobs dang*/ tshe 'dir thos bsam sogs dge ba yang yang goms pa'i stobs las byung ba ste/ lnga las/ dang po mi brtan pa/ lhag ma bzhi brtan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod// chos dang sems can rnams dang ni// de yi bya ba sangs rgyas nyid// mchog la sems mnyam rnyed pa'i phyir// de yis rab dga' khyad par 'phags// skye ba rgya chen de la spro// bsam pa yang ni dag pa dang*// lhag ma dag la mkhas pa dang*// nges par 'byung bar shes par bya// zhes pas don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa de yang sa rab tu dga' bar thob ste/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas chos la sems mnyam/ bdag gzhan mnyam par rtogs pas sems can la/ bdag gi sdug bsngal dang 'dra bar gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zad par 'dod pas sems can gyi bya ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid dang bdag dbyer med par rtogs pas sangs rgyas la sems mnyam pa thob pa'o// de yang khyad par drug ste/ theg chen chos la mos pa'i sa bon sher phyin skyed byed kyi ma/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba'i mngal/

snying rje skyong ba'i ma ma ste/ bzhis skye ba'i khyad par/ smon lam (156) chen po bcu sgrub pas rgya che ba/ dka' spyad yun ring pos mi skyo bas spro ba/ byang chub dang nye bar shes shing de'i thabs shes pas bsam pa dag pa/ sa gzhan gyi tshul la mkhas pas lhag ma la mkhas pa/ 'di ni rtog pa tsam mo// zhes sa rnam par bzhag pa de rtog pa nyid du shes la/ de nyid la mi rtog par yid la byed pas nges par 'byung ba'o// de ni bsgoms pas bskyed par bya ba yin gyi/ cho ga las mi skye ste/ sgom rim las/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa/ spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba/ shin tu gsal ba/ don dam pa'i spyod yul/ dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun bzhin du mi g.yo ba'o// de grub pa ni/ rtag tu gus pas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor goms par byas pa las 'gyur te/ zhes pas so// snga ma kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la cho ga las skye ba yang yod do// gsum pa la/ dngos kyi don dang*/ rtsod spang ngo*// dang po ni/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod// de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes pas mos spyod kyi sa la mos pa las byung ba/ sa bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam dag pa/ brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa la rnam par smin pa/ sangs rgyas sa la sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa la sems bskyed med de/ yod na/ sprin lta bu yod dgos pa la de med par/ rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa// sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam ston par 'dod pa shes pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ rgyal sras la yod pas sangs rgyas la mi khegs shing*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpar btags pa'ang yod pa'i phyir ro// 'o na/

dga' ldan gyi gnas na gnas pa la sogs pa rnam pa kun tu ston par rung zhes bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ (157) mi 'gal te/ 'og min du sangs rgyas nas de nyid 'dod khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa yod pa'i phyir ro// lang gshegs las/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag rnam spangs pa'i// 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa rnams ni 'dir 'tshang rgya// zhes pas so// bzhi pa la/ mi zad pa brgyad cu dang sbyar ba'i sems bskyed nyer gnyis te/ bskyed pa sa dang 'dra bar 'dod// ces sogs so// lnga pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod de/ de nas rang 'tshang rgya 'dod pa rdzi bo lta bu/ rang gzhan mnyam par 'tshang rgya 'dod pa mnyan pa lta bu/ thog mar rang sangs rgyas nas de nas sems can gyi don byed pa rgyal po lta bu dang gsum du bshad do// gsum pa la gnyis te/ gzhogs 'phyas brtse ba med pa'i tshig 'phags pa pha rol la smod pa'o// mdzod las/ nyams pa nyes dmigs kyi dang*/ thob pa phan yon gyi 'bras bu'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dam bca' nyams pas kun gyis smad// ming don 'phos pas rang gzhan la gnod// nyes pa lci bas ngan song du skye ba'o// dang po ni yar skyabs gnas/ mar sems can/ bar du rang bslus pas sangs rgyas mi mnyes/ sems can mi mgu/ rang don nyams shing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis smad pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo las/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ byang chub sems dpas sems can ma brgal ba bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir sems can thams cad la dbugs phyung la/ mang du thos pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i dge ba byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la yang brtson par mi byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni/ ji skad du smras pa de bzhin byed pa ma yin te/

lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la slu ba yin no// de lta bu de sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba'i lha rnams (158) kyis mthong na 'phya zhing gzhogs 'phyas byed la rnam par smod de zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po rgyal srid nyams pa ltar ming don shor nas tshe 'dir bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing me long dang byad bzhin nam/ 'go nad bzhin gzhan la'ang gnod do// brgyad stong par/ byang chub sems dpa' sun 'byin par rig par bya'o// byang chub sems dpa' sre dar rig par bya ste/ zhes pas so// gsum pa ni/ mtshams med pa bas ches cher lci ba'i phyir dmyal ba la sogs ngan song las mi thar zhing zhes te/ thar yang lam gol ba nyan rang du ltung ba ste/ sdud par/ sems bskyed de ni phas pham pas kyang shin tu lci// zhes pa dang*/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ cung zad cig bsam pa las ma byin na/ yi dwags su skye'o// dam bcas pa las ma byin na/ sems can dmyal bar 'gro'o// zhes pas so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ skyes thob kyi 'bras bu ngo mtshams bar skabs kyi 'bras bu yid bzhin gyi nor bu sems la rnyed pas dgos 'dod char bzhin du 'bab/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'o// dang po la/ rang don gzhan don gnyis don gsum mo// dang po ni/ sdig pas dben pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med cing*/ bsod nams rlabs chen thob pas mtho ris kyi bde ba thob par nges pa ste/ myong bar nges pa'i sdig pa zil gyis gnon pa ni/ spyod 'jug tu/ sdig pa stobs chen mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// zhes pa dang*/ ma nges pa'i sdig pa drung nas 'byin par spyod 'jug tu/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed// ces so// phyin chad mi gsog par yang*/
blo ldan sems mchog bskyed ma thag tu yang*// mtha' yas nyes par spyod las sems rab bsdams// zhes seng ge'i 'o ma ltar gsungs so//

(159) bsod nams rlabs chen thob par dpa' byin gyis zhus pa las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ste// de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur// sems can kun gyi bsod nams kyi// phung po ji snyed yongs bzung ba// de snyed byang chub sems dpa' yi// byang chub sems las rab tu 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhan don du rang sdug bsngal la dga' ba thob pas 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod gnas su gyur pa yin te/ gnyis 'phel byed pa rtag tu dge ba dang*// brtse ldan bde dang sdug bsngal dag gis dga'// zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug tu/ byang chub sems skyes gyur pa'i skad cig la// srid pa'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// rgyal ba rnams kyi sras zhes rab brjod cing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur// zhes so// shar ri'i sde pa'i lung las/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo// tha na byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dud 'gror gyur pa la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas mnyes/ sems can mgu/ rgyal bsras bcas kyis bsrung bskyab sba ba byed pas rang don 'grub ste/ bslab btus su/ 'di nyid de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes byed yin// sems can smin par byed pa'ang 'di nyid de// rang don yang dag 'grub pa'ang 'di nyid do// zhes so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rang don/ gzhan don/ gnyis don no// dang po ni/ klu sgrub kyis/ sems can skyob pa'i bsam pa can// de dag srid pa'i 'dam skyes kyang*// de byung nyes pas ma gos pas// chu yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhin// zhes skyes bu gsum gyi don 'grub par bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad yongs su grub

(160) pas nor bu rin po che lta bu'o// byang chub kyi sems ni/ 'khor ba'i chu na rgyu ba 'don pas lcags kyu lta bu'o zhes so// nges pa dang ma nges pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdor/ 'jam dpal/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la las/ phyogs bcu'i sems can btson rar bcug pa thams cad btson ra nas bton te 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i bde ba'am tshangs pa nyid kyi bde ba la bkod pa bas/ 'jam dpal/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang gis/ theg chen la mos pa la dad pa'i sems kyis blta ba thob cing*/ de'i bsngags pa yang brjod na/ 'di ni/ de bas bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed do// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ spyod 'jug tu/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel pa yi// mi zad gter kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o zhes sems bskyed pas mi gtsang ba'i lus sangs rgyas kyi skur sgyur bas gser 'gyur dang 'dra la/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu byed pas sa bon lta bu ste/ zhi ba lhas/ sdong po bkod par gsungs pa'i don bsdus te/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par sgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zungs// zhes so// dpa' bar 'gro ba 'di na blangs nas bslab btus/ las/ g.yo byas te byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'ang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gsungs na/ dge ba sna 'ga' byas te sems bskyed pa lta ci smos zhes so// gnyis pa la/ spyir chos nyid kyis thob pa bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa dang*/ yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba'i sdom pa gnyis las/

'di la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu gsum las/ dang po la/ skye ba'i dang*/ ldog pa'i rgyu gnyis (161) so// dang po la/ rten/ rgyu/ bdag rkyen gsum las/ dang po skyabs 'gro khyad par can yin te/ sdud par/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste// sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na// mkhas pas tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa dad pa snying rje 'dod pa gsum gyi steng du sdom pa'i rang bzhin legs par shes pa'i len par 'dod pa dgos te/ dkon mchog sprin las/ ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar spyod de/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa tsam gyis bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar mi nus kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas gang 'di mdo sde dang de dag las byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas bcas pa de dag la bdag gis bslab par bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa bla ma nus pa dang ldan pas cho ga rnam dag byas pa dgos te/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes so// byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar par/ lung nod pa thams cad dang*/ sdom pa gzung ba yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas la sgom pa lhur byed pa sdom pa dang ldan pa la nod do// dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du bsgoms te bdag gis ci nus pa dang sbyar zhing sdom pa gzung ngo*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu bdag rkyen de dag ma tshang na skye ba ldog la/ kun nas dkris pa chen pos rtsa ltung spyad pa dang*/ byang chub tu smon pa'i sems spangs pas rgyun ldog go /phul bas ldog par bsdu par mi brda 'phrod pa'i drung du 'bul ba dang ldan pa'i tshig rjod par byed pa dang zhes/

bshad do// rtsa (162) ltung ni/ zhi ba lhas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa// phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod// dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa// gnyis par thub pas gsungs pas na// tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la// ngur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang*// btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang*// rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang*// srog bral byed pa gsum pa yin// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang*// grong la sogs pa 'jig pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung bar rgyal bas gsungs// blo sbyangs ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang*// sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzlog pa dang*// so so thar pa yongs spangs te// theg pa che la sbyor ba dang*// slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs// spong bar 'gyur ba min zhes 'dzin// pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang*// rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu yis gzhan smod dang*// bdag ni zab mo bzod pa zhes// log pa nyid du smra ba dang*// dge sbyong chad pas gcod 'jug dang*// dkon mchog gsum ni sbyin byed dang*// sbyin pa len par byed pa dang*// zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang*// yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams// kha ton byed la sbyin pa rnams// de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste// sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu// rmi lam 'phags pa mkha' snying po'i// mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya// zhes bco brgyad dam bcu gsum mo// bsdu na bzhi'o// gnyis pa la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spang bya gzhi dang bcas pa spong ba'i sems pa dbang rgyun chags rnam par rig byed las thob pa ste/ des sdom pa min pa dang*/ nyan rang gi dang*/ chos nyid kyis thob pa bsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i brda byung gi sdom par mtshon no// zhi ba'i lhas/

spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol phyin gsungs te// de ltas de ni sems (163) nyid do// zhes so// bye brag tu mi dge ba mtha' dag spong ba dang*/ dge ba mtha' dag sgrub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don bya bar 'dod pa'i sems pa/ sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsum gyi mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ dge ba mtha' dag gi sdom du gyur pa dang*/ mi dge ba mtha' dag sdom zhing 'ching ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu bde ba'i mchog ster bas/ sdom pa'o// gsum pa la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi byang sems kyi sdom pa tsam mo// dbye ngo ni/ sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsum mo// tha dad ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de/ tshul khrims ngo bo gcig nyid/ mi dge ba spong ba/ dge ba sgrub pa/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i cha tha dad la sdom pa gsum du bzhag ste/ dper na/ nor bu gcig nyid/ mun pa sel/ nor sdud/ rims nad la phan pa bzhin no// grangs nges ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba la/ rang gzhan gyi bya ba gnyis su nges shing*/ gzhan gyi bya ba sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ rang gi bya ba la/ mi dge ba spong ba dang*/ dge ba sgrub pa gnyis su nges pas dang po sdom pa dang*/ gnyis pa dge ba chos sdud du nges so// gsum pa la gnyis te/ nyams pa nyes dmigs kyi dang*/ thob pa phan yon gyi'o// dang po ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis 'khrul bar gyur pa/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa las dang po pa bdag ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa thams cad sprugs par 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur zhing lha dang mi dang theg pa chen po'i bde ba las nyams par 'gyur/ ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba dang*/ 'khor ba na yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro// zhes so// ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/

tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gro der 'gro ste// de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus// zhes so// gnyis (164) pa la/ thun mong ba sngar dang 'dra ba la/ thun mong ma yin pa la/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o// dang po la/ las mtha' dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ skyes thob kyi tshul khrims gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrib gnyis bag chags kyis dag par bya ba'i phyir da lta nyid nas mi dge ba mtha' dag spang bar bya'o// zhes go cha bgos nas sbyor bas mi dge ba ci rigs spong ba dang*/ bde ba'i phar phyin sogs thob par bya ba'i phyir da lta nyid nas dge ba bsgrub par bya'o// zhes go bgos nas sbyor bas dge ba ci rigs su sgrub pa dang*/ sems can ma lus pa'i don byed pa'i 'phrin las kyi phyir da lta nyid nas sems can gyi don bya'o// zhes go bgos nas sems can gyi don ci rigs su byed pa rim pa bzhin du tshul khrims gsum gyi las mtha'o// gnyis pa ni/ las dang po pa la sdom pa'i tshul khrims gtso che bas yi dam gyi spyod pa yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi spyod pa bya la/ mos pa spyod pa la dge ba chos sdud gtso che bas ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa bya zhing*/ sa thob pa rnams la/ sems can don byed gtso che bas sems can bsten pa'i spyod pa bya'o// gsum pa ni/ 'gal rkyen ma byung na/ tshe rabs thams cad du tshul khrims rgyun chad med par rang gzhan gyi don phul du phyin pa tshul bzhin du mdzad pa chos tshol ba rtag tu ngu lta bu'am/ sems can smin par byed pa dga' mchog lta bu'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa gzhon nu nor bzang lta bu'o// gnyis pa spangs rtogs 'phrin las gsum mo// gsum pa la gnyis te/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi khyad par/ sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed rten dang brten pa'i khyad par yod la/ 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de/

skyabs gnas kyi go 'phang de thob par 'dod pas dpung gnyen du 'dzin cing khas len pa'i cha nas skyabs 'gro/ skyabs gnas kyi go 'phang de rang (165) gzhan gyi don du thob par 'dod pa'i blo bskyed pa'i cha nas sems bskyed de/ dper na/ rgyal sa thob par 'dod pas rgyal po la dpung gnyen zhu ba dang*/ rgyal sa thob 'dod kyi blo bskyed pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ dze ta ris/ gzhan don du sems bskyed par bya'o// zhes khas 'ches pa smon pa sems bskyed/ sems bskyed mi nyams par bsrung bar bya'o zhes zhes khas 'ches pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed/ gzhan don du byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa mtha' dag gzung bar khas 'ches pa smon pa'i sdom pa/ sdom pa bzung ba ltar slob par khas 'ches pa 'jug pa'i sdom pa yin pas sems bskyed brtan par byas nas phyis sdom pa len par bzhed do// rang lugs kyis/ sems bskyed dang sdom pa khyad par yod de/ sems bskyed sems can dang byang chub la dmigs pa'i sems yin la/ sdom pa ni/ spong ba'i sems pa dbang rgyun ldan yin pas sdom pa blangs nas ma btang bar du gnyid log pa dang brgyal ba'i dus su'ang yod pa'i phyir ro// gal te khyad par med na/ bslab btus kyi sems bskyed so so skye bo la yod par bsgrubs nas de'i rjes su/ ci/ sar ma tshud pa la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yod dam med ce na/ yod par rig par bya ste/ zhes bzlos par 'gyur ba dang*/ byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la// zhes bslab sems tha dad don med par 'gyur ro// yang na/ sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing zhes pa smon pa/ sems bskyed bslab pa la zhes pa 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pas/ de cho gas blangs nas ma btang bar du bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung bas smon 'jug gi sdom par 'gyur ro// sa skya pa'i zhal nas/ smon pa'i sems/ smon pa sems bskyed/

smon pa sems bskyed mi nyams par srung ba gsum/ 'jug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa sems bskyed/ 'jug pa sems bskyed mi nyams par srung ba gsum (166) las/ sems bskyed rkyang pa sdom pa ma yin la/ smon 'jug sems bskyed la/ mi mthun phyogs gzhi dang bcas pa spong sems yod na/ gnyis ka'ang sdom par 'gyur te/ sdom pa'i mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyir ro// 'o na/ zhi ba lhas/ byang chub smon pa'i sems la ni// 'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang*// ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du// bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba med// zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ de smon sems rkyang pa la dgongs so// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma'i lugs gnyis so// dang po ni/ sems tsam gyi gzhung lugs dang bstun pa/ rje btsun byams pa las brgyud pa/ slob dpon thogs med/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ jo bo rje la sogs pas phyag len du mdzad pa ste/ 'di la bzhi ste/ rten gyi khyad par ma skyes pa skyed pa'i khyad par/ skyes pa mi nyams par srung ba'i khyad par/ nyams na phyir bcos kyi khyad par ro// dang po ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom ldan zhig dgos te/ lam sgron las/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba'i dus su phyag dang mchod pa tsam byas te/ bslab pa brjod pa dang bar chad dri ba la sogs pa mdzad do// dngos gzhi smon pa sngar blangs nas 'jug pa phyis len no// mjug mkhyen par gsol ba la sogs pa mdzad do// gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba rnams mi 'byung bar sdom ste/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ rnyed dang bkur sti chags sogs kyis// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par// khros pas gzhan la brdeg pa dang*// theg pa chen po yongs spangs te// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o// zhes phas pham bzhi/
tshul khrims 'chal rnams yal bar 'dor// zhes pa la

(167) sogs pa nyes byas kun nas dkris pas byas pa nyon mongs pa can dang*/ brjed pa la sogs pas byas pa nyon mongs pa can min pa rnams so// bzhi pa ni/ smon pa'i sems spangs sam/ kun nas dkris pa chen pos pham pa bzhi spyad na sdom pa bskyar nas len/ 'bring gis spyad na gsum la bshags/ nyes byas rnams gcig la bshags so// sdom pa nyi shu par/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya// zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags// gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pa'i gzhung lugs dang bstun pa/ 'jam dpal las brgyud/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang zhi ba lha la sogs pas phyag len du mdzad pa ste/ 'di la'ang sdar bzhin bzhi las/ dang po ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan na/ rten phun sum tshogs par bya la/ med kyang chog ste/ dang po skye ba'i rten du ma nges te/ mdo las/ lha'i bu gang dag gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa de dag gis kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o// zhes pas so// skyes zin gnas pa'i rten du ma nges te/ dud 'gro'i rten la'ang gnas shing gzhan don du so so thar pa'i sdom pa phul nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa 'jug pa'i phyir ro// des na/ len 'dod dang brda shes don go na/ rgyal po'am/ lha la'ang skye'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba sems kyi tha ba sbyang*/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems kyi sa bon gdab/ rjes rang gzhan dga' ba bskyed de brtan par bya ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ rten bsham/ gsol ba gdab/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog gi rten la dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bya/ rdul re'i steng na rdul rnyed kyi sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par bsam/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pas ci 'byor dbul/ phun sum tshogs pa'i khri la (168)

bzhugs pa'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ dad pas yon phul/ maṇ+ḍal dang phyag phul/ thal mo sbyar te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bdag la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab la/ slob dpon gyis ji ltar nus pa bzhin du sbyin no zhes khas blang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ zhi lhas/ sdig pa bshags par bya ba dang*// bsod nams rjes su yi rang dang*// sangs rgyas bskul dang gsol gdab pa// bdag dang gzhan gyi phyir byed do// yongs su bsngo ba de bzhin te// bye brag med par rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems can khams bzhin du// bsod nams mtha' yas rab tu 'byung*// zhes pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bla ma dkon mchog la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis cho ga sbyor dngos thams cad byed par bsam la/ yan lag bdun pa dngos la/ mchod pa/ sdig bshags/ yi rang*/ 'khor lo bskor ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ bsngo ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bdun no// dang po la lnga/ bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba/ bkur sti'i mchod pa/ yo byad blos sprul pa/ lus 'bul ba/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing bstod pa byed par bsgom ste/ dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud nas ni bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes lan gsum phyag byas nas/ bstod pa ci shes pas bstod do// gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni/ yo byed kyi mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang*/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba dang*/ blos kyang dpag tu med par sbrul nas mchod par bsam zhing*/ me tog bdug pa mar me dang*// dri dang lha bshos nyid dang ni// na bza'

(169) dang ni rgyan dang gdugs// gar dang rol mo glu dbyangs ni// yid 'ong sangs rgyas spyod yul dag /nam mkha' mtha' dag kun khebs pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar ni// blos sprul nas ni bdag 'bul lo// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gis lus kun rnam pa kun tu 'bul// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag gi yon bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// zhes bya ba 'dis bdag gi lus sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya'o// lnga pa ni/ mchod par bya ba dang*/ mchod par byed pa dang*/ mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis dbyer med par dmigs te/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa blo yul du byas la/ bshags pa byas par bsgoms te/ thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag la// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa// bgyid du rtsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te// rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa// de ni 'gyod pas shin tu spang*// 'gyod par bgyis te bdag 'chags kyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis nyes pa la// nyes pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// mgon po slan chad bdag mi bgyid// ces brjod do// gsum pa ni/ bdag gis byas pa'i dge ba la dga' ba/ gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang ba bcos ma ma yin par bsgoms la/ zag bcas zag pa med pa yi// dge la dga' bas yi rang ngo*// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du// sangs rgyas (170) rnams la bdag bskul lo// zhes lus longs spyod phul bar dmigs te gsol ba gdab bo// lnga pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams// bskal pa mtha' yas bzhugs su gsol// zhes mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab bo// drug pa ni/

bdag gi dge kun ltos med par// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// zhes so// bdun pa dgongs su gsol ba 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas la ni skyabs su mchi'o// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ bsam pa sbyang ba dang*/ cho ga brjod pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar gyur pa yin la/ de thams cad ngan song dang 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di snying rje snyam pa'i bsam pas/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa thams cad sems can thams cad la sbyin zhing gzhan dbang bar bsgom/ da phyin chad bdag la rdeg 'tshog byed dam/ mi snyan pa brjod dam/ chags sdang byed pa thams cad sangs rgyas thob par smon/ bdag sems can thams cad la mkho ba'i longs spyod dang*/ bran dang*/ grogs pho mo dang*/ bza' ba la sogs pa ji tsam dgos kyi bar du lhun grub tu 'byung bar gyur cig ces zhe thag pas bya ste/ zhi ba'i lhas/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phangs pa med par gtang bar bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dpon slob gnyis ka ma yengs par byas la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas (171) dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i chen po rnams kyis ji ltar byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya ba'i phyir/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod do// yang na/

dgongs gsol sngar dang 'dra ba la/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no// zhes brjod/ slob mas legs so// zhes bya'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ rang dga' ba bskyed pa dang*/ gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag mi lus thob/ bstan pa dang mjal/ sngar bshad pa'i phan yon de dag dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed rgyud la skyes pas byang chub sems dpar gyur pas sngar ma shi ba don can du gyur/ da phyin chad byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la bslab snyam pas ngag tu/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med (172) btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod do// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyang dmangs pos bu rnyed pa ltar/ thugs dgyes pa skyed cig ces byas la bslab bya mdo tsam brjod/ gtang rag bzang po bya'o// gsum pa la gsum ste/ thun mong gi bslab bya mdor bstan/ so so'i bslab bya rgyas par bshad/ chos gcig gis don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi gcod pa// sems can blos mi spong ba ste/

bslab pa'i chos gsum/ ltung ba dang*/ ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan/ ltung ba med pa dang*/ ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan te/ shes par bya ba'i chos bzhi/ zhum pa/ sgyid lug pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes pas skrag pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems kyi mi mthun phyogs gsum spang ba la bslab pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'gal rkyen spang pa dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ nag po'i chos bzhi/ mi dge ba'i grogs po bsten pa/ bsam pa phrag dog pa/ rgyud 'khon du 'dzin pa/ nyer len mi gsod pa/ thams cad du dman pa la mos pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems mi 'phel ba'i rgyu drug spang ba la bslab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya snyam pa 'bras bu la smon pa/ sa dang lam thams cad la bslab par bya snyam pa thab la smon pa/ sems can thams cad kyi re ba bskang bar bya snyam (173) pa 'phrin las la smon pa ste/ skyes bu dam pa'i smon pa gsum dang*/ sngar gyi spang bya spong byed kyi gnyen po mtha' dag la bslab bo// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'gal rkyen spang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyor ba'i skyon gzhan smin pa la rang smin dgos pas rang smin pa'i gegs thos pa la mi mos/ bsam pa la g.yel/ sgom pa la lhod pa ste/ shes rab kyi gegs gsum/ sbyor ba le lo che ba/ spyod pa gzhan ma dad pa/ dngos gzhi'i dus su phan mi 'dogs/ 'dogs kyang chos ma yin pas 'dogs pa dang*/ rjes lam gol ba la sbyor ba ste/ gzhan don mi 'grub pa'i rgyu lnga spong ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mi nyams pa'i rgyu dang*/ 'phel ba'i rkyen la bslab pa'o// dang po la/ tshe 'dir mi nyams pa'i rgyu/ sems bskyed skyes pa'i phan yon/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ rnyed dka' ba dran pa ste gsum/ phyi mar mi nyams pa'i rgyu/ yan lag bdun pa dus gsum du byed pa/

rgyal ba sras bcas la gsol ba 'debs pa/ bdud las shes te 'bad pas spong ba ste/ phyin ci ma log pa'i thabs gsum/ 'di phyi thams cad du mi nyams pa'i rgyu/ sems can thams cad la rang bas gces/ spyir chos la nor bu rin po che bas gces/ bye brag tu byang chub kyi sems la dge ba gzhan pas lhag cing mig 'bras pas gces/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dmigs bu bas gces/ 'byung 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas la sems can rang gi 'tsho ba bas gces pas myur du thob par 'dun pa ste/ bla na med pa'i 'dun pa lnga la bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ srog gi phyir yang rdzun mi smra ba/ gdul bya theg chen la sbyor ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes/ sems can thams cad la (174) lhag pa'i bsam pas spyod pa ste/ dkar po'i chos bzhi dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi la bslab bo// gsum pa ni/ dpal phreng seng ge sgras zhus pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad smon lam chen po gcig gi nang du 'dus te/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par ro// zhes dang*/ seng ges zhus par/ grong dang grong khyer rnams su'am// gang du gnas pa'i yul rnams su// byang chub la ni yang dag 'dzud// des ni sems 'dor mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rgyal po la gdams par/ rgyal po chen po khyod/ 'di ltar bya ba mang ste/ nyin mtshan du sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar du bslab par mi nus te/ de bas na/ khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dad pa dang don du gnyer ba dang smon pa rtag par rgyun du dran pa gyis la yid la bzung ste sgoms shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rang nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa bya bar phul cig phul nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar nyin gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shig

rgyal po chen po khyod de ltar byed na/ rgyal srid kyang byed la rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur la/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa yi ge med pa za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po las/ rigs kyi bu/ gang byang chub sems dpa' rtag par rgyun du mngon par bsrung bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' gang bdag mi 'dod pa (175) de gzhan la mi bya'o// rigs kyi bu/ gang la la zhig gis chos gcig po de bsrungs na/ des de bzhin gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ gang bdag gi srog phangs par 'dzin pa des gzhan gyi srog mi gcod do zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bslab bo// bzhi pa ni/ zhi lhas/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems bsten pas// ltung ba'i lhag med zhi bya// zhes pa ltar rtsa ltung byung ba nyi ma'i sum cha 'das na gtong bas/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa byas la slar blang*/ nyes pa gzhan rnams phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la sogs pas bshags par bya'o// yang na/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa nyes pa dang bcas pas tho rangs kyi thun las langs te/ kha shar phyogs su bstan de 'dug la lha'i bu skya rengs la gsol ba gdab par bya ba 'di skad du brjod/ skya rengs skya rengs thugs rje chen po can/ skal pa chen po can khyod/ 'dzam bu'i gling du shar ma thag tu bdag la thugs rjes 'gebs par mdzod cig byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje can la bdag gi tshig gis sbron te/ bdag gi rmi lam du yang de ston par 'gyur zhing bdag gi thabs des ltung ba bshags par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po la thabs dang ye shes thob par mdzod cig ces smras nas/
des de'i tshe mal du gnyid log par bya ste/ skya rengs 'dzam bu'i gling du shar ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po 'dir 'ong

(176) bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de'i rmi lam du tha mal par mdun du 'dug ste ltung ba'i rtsa ba de yang 'chags su 'jug ces gsungs pa bzhin bya'o// yang dang yang du sems bskyed blang par bya'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ rab dbye/ sa mtshams so// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sems bskyed pa'i rang gi ngo bo gang la dmigs pa'i yul dang bcas pa gsungs pa/ rtsa ba ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa'o// mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' ci nas bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don bsgrub par bya'o// zhes de ltar don du gnyer bar byed pa yin no// zhes pa ltar ro// 'grel pa la/ mtshan nyid can gyi dbye ba dang*/ mtshan nyid la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su grub nas ched du bya ba gzhan gyi don gyi phyir gdul bya'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum gyi chos bstan pa la sogs pas 'bad par bya'o zhes sems pa de/ mtshan gzhi/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par mtshon/ gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa de'i mtshan nyid do// de yang 'gro bar 'dod pa dang 'gro ba'i bye brag ltar 'bras bu tsam thob par 'dod pa smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du sgrub pa la 'jug pa 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis so// gnyis pa la/ rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid ni chos can/ ji ltar na/ sems bskyed pa yin par 'gyur te/ ma yin par thal/ sems las byung ba yin (177) pa'i phyir/ la ni/ mtshams sbyar ro// rtags grub ste/ 'dod pa ni/ gzhan don byang chub de thob par don du gnyer ba yin pas 'dun pa'i bye brag dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa yin pa'i phyir ro// khyab pa yod de/

sems bskyed pa ni/ sems byung dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems/ yul khyad par du 'phags pa gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs par snang ba can du 'byung ba min nam ste/ yin pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ lan la/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa dang*/ grogs ming grogs can la btags pa'i lan gnyis so// dang po la/ 'dod pa de sems bskyed dngos min par thal zer ram/ 'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa min par thal zer/ dang po la/ 'dod pa de sems bskyed dngos min pa bden mod kyi ste/ 'dod pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ ma nges te/ 'dod pa dngos min pa 'on kyang sems bskyed ston pa'i skabs 'dir sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i ming gis nye bar btags pa la brten pa yin pas sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa med do// 'di la/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu ni/ sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor nub pa la bltas nas de 'don par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi don du gnyer ba yod na/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'gyur bas rgyu 'dod pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed la btags nas bstan pa yin no// te ni/ gzhan 'dren pa'o// btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de ltar na/ gzhan don don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i chos sems bskyed la sogs pa thams cad/ rnam par te/ khyad par du 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir btags so// gnyis (178) pa la/ lan gyi rnam pa gcig tu na/ grogs ming gis btags pa yin no// 'dogs pa'i rgyu ni/ sems bskyed kyi grogs smon lam ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa ste/ de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid yin la/ smon lam de dang lhan cig spyod cing mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed la smon lam de'i sgrar btags nas bstan no// sems bskyed pa'i skabs na/

don gnyer gtso che ba'i phyir ro// dgos pa ni/ de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la byang chub thob 'dod kyi smon lam dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed de skye'o// zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir btags pas 'di 'thad pa yin no// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ snga 'grel/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa/ don bsdu/ mdo gzhan ma bris pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la/ yang ni/ rim pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// blo'i ngo bo gang*/ 'dod pa'i bdag nyid ni/ gang*/ dgos pa gang gi don du sems bskyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de ni gang yin/ gzhan gyi don ni/ gang yin zhe na dri ba'o// gnyis pa la/ brjod ces drang ngo*// gang na/ byang chub de dang gzhan don de ni'o// gang gi sgo nas na/ mdor bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so// ji ltar du na/ mdo nas bshad pa bzhin du'o// gsum pa la/ bstan te zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang*/ gzhan gyi don no// gang gi sgo nas na/ bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas so// ji ltar na/ blo gros mi zad pa dang*/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i don dang mi 'gal bar ro// gang las na/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnam pa gsum char las kyang ngo*// kyang ni/ mdo gzhan bsdu ba'o// gang gis (179) na/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya'o// zhes byang chub shes par byed pa'i don can gyi ngag gis byang chub mdor bstan no// rgyas bshad sbyin pa la sogs pa thams cad la sbyar te bshad pa ni/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chen po mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis sher phyin la gnas te/ sbyin par bya ba dang sbyin pa po dang len pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su btang ba med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsgrub par bya'o// sogs pa ltung ba dang mi ltung ba'i bya ba med pa'i phyir tshul khrims/

'khrugs pa med pa'i phyir bzod pa/ lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa'i phyir brtson 'grus/ ro myang ba med pa'i phyir bsam gtan/ shes rab dang shes rab 'chal pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir sher phyin yongs su bsgrub par bya'o// zhes byang chub shes par byed pa'i don can gyi ngag gis byang chub rgyas par bshad do// gdul bya'i skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du myang 'das la dgod pas gzhan don bstan te/ sems can gang zhig yod pa de dag thams cad phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bsgrub par bya'o// zhes gzhan don rab tu ston pa lhur len pa'i ngag gis gzhan don mdor bstan no// sems can ser sna can rnams ni/ sbyin pa la/ sogs pa tshul khrims 'chal pa rnams ni/ tshul khrims la/ gnod sems mang ba rnams ni/ bzod pa la/ le lo can rnams ni/ brtson 'grus la/ sems rnam par (180) g.yeng ba can rnams ni/ bsam gtan la/ shes rab 'chal ba rnams ni/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la dgod par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas/ sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// zhes gzhan don rab tu ston pa lhur len pa'i ngag gis gzhan don rgyas par bshad do// de dag gis dri ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i lan bstan to// bzhi pa ni/ bshad pa'i tshul de ltar na/ sems bskyed pa ni/ ched du bya ba gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ dmigs yul yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs nas/ blo'i ngo bo dngos por zhen pa med par sgyu ma ltar 'dod pa'i bdag nyid yin par shes par bya'o// 'dis dri ba dang po'i lan bstan to// lnga pa ni/ gal te/ byang chub dang gzhan don mdo rnams las gsungs na/ ji ltar gsung smos dgos so// zhe na/ gtsug lag gi gzhung ste/ mdo/ skabs kyi don byang chub dang gzhan don ston pa lhur len pa ni/

rgyas 'bring thams cad las kyang gsungs mod kyi/ tshig mang na/ gdul bya'i blo 'khrugs par 'gyur du dogs nas shes byed kyi khungs nyid du ma bris kyi/ brjod mi nus pa ma yin no// gsum pa la bzhi las/ snga 'grel ni/ tshul de ltar sems bskyed pa dmigs pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo dang bcas pa brjod nas bshad de zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sems bskyed pa de'i rab tu dbye ba rnam pa nyer gnyis po/ gang gis na/ sngar sems bskyed mdor bsdus te gsungs pa'i khyad par gyi rab tu dbye ba rgya cher bstan pa'i skabs kyi khongs su gtogs pas na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad kyis so// 'og gi bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad thams cad kyang des shes par bya'o// dus gang gi tshe na/ skabs su bab pas da ni ste/ da lta'o// rtsa ba la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi sems bskyed tsam de yang ngo*// dbye ngo*/ 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa sa lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du (181) sbyar te/ bsam pa dang ldan pa gser/ lhag bsam dang ldan pa zla ba/ sbyor ba dang ldan pa me/ sbyin pa dang ldan pa gter/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa rin chen 'byung gnas/ bzod pa dang ldan pa mtsho/ btson 'grus dang ldan pa rdo rje/ bsam gtan dang ldan pa ri/ shes rab dang ldan pa sman/ thabs dang ldan pa bshes gnyen/ smon lam dang ldan pa yid bzhin nor bu/ stobs dang ldan pa nyi ma/ ye shes dang ldan pa klu/ mngon shes dang ldan pa rgyal po/ tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa mdzod/ byang chub phyogs mthun dang ldan pa lam po che/ snying rje lhag mthong dang ldan pa bzhon pa/ gzungs spobs dang ldan pa bkod ma'i chu/ chos kyi dga' ston dang ldan pa sgra snyan/ bgrod gcig lam ldan chu bo/ chos kyi sku ldan sprin lta bu rnams so// tha dad ni/ ci rigs pa ste/ dang po ni/ phyi ma rnams kyi rgyu kho na'o// phyi ma gnyis ni/ snga ma rnams kyi 'bras bu kho na'o// bar pa rnams phyi ma'i rgyu dang snga ma'i 'bras bu gnyis ka'o// grangs nges ni/

sems bskyed rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bdag nyid can gyi sems bskyed so so skye bo nas sangs rgyas la yod pa'i bar gyi smon 'jug thams cad bsdus pas ma tshang ba'ang min/ lhag pa'ang min par de kho nar nges so// 'grel pa ni/ grogs dang dpe dang chos mthun pa'i rtags rnams grangs bzhin du sbyar te bshad pa ni/ gzhan don gyi ched du byang chub la 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed chos can/ lo tog skye ba'i gzhi sa lta bu yin te/ chos dkar po sangs rgyas kyi chos dang*/ de'i rgyu tshogs thams cad skye ba'i gzhi'am/ rten gyi dngos po byed pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu nas brtson par bya'o'i bar byang chub mdor bstan bzhin no// phyin drug gis bsdus pa 'di phyi la phan bde'i bsam pa dang ldan pa ni/ mi 'gyur bas gser bzang po 'dra ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur bar gnas pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu nas bya'o'i (182) bar byang chub rgyas bshad bzhin no// byang chub phyogs mthun sogs khyad par rtogs par 'dod pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa ni/ dkar phyogs kyi zla ba tshes pa ste/ gsar pa 'dra ste/ dge ba'i chos dran pa nyer gzhag sogs mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mdo ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bya'o// zhes so// mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba mchog tu gyur pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni/ me dang 'dra ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i bud shing sreg pa'i phyir/ 'di la/ bud shing gis me 'phel ba ltar sbyor ba khyad par du 'gro ba'o// zhes gzhan du mang pos bshad do// mdo ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid la shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas sher phyin bsgom par bya'o zhes so// 'di dang snga ma gnyis dkon brtsegs dang rgyan las go ldog ste bshad pa ni/

gnyis ka yang gnyis kar 'byung bar bshad par byed pa'o// sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa ni/ dung sogs gter chen po 'dra ste/ zang zing longs spyod kyis sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa dang mi zad pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sems can ser sna can rnams sbyin pa la 'jog par 'dod pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sbyin pa rnams sems bskyed pa gcig gis zil gyis gnon par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen pos sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// zhes so// gzhan lnga la'ang de bzhin du sbyar ro// tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas dang 'dra ste/ yon tan rin po che thams cad 'byung zhing skye ba'i rten gyi dngos po byed pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ tshul khrims 'chal sogs so// bzod pa dang ldan pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ste/ mi 'dod pa nyam nga ba'i me dang mtshon la sogs pa thams cad thog tu bab pas kyang sems mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir ro// mdo (183) ni/ gnod sems can sogs so// brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni/ rin po che rdo rje dang 'dra ste/ byang chub rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa brtan pas bdud las kyis mi phyed/ phar bdud las kun 'joms pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ le lo can la sogs/ bsam gtan dang ldan pa ni/ ri'i rgyal po lhun po 'dra ste/ mtshan mar dmigs pa'i rnam par g.yeng bas mi bskyod cing mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sems rnam par g.yeng sogs so// shes rab dang ldan pa ni/ sman chen po 'dra ste/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang*/ rtog pa shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ shes rab 'chal sogs so// phyin drug gi dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dra ste/ tshad med bzhis gnas skabs thams cad du sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ste/

yal bar mi 'dor pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sems bskyed pa gcig tsam yang thabs mkhas pas rnam mkhyen nyid du yongs su bsngos pas mi zad par byed 'dod sogs so// gang gis skye ba thams cad du phyin drug la spyod par 'gyur ba'i smon lam chen po bcu sogs dang ldan pa ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dra ste/ yid kyis ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku sgrub par 'dod sogs so// nyi ma so sor de rnams la spyod pa dang sgom pa dang so sor rtog pa'i stobs dang ldan pa ni/ nyi ma 'dra ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis gdul bya'i lo tog yongs su smin par byed pa ste/ myang 'das gsum thob par byed pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ yo byad rnams kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya bar 'dod sogs so// theg chen gyi dgongs pa ji lta bar shes pa'i ye shes kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa ni/ dri za'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs sam klu snyan pa dang 'dra ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis gdul bya 'dun cing dad par byed pa'i chos ston

(184) pa'i phyir/ phar phyin ni/ gong ma dgu la'ang sbyar ro// mdo ni/ sbyin pa 'di ltar byin pas ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par nus so zhes shes so zhes so// zag zad sogs mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa ni/ rgyal po chen po dang 'dra ste/ mthu thogs pa med pas rton pa bzhis gzhan gyi don chud mi za bar sgrub pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon par shes pa mngon sum du bya bar 'dod cing yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du mi bya bar 'dod sogs so// sbyin sogs bsod nams dang shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa ni/ rdzas mang po bzhag pa'i bang mdzod dang 'dra ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang po'i mdzod de/ gnas lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad bsod snyoms gcig gis khyad par bya bar 'dod sogs so// sbyin sogs byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos so bdun dang ldan pa ni/ lam po che dang 'dra ste/ 'das pa dang da ltar gyi 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs shing ma 'ongs pa rnams rjes su gshegs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rjes su thob par 'dod sogs so// brtse ba snying rje dang lhag mthong shes rab dang ldan pa ni/ bzhon pa rta cang shes 'dra ste/ thabs shes zung du 'gro bas srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa gang du yang mi ltung bar sems can gyi khur bde blag tu khyer te 'gro ba'i phyir/ mdo ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sngon du 'gro bar 'dod sogs so// chos kyi don 'dzin pa'i gzungs dang*/ gzhan la ston pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa ni/ chu 'dzin cing mi zad par 'byon pa'i bkod ma'i chu dang 'dra ste/ sngar thos pa dang sngar ma thos thos 'gyur gyi chos 'dzin cing mi zad par ston nus pa'i phyir/

mdo ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bshad pa dang 'chad pa dang (185) 'chad par 'gyur ba dang ji snyed pa 'di lta ste/ mdo dang zhes pa nas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis ma thos pa gang yin pa de gzung bar 'dod sogs so// chos kyi sdom bzhi'i dga' ston dang ldan pa ni/ sgra snyan pa ste/ lha'i rnga sgra'am/ thos na bdud rtsis tshim par 'gyur ba kun dga' ba'i sgra 'dra ste/ srid zhi las thar pa'i byang chub chen por thob par 'dod pa'i gdul bya la snyan pa sdom bzhi sogs sgrog pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ sems can gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang chos kyi sgra dang dge 'dun gyi sgra yang dag par sgrog par 'dod pa dang*/ sems can de dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la sbyar bar 'dod sogs so// sa bcu pa man chad las khyad par du 'phags pa bla na med pa'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang ldan pa ni/ chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ste/ shes pa dang shes bya mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i thabs shes dang thugs rjes gzhan gyi don bya ba tha mi dad par rgyun du 'byung ba'i phyir/ mdo ni/ mun pa'i mthus ldongs par gyur pa'i sems can gang yin pa de dag mig gis gzugs mthong bar bya bar 'dod sogs so// chos kyi sku sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang ldan pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi 'byor pa 'byung ba'i sprin lta bu ste/ thabs la mkhas pas dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa dang*/ sogs pa 'phos nas lhums su 'jug pa sogs kun tu ston par rung ba ste/ nus pa'i phyir ldan pa ni dang*/ lta bu ste gnyis kun la sbyar ro// dang ni/ bsdu ba'o// mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam ston par 'dod pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa dang tshul rnam par dag pa dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i 'phrin las dang gsung gi 'phrin las dang thugs kyi 'phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba dag pa dang*/ glang po che'i lta stangs kyis lta bar 'dod pas sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// zhes so// don bsdu ni/ grogs dang*/ dpe dang*/ byed pa gsum bstan pa de ltar na ste/ de'i phyir/ de yang sa (186) gser zla ba me// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sems bskyed pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo dang mthun par bshad pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba ni chos can/ las dang po pa'i sa nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin no// tshogs lam chung ngu nas sprul sku'i bar gyis bsdus pa de lta na ste/ de'i phyir/ ma grub bo// zhe na/ de sgrub pa ni/ tshogs sbyor/ sa bcu/ khyad par gyi lam/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa lnga las/ dang po ni/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis spyir bstan pa de la zhes pa/ dmigs kyis bsal ba la bdun pa'o// bsdus zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sems bskyed pa dang po 'dun pa bsam pa lhag bsam dang ldan pa gsum ni'o// gang gis na/ theg chen las dang po pa'i sa/ tshogs lam gyis so// ji ltar na/ dang po tshogs lam chung ngu dang bar pa 'bring dang tha ma chen po nyid kyis so// gnyis pa ni/ bsdus so// gang na/ gsum po de'i 'og tu gcig sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni'o// gang gis na/ sa dang po la 'jug pa sbyor ba'i lam gyis so// gsum pa ni/ bsdus te'o// gang na/ bzhi po de'i 'og tu sbyin pa nas ye shes dang ldan pa'i bar bcu'o// gang gis na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*/ sogs pa chos kyi sprin gyi bar sa bcus so// dang po mthong lam dang*/ phyi ma rnams sgom pa'i lam gyi spyod yul can yin no// bzhi pa ni/ bsdus so// gang na/ bcu bzhi po de'i 'og tu mngon shes dang ldan pa sogs lnga ni'o// gang gis na/

khyad par gyi lam sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyis so// zhes a bh+ya dang chos bshes so// dag pa'i sar 'dod pa'ang yod do// lnga pa ni/ bsdus so// gang na/ bcu dgu po de'i 'og tu sems bskyed pa tha ma gsum ni'o// gang gis na/ sangs rgyas kyi sas so// ji ltar na/ byang sems kyi sa dang 'brel pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ dngos te/ sangs rgyas sa'i mnyam gzhag dang*/ mjug ste/ rjes thob kyis rim pa bzhin bsdus so// a bh+ya ni/ (187) dngos/ sku gnyis sam ye shes snga ma bzhi yin la/ mjug sprul sku'am bya sgrub ye shes yin no// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus par mi 'thad de/ byang sems kyi sas bsdus pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// sa mtshams de dag kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gdams ngag bcu spyir bstan pa dang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ snga 'grel/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa/ grangs nges kyi sgo nas don bsdu dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba zhar la brjod nas de'i rjes la gdams ngag 'chad pa la/ 'doms zhes drang ngo*// gang la na/ byang chub kyi sems dang po 'dun ldan dang*/ sogs pa gnyis pa la sogs pa bskyed pa'i byang sems la'o// gang gi tshe na/ sems bskyed rnams kyi sa mtshams du dgos pa gnyis kyi phyir gdams ngag don du gnyer bar byed pa'i dus ji lta ba bzhin du ste/ de'i dus su'o// gang gi don du na/ rgyu'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang sems bskyed des 'phangs pa'i chos 'bras bu'i sems bskyed sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams sam/ bslab bya rnams 'grub par bya ba'i phyir te/ rjes bstan gyi dgos pa'o// snga ma'i yon tan thob pa rnams mi nyams par yongs su bsrung ba'i don nam/ dbang gis gong ma gong ma'am mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir te/ gdams pa'i dgos pa'o// gang gis na/

sangs rgyas kyis so// de dag gis gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid bstan no// gnyis pa la/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sgrub pa'i rgyu gdams ngag gi ni'o// ji ltar na/ grangs bcu'i bdag nyid du'o// gang gi phyir na/ yul bcur nges pa'i phyir ro// yul bcu gang zhe na/ sems bskyed dang*/ des 'phangs pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid yum la mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa 'jug pa sgrub pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de'i dmigs yul bden pa bzhi po rnams dang*/ (188) rten sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa chos la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang*/ de nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ lus ngag gi bde ba la ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ bgrod bya ji srid par 'gro ba'i rgyu/ phyogs bcu lta yang yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ lam gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i rgyu/ ye shes kyi lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i rgyu/ spyan lnga dang*/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i rgyu/ mngon shes kyi yon tan drug dang*/ mthar thug pa'i rgyu/ mthong lam sgom lam zhes bya ba bcu'o// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi/ rten dkon mchog gsum/ sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jug par bya'o// zhes drang ngo*// gang la na/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba nyer gnyis sngar ji skad bshad pa'i bya ba nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa la'o// gang gis na/ spyod pa spyad 'bras spyad bya spyod pa'i rang gi ngo bo ldog zla dang bcas pa dang*/ phung po lnga mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis so// yang na/ rnam par g.yeng ba'i rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen por dngos med dang dngos po/ sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs/ gcig dang tha dad/ ngo bo nyid dang khyad par/ ming ji lta ba bzhin du don dang don ji lta ba bzhin du ming du rnam par rtog pa'i yul bcu mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis so// mdo ni/

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang sems chen pos yum la spyad par bgyi zhes pa'i lan du shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen pos yum la spyod pa'i tshe byang sems chen po yod bzhin du byang sems yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ byang sems kyi ming yang*/ byang chub kyang*/ byang chub kyi ming yang*/ yum yang*/ yum gyi ming yang*/ spyod ces bya bar/ mi spyod ces bya bar/ spyod kyang spyod la mi spyod (189) kyang mi spyod ces bya bar/ spyod pa'ang ma yin mi spyod pa'ang ma yin zhes bya bar gzugs kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes sogs gsungs so// chos dang gang zag gi bdag mi dmigs pa'i sgrub pa de nyid sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' ba dang*/ phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ chos sku thob pas bsdus pa ched du bya ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas nyan thos dang*/ sogs pa rang sangs rgyas dang thun mong ma yin pas so// nyan thos kyi sogs pa ni/ 'og tu'ang dmigs bsal med pa rnams 'di bzhin bshad do// mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu gal te phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi lo ka'i khams/ dge slong shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu lta bu sha stag gis 'di lta ste/ 'dam bu/ 'od ma/ bu ram shing*/ smig ma/ 'bras kyi tshal lam/ til gyi tshal ltar gang bar gyur kyang de dag gi shes rab gang yin pa des/ byang sems yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig bsgoms pa tsam gyi brgya'i char yang mi 'gro/ stong dang*/ brgya stong nas grangs char yang*/ bgrang bar yang*/ rgyur yang*/ dper yang nye bar mi 'gro'o// zhes pa nas/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di ltar/ byang sems kyi shes rab ni/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i don du nye bar gnas pa yin te/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab ni/

de ltar ma yin no// zhes so// ji lta bus na/ tha snyad du sgyu ma lta bur snang ba kun rdzob dang*/ de kho nar cir yang ma grub pa don dam pa'i bden pa las mi 'da' bas zhes de ltar slob pa ni/ sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag go /gnyis pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la bzhi ste/ bden bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rang bzhin/ rtsod spang ngo*// dang po ni/ zag bcas 'bras bus bsdus pa dang*/ (190) zag bcas rgyus bsdus pa dang*/ zag med 'bras bus bsdus pa dang*/ zag med rgyus bsdus pa rim pa ltar bden bzhi'i mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi bden pa tsam mo// dbye ngo bzhi'o// tha dad ni/ 'gog bden ni/ gzhan gsum dang de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med la/ sdug kun ltos sa tha dad la ltos te ngo bo gcig pa srid/ snga ma'i las nyon gyi 'bras bu nyid/ phyi ma'i rgyur yang 'gyur srid pas so// gcig la ltos te ngo bo tha dad do// lam zag bcas dang sdug kun ngo bo gcig pa srid do// grangs nges ni/ thar pa 'dod pa'i gang zag gi shes bya duḥkha/ spang bya kun 'byung*/ thob bya 'gog pa/ bsten bya lam bden dang bzhir nges te/ rgyud blar/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la// bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar// duḥkha rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam// shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya// zhes so// yang na bden pa bzhir byas pa la 'khor 'das gnyis su nges/ 'khor ba'ang rgyu 'bras gnyis su nges pas kun 'byung dang duḥkha gnyis so// myang 'das kyang rgyu 'bras gnyis su nges pas lam dang 'gog pa gnyis su nges so// gsum pa la/ sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi las/ dang po la/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshan nyid gnyis so// dang po ni/ las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i snod bcud kyi lo ka'o// gnyis pa la/ rang mtshan/ spyi mtshan gnyis las/ dang po ni/

skye rga na 'chi mi sdug pa dang phrad pa lnga duḥkha'i duḥkha/ sdug pa dang bral ba dang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa gnyis 'gyur ba'i duḥkha/ nyer len gyi phung po lnga 'du byed kyi duḥkha'o// gnyis pa ni/ mi rtag duḥkha stong pa bdag med pa'o// gnyis pa la/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshan nyid gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs dang*/ las gnyis so// dang po la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu/ spong tshul bzhi'o// rgyu ni/ rkyen bzhi ste/ rgyu'i rkyen/ rang rang (191) gi rigs 'dra snga mas bzhag pa'i bag la nyal ma spangs par yod pa/ dmigs rkyen/ sdug pa dang mi sdug par snang ba sogs yul nye bar gyur pa/ bdag rkyen/ mi gtsang pa la gtsang bar 'dzin pa sogs tshul bzhin min pa'i yid byed/ de ma thag rkyen/ rig pa snga ma ste/ mdzod du/ phra rgyas spangs par ma gyur dang*// yul ni nye bar gyur pa dang*// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las// nyon mongs rnams ni skye bar 'gyur// zhes so// ngo bo la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ gang zhig de byung bas sems kyi rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'o// gnyis pa la/ mthong spang dang*/ sgom spang dang*/ de dag la rtsod pa spang ba gsum las/ dang po la/ nyan thos kyi dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs so// dang po la/ 'dod pa khams na/ duḥkha mthong spang bcu/ kun 'byung 'gog pa la lta ba dang po gnyis dang tha ma bor bas bdun bdun/ lam la lta ba dang po gnyis bor bas brgyad de/ so gnyis so// mdzod du/ de dag bcu dang bdun bdun brgyad// lta ba gsum gnyis ma gtogs so// zhes so// khams gong gnyis na khong khro bor bas/ de dag dgu dang drug drug bdun du 'gyur bas nyer brgyad do// gnyis pa ni/ 'dod khams na/ bde pa bzhi la bcu bcu ste/ bzhi bcu/ khams gong gnyis na/ khong khro med do// rgyud zhi gnas dang ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dis gnod pa byas so// byed do// byed par 'gyur ro// bdag gi gnyen la de lta bu gsum/

bdag gi dgra la phan btags so// 'dogs so// 'dogs par 'gyur ro ba gsum ste/ kun nas mnar sems pa'i dngos po dgu med pa'i phyir ro// des na bden pa bzhi la dgu dgu ste/ so drug pa gnyis so// de'ang log par zhugs tshul gyis phye na/ sdug kun la dngos su dang*/ log pa la dang*/ dbang gis log zhugs dang gsum/ 'gog lam la dngos su dang*/ log pa la log
