chos nyid (286) kyi rigs pas sgom ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sgom byed byang sems dang*/ bsgom bya yum dang don gsum po phan tshun te/ byang sems yum du ngo bo gcig yum ting nge 'dzin du ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir so sor bstan mi nus pa'o// rnam pa gang gis dmigs na/ byang sems la sogs pa'i chos thams cad don dam par yod pa ma yin pa nyid kyis bsgom bya sgom byed sgom ting nge 'dzin du rnam par mi rtog ste/ rtogs bya bral bar dmigs te sgom pa ni/ mthong lam skyed pa'i thabs dam pa'o zhes bya ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ rnam pa de ltar na/ dmigs rnam dang ldan pa'i rtogs pa rnam pa gsum po chos can/ chos mchog ces bya ba yin te/ mthong spang dang bcas pas lo ka pa'ang yin la/ zag pa med pa'i chos rnams thob par byed pas mchog kyang yin pas/ lo ka ba'i chos bzod pa man chad thams cad kyi mchog yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgra'i dbye bas don ston par byed pas na/ khyad par du byas pa can gyi chos can dang chos brjod pa'i sgras dmigs pa dang rnam pa brjod par bya ba rigs pa yin na'ang*/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can zhes bya ba la/ chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgras brjod pas de ma gtogs te/ dmigs bsal lo// de las gzhan pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig dang*/ rnam pa bcu gnyis po thams cad khyad par can gyi chos brjod pas thams cad du mtshungs par brjod pa ni/ mi rigs te/ chos can bstan par rigs pa la/ chos can ma bstan pa'i phyir/ ma grub pa min te/ rten chos can med pa'i chos tsam ni/ sgom par mi rigs pas so// zhe na/ gnyis pa la/ sgra gnyis brjod bya tha dad med pas dang*/ don gyi shugs kyis chos can go ba'i lan no// dang po ni/ rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog ces pa la sogs pas rnam pa dang dmigs pa'i chos can kun (287) tu drangs pa lta bur thams cad du bshad cing rtogs pas sgom par mi rigs pa'i skyon med do// 'o na/

chos brjod pas chos can rtogs sam zhe na/ rtogs te/ chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra 'di dag la khyad par ldog pa gzhan spong ba chos brjod kyi sgra dang*/ mi spong ba chos can brjod pa'i sgra zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs par brjod bya'i don la khyad par 'ga' yang med do// zhes lugs las 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ gang bden bzhir gtogs pa'i chos dmigs rnam brjod pa'i tshe/ chos de dag bden bzhir gtogs par grags pa'i phyir dang*/ chos dang chos can gnyis ka med na mi 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir chos can rtogs so// 'di'i mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/ sgra gnyis kyi ngo bo/ don la khyad med tshul/ khyad par gzhan spong mi spong gi sgo nas brda'i bye brag bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ba lang zhes brjod pa chos can/ chos can brjod pa yin te/ rdzas brjod pa yin pa'i phyir ro// ba lang nyid ces brjod pa chos can/ chos brjod pa yin te/ dngos po brjod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ sgra de gnyis kyi khyad par chos gzhan spong mi spong tsam du zad kyi/ don la brjod bya la khyad par 'ga' yang med do// de gnyis kas ba lang ma yin pa rnam par bcad pa ston pa'i phyir ro// rnam 'grel las/ kun la rdzas dang dngos brjod pa'i// sgra yi khyad par de nyid de// des na de dag brjod bya la// khyad par 'ga' yang yod ma yin// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sgra gnyis kyi brjod bya tha dad med na/ brda tha dad don med du 'gyur ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ ba lang gi gong bu gcig la rta dang ma he ma yin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gzhan dag yod mod kyi/ ma he ma yin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gzhan spong ba ste/ rang gir mi byed pa'ang de dag yod pa la mi ltos par rta bcad tsam de rtogs par 'dod na/ don de lta bu shes par bya ba'i phyir te/ rta rnam par bcad tsam la brdar byas

(288) pa'i sgras 'di la rta ma yin pa nyid yod do zhes ston pas/ khyad par gzhan spong ba de/ chos brjod kyi brda'i bye brag gi rgyu yin la/ yang khyad par gzhan ma he ma yin pa la sogs pa mi spong ste/ mi 'dod pa med par rta rnam par bcad pa khyad par gzhan ma spangs pa'i ba lang gi rdzas shes par 'dod na/ de ltar bstan pa'i phyir khyad par gzhan ma spangs pa la brdar byas pa'i sgras 'di ni rta ma yin pa yin no zhes ston pas khyad par gzhan mi spong ba ni/ chos can brjod pa'i brda'i bye brag gi rgyu'o// des na/ chos can brjod pa la ba lang dkar po zhes pa lta bu gzhi mthun pa dang*/ ba lang dkar ram sngo zhes pa lta bu khyad par dang khyad par can gyi gzhi'i dngos po yang srid la/ chos brjod la de dag mi srid do// chos mchog gi chos de/ sgra'i chos gzhan dag dang 'brel rung du brjod na/ chos gzhan mi spong ste/ sgra mi rtag pa zhes pa bzhin/ chos de nyid sgra la brten pa'i chos gzhan dag dang 'brel mi rung du brjod na/ chos gzhan spong ste/ sgra'i mi rtag pa nyid ces pa bzhin no// zhes bzhed de/ rnam 'grel las/ khyad par gzhan ni spong ba dang*// mi spong ba dag de gnyis kyi// brda yi bye brag rtogs pa po'i// 'dod pa'i rjes su byed pa'i gzhi// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lan gyi rnam pa gcig tu na/ tshig le'ur byas pa sdeb pa la sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i nyes pa spang ba'i ngor chos can las tha dad par chos brjod kyi sgras brjod kyang duḥkha la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi ni/ chos can yin la/ der gtogs pa kho na dmigs pa dang rnam pa chos su shes par bya ba yin no// de ci ste zhe na/ mngon par zhen pa dang*/ sogs pa dmigs pa la sogs pa bkag pa dang ldan pa'i bdag la sogs pa ni/ rim dang gcig car gyis don byed par mi rigs so// zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshad mas brtags pa na/ de kho nar ri bong rwa bzhin du sgrub pa skye ba dang 'gag pa/

'jig pa dang bral bar gyur pa'i phyir/ bdag la sogs pa bden pa (289) gnyis kar med pas rten du mi rigs kyi/ bden bzhi ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden par yod pas rten yin no// 'og ma dag la yang ste/ gang du chos tsam zhig bstan pa thams cad du sngar bshad pa de bzhin du bden pa bzhi kho na chos can yin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig bo dong na re/ rtog pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ rnam byang la yul du 'khrul pa dang*/ rdzas 'dzin dang btags 'dzin du 'khrul pa'o// zhe na/ nyan rang sbyor lam pa chos can/ 'dir smos gzung rtog sogs yod par thal/ kun nas nyon mongs sogs la yul du 'khrul pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dir smos rtog pa chos can/ theg chen sbyor lam/ nyan rang sbyor lam las khyad par du byed chos ma yin par thal/ nyan rang sbyor lam la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya 'dzin rtog gzhir byas la so skye la yod pa rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ 'phags pa la yod pa btags 'dzin rtog pa'o// zhe na/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya btags 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ rdzas 'dzin rtog par thal/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya 'dzin rtog so skye la yod pa de yin pa'i phyir ro// rtags ma grub na/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya btags 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi khyad par byed chos ma yin par thal/ theg chen sbyor lam na med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ spang bya rnam rtog spong byed gnyen po'o// dang po la/ rtog pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ khyad par du byed chos su 'gyur tshul lo// dang po la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir rtog pa la/ rnam 'grel las/ shes gang gang la sgra don 'dzin// de ni de la rtog par brjod// ces pa ltar/ sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang*/

(290) gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba khams gsum pa'i sems sems byung thams cad rtog par byas pa gnyis snang gi rtog pa ste/ de skad du/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni// sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa// zhes pa ste/ gnyis so// de la 'dir phyi ma gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de'i mtshan nyid/ yul ji lta ba bzhin ma yin par 'dzin pa'o// ji bzhin yul/ min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// zhes pa dang*/ de ni de ltar 'dzin pa yi// ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes so// de la/ yod do// yin no// zhes rtog pa sgrub rtog med do// min no// zhes rtog pa dgag rtog gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'o// de la gnyis las/ gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid gang zhig gzung ba'i rten can no// de la kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang zhig nyes pa'i gzhi'i rten can no// gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig gnyen po'i rten can no// gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid gang zhig 'dzin pa'i rten can no// de la rdzas 'dzin dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang zhig rdzas 'dzin gyi rten can no// gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig btags 'dzin gyi rten can no// 'dir smos khyad par du byed chos kyi rtog pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid la/ sngar gyi la rim pa bzhin du/ theg chen drod dang rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog dang mtshungs par ldan pa bsnan no// gnyis pa ni/ phyin ci log tu snang bas rnam rtog don la med pa snang ba'i phyir yang dag pa ma yin pa/ rnam pa thams cad du don la med pa sgro btags nas 'dzin pas kun tu rtog pa ste/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed las/ med pa snang ba'i phyir yang dag pa ma yin pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ thams cad du med cing rtog pa tsam yin pa'i phyir kun tu rtog pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ rtog pa bzhir dbye/ de nyid mu bzhir dbye/

mthong spang dang sgom spang du dbye/ mngon gyur dang sa bon (291) du dbye ba bzhi'o// dang po la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi/ 'dir smos rtog pa tsam mo// dbye ngo ni/ slob dpon 'di'i bzhed pas/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog rnam byang gzung rtog rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa ste bzhi'o// 'phags pa ni/ dngos po tsam la brten pa dang*/ gnyen po phyogs la brten pa'i gzung rtog gnyis su bzhed do// re re la'ang dgu dgu'o// tha dad ni/ spyir ngo bo gcig pa yod kyang*/ 'dir smos bzhi dngos po tha dad de/ cha mthun bzhi la rim pa bzhin ldan pa'i phyir ro// nang tshan gyi dgur dbye ba ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad gtso che'o// grangs nges ni/ 'dir smos kyi rtog pa gzhir byas pa la yul dang yul can rtog pa gnyis yod pas/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis su nges so// dang po la'ang yul kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam byang la rtog pa gnyis yod pas gzung rtog gnyis su nges so// gnyis pa la'ang rdzas 'dzin dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis yod pas 'dzin rtog gnyis su nges la/ re re la yul dgu dgu yod pas yul can rtog pa dgur nges so// gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol gzugs sgra la rtog pa gzung rtog kho na'i mu/ rang gi shes pa skad cig ma la rtog pa 'dzin rtog kho na'i mu/ gzhan gyi shes pa la rtog pa gnyi ga'i mu/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi yum gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu'o// 'phags pas/ mu dang po ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul drug go /gnyis pa ni/ skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i rnam par rig pa'o// gsum pa ni/ skad cig ma gzhan gyi de nyid do// bzhi pa ni/ rnam pa de dag dang bral ba'i yum mo// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ 'phags pas rtog pa 'di dag sgom spang du mi bzhed kyang*/ slob dpon gyis bzhed pas/ 'di dag gi rags pa'am/ kun btags kyi cha de mthong spang*/ phra ba'am/

lhan skyes kyi cha sgom spang ngo*// dang po la/ 'jug yul du 'khrul pa dang*/ ldog yul du 'khrul pa'i bye brag gis 'jug (292) pa dang ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis/ 'dzin rtog la/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas// zhes pa'i don/ so skyes rdzas su yod pa nyid bdag tu 'dzin pas de la dmigs pa rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'o// so skyes kyang chos thams cad bdag med du shes pa yod pas rdzas su 'dzin pas ma khyab bo// zhe na/ de ni/ mos pa yid la byed pa yin la/ 'dir ni de kho na nyid yid la byed par 'dod pa skyon med do// 'phags pas bdag ni btags par yod pa nyid kyis 'dzin pas de la zhen pa btags 'dzin rtog pa'o// 'phags pa la'ang rdzas 'dzin yod do// nga de'i tshe de'i dus su ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge yan lag ma smad par zhes bya bar gyur to// zhes pas so// zhe na/ de ni drang don yin gyi/ nges don ma yin no// des na so skye dang 'phags pa'i 'dzin pa dmigs yul du ston pa yin te/ chos bshes kyis/ so so'i skye bo yul du byas te/ de la skyes bu rdzas su yod par 'dzin pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag yul du byas te/ de la btags par yod par 'dzin pa zhes so// gnyis pa sgom spang la/ 'phags pas/ tshogs sgrub tu dngos po tsam gyi rnam pa la brten pa dang*/ gnyen po'i rnam pa la brten pa ste/ gzung rtog gnyis/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad du btags pa la brten pa dang*/ btags pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten pa zhes pa 'dzin rtog gnyis so// slob dpon gyis ni/ rtse sbyor gyi skabs su snga ma bzhin du zhes smos pa'i don/ 'jug pa gzung rtog ldog pa gzung rtog rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ btags 'dzin rtog pa'o// zhes 'bum pa gsung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ rtog pa de dag yid la byed pa mngon du rgyur gnas pa mngon gyur/ mngon du gyur med kyang rkyen dang phrad na 'byung rung gi bag la nyal ni/

sa bon no// gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa 'di dag sgrub rtog dang*/ dgag rtog tu byas nas sbyor lam gyis spong bar 'dod pa ni/ mi mdzes so// des na/ da ltar sbyor lam gyi ngo bor gnas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na rang gi mthong lam gyi (293) spang byar 'gyur bas khyad par 'phags te/ nyan rang la de med pa'i phyir ro// de la kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'am/ brjod pa tsam du shes pa drod la/ rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'am/ don du med par shes pa rtse mo/ rdzas 'dzin rang bzhin med par shes pa bzod pa/ btags 'dzin rang bzhin med par shes pa chos mchog la mtshungs par ldan te/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ dngos po tsam la brten pa ni/ gang gis na/ phung po la sogs pa'i dngos po tsam la brjod pa tsam du shes pa'o// gnyen po la brten pa ni/ gang gis na phar phyin la sogs pa'i rnam par byang ba'i dngos po kho na la sems tsam du rnam par 'jog par byed pa'o// 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa yang rnam pa gnyis te/ gang zag gi rdzas la brten pa ni/ gang gis na/ 'dzin pa'i rnam pa gang gi rdzas su sgro btags pa gtso bor sems can la sogs par lta ba'i yul gyi dngos po 'gog par byed pa'o// der gdags pa la brten pa ni/ gang gis na/ der gdags pa tsam yang 'dzin pa ma yin pa nyid du rab tu 'byed par byed pa'o// zhes pas dgag rtog cha mthun bzhi'i ngo bor gnas shing*/ phyis spong bar khyad par du 'phags so// gnyis pa la/ kha cig na re/ sbyor ba zhes pa bar chad med lam/ 'jug pa zhes pa rnam grol lam gyi spang bya'o zer ba ni/ mi rigs te/ rnam grol lam spong ba'i gnyen po min pa'i phyir ro// des na/ gzung rtog dang po dang*/ 'dzin rtog dang po gnyis ni/ mthong sgom gnyis kyi sbyor lam zhes pa nyer bsdogs kyis gcig nas phye ste rim gyis spong ngo*// tha ma gnyis ni/ lam gnyis kyi 'jug pa'i gnas skabs zhes pa bar chad med pa'i lam gyis ma lus par gcig car spong ngo*// gsum pa la/

rnam dag bskyed pa la rtog pa rnam byang gzung rtog tu thal/ yul rnam byang (294) yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'phags pa ltar na/ 'dod de/ gzung rtog dang po gang yin pa gnyis pa'ang yin pa'i mu yin pas so// slob dpon ltar na/ rtags ma grub ste/ kun nas nyon mongs kyis skyo ba bskyed la de las rnam dag skye bas sam nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin la dgongs pa ste/ 'grel chen las/ 'di gnyis ni/ tha dad pa kho na'o// zhes so// skye ba la rtog pa kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog tu thal/ skye ba kun nas nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ mtshan nyid pa yin pa ma grub/ rjes mthun pa rnam byang du mi 'gal te/ rgyud blar/ yang dag ji bzhin mthong ba'i phyir// skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*// snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang*// rga dang na dang 'chi bar ston// zhes so// ma rig pa la rtog pa 'dzin rtog tu thal/ yul 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ skyon med de/ ma rig pa'i yul la rtog pa la ma rig pa'i rtog pa zhes brjod pas so// yang na/ 'dod pa yin te/ gzung rtog 'dzin rtog gnyis// yin pa'i mu bshad pas so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ brgyas par bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po la/ bshad de zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rnam rtog bzhi dang ldan pa yang ste/ yang ni/ bsdu ba'o// gang gis na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad kyis so// ci'i don du na/ de'i don gsal bar bstan par bya ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan no// dang po la gnyis te/ rtsa ba 'grel ba'o// dang po la/ gzung bar rtog pa ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ srid par brgyud pa'i bya ba byed pa'i gzhi nyon mongs pa la dmigs pa'i rtog pa dang*/ nyon mongs de'i gnyen po lam la dmigs pa'i rtog pa ste/ gnyis po de ni/ rmongs pa ma rig pa la sogs pa'i yul dgu dang*/

rnam byang phung po la sogs pa'i yul dgu'i bye brag gis so sor te/ re re la rnam pa dgu dgu'o// (295) gnyis pa la/ lus dang yan lag gi dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ gzung bar rnam par rtog pa tsam ni/ dbye gzhi'o// kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ rnam byang gi gzung rtog rnam pa gnyis ni/ dbye ba'i ngo bo'o// grangs nges ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa kun nas nyon mongs pa'i gzhi la brten pa can dang*/ sems bskyed pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po la brten pa can gyi rtog pa gnyis su nges pa nyid kyis so// rten can ni/ rten ni/ dmigs yul/ can ni/ ldan pa'i sgra ste/ yul de la dmigs pa'i yul can ni/ de'i rten can te/ 'og ma thams cad la'ang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dbye gzhi gzung rtog gnyis la/ dbye ngo rnam pa dgu dgu'o// grangs nges ni/ ma rig pa dang phung po la sogs pa'i yul dgu dang*/ rnam par byang ba'i phung po dang*/ sogs pa skye mched la sogs pa'i yul dgu'i rab tu dbye bas yul can rtog pa dgu dgur nges so// rtsa ba dang 'grel pa'i sogs ni/ don gnyis gnyis la sbyar ro// gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba 'grel pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ni/ gang zag rdzas su yod pa la brten pa can dang*/ skyes bu btags par yod pa la brten pa can gyi rnam rtog rnam pa gnyis su 'dod do// gnyis po de yang yul bdag rang dbang can gyi ngo bo la sogs pa dang*/ phung po la sogs pa'i rten dgu dgu las/ rten can 'dzin rtog dgu dgu ste/ dper na/ gzung rtog yul gyis phye ba de bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ las dang*/ yan lag gi dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la gsum las/ dbye gzhi ni/ 'dzin rtog tsam mo// dbye ngo ni/ gzung rtog tu ma zad/ 'dzin rtog kyang rdzas 'dzin dang btags 'dzin rtog pa rnam pa gnyis yin no// grangs nges ni/ yul 'ga' zhig gis bden par sgro btags pa'i gang zag rdzas su yod pa dang*/
tha snyad du btags pa tsam gyi skyes bu btags

(296) par yod pa gnyis yod pas/ de la dmigs pa'i rtog pa la'ang gnyis so// gnyis pa la/ dbye gzhi 'dzin rtog gnyis la/ dbye ba'i ngo bo gzung rtog dgu dgu yod pa de ltar du so sor te/ re re la rnam pa dgu dgu'o// grangs nges ni/ yul bdag rang dbang can dang*/ gcig pu la sogs pa dang*/ phung po dang*/ sogs pa skye mched la sogs pa dgu yod pa nyid kyis de la dmigs pa'i rtog pa'ang dgur nges so// rgyas bshad la/ rtog pa bzhi po de la brjod bya mang du yod na'ang mdor bsdus te rtog pa bzhir bshad pa'i don 'di yin te/ gzung rtog rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog rgyas bshad dang*/ rnam byang gzung rtog rgyas bshad gnyis so// dang po la/ dbye gzhi spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog tsam mo// dbye ngo gzung bar rtog pa dgu po rnams so// grangs nges ni/ yul gyi dbye ba las te/ la kun la sbyar bas yul dgu ste/ dang po bzhi nyon mongs pa'i ngo bo/ de nas gnyis nyes dmigs/ de nas gnyis dmigs pa/ gcig rang bzhin nam/ rnam byang rjes mthun pa'o// la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa zhes kun la sbyar ro// las 'bras dang*/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa ma rig pa la'o// mdo ni/ chos 'di dag ni/ byis pa so so'i skye bos ji ltar mngon par chags par bya ba de lta bu'i rnam par yod pa ma yin no// zhes so// gzugs dang*/ sogs pa tshor ba la sogs pa'i phung po'i'o// mdo ni/ gzugs nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no// zhes so// tshor ba la sogs ming bzhi dang*/ mig la sogs pa gzugs kyi phung po la de kho nar byed pa'i chos rnams btags nas mngon par zhen pa'i'o// mdo ni/ med pa'i chos de dag btags nas ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen zhes so// rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis la chags shing zhen pa'o// mdo ni/

med pa'i mtha' gnyis dag tu rtog par (297) byed do// zhes so// ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa rnam par byang ba'i rang bzhin mi shes pa'i'o// mdo ni/ gzugs kun nas nyon mongs pa'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo zhes so// ma dad pa'i rgyus sbyin pa nas ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar 'phags pa'i lam la mi gnas pa'i'o// mdo ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gnas pa ma yin no// zhes so// gzugs sogs su dmigs shing zhen pa'i'o// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba yin no// zhes so// bdag dang*/ sogs pa sems can la sogs pa bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin pa la sogs pa'o// mdo ni/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag mi dmigs shing mi mthong zhes so// nyon mongs rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa la skyed pa ste/ skye ba dang*/ sogs pa 'byung ba la sogs med pa la'o// mdo ni/ rnam par dag pa ni/ skye ba med pa/ 'byung ba med pa/ mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'o// zhes so// ma rig pa gzung bar rnam par rtog pas na/ ma rig pa'i rtog pa zhes sogs su'ang sbyar ro// gnyis pa la/ dbye gzhi nyon mongs kyi gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog tsam mo// dbye ngo rnam byang gi gzung ba sems tsam du rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi rnam par rtog pa dgu po rnams so// grangs nges ni/ yul gyi dbang gis te/ rnam byang gi ngo bo gcig rgyu gsum/ dmigs pa gcig spyod pa gcig dbye ba gsum ste/ dgu la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa zhes sbyar ro// yang na/ phung po sogs kyi don la dmigs pa'i rtog pa yin pas/ phung po'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa zhes sogs su sbyar ro// rnam byang du ma spungs pa phung po'i don no// mdo ni/ thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin no// zhes so// mig shes la sogs pa'i rnam shes skye ba'i sgo skye mched bcu gnyis kyi don dang ngo*// mdo ni/

mig la rtog sogs (298) sngar bzhin no// rigs 'dra skyed pa'i sa bon khams kyi don no// mdo ni/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams su rtogs sogs so// rten 'brel ma byung ba las byung ba skye ba'i don no// mdo ni/ ma rig par rtog cing sogs so// med pa tsam bdag lta'i gnyen po min pa'i phyir bdag gnyis kyis stong pa nyid kyi don no// mdo ni/ nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la rtogs so// med pa tsam don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa sgrub byed ma yin pas de sgrub byed phyin drug gi don no// don zhes gong ma kun la'ang thob bo// mdo ni/ phyin drug la rtog ces so// yod pa'i bzod shes kyi skad cig ma rnams spang bya dang bral nus pas chos rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo mthong lam mo// mdo ni/ byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la rtog ces so// yan lag dang dmigs pas 'da' ba'i sgom lam bsam gtan sogs so// mdo ni/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la rtog ces so// bslab pa rdzogs pas mi slob pa'i lam stobs sogs so// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar la rtog ces so// gnyis pa la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa rgyas bshad do// dang po la/ dbye gzhi/ gang zag rdzas su yod pa'i rten can gyi rtog pa tsam mo// dbye ngo*/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu rnams so// grangs nges/ yul dang po bzhi bdag gi mtshan nyid/ phyi ma rnams rten chos yin pas/ la rdzas kyi 'dzin pa rnam par rtog pa zhes sbyar ro// gzhan la mi ltos pas/ bdag rang dbang can la'o// mdo ni/ bdag med cing mi dmigs so// zhes so// cha shas med pas gcig pu'i bdag go /mdo ni/ gzugs nye bar mi dmigs zhes so// rnam shes kyi rgyur gyur pas rgyu'i bdag zhes bya ba nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mi dmigs so// ji ltar mi dmigs she na/

bdag nyid du'o// de'i phyir zhe na/ bdag shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir zhes gang gsungs pa de thams cad la brjod par bya'o// zhes nyi khri snang bar ro// go /mdo ni/ mig mi dmigs zhes so// longs spyod pa po (299) dang spyad bya la sogs yin pas lta ba po dang*/ sogs pa blta bya la sogs pa'i bdag go /mdo ni/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam par shes pa mi dmigs zhes so// bdag ces pa gong ma la'ang 'thob bo// ma rig pa la sogs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten no// 'og gi rten zhes pa gong ma bzhi la'ang drang ngo*// mdo ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mi dmigs so// zhes so// lo ka pa'i lam gyis sa 'og ma las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rten no// mdo ni/ bsam gtan dang po mi dmigs zhes so// bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i lam gyi rten no// mdo ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mi dmigs so// zhes so// rnam thar snyoms 'jug gi bdag nyid sgom pa'i lam gyi rten no// mdo ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mi dmigs so// zhes so// rang gzhan gyi don ni/ bya ba byas pa stobs sogs kyi rten no// mdo ni/ stobs bcu mi dmigs so// zhes so// phung po'i don la sogs pa ni/ gcig pur 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs su shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dbye gzhi/ skyes bu brda'am tha snyad du btags par yod pa'i rten can gyi rtog pa tsam mo// dbye ngo*/ btags pa'i 'dzin par rnam par rtog pa dgu rnams so// grangs nges ni/ yul gyi dbang gis te/ dang po bzhi las kyi sgyu ma las byung ba'i btags pa tsam/ lhag ma rnams ye shes kyi sgyu ma las byung ba'i btags pa tsam yin pas/ la btags pa'i 'dzin par rnam par rtog pa zhes sbyar ro// spungs pa'i don med pas gzugs sogs kyi phung po rdzas su med pa'o// mdo ni/

rab 'byor 'di ci snyam du sems/ gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma'ang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam zhes so// mig sogs rdzas su med pas skye ba'i sgo'i don med pas skye mched do// ming ni/ (300) mig kyang gzhan la sgyu ma'ang sogs sngar bzhin no// rigs kyi don med pas khams rdzas su med pa'o// mdo ni/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam shes kyang gzhan zhes sogs so// ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir skye ba'i don med pas rten 'brel rdzas su med pa'o// mdo ni/ sgyu ma'ang gzhan la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'ang gzhan zhes sogs so// gzings ltar gtan du ba min pas chos so bdun gyi ngo bo rnam byang ngo*// mdo ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyang gzhan zhes so// spang gnyen tshogs pa tsam nyid kyis ngo bor ma grub pas sgo gsum mthong lam mo// mdo ni/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa'ang gzhan zhes so// yan lag dang dmigs pas 'da'i/ rdzas su med pa'i sgom lam mo// mdo ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'ang gzhan zhes sogs so// kun btags pas stong pa'i phyir stong nyid rtogs pa'i khyad par gyi lam mo// mdo ni/ sgyu ma'ang gzhan la stong pa thams cad kyang gzhan la zhes so// sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin pas stobs sogs mi slob pa'i lam mo// mdo ni/ byang chub kyang gzhan zhes sogs so// spyi dang bye brag gi dang ni/ zlas dbye ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ rnam pa de lta bu'i rnam rtog rang gi lam gyi spang byar gyur pa bzhi dang nges 'byed cha mthun drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi po grangs bzhin du mtshungs par ldan pa yin no// rnam rtog mtha' yas kyang lam du gtogs pa'i spang bya rtog pa bstan gyi/ gzhan ni/ blang dor bya rgyu min pas ma bstan no// gsum pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gsungs zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyad par ro// gang gis na/

bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gis so// gang du na/ rtog pa'i mjug thogs su'o// mdor bstan dang go rim mi mthun no// zhe na/ skyon med de/ mdor bstan du tshigs su bcad pa (301) sbyar ba mthun par te/ sdeb sbyor gyi ngor rtog pa'i sngar gsungs na'ang*/ rgyas bshad du yongs 'dzin de'i stobs kyis ji skad du bshad pa'i rtog sa bzhi po nyan rang sbyor lam dang thun mong min pa'i khyad par du byed chos su 'gyur zhes bstan pa'i phyir mjug tu bstan no/ yang ni/ rim pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// rtsa ba la/ nang yongs 'dzin thabs mkhas/ phyi yongs 'dzin dge bshes/ de'i mi mthun phyogs bor ba dang gsum mo// dang po la/ yongs 'dzin yin zhes drang ngo*// gang na sbyor lam pa'o// gang gis na/ chos thams cad spros bral stong pa nyid sogs la sems mi 'gong ste/ rgyun du 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ sogs pa gnas min pa la 'jigs pa dang dngangs ba dang 'jigs pa nges par gyur pa skrag pa de dag med pa'i thabs mkhas kyis so// ji ltar na/ skrag pa la sogs pas rnam pa kun tu'o// mdo ni/ byang sems de ltar yum la spyod pa ni/ dngangs par mi 'gyur/ skrag par mi 'gyur/ kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gang na/ sbyor lam pa'o// gang gis na/ phan pa thob pa'i don du chos thams cad bdag dang chos kyi ngo bo nyid med pa la sogs pa'i shes rab/ sogs pa sems bskyed bsngo ba la sogs pa'i thabs ston pa dang*/ mi phan pa spang ba'i don du bdud la sogs pa ston par byed pas so// ji ltar na/ thabs shes rab dang mi ldan pa las rnam pa kun tu'o// mdo ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang de la gzugs mi rtag ces bya ba de dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam mkhyen nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang rgyal gyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug go

/gsum pa la/ nang gi dang phyi'i mi mthun phyogs bor ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ thabs mkhas (302) de'i mi mthun phyogs rang don du sgom pa dang rlom pa dang*/ dngangs pa la sogs pa bor ba'o// mdo ni/ de ltar thabs mi mkhas pas yum bstan pa 'di thos nas dngangs shing skrag la kun tu skrag pas zin par 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dge bshes de'i mi mthun phyogs mdo sde 'di dag ni/ rang gzor byas pa ste/ mnyan par mi bya'o// zhes sogs gzung spong ba'i sdig grogs/ phyin drug las bzlog cing mos pa med par byed de/ zhes sogs lam spong ba'i sdig grogs/ nyan thos kyi sa mngon du gyis shig bla med byang chub kyis khyod la ci zhig bya zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o// zhes pa ltar 'bras bu spong ba'i sdig grogs rnams bor ba'o// de dag ni/ 'phags pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i bshad pa ste/ slob dpon 'di ni/ thams cad du yongs 'dzin dge bshes thabs mkhas su 'dod do// 'grel pa la/ yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa ni chos can/ yongs su 'dzin pa yin no// de dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can yin pa'i phyir te/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten// zhes so// yon tan gnyis gang na/ rang don ni/ phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs kyi chos ser sna dang tshul khrims 'chal pa la sogs pa dang mi ldan pa'o// gzhan don ni/ ston par byed ces drang ngo*// rgyu gang gis na/ stong nyid sogs la sems dang por mi dngangs/ bar du mi 'gong zhing*/ mthar mi skrag pa dang*/ sogs pa sems bskyed bsngo ba la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas so// gang na/ dngos po mtha' dag go /ji ltar na/ rgyal po'i btsun mo sdug pa shi ba brda sprad pa'i tshul du gdul bya'i bsam pa'am/

dbang po rno rtul gyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ sogs pa chos kyi bdag gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pa la sogs par ston te/ mdo (303) las/ de bzhin snod min nyan thos theg pa dag /theg chen bshad pa thos na rmongs 'gyur zhing*// chad par lta la ngan song ltung 'gyur bas// de na dbang po brtags te chos ston no// zhes pa ltar ro// gal te yongs 'dzin gyis khyad par du 'phags par mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas rigs can gsum ga'i ston par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ sangs rgyas la khyad par med kyang rang gi bsam pa dang smon lam gyi dbang gis yongs su 'dzin mi 'dzin gyi khyad par yod de/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin no// bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ gang la brten nas sgrub pa 'byung ba'i rgyu rigs/ gang la dmigs te sgrub pa'i yul dmigs pa/ gang gi don du sgrub pa'i 'bras bu ched du bya ba/ ji ltar sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo'o// dang po la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la/ rigs kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgrub byed dang*/ yon tan/ nyes pa/ rtags/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rigs chad ma chad kyi don bstan pa/ dpe/ 'bras bu'i khyad par dang bcu'o// dang po nyan thos ni/ thar pa'i rigs/ ma chags pa'i dge bar 'dod de/ mdzod du/ ma chags 'phags rigs zhes so// rang bzhin dang ni rgyas pa dang*// de ni rten dang brten pa dang*// yod med nyid dang zhes pa la/ sems tsam pas skye mched drug gi khyad par/ thog ma med pa'i dus can/ 'tshang rgya ba'i skal pa dang ldan pa ni/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs so// de rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa na rgyas 'gyur ro// de gnyis snga ma rten dang*/ phyi ma brten pa'i dngos po yin no// snga ma ni/ rgyu'i dngos por yod la/ 'bras bu'i dngos por med do// de la/ khyed kyis rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/ sa bon nam rgyu yin pas so// zhe na/
'o na/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyang der 'gyur te/ rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// des na 'di rigs btags pa ba yin no// des na chos dbyings ni/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs yin pas/ mdo

(304) las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa'i rigs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi dbyings lhur len pa/ nam mkha' ltar yangs pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste/ zhes so// de la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba gang zhig chos nyid kyi skur 'gyur ba'o// rgyas 'gyur rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'o// rgyud bla las/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa mchog yin no// rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin// dang pos sku ni dang po ste// gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis// zhes so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ spyir rigs kyi khyab pa yi dang*/ gnas skabs rigs tha dad kyi dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs mchog tu dang*/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs stong zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgrub byed do// dang po ni/ sems can chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod de/ srid pa'i duḥkha la skyo zhing zhi ba la 'dod pa dang don gnyer 'byung ba'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rgyud bla las/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na// sdug la'ang skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*// don gnyer smon pa med par 'gyur// srid dang mya ngan 'das la de'i// bde sdug skyon yon mthong ba 'di// rigs yod las yin gang phyir de'i// rigs med dag la med phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sems can rnams chos can/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad de/ rgyu khams sna tshogs pa dang*/ rkyen theg pa tha dad la mos pa dang*/ nges pa dang ma nges pa'i sgrub pa tha dad dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub gsum tha dad yin pa'i phyir ro// khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang*// sgrub pa tha dad dbye ba dang*// 'bras bu tha dad dmigs pa'i phyir// rigs yod

(305) nyid du nges par brjod// ces so// gsum pa ni/ theg chen gyi rigs chos can/ mchog yin te/ dge ba khyad par du 'phags pas yun ring du sbyangs pa dang*/ stobs sogs yon tan thams cad yod pa dang*/ gzhan don chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas zad par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de dag khyad par 'phags pa dang*// thams cad dang ni don chen dang*// mi zad pa yi rgyu mtshan phyir// rigs mchog nyid ces brjod pa yin// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs de chos can/ sgro skur dang bral ba'i stong nyid yin te/ nyon mongs bsal rgyu med/ rnam byang dag pa'i chos gzhag rgyu med kyang glo bur nyon mongs kyis stong gi rang bzhin dag pas mi stong pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla las/ 'di la bsal bya sogs nas/ yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// rnam dbye bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong pa min// zhes so// yang khams de nyid chos can/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam mkhyen gyi yul yin te/ dri bcas kyi dus su dag pa'ang yin/ ma dag pa'ang yin pa'i phyir dang*/ dri med kyi dus su der sngar dri mar ma gyur pa phyis dag par gyur pa'i phyir ro// rgyud blar/ dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir// kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ ngan song du 'gro dka'/ song yang thar sla/ duḥkha chen po mi myong*/ 'khor ba la sems skyo zhing*/ de'i sems can smin par byed pa ni/ rigs kyi phan yon te/ ring mo zhig nas ngan song du// 'gro zhing myur du thar pa dang*// der yang duḥkha chung ngu myong*// skyo bcas sems can smin par byed// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ rigs la gnas kyang sangs rgyas mi thob cing*/ yon tan la mi 'jug pa'i nyes pa bzhi ste/ nyon mongs mang ba/ mi dge ba'i grogs (306) po/ yo byad kyis 'phongs pa/

bran ltar gzhan dbang du gyur pa'o// nyon mongs goms dang grogs ngan dang*// 'phongs dang gzhan gyi dbang nyid de// mdor na rigs kyi nyes dmigs dag /rnam pa bzhir ni shes par bya// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ sbyor ba'i sngon rol nas sems can la snying rje ba dang*/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa dang*/ dka' spyad la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang*/ phar phyin drug gi dge ba la spyod pa ste/ bzhi ni/ byang sems kyi rigs kyi rtags so// sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*// mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*// dge la yang dag spyod pa ni// rigs kyi rtags su shes par bya// zhes so// drug pa ni/ yon tan ni/ sgrol ba'i don du rigs zhes bya// zhes te/ go tra las/ gu ṇa ta ra zhes bsgyur na/ yon tan sgrol ba'i don gyis rigs te/ de las yon tan de dag skye zhing 'byung ba'o// yang na/ go sgra don dgu la 'jug ste/ ji skad du/ ngag phyogs sa dang 'od zer dang*// phyugs dang mig dang rdo rje dang*// mthor sa chu dang don dgu la// mkhas pas go sgra nges par gdags// zhes bshad la/ tra ya na skyob pas phyogs sam/ sas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams skyob pas rigs so// yang na/ snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba ngan par thim pa'am/ yon tan gyi tshogs kyi rten yin pas ku la ste/ rigs so// de'i rnam grangs ni/ a bh+yas/ chos kyi dbyings chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can kho na/ 'phags pa'i chos thams cad kyi rgyu nyid kyi phyir rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang*/ gzhi dang*/ stan pa dang*/ rgyu dang*/ rten dang*/ nye bar gnas pa dang*/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ gnas dang*/ sa bon dang*/ khams dang*/ rang bzhin zhes pa'i rnam grangs kyis brjod do*// zhes so// bdun pa ni/ rigs ni nges dang ma nges pa// rkyen rnams kyis ni mi 'phrog dang*// 'phrog pa nyid de mdor na rigs// dbye ba 'di ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes ngo bo nyid kyis nges ma nges

(307) gnyis po/ rim pa bzhin du rkyen gyis 'phrog mi 'phrog gnyis te/ bzhi'o// lang gshegs las/ nyan rang theg chen du nges pa gsum/ ma nges pa dang*/ chad pa ste/ lngar bshad do// de la/ rigs nges pa ni/ rang gi byang chub thob nges pa/ ma nges pa ni/ lam gzhan du'ang 'gyur srid pa ste/ 'di la nyan thos bshad zin la/ rang rgyal ni/ bse ru blta bu drod nas nges kyi/ de man chad ma nges/ tshogs spyod chen po bzod chen nas/ chung ngu sgom lam mam/ mthong lam nas nges kyi/ de man chad ma nges so// byang sems la dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum las rno na/ sbyor lam nas nges te/ 'grel chen las/ la la rigs ma nges pa yin kyang dbang po rno bas nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i gnas skabs su thabs kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid du nges pa yin no// zhes so// tshogs lam man chad ma nges te/ chos bshes kyis/ thar ba'i cha dang mthun pa ni/ theg pa khyad par can gyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog par nges pa ma yin pas na/ phyir mi ldog pa zhes mi brjod do// zhes so// dbang 'bring ni/ mthong lam nas nges kyi/ de man chad ma nges te/ a bh+yas/ dbang po 'bring ni/ rab tu dga' bar phyir mi ldog ste/ zhes pa dang*/ ji srid du sa rab tu dga' ba ma thob kyi bar nges pa dang ldan pa ma yin te zhes so// dbang rtul ni/ sa brgyad pa nas nges te/ a bh+yas/ dbang po rtul po ni/ sa mi g.yo ba la phyir mi ldog ste zhes pa dang*/ sa brgyad pa la/ thams cad nges pa nyid kyis phyir mi ldog pa nyid du rnam par gzhag go zhes so// sa bdun pa man chad la ma nges pa srid de/ rgyud las/ ji srid sa brgyad ma thob pa// de srid theg pa dman pas 'jigs// zhes dang*/ dpa' bos/ yid ni mchog tu g.yo bas ldog /de phyir de la dbugs ma phyung*// sa bzhin g.yo med ma thob par// brtan med mi g.yo'i sa rtogs dka'// zhes dang*/

sa bcu pa'i sa brgyad par/ sangs (308) rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang sems de dag mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo la bcug par ma gyur na ni 'di de'i tshe nyid du mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ro// zhes so// 'o na/ myang 'das de gang yin/ nyan thos kyi'am/ sangs rgyas kyi yin/ dang po mi rigs te/ de'i myang 'das 'dod pa sems bskyed pa nas spangs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mi rigs te/ sgom spang ma spangs pas so// zhe na/ myang 'das mang ste/ rtse mo thob pas dge rtsa chad pa'i/ bzod thob kyis ngan song*/ bsam gtan thob pas de'i yan lag rgyun zhugs kyis ni srid pa brgyad pa/ phyir 'ong gis ni gnyis pa/ phyir mi 'ong gis 'dod khams/ dgra bcom gyis phung po lhag bcas lhag med du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// 'dir ni/ dgongs pa can gyi mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ dgongs gzhi/ dus de srid du sems can gyi don rgyun chad pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du 'gog par ltung ba'ang dgongs pa can yin la/ sar ltung ba ni/ dgongs pa can min no// a bh+yas/ de lta ma yin te/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltung ba ni/ rtogs pa ste zhes so// brgyad pa ni/ rigs chad srid dam/ mi srid ce na/ gzhan dag rigs skye mched kyi khyad par du 'dod pas chad pa yod par 'dod la/ de'ang mtshams med byed pa sogs gcig tu nyes par spyod pa/ log ltas dge rtsa chad pa/ thar pa cha mthun ma skyes pa/ cung zad yod kyang tshogs ma rdzogs pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ rigs dman pas na/ med pa'o// thar pa'i rgyu dang bral ba ni/ rigs gtan med pa'o// la la gcig tu nges par spyod nges yod// la la dkar po'i chos rnams kun tu bcom// la la thar pa'i cha mthun dge ba med// dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral// zhes so// 'dir chos nyid la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs su 'dod pas de chad pa mi srid de/ rgyud bla mar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu

(309) sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes pa dang*/ yum dpal mchog dang por/ byang sems kun tu bzang po/ sems can thams cad ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no// zhes so// rigs chad bshad pa ni/ rnam par grol bar dka' ba la dgongs pa ste/ thogs med kyis/ log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba'i log sred can nyid kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir theg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba ldog pa'i don du dus gzhan la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin no// zhes so// dgu pa ni/ dge ba mang ba/ ye shes kyi 'od gsal ba/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma med pa/ mngon shes la sogs mthu dang ldan pas sam/ mi 'gyur zhing rnam par dag pas gser dang 'dra ste/ gser gyi rigs bzhin shes par bya// dge ba dpag tu med pa'i gnas// ye shes dang ni dri med ldan// mthu rnams kyi yang gnas yin no// zhes so// rgyud blar/ rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang*// dge dang rnam par dag pa'i phyir// de bzhin nyid 'di gser gyi ni// gzugs dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin// zhes te/ rgyas par de nyid du shes par bya'o// bcu pa ni/ rigs ni/ 'bras bu bde ba thob cing*/ duḥkha zhi ba/ byang chub kyi shing dang rang gzhan la phan bde skyed pa'i rtsa ba'o// yon tan shin tu rgya che byang chub shing bskyed phyir// bde dang duḥkha chen po zhi ba thob bya'i phyir/ bdag dang gzhan la phan bde byed pa 'bras bu'i phyir// rigs mchog de ni rtsa ba bzang po lta bu yin// zhes so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rtsod spang ngo*// dang po la/ snga 'grel/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa/ don bsdu ba las/ dang po ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sgrub pa nyams su len pa dang ldan pa'i byang sems la'am/ sgrub pa brten par ldan pa'i rigs la sngar nges 'byed cha mthun ji skad bshad

(310) pa go sgrub sogs dang*/ tshogs sgrub sogs kyi ngo bo mthong lam dang*/ sogs pa/ sgom lam la sogs pa'i sgrub pa gzhan yang 'byung bas sgrub pa de rnams kyi rten nam gzhir gyur pa rigs 'chad do// gnyis pa la/ rten la sangs rgyas kyi rigs zhes brjod ces kun la sbyar ro// chos drug ni/ drod kyi rtogs pa'i chos kyi'o// mdo ni/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' la bya'i rjes med cing mi dmigs so// rab 'byor de bzhin du/ byang sems kyi tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so// zhes so// de la nam mkha' ni/ rigs kyi dpe'o// bya'i rjes sogs rtogs pa/ de med pa ni/ rigs kyi rang bzhin no// tshig gi don dang gzhi'i don/ 'gyur khyad do// rtse mo'i rtogs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas med cing sogs so// bzod pa'i rtogs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas med sogs so// chos mchog gi rtogs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don med sogs so// mthong lam gyi rtogs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la tshig gi don med sogs so// sgom lam gyi rtogs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ skye ba med pa'i tshig gi don med sogs so// spang bya'i gnyen po skye ba'i'o// mdo ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon par shar ba'i tshe mun pa'i gnas med sogs so// mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i'o// mdo ni/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i tshe 'du byed kyi gnas med sogs so// gnyen po dang mi mthun phyogs kyi rnam rtog de dag yongs su gtugs pa ste/ spangs pa'i'o// mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims ngan pa'i gnas med sogs so// srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i shes rab snying brtser

(311) bcas pa'i'o// mdo ni/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od la gnas med sogs so// slob ma nyan thos sogs dang thun mong min pa'i yon tan gyi'o// mdo ni/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ gza' dang*/ skar ma dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ glog gi 'od la gnas med sogs so// gzhan gyi don dge legs gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro ba'i go rim gyi'o// mdo ni/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med sogs so// sems can gyi don dang*/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar te/ lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i'o// mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od la gnas med sogs so// de la gnas ni/ rten gyi dngos po/ med pa ni/ de bzhin nyid de/ rigs so// gsum pa la/ ngo bo/ go rim/ grangs nges pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ re zhig ni/ rim pa bzhin du ston pa ste/ ji srid du zhes pa'i don to// bcu gsum gyi dang po lo ka'i nges par 'byed par cha mthun drod sogs bzhi po rnams so// de'i 'og tu ni/ de nas te/ de'i rjes la zhes pa'o// khams gsum gyi gnyen po lo ka las 'das pa mthong sgom gyi lam dag go /de'i 'og tu mthong sgom gyi lam de dag skyes pa'i stobs kyis/ dper na/ rkun po phyung ba dang sgo 'phar bcad pa dus mnyam pa ltar/ gnyen po lam de dag skye ba dang lam de dag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'gag pa dag dus mnyam du 'byung ba'o// de'i 'og tu spang gnyen de dag mi dmigs par rtogs pas spang gnyen de dag skye ba dang 'gag pa dang ldan pa'i rnam rtog shes sgrib spangs ba'o// de'i 'og tu sngon gyi gzhan don byed pa'i smon lam dang sbyin pa la sogs pa mi dmigs par shes pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i

(312) mtshan nyid kyi shes rab dang thabs so// de'i 'og tu thabs shes rab de dag skyes pas nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos lo ka mtha' yas su 'phro ba'i ye shes stobs bcu la sogs so// de'i 'og tu 'god pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gzhan gyi don gyi go rim mo// 'god ces drang ngo*// gang la na/ theg pa gsum gyi lam la'o// ji ltar na/ gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du'o// gang gi sgo nas na/ nyan thos bstan pa la gzhug pa'i phyir gzugs sogs kyi don yod par bshad pa lta bu gzhug pa la ldem dgongs te/ nyi shu par/ gzugs sogs skye mched yod par ni// des 'dul ba yi skye bo la// dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste// rdzus te skye ba'i sems can bzhin// zhes so// kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum la dgongs nas chos thams cad med do// yod do// rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa'o// zhes bshad pa mtshan nyid la ldem dgongs so// nga nyid sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs so// zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas nas gzod theg chen gyi rtogs pa skye'o zhes pa dang*/ bde ba can du skye bar smon lam btab na der skye zhes pa dang*/ la lar sbyin pa la bsngags la gzhan du smad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'byor pa bsngags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la la'i phun sum tshogs pa bsngags pa dang*/ gang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gnod par byed pa de dag mtho ris su 'gro bar bstan pa dang*/ nyan thos sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa'am/ theg pa gcig tu bshad pa rnams sangs rgyas la brnyas pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa brgyad kyi gnyen po la ldem dgongs te/ sangs rgyas chos la brnyas pa dang*// le lo cung zad chog 'dzin dang*// nga rgyal 'dod chags spyod pa dang*// 'gyod dang ma nges ldog pa ni// sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa ste// de yi gnyen por theg mchog gsungs// zhes so// snying po med la snying

(313) por shes// phyin ci log la legs par gnas// nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ snying po rnam g.yeng ngo*// de med pa la snying por 'dzin pa dang*/ rtag pa/ bde ba/ gtsang ba/ bdag tu 'dzin pa las phyin ci log mi rtag sogs la gnas/ yun ring por dka' spyad kyis nyon mongs pas rab tu nyon mongs par byas na byang chub thob ces pa bsgyur ba la ldem dgongs so// nyan thos dang ni ngo bo nyid// de bzhin nyes pa gdul ba dang*// brjod pa zab pa nyid la ni// ldem por dgongs pa 'di rnam bzhi// zhes so// dgongs pa can bzhi ni/ mnyam pa nyid dang don gzhan dang*// de bzhin du ni dus gzhan dang*// gang zag gi ni bsam pa la// dgongs pa rnam pa bzhir shes bya// zhes te/ mdzod du/ tshogs dang chos kyi sku dag dang*// 'go ba'i don ni spyod pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa ste// sku tshe rigs dang tshad kyis min// zhes pas rgyu 'bras byed pa gsum mnyam pa la dgongs nas/ nga sangs rgyas rnam gzigs nyid yin no// zhes pa dang*/ ji skad du/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya zhing*// zhes sogs don gzhan dang*/ gnyen po'i ldem dgongs gsum pa lta bu dus gzhan la skye ba la dgongs pa dang*/ bzhi pa lta bu gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa'o// 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ dgos pa gtso bor ston pa ldem dgongs/ dgongs gzhi gtso bor ston pa dgongs pa can te/ ngo bo gcig go /de dag sogs pa ste/ dgongs pa brgyad kyi sgo nas so// 'di dag kyang phal cher sems tsam dang bstun pa yin gyi/ 'dir nges par mi bsam ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes// thub pa yis ni gang bstan pa// byis rnams skrag pa spang don te// de ni de bzhin nyid ma nyid// stong nyid bdag nyid tshul gcig gi /sems 'di nyid la kun btags dang*// gzhan gyi dbang dang yongs grub pa// nyid du yang ni btags pa

(314) yin// zhes pa dang*/ theg gcig drang don du bstan pa'ang drang don yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// gtso bo'i theg par dbyer ma mchis// khyod kyis sems can gzhug pa'i phyir// theg pa gsum du gsungs pa'o// zhes de dag dgongs pa can du bshad do// de'i 'og tu 'byung ba'i phyir zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ gzhan gyi don gyi ye shes so// ji tsam du na/ 'khor ba ji srid bar ro// ji ltar na/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma med par lhun gyis grub par ro// gnyis pa ni/ bcu gsum po 'di ni/ rtogs pa'i go rim yin te/ de la bud+dha shrīs/ drug pas bdun man chad/ bdun brgyad gnyis sa brgyad pa zhes so// chos bshes kyis/ drug pa sgom lam spyi'o// bdun dgu gnyis ni/ drug po'i spangs pa dang thob pa/ brgyad pa ni/ sa gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar/ bcu pa sa bdun pa/ bcu gcig pa sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar/ bcu gnyis pa skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa/ bcu gsum pa ni/ bar chad med lam na yod kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod pa mi 'thad do// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sgrub pa chos can/ bcu gsum po 'di la chad lhag gi skyon med de/ bcu gsum po 'dis kyang*/ skyes bu'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// 'grel chen las/ 'dis kyang rtogs pa'i chos thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir zhes pa ltar na/ bcu gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod pa sher 'byung blo gros kyi dang*/ 'phags pas/ sems bskyed pa nas brtsams te nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa dang zhes pa gnyis ka khas blang dgos so// bzhi pa ni/ kun rdzob tu sgrub pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs nges 'byed cha mthun sogs tha dad pa'i bye brag gis/ byang sems rnam pa bcu gsum po'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la chos can sangs rgyas kyi rigs zhes bya ste/

sngar ji skad bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i chos kyi gzhi'am rten tu gyur pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ de (315) sems bskyed sogs dang sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba yin pas dang por bshad par rigs so// zhe na/ don la skye rim de ltar yin la/ 'di ni/ 'bras bu sngar bshad nas rgyu phyis 'chad pa bshad pa'i go rim mo// yang na/ 'bras bu sgrub pa/ rgyu rigs la mi 'khrul pas/ rgyu rigs rtogs par byed pas rtogs pa'i go rim yin no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod lan no// rtsod pa la/ khas blang brjod pa dang*/ thal ba dgod pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ don la 'jug pas na/ gal te'o// chos kyi dbyings kho na sangs rgyas sogs 'phags pa'i chos rtogs par 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir chos dbyings de'i bdag nyid can gyi byang sems bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos stobs sogs rnams kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs can yin na'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyogs snga khong du chud pas 'o na ni byang sems chos can/ de kho na sangs rgyas kyi rigs can min par thal/ chos dbyings de ni de dang gzhan nyan thos la sogs pa la'ang spyir gnas pa ste/ yod pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ de'i tshe'o snyam pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa ste/ shes rab chung ba'i ngor dogs pa bsus nas rtsod lan bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad kyis ston pa ni/ rigs ni chos can/ nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi rigs so// zhes tha dad du rung ba ma yin par thal/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ lan la/ bstan bcos dang*/ lo ka la grags pa'i lan gnyis so// dang po ni/ ji ltar ni/ dper na'o// rigs ngo bo gcig yin yang rkyen gyis byas pa'i nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ sogs pa rang rgyal gyi theg pa la sogs rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pas rigs tha dad 'thad par 'dod pa de bzhin du chos dbyings gcig yin kyang 'phags pa'i chos rtogs par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings la dmigs pa'i 'phags pa gsum po gang gi chos rtogs pa'i rgyu'i

(316) ngo bor rnam par 'jog pa ste rgyur gyur pa'i sgo nas/ de'i rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so// zhes bya ba'i lan zhig kyang gzigs mod kyi'o// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ mod kyi/ de bzhag nas sla chos nyid du lo ka pa'i ngag ste/ grags pa'i dpe yis lan gzhan du ston no// rtsa ba ni/ mthar thug rigs gsum gyi dbye ba med par thal ba 'dod pa yin no// rgyud las/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes so// gnas skabs rigs gsum du dbyer med par thal ba la khyab pa med de/ brten pa'i chos tha dad kyi bye brag gis rten rigs de'i dbye ba tha dad yongs su brjod do// 'grel pa ni/ dper na/ nyer len 'jim pa gcig las mngon par grub cing rkyen me lce gcig gis so btang ba rten rdza bum dang*/ sogs pa lhung bzed la sogs pa gcig nyid/ brten pa nang gi bcud sbrang rtsi dang*/ li khar ste/ bu ram dang*/ sogs pa khar la sogs pa'i snod nyid kyis bum pa tha dad du 'jog pa de bzhin du brten pa'i chos theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa rtogs shing thob par bya ba tha dad pa nyid kyis rten rigs tha dad pa nyid do zhes tha snyad du bstan gyi/ don dam par tha dad min te/ 'phags pas/ rigs de ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid kyis khyad par med pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ snga 'grel rtsa ba/ 'grel pa/ dgag sgrub bstan pa dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ sngar ji skad du bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i byang sems kyi dmigs pa gang yin snyam pa la de ston no// gnyis pa la/ bstan bshad shin tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i dmigs pa ni/ shes bya'i chos rnams thams cad yin te/ zhi lhas/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i// dngos de gang na'ang yod ma yin// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ chos de yang blang bya dge ba dang*/ sogs pa dor bya mi dge ba dang*/

btang (317) snyoms su gzhag bya lung ma bstan dang gsum mo// gsum pa ni/ so skyes bsdus pa lo ka pa'i rtog pa dang*/ 'phags pas bsdus pa gang dag lo ka las 'das par 'dod dang*/ kun btus su/ zag pa de'i bdag nyid dang*/ zag pa dang 'brel pa dang*/ zag pas bcings pa dang*/ zag pa'i rjes su 'brel ba dang*/ zag pa'i rjes su mthun pa dang*/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir zag pa dang bcas par blta'o// zhes pa ltar zag pa'i sgo drug dang 'brel pa zag bcas dang*/ zag pa'i sgo drug dang ma 'brel ba zag pa med chos dang*/ chos gang dag rkyen rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas byas pa dang*/ skye 'jig gnas 'gyur bzhi dang bral ba 'dus ma byas dang*/ slob ma ste/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la'ang 'byung ba thun mong gi chos rnams dang*/ chos gang dag thub pa sangs rgyas kho na'i thun mong min pa stobs sogs te/ brgyad do// mdo ni/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa dang*/ lo ka pa dang*/ lo ka las 'das pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa dang*/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa ste/ rab 'byor/ de dag ni chos thams cad ces bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ bstan bshad sgra don gyi sgo nas don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ re zhig dmigs pa bcu gcig gi dang po spyir te/ nyan thos sogs dang*/ thun mong du bshad pa go rim bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i nyes pas ma gos pa'i rnam byang*/ dge ba'am khyad par mi dge ba'i gnyen por gyur pas dge ba'i las te/ dge sbyong gi tshul dri ma med pa'i lam nyid dang*/ tshul khrims la sogs pa ste/ ngo bo nyid dang 'brel pa la sogs pa'o// dge ba'i 'gal ba'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa mi dge ba ste/ bsam bzhin ma nor bar gzhan gsad pa srog gcod pa dang*/ sogs pa ma byin par len pa la sogs pa lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum mo//

(318) dge mi dge gang yang min pa'i las ni/ lung du ma bstan pa ste/ lung du ma bstan pa'i lus kyi las dang*/ sogs pa ngag dang yid kyi las bzo dang sprul pa dang spyod lam dang rnam smin bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i 'og tu gsum po de dag nyid lo ka pa dang*/ sogs pa lo ka las 'das pa la sogs pa rnam pa gnyis po ste/ zung du sbyar ba'i dbye ba/ phrag bzhi nyid kyis/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan dor ba'i lhag ma rnams te/ sogs kyi sgra re re la sbyar te/ rtsa ba'i grangs sam go rim bzhin du ston pa ni/ byis pa ni/ 'phags pa dang mkhas pa dang rgan po'i zlas grangs pa gsum las/ 'dir dang po ste/ de'i skye bo thams cad kyis bsdus pa'i phung po lnga dang*/ khams dang skye mched la sogs pa ni/ lo ka pa'o// 'phags pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis bsdus pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med pa nas ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar lo ka las 'das pa'o// gang zag gi bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po ma yin pa nyid kyis/ ma 'ongs pa'i phung po la 'dun pa dang*/ da ltar bas 'dod chags pa'i nye bar len pa dang ldan pa'i phung po lnga dang*/ khams/ gzugs med/ mngon shes lnga'i bar ni/ zag bcas so// bdag der lta ba'i gnyen po 'dod 'dun dang ma 'brel ba dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar ni/ zag med do// kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen la rag las nas 'byung ba 'dod khams sogs/ khams gsum dang byang chub kyi phyogs la sogs pa 'dus byas so// rgyu rkyen la mi ltos pa khams gsum du ma gtogs pa de bzhin nyid dang 'dod chags zad pa sogs kyi 'gog pa ni/ 'dus ma byas so// 'phags pa'i skye bo ste/ gang zag thams cad de/ phal cher gyi rgyud la 'byung ba'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ tshad med sogs ni/ thub pa dang gzhan gyi thun mong gi chos dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la 'byung ba mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi chos can nam/

stobs (319) kyi khyad chos mang po'i chos can stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa thun mong min pa'o// gsum pa ni/ tshul de lta bu la sogs pa'i shes bya'i chos thams cad sgyu ma ji lta bur ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pas te/ las dang po pas zhen nas dmigs la/ phyi ma rnams kyis zhen med du dmigs pa'am/ yang na/ dge ba blang bya la sogs par rim gyis bsgom zhing sems pas na/ spyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas dmigs pa rnam pa bcu gcig go /bzhi pa ni/ gzhan dag chos nyid rtag tu dag pa gnyis med kyi ye shes kho na dmigs pa yin no// snyam na/ dmigs pa chos can/ gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro mi srid par thal/ rtag tu dag pa'i phyir ro// gal te/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams// dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod// ces glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'o zhe na/ 'o na ni/ dag pa de kho na nyid kyi ye shes so// zhes gnyen po la zhen pa dang*/ de yod na/ spang bya la zhen pa'ang yod pas de gnyis ma spangs pas dag pa phyogs gcig par 'gyur ro// 'o na/ khyod la'ang dag pa khyad par du 'gro ba med par 'gyur te/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med pa'o zhes pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ dngos po med pa ni/ gnyis kyi dngos por dmigs shing zhen pa med pa yin pas so// des na/ rang bzhin gtso bor gyur pa ni/ rigs yin la/ rnam 'gyur gtso bor gyur pa ni/ dmigs pa yin pas khyad par yod cing*/ gnyis ka'ang gnyis kar ma bkag ste/ 'brel bas dmigs pa dag pa khyad par du 'gro ba 'thad do// gsum pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ dmigs pa bcu gcig po de lta bu la sgrub pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ched du bya ba gang yin zhe na/ ched du bya ba ston pa/ rtsa ba ni/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rang

(320) nyid sangs rgyas su 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i byang sems rnams kyi ched du bya ba 'di'o// yang na/ rang byung ni/ sangs rgyas yin la/ byang sems ni/ de thob pa'i skal pa can yin pas rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming ngo*// gang gis na/ sems can gyi phung po dang*/ sde chen po kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i chos sems chen po ste/ mdo ni/ sems can gyi phung po chen po dang*/ sems can gyi sde chen po kun gyi mchog nyid du byed par 'gyur ba de'i phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o// zhes so// sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa/ spong ba chen po ste/ mdo ni/ thabs mkhas pas lta ba'i rnam pa de dag spang ba'i phyir mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston zhes sogs so// tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du chags pa med par chos thams cad rtogs pa/ rtogs pa chen po ste/ mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub kyi sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma lags pa'i sems/ zag pa ma mchis shing khams gsum du ma gtogs pa'i sems gang lags pa de la'ang rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i slad du chags pa ma mchis pa ste/ de'i phyir byang sems zhes bgyi ba'i grangs su mchi'o// zhes so// de ltar gsum po la chen po gsum gyis so// 'grel pa na/ shes par bya'o zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi spangs rtogs rnam pa thams cad du yongs su shes pa'i sgo nas rnam mkhyen du 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ der btags pa byang sems rnams kyis ched du bya ba'o// ji ltar na/ spangs rtogs gzhan don chen po nyid gsum dang ldan pas rnam pa gsum du'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsum po de nyid kyi dbang du byas nas tshul de ltar sgrub pa la 'jug pas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ro// 'o na/ gsum po gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad sems can gyi phung po

(321) chen po 'khor ba pa'i sems can gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ sems can gyi sde chen po rigs kyi sa pa la sogs zhugs pa dang gnas pa'i gang zag kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i chos sems bskyed pa lnga ste/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor ba dpag tu med par go cha gyon te/ bdog pa thams cad gtong zhing sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pas de dag theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan las 'das kyang 'das pa med par rtogs la/ nyan thos dang ma 'dres pas phyin drug la spyad de/ kun tu 'gro ba dang chos thams cad tshul gcig tu rtogs par bya ba dang*/ sems can re re'i don du'ang de dag myang 'das ma thob bar du bdag gis de'i sdug bsngal myong bar bya'o zhes khas blangs nas phyis tshogs bsags te byang chub 'dod pa rdo rje lta bu'i sems so// sems bskyed phyin chad chags sogs dang*/ nyan thos kyi sems mi bskyed pa rlabs po che'i sems so// rtag tu rlom sems med pa mi bsgul ba'i sems dang*/ sems can thams cad skyob cing mi gtong la rlom pa med pa phan bde'i sems dang*/ chos la dga' bas stong nyid thams cad dang*/ byang chub phyogs mthun dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar dang*/ rdo rje lta bu ting nge 'dzin gyi bar la mi dmigs pas gnas pa mos pa'i sems bskyed pa lnga ni/ sems chen po nyid dang*/ bdag tu lta ba nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar lta bu'i bar gyi lta ba rnams spang ba'i phyir mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa spong ba chen po nyid dang*/ gang dang yang mi mnyam pa sangs rgyas yin la/ de dang mnyam pa'i sems sogs rtogs pa chen po'o// nyid ni/ dngos po'i rkyen no// dmigs pa dang ched du bya ba'i khyad par ni/ yul gyi cha dmigs pa/ 'bras bu'i cha ched du bya ba'o// bzhi pa la gsum ste/ sgrub pa spyi'i ngo bo/ bye brag gi sa (322) mtshams/ so so'i don no// dang po la/

sngar bshad pa de ltar sgrub pa'i rten tu gyur pa rigs dang*/ sogs pa dmigs pa ched du bya ba rnams brjod nas sgrub pa de'i rang gi ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ lan ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yul la goms pa'i mthu ma thob pa'i phyir spyir dge ba ste/ dkar po'i chos spyi'i rten can sgo du ma nas spyod pa'i bya ba ni/ mkhyen gsum yul gyi sgrub pa'o// rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa dang*/ sogs pa rtse sbyor la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa rnam pa bzhi la yun ring du 'dres pa'i mthus mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs re re zhing yang dge ba sgrub pa ji snyed pa phyin drug gi rten can du bsdus te sgrub nus pa'i bya ba ni/ sbyor ba'i sgrub pa ste/ dang po spyi yin la/ 'di khyad par ro// chos sku ni/ 'bras bu yin pas/ bya ba gzhan med pa'i phyir de la sgrub pa med do// chos bshes kyis/ go sgrub ni/ gnyis ka yin pa/ gzhan gsum dang por bzhed do// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ 'jug sgrub tshogs lam chung ngu nas yod la/ nges 'byung sgrub pa rgyun mtha' kho na na yod do// zhe na/ 'jug sgrub chos can/ tshogs lam chung ngu na med par thal/ mos spyod kyi sas bsdus pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ sdud 'grel las/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni/ mos pa spyod pa'i sa yin par rtogs par bya'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// nges 'byung sgrub pa chos can/ byams pa la med par thal/ rgyun mtha' kho na na yod pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ 'phags pa byams pas brnyes pa ltar nges par 'byung ba bya ba yin/ zhes 'grel chen las bshad pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar na/ sgrub pa bzhi dang lam bzhi rim pa ji lta ba'am/ ji ltar rigs pa'i rim pa bzhin du sbyor ba'i lam la dngos dang*/ brgyud pa dang*/ mngon sum du sbyor ba gsum las/ mthong lam la brgyud pas sbyor ba tshogs lam gyi ngo bo nyid go cha'i sgrub pa dang*/

dngos su sbyor ba nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ngo bo nyid 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ mngon sum du sbyor ba chos (323) mchog gi ngo bo nyid tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga/ mthong lam gyi ngo bo nyid sa rab dga' dang*/ mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub sgom lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid sa dgu dang*/ sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub/ khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid nges 'byung sgrub pa rnams so// thogs med kyis/ go cha dang 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dag ni/ go rim bzhin du brgyud pa dang dngos su sbyor ba'i rang bzhin/ tshogs dang mos pa spyod pa'i sas bsdus pa yin no// tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni/ rtse mo nas brtsams te gzungs kyi bar ni/ mngon sum du sbyor ba'i rang bzhin/ chos mchog chen po bsdus pa yin no// sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni/ mthong ba'i lam gyi bdag nyid yin la/ sa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin/ sgom pa'i lam gyi ngo bo nyid yin zhing*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi bdag nyid can gyi tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni/ lam gnyis ka'i spyod yul can yin no// nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam la brten pa yin no// zhes gsungs la/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ de nyid 'grel chen du shes byed du bris la/ sdud 'grel du de dang mthun par sa mtshams bzhag cing*/ a bh+yas kyang de ltar bzhed do// nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i snga logs man chad na yod de/ rgyun mtha' na de'i 'byung sa yod pas so// gsum pa ni/ chos bshes dang*/ sher 'byung blo gros kyis rim pa ji lta ba bzhin sbyar ba dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ gtso che ba la dgongs pas so// chos bshes kyis/ de ltar sgrub pa bzhi lam bzhir bstan pa ni/ re zhig shas che ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ de dag re re zhing yang thams cad du mi 'gro ba ma yin pas nyes pa med do// zhes so// de ltar min na/

mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ mthong lam na med par thal/ sgom lam kho nar yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lung dang 'gal lo// yang nges par (324) 'byung sa chos can/ brgyad po las lhag pa yod par thal/ slob lam na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ khyab pa med de/ slob lam na yod kyang lam gyi yul can du nges par 'byung sa la de bas lhag pa shes bya la med de/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na de'i 'byung sa med pas so// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ go 'jug tshogs nges so// dang po la/ snga 'grel/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa las/ dang po ni/ bzhi po rnams kyi nang nas sgrub pa bzhi'i dang po go cha'i brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo nyid kyis phyin drug re re la thams cad tshang bar sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i mda' mtshon gyis mi phigs pa mi dmigs pa go cha'i sgrub pa gsungs pa/ gnyis pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po ni/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*// nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang*// de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs// yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin zhes bya// zhes pa bcu'i steng du khyad par dpyad pa dang bcu gcig gis bshad par bya'o// dang po la drug ste/ rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don/ theg chen lam/ bslab gsum la ltos te phyin drug tu grangs nges so// dang po ni/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*/ rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*// bya ba rnams ni phyin ci ma log pa'o// zhes phar phyin dang po bzhis longs spyod/ lus/ 'khor/ las kyi mtha' thams cad rtsom pa bzhis mngon mtho sgrub pa'o// phyi ma gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ bya ba phyin ci ma log par rtsom pas nges legs sgrub pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sems can don la rab brtson pa// gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed// gnas dang grol ba gzhir bcas pas// rang don rnam pa thams cad spyod// ces pas/

phar phyin dang po gsum gyis gtong ba dang mi gnod pa dang gnod pa la bzod pas gzhan don byed do// bsam gtan gyis sems (325) gnas/ shes rab kyis grol/ brtson 'grus kyis de gnyis kyi gzhi byed pas rang don byed do// gsum pa ni/ mi 'phongs pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang*// rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang*// dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir// gzhan gyi don ni rang gi don yin no// zhes pas phyin drug gis yo byad kyis mi 'phongs pa dang*/ mi 'tshe ba dang*/ 'tshe ba bzod pa dang*/ dgos pa'i grogs bya bas mi skyo ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i mthus dga' bar byed pa dang*/ the tshom gcod pa'i sgo nas legs par brjod pa drug gis gzhan don byed do// bzhi pa ni/ longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang*// rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang*// rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa// theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do// zhes pas longs spyod la mi lta ba dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa dang*/ duḥkha la mi skyo ba dang*/ dge ba la mi skyo ba dang*/ zhi gnas kyi rnal 'byor/ lhag mthong rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ drug gis theg chen thams cad bsdus so// lnga pa ni/ yul rnams la ni ma chags lam// de thob rnam g.yeng sdom pa gzhan// sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang*// sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba gzhan// zhes pas yul rnams la chags pa'i dang*/ de thob pa'i rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i dang*/ sems can mi gtong ba'i dang*/ dge ba 'phel ba'i dang*/ nyon mongs dang*/ shes sgrib sbyong ba'i lam dang drug go /drug pa ni/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni// rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum// tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis// gcig ni gsum char la'ang gtogs// zhes pa dang po gsum tshul khrims kyi/ bsam gtan sems kyi/ shes rab shes rab kyi bslab pa'o// brtson 'grus ni/ thams cad la gtogs pa'o// gnyis pa la/

mtshan nyid ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gtong pa chos (326) bzhi ldan no// chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna nyams pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ gang ci 'dod pa de la sbyin pas 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ sbyin pas bsdus nas theg pa gsum gyis skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can smin par byed pa gsum mo// de bzhin du spong ba'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa chos bzhi ldan dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la spro ba chos bzhi ldan dang*/ sems rtse gcig pa chos bzhi ldan dang*/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed chos bzhi ldan rnams tshul khrims la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid do// sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed// sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum// de bzhin du gzhan la'ang 'don pa bsgyur ro// gsum pa la/ go rim ni/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim par bstan pa yin// zhes pas skye ba'i rim pa ni/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ byang sems lus dang longs spyod la mi lta na ni/ tshul khrims yang dag par len par byed do// tshul khrims rjes su bsrungs na/ bzod pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// bzod pa dang ldan na/ brtson 'grus rtsom par 'gyur ro// brtson 'grus brtsams na/ bsam gtan sgrub par 'gyur ro// bsam gtan bsgrubs na/ lo ka las 'das pa'i shes rab thob bo// zhes pa ltar ro// dman mchog gi rim pa ni/ snga ma snga ma dman la phyi ma phyi ma mchog go /phra rags kyi rim pa ni/ snga ma rnams rags la/ phyi ma rnams phra bas so// bzhi pa ni/ nges tshig ni/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes pas rang gzhan gyi dbul ba 'dor ba/

nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba las (327) bsil ba thob pa/ khro ba bzod pa/ dge ba mchog dang sbyor ba/ yid nang du 'dzin pas bsam gtan/ don dam pa shes pa rnams so// lnga pa sgom pa ni/ thams cad sgom pa dngos po dang*// de bzhin yid la byed pa dang*// bsam pa dang ni thabs dag dang*// dbang sbyor nyid la brten par brjod// ces pas rgyu dang*/ rnam smin dang*/ smon lam dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i stobs la brten pa bzhis dngos po la brten pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/ ro myang ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang dang*/ mngon par dga' ba yid la byed pa bzhis yid la byed pa la brten pa dang*/ ngom mi shes pa/ rgya chen po/ dga' ba/ phan pa/ ma gos pa/ dge ba'i bsam pa ste/ drug gis bsam pa la brten pa dang*/ 'khor gsum dag pa'i thabs la brten pa dang*/ sku dang spyod pa dang ston pa la dbang 'byor pa dang gsum gyis dbang 'byor pa la brten pa'o// drug pa rab dbye la/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab kyi dbye ba drug las dang po ni/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang*// rtsa ba'i sems pa la brten dang*// lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang*// gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang*// ser sna med ldan de la ni// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gtong*// sbyin pa de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed// ces pa don drug ste/ len pa po rnams la don gtong ba/ ngo bo ma chags pa la sogs pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sems pa rgyu/ lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs 'bras bu/ rang gzhan rjes su 'dzin cing byang chub chen po'i tshogs rdzogs par byed pa las/ ser sna med pa ldan pa/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa gsum 'jug pa'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ yan lag drug zhi bsam pas zin// bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang*// rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med// bsod nams tshogs dang ldan pa dang*// brdar btags chos nyid thob pa ste// sdom

(328) la gnas pa rnams la yod// tshul khrims de 'dra la sogs so// yan lag drug ni/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gnas pa/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa/ cho ga phun sum tshogs pa/ spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa/ kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam la yang 'jigs par lta ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang dag par blangs te slob pa rnams ngo bo/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi bsam pas zin pa rgyu/ bde 'gror skye ba 'bras bu/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten/ nyon mongs kyis gdungs pa zhi ba/ mi dge ba'i rgyus 'jigs pa dang kha na ma tho ba dang 'khon rnams med pas 'jigs pa med pa las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa ldan pa/ brdar btags pa so thar gyi sdom pa/ chos nyid kyis thob pa bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa gnyis te/ gsum ni/ 'jug pa'o// gsum pa ni/ mi mjed ji mi snyam shes dang*// snying rjes chos la brten pa'i phyir// phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad// de ni gnyis kyi don byed de// dka' thub gtso dang kun tu ldan// de la de ni rnam gsum 'dod// bzod pa de 'dra la sogs so// gnod pa la mi mjed ba/ duḥkha la ji mi snyam pa/ chos la nges par rtog pa bzod pa'i ngo bo'o// snying rjes tshul khrims dang thos pa sogs dge ba la brten pa rgyu/ 'khon med pa/ dbyen med pa/ bde ba dang yid bde ba mang ba/ 'gyod pa med par 'chi ba/ shi nas bde 'gror skye ba lnga 'bras bu/ rang gzhan gyi don byed pa las/ dka' thub kyi mchog dang ldan pa ldan pa/ sngar bshad pa gsum po 'jug pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ dge la yang dag spro ba dang*// dad dang 'dun la brten pa dang*// dran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyen po dang*// ma chags la sogs yon tan ldan// de dag la yang de rnams bdun// brtson 'grus de 'dra sogs te/ dge ba la spro ba ngo bo/ dad pa dang don gnyer rgyu/ dran pa ting nge 'dzin sogs 'bras bu/

nyon (329) mongs kyi gnyen po byed pa las/ ma chags pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ldan pa/ bslab pa gsum la lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa drug thun mong du gus sbyor te/ bdun 'jug pa'o// lnga pa ni/ sems ni nang du gnas pa dang*// dran dang brtson 'grus la brten pa// bde ba skye bar byed pa dang*// mngon shes gnas la dbang bsgyur dang*// chos rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste/ de dag la yod de rnam gsum// bsam gtan de 'drar sogs te/ sems nang du gnas pa ngo bo/ dran pa brtson 'grus gnyis rgyu/ bde ba skye ba 'bras bu/ mngon shes 'phags pa lha tshangs pa'i gnas la dbang bsgyur ba las/ chos thams cad kyi gtso bo ldan pa ldan pa/ rtog dpyod dang bcas pa/ rtog pa med pa dpyod pa tsam/ rtog dpyod med pa gsum 'jug pa'o// drug pa ni/ shes bya yang dag rab rnam 'byed// ting nge 'dzin la brten pa dang*// kun nas nyon mongs shin tu grol// shes rab 'tsho ba legs bshad dang*// chos rnams kyi ni mchog yin te// de dag la yod de rnam gsum// shes rab de 'drar sogs te/ shes bya yang dag rnam par 'byed pa ngo bo/ bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin rgyu/ nyon mongs pa las grol ba 'bras bu/ shes rab kyis bla na med par 'tsho ba dang chos legs par bshad pa las/ chos thams cad kyi mchog ldan pa ldan pa/ lo ka pa dang lo ka las 'das pa chung ngu nyan rang dang*/ chen po theg chen gyi shes rab gsum 'jug pa'o// bdun pa bsdus pa ni/ dkar po'i chos kun rnam par g.yeng ba dang*// mnyam par gzhag dang gnyis kar shes par bya// pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis// gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin// dkar chos thams cad mnyam rjes/ gnyis ka gsum du 'dus la/ rjes thob ni/ sbyin pa tshul khrims kyis bsdus/ mnyam gzhag ni/ bsam gtan shes rab (330) kyis bsdus/ gnyis ka ni/ bzod pa brtson 'grus kyis bsdus so// brgyad pa ni/

mi mthun phyogs kyi chags pa bdun bdun te/ dang po sbyin pa'i bdun ni/ longs spyod/ phyi bshol/ de tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa/ lan la re ba/ rnam smin/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna'i bag la nyal/ theg dman gyi yid byed 'khor gsum du rtog pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba la chags pa ste/ bdun las grol ba'o// de bzhin du/ gzhan la'ang chags pa dang po rang rang gi mi mthun phyogs mngon gyur/ drug pa bag la nyal/ gzhan 'gre'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ ma chags mi chags chags pa med// chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te// ma chags mi chags chags pa med// de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar ro// dgu pa yon tan la/ yon tan bzhi bstan/ mchog brgyad bstan pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas sras rnams slong dang phrad na rang gi srog kyang rtag tu gtong*// snying rjes gzhan la lan yang mi re 'dod pa'i 'bras bu don mi gnyer// sbyin pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// sbyin pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas lo ka dag na mi bzad bzhag /rgyal ba'i sras rnams sdom dang brtson pa'i rang bzhin tshul khrims gsum rtag blangs// mtho ris mngon par mi 'dod yang dag thob kyang de la chags mi byed// tshul khrims de nyid man chad 'don pa bsgyur ro// sdom pa ni/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims so// brtson pa ni/ dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed do// sangs rgyas sras rnams shin tu bya dka' de bzhin mi yi gnod kun bzod// mtho ris gnyer dang mi nus pas min 'jigs pas ma yin phan ltas min// bzod pa bla na med pa sogs so// bzod pa gnyis po duḥkha la ji mi snyam pa dang*/ gnod pa la mi mjed pa'o// rgyal ba'i sras rnams go cha'i sbyor ba'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus dpe med byas// rang dang gzhan gyi (331) nyon mongs tshogs 'joms byang chub dam pa thob par byed// brtson 'grus sogs so// rgyal ba'i sras rnams ting 'dzin mang ldan bsam gtan rnam pa thams cad sgrub// bsam gtan bde ba'i phul gyis gnas shing snying rjes skye ba dman la brten// bsam gtan sogs so// rgyal ba'i sras rnams de nyid shes bya gang yin mtha' dag rnam kun shes// mya ngan 'das la'ang blo yis chags rab mi skyed 'khor bar smos ci dgos/

ye shes de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// ye shes sems can yongs su bzung bas lo ka dag na mi zad bzhag /ces so// de nyid ni/ bdag med gnyis so// shes bya mtha' dag ni/ ji snyed pa'o// de la rkang pa dang pos sbyin sogs rgya che/ gnyis pas rang don la ma chags pas zang zing med pa/ gsum pas sems can gyi don chen po byas pas don che ba/ bzhi pas sbyin sogs lnga mi rtog ye shes kyis zin pas lhag med du'ang mi 'dzad la/ shes rab ni/ sems can yongs su bzung bas mi zad pa ste/ rgya che ba dang zang zing med// don che ba dang mi zad pa// sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyi// yon tan bzhir ni shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyin pa'i rten byang sems/ sbyin pa gsum gyi gzhi ni/ nang gi dngos po lus dang*/ ngan song dang*/ 'khor bas mi 'jigs pa dang*/ theg chen gyi chos so// rgyu mtshan snying rje'o// yongs su bsngo ba ni/ byang chub chen po don gnyer ro// rgyu ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la goms pa'i bag chags so// ye shes 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'o// zhing ni/ slong ba dang*/ duḥkha pa dang*/ rten med pa nyes par spyod pa dang*/ yon tan can no// gnas ni/ mos pa dang*/ yid la byed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang 'byor ba'o// de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi gzhi/ byang sems kyi sdom pa/ bzod pa'i gzhi/ shin tu dman pas gnod pa chen po (332) byed pa/ brtson 'grus kyi gzhi/ phar phyin sgom pa dang de'i spang bya spong ba/ bsam gtan gyi gzhi byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi gzhi/ de bzhin nyid/ thams cad kyi zhing theg chen no// gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin no// sbyin pa rten dang gzhi dang ni// rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang*// rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang*// gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod// de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur ro// bcu pa phan tshun rnam par nges pa ni/
