phan tshun bsdus phyir rab dbye'i phyir// chos nyid phyir dang rgyu mtshan phyir// pha rol phyin drug rnam kun tu// rnam par nges par shes par bya// zhes te/ phan tshun bsdu ba ni/ tshul khrims dang bzod pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas bsdus/ bsam gtan shes rab chos kyi sbyin pas bsdus/ brtson 'grus ni/ de gnyis kas bsdus so// de bzhin du dge ba chos sdud kyis lnga po thams cad bsdus so// gzhan yang des shes par bya'o// rab dbye ni/ re re la drug drug tshang ba gzhung du ston pa bzhin no// chos nyid kyi phyir ni/ sbyin sogs don brjod bya dang*/ mdo la sogs pa rjod byed phan tshun bsdus pa'o// rgyu mtshan gyi phyir ni/ sbyin pa'ang tshul khrims kyi rgyu yin te/ longs spyod la mi lta na/ tshul khrims len pa'i phyir ro// tshul khrims kyang sbyin pa'i rgyu mtshan yin te/ dge sbyong gi sdom pa blangs na/ yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad gtong ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin du gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o// bcu gcig pa la/ 'bras bu dang*/ nges par 'gyur ba/ gdon mi za bar bya ba/ rtag tu bya ba/ gtso che ba/ tshogs gnyis/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i khyad par dang bdun no// dang po ni/ bral 'bras rang gi spang bya spangs pa/ rgyu mthun khyad par can gyi phyi ma/ bdag 'bras yon tan bzhi'am/ sngar bshad pa'i ldan pa/ skyes bu byed 'bras/ snod nyid du ni byed pa dang*// tshul khrims dag la 'god pa dang*// gnod pa la ni bzod pa dang*// don byed par ni 'gro ba dang*// bstan pa 'di la 'dzud pa dang*// the tshom gcod par byed pa 'di// blo ldan (333) rnams kyi sems can la// phan 'dogs nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes so// rnam smin ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde// bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson pas brjid// bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/

blo ldan rnam pa thams cad du// phun tshogs skye dang mi skyo dang*// rtag tu sgom par byed pa dang*// ting 'dzin nyams pa med pa dang*// bya ba 'grub dang lhun grub pa'i// bzod pa thob la nges par 'gyur// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ mchod bslab yang dag bslang ba dang*// snying rjes dge ba sgom pa dang*// de bzhin dgon par bag yod dang*// thos don ngom mi shes pa dang*// sa rnams kun la brtan pa yis// gdon mi za bar bya ba nyid// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs shes pa dang*// 'khrul pa dag la rtog pa dang*// duḥkha dang du len nyid dang*// dge ba dag ni sgom pa dang*// bde la ro myang med nyid dang*// mtshan ma rnam par mi rtog pa// sa rnams kun la brtan pa yis// rtag tu bya ba dag yin no// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ chos sbyin tshul khrims dag pa dang*// mi skye bzod pa thob nyid dang*// theg chen brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mtha' la snying rje ldan gnas dang*// shes rab blo dang ldan rnams kyi// pha rol phyin pa'i gtso bor 'dod// ces so// drug pa ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi// tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi// gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka ste// lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs// zhes so// bdun pa ni/ re ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang*// yang srid mi 'dod tshul khrims dang*// thams cad la ni bzod pa dang*// yon tan kun 'byung brtson 'grus dang*// de bzhin bsam gtan gzugs med min// shes rab thabs dang ldan pa ni// pha rol phyin pa drug po la// brtan pa rnams kyis yang dag sbyor// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ bshad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin de'o// (334) ji ltar na/ mdo ji lta ba bzhin du'o// gang gis na drug tshan drug gis so// de gang zhe na/ bsdus pa yis so// gang na/ phar phyin drug po de dag go /gang du na/ sbyin pa la sogs pa rnam pa drug tu'o// ji ltar na/

so sor te/ re re la thams cad tshang ba'i tshul du'o// mdo ni/ sems dpa' chen po shī la'i phar phyin la de ltar spyod pa ni/ phar phyin drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ phye ste bshad pa dang*/ bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po la/ drug tshan drug las/ dang po la/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la spyod pa na/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ sogs pa zang zing gi sbyin pa la sogs sbyin pa na/ sbyin pa'i dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba sbyin pa'i go cha dang*/ de nyid kyi nyan thos kyi yid la byed pa la sogs pa spong ba tshul khrims kyi dang*/ de nyid rnam mkhyen nyid kyi chos la bzod cing mos pa skye ba thams cad kyis mi snyan par smra ba nyid bzod pa bzod pa'i dang*/ de nyid dge ba'i rtsa ba gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa brtson 'grus kyi dang*/ de nyid nyan rang gi theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa nyid kyis dge ba bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi dang*/ de nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i 'du shes nye bar gnas pas sbyin par bya ba dang*/ sbyin pa po dang*/ len pa po mi dmigs pa ni/ 'di'i skabs kyi shes rab kyi go cha yin la/ 'og ma rnams kyi ni go rim bzhin du/ sogs pa tshul khrims bsrung bya srung byed la sogs pa mi dmigs par go bar bya ste/ drug tshan dang po'o// re re la thams cad tshang ba de bzhin du tshul khrims srung bar byed pa gnyis pa/ bzod pa rdzogs par byed pa gsum pa/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa bzhi pa/ bsam gtan sgrub pa lnga pa/ de lta bus shes rab sgom par byed pa drug pa'o// 'di ni/ 'bum ṭīka bsngo ba sbyin pa la sbyar la/ 'phags pa dang 'grel chen gnyis (335) kas 'di dang mthong lam rtse sbyor gnyis ka bsngo ba bsam gtan la sbyar ba ltar bris pa'o// yang na/

dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba shes rab yin la/ drug po la go rim bzhin du sbyin par bya ba la sogs pa mi dmigs pa ni/ go cha'o zhes gser gling pa'i ltar bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ bsdus pas na/ go cha'i sgrub pa rnam drug go /gang bsdus na/ sbyin pa la sogs pa phar phyin no// gang gis na/ sbyin pa la sogs pas so// ji ltar na/ sngar bshad pa de ltar so sor te/ re re la thams cad tshang bar ro// 'o na/ so drug tu 'gyur ro zhe na/ drug tshan drug gis rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug yin mod kyi/ sbyin pa la sogs drug dang go cha drug tu chos mthun pa'i phyir/ drug tu bsdus so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ tshul de ltar rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis phar phyin rnams mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i go bgos pa la theg chen la 'jug pa 'byung bas sgrub pa gnyis pa theg chen la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ston no// rtsa ba la/ 'jug yul theg chen ngos bzung ba dang*/ de la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'o// dang po la/ dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ mtshan nyid do// dang po ni/ dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di rnams dang ldan pa// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces te/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis rgya chen po la dmigs pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang*/ 'khor bar gnas kyang nyon mongs kyis mi gos pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang stobs dang mi 'jigs pa sogs yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ byang chub pa dang mya

(336) ngan las 'das pa la sogs sangs rgyas 'phrin las te/ dang po lnga rgyu'i theg chen/ gnyis 'bras bu'i theg chen no// chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir theg chen zhes nges tshig tu sbyar yang rung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*// de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang*// sbyin pa la sogs sgrub pa dang*// skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang*// sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang*// zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang*// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*// byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o// zhes te/ bcu po 'dis theg chen bsdus te/ rigs dang theg chen gyi chos la mos pa dang*/ de'i rgyus sems bskyed pa dang*/ phyin drug sgrub pa dang*/ sa dang po skyon med pa la 'jug pa dang*/ sa bdun pa'i bar sems can smin par byed pa dang*/ dag pa sa gsum la zhing sbyong ba dang*/ mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na byang chub pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'o// gsum pa la/ spyir theg chen ni/ bgrod pa gang zhig chen po bdun ldan/ khyad par rgyu'i theg chen ni/ chen po bdun ldan gang zhig 'dis bgrod par byed pa/ 'bras bu'i theg chen ni/ chen po bdun ldan gang zhig bgrod bya mthar thug pa'o// gnyis pa la/ shes par bya/ zhes dang po// gang na/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'o// ji ltar na/ dang por theg chen gyi chos la 'jug pa yin la/ phyis gong nas gong du khyad par rtogs pas 'dzeg pa yin par ro// yang na/ 'jug pa dang*/ 'dzeg pa don gcig tu'o// dbye na du zhe na/ dgu yod de/ dang por rang rang gi rnam pa dang rtags dang mtshan mas bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa zhes thams cad la sbyar te/ mdo ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag gis sbyin pa'i phar phyin la spyod/ ces sogs so// de nas tshogs gnyis la slob pa'i phyir 'khor gsum dag pa'i sbyin sogs lam

(337) shes pa'i 'o// mdo ni/ sems can thams cad kyis nyon mongs pa rab tu spang ba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o// snyam pa 'di ni/ sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin no// zhes so// de nas de kho na nyid la lhag par mos pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam la'o// mdo ni/ theg pa chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun sgom pa dang zhes so// de nas gzhan don byed pa'i byams pa dang*/ sogs pa snying rje sogs tshad med pa bzhi la'o// mdo ni/ byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad med pa/ 'khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ thams cad du song ba/ shin tu bsgoms pa/ phyogs gcig gi lo ka'i khams chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa thams cad dang ldan pa zhes sogs te/ dgu dang*/ gnyis dang*/ gnyis ni/ sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i ched med do// de nas gzhan don gyi 'ching ba spong ba dmigs pa med pa dang ldan pa la'o// mdo ni/ theg pa chen po ni/ gang nang stong pa nyid ces kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin no// zhes so// de nas las dang bya ba byed po mi dmigs pa 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa la'o// mdo ni/ sbyin pa po dang len pa po dang sbyin pa rnams mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs su med pa de ltar na zhes sogs so// de nas rang gi bsgrub bya la 'bad pa'i phyir ched du bya ba la'o// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas sgom par rnam par gzhig pa'i don du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom zhes so// de nas gzhan gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa la brtson par byed pas mngon shes drug la'o// mdo ni/ mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir na sems can yongs su smin par byed do// zhes so// de thob

(338) nas sangs rgya bar spro bas rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la'o// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed do// zhes so// 'grel pa la rtog pa'i rim pas yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can rnam pa dgu ni chos can/ 'jug sgrub yin te/ gang zhig bsam gtan sogs theg chen pa'i chos mtha' dag sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis gnon zhing bgrod pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// dgu po gang zhe na/ dang po ni/ yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ces thams cad la sbyor/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la rnam pa dang rtags dang mtshan ma mi dmigs par 'jug pa ste/ 'di'i mtha' bar pa la/ ngo bo dang*/ yan lag dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam byang dang*/ tshad dang drug go /ngo bo ni/ bsam gtan dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs dang mi ldan zhing 'dod pa'i dngos po la mi dmigs pas 'dod pas dben pa/ mi dge ba'i chos mtha' dag gis dben pa/ 'dod pa'i gnyen po rtog dpyod dang ldan pa/ dben pa las skyes pa/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i dga' bde dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rtog dpyod sems 'khrug byed kyi skyon du mthong nas de las ldog ste g.yeng ba'i dmigs pa dang bral nas rtse gcig dpyod pa'i dmigs pa dang gcig pas zhi ba dang nang rab tu dwang ba/ rtog dpyod dang bral zhing glags mi rnyed pas sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pa'o// gsum pa ni/ dga' ba yang dag pa nyid kyis btang snyoms su byed pa'i phyir dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i gzugs dang*/ yid kyi lus kyi bde ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ bde sdug yid bde mi bde dang bral ba/ dran pa dang btang snyoms yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa/ tshor ba btang snyoms pa dang ldan pa'o// gzugs med nam mkha' mtha' yas ni/ sngon po sogs kha dog dang gyang dang rwa ba sogs sgrib pa dang*/

khang bzang dang skyed mos (339) tshal sogs sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams la 'dod chags dang bral bas de rnams snang ba med pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so// zhes dmigs shing mos pa'o// rnam shes ni/ shes pa gang gis nam mkha' mtha' yas so// snyam pa'i shes pa de kho na mtha' yas so zhes mos te/ thams cad du nam mkha'i 'du shes bzlog ste sgom pa'o// ci yang ni/ rnam shes mtha' yas la sogs gong du bskyed pas gzugs can gzugs med kyi dmigs pa ci yang ma rnyed nas med do// zhes dmigs te sgom pa'o// srid rtse ni/ ci yang med do// snyam pa'i 'du shes rags par mthong nas zlog cing*/ ci yang gi 'du shes sngar bzlog zin pas 'du shes med/ 'du shes phra ba ma spangs par yod pa'o// gnyis pa la/ bsam gtan dang po la yan lag lnga ste/ rtog dpyod gnyis/ 'dod pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ 'tshe ba'i rtog pa spong bas gnyen po'i yan lag dga' bde gnyis phan yon gyi yan lag sems rtse gcig pa ni/ de gnyis ka'i gnas kyi yan lag ste/ ting nge 'dzin la brten nas rtog dpyod sogs gnyen po 'jug cing phan yon 'byung bas so// gnyis pa la yan lag bzhi ste/ nang rab tu dwang ba/ rtog dpyod spong bas gnyen po/ dga' bde gnyis phan yon/ rtse gcig pa gnas so// gsum pa la yan lag lnga ste/ dran pa shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum/ dga' ba spong bas gnyen po/ bde ba phan yon/ rtse gcig pa gnas so// bzhi pa la yan lag bzhi ste/ dran pa btang snyoms g.yeng ba'i skyon yongs su dag pa gnyis ni/ bde ba spong bas gnyen po/ bde sdug gnyis ka ma yin pa phan yon/ rtse gcig pa gnas so// btang snyoms gcig nyid/ phan yon gnyen po gnyis su mi rung ngo*// zhe na/ 'du byed btang snyoms gnyen po/ tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon yin (340) gyi/ gcig min no// gzugs med pa rnams ni/ yan lag mi 'dra bas 'da' ba min te/ thams cad kyi yan lag btang snyoms dang rtse gcig par mtshungs pas so// dmigs pa las yang dag par 'da' ba yin la zhi rags kyi khyad yod do// ras yug mchu zheng mnyam yang phra sbom gyi khyad yod pa bzhin no// gsum pa ni/

yid la byed pa bdun gyis bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug ste/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa dang*/ mos pa las byung ba dang*/ rab tu dben pa dang*/ dga' ba sdud pa dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha' dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i 'bras bu yid la byed pa'o// dang po ni/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sa pa'i yid la byed pas nyon mongs dang duḥkha'i nyes dmigs shas che zhing rags pa 'dod pa'i dang*/ de chung zhing zhi ba bsam gtan dang po'i mtshan nyid thos bsam gyi rig pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas gcig tu sgom pa'i rnam pas zhi rags kyi mtshan ma la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong sgom zhing rtog dpyod kyis zhi rags su mos pa'o// gsum pa ni/ goms pas nyon mongs pa chen po gsum spong ba'i lam mo// bzhi pa ni/ spong ba la dga' bas nyon mongs pa 'bring spangs te/ dben pa'i dga' bde chung ngus reg la/ dus dus su dad pas rmugs pa dang gnyid dang rgod pa dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir rab tu dga' bar byed pa'o// lnga pa ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs spangs sam/ ma spangs shes pa'i don du sdug pa'i mtshan ma yid la byed pa la sogs pas skye mi skye rtog pa'o// drug pa ni/ de nas nyon mongs pa chung ngu gsum spang bar bya ba'i phyir dang po'i dngos gzhi la thug gi bar du gnyen po sgom pa ste/ drug po nyer bsdogs yin la/ de la brten nas nyon mongs pa spong mi nus pa med pas na/ mi lcogs pa med pa'o// bdun pa ni/ dang po'i dngos gzhi'o// de bzhin du 'og ma rnams duḥkha che zhing tshe thung*/ gong ma rnams de las (341) ldog pas rags pa dang zhi bas spang bya dang blang byar shes nas de'i sems 'jog pa dang po/ de'i 'og tu yang dag pa'i sbyor ba rtsom pa gnyis pa/ 'og ma'i nyon mongs chen po spong ba gsum pa/ 'bring spong ba bzhi pa/ thob par mngon pa'i nga rgyal spong ba lnga pa/ chung ngu spong ba drug pa/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu dngos gzhi nyams su myong ba bdun pa ste/

des srid rtse'i bar du snyoms par 'jug go /bzhi pa ni/ sred pa lta ba nga rgyal ma rig pas nyon mongs pa can du gyur pas bsgribs la lung du ma bstan par 'gyur ro// lnga pa ni/ dag pa'i bsam gtan gzugs med ni/ dge ba'i phyir kun nas dkris pa'i dri ma dang bral bas rnam byang zhes bya la/ rab kyi mtha'i cha las byung ba'i bsam gtan gzugs med ni/ yon tan khyad par can mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir 'dod pa bzhin du las su rang bas mchog tu 'gro bar byed pas rnam par dag pa zhes bya'o// drug pa ni/ yid la byed pa de dag la chung 'bring chen por bsgoms pas bsam gtan bzhi'i skye ba gsum gsum 'grub bo// gzugs med na/ gzhal med khang gi gnas gzhan med pas skye ba'i bye brag med kyang chung ngu la sogs par bsgoms pas tshe ring thung gis mtho dman dang nyon mongs mang nyung gi bzang ngan gyi khyad par yod do// las su rung ba'i sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin drug la dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ mi slob pa dang khyad par gyi lam dang ngo*// mi slob lam la 'jug sgrub med ces a bh+ya zer ro// tshad med pa bzhi la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// rgyu ni/ bde dang duḥkha de rgyu las// byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ste// rgyu dang bshes gnyen rang bzhin las// byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'o// zhes pas bde ba/ duḥkha/ de'i rgyu btang snyoms rnams snying rje'i dmigs rkyen no// gzhan ni/ dbye ba las shes par bya'o// rgyu rigs sam/ kun gzhi'i sa bon/ bdag rkyen dge ba'i (342) bshes gnyen/ de ma thag rkyen rig pa'i rang bzhin no// ngo bo la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ brtan pas tshangs pa'i mi mthun spangs// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed// ces pas/ gnod sems sogs mi mthun phyogs spangs pa/

gnyen po mi rtog ye shes dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa sems can dang chos dang dmigs pa med pa la 'jug pa/ byed las sems can smin par byed pa ni/ spyi'i mtshan nyid do// bye brag tu bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bo// de bzhin du sbyar te/ duḥkha dang bral bar 'dod pa dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dang*/ chags sdang gis kun nas nyon mongs pa med par 'dod pa'o// sems can rnams la brtse ba can// 'phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde'i dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lha tshangs par skye ba'i rgyu yin pas tshangs pa'i gnas so// bye brag tu 'bum ṭīka tu/ sems can tshad med pa la dmigs pa dang*/ tshogs tshad med pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ chos tshad med pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ ye shes tshad med pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i phyir tshad med pa zhes bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ gsum dang*/ drug dang*/ bcur dbye ba'o// dang po la/ spyi'i dbye ba dang*/ bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis so// dang po la/ lta ba dang*/ sa mtshams dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ bsam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba bzhi'o// dang po ni/ rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bden gyi sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la dmigs pa gsum/ sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i byams sogs gsum mo// (343) gnyis pa ni/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ thog mar sems bskyed pa'i byang sems rnams kyi byams pa ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'o// spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems rnams kyi byams pa ni/ chos la dmigs pa'o// mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa'i byang sems rnams kyi byams pa ni/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'o// zhes so// thog mar sems bskyed pa ni/

tshogs sbyor ba'o// spyod pa la zhugs pa ni/ sa bdun pa'i bar ro// bzod pa thob pa ni/ sa brgyad pa yan chad do// gsum pa ni/ brtan pa rnams kyis de dag bde 'dod dang*// duḥkha yis nyam thag dang bde ba dang*// nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos dang*// de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /ces pas bde ba 'dod pa nas nyon mongs can gyi bar la dmigs pa sems can la dmigs la/ tshad med pa de dag bstan pa'i chos la 'jug pa chos la dmigs pa dang*/ sems can dang chos su mi rtog pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ bde ba dang ldan na re dga'/ ldan par gyur cig ldan par bya'o// snyam pa gsum/ rjes su yi rang dang*/ smon lam dang*/ go cha'i ngo bor gyur pa'i byams sogs gsum mo// gnyis pa la/ byams pa gsum ni/ mos spyod du sems can la dang*/ sa bdun pa'i bar du de bzhin nyid la dang*/ sa brgyad yan chad dmigs med la dmigs pa'o// snying rje gsum ni/ duḥkha can dang*/ nyes spyod mang ba dang*/ rkyen dang mi ldan pas rnam par ma grol ba'i sems can la dmigs pa gsum mo// dga' ba gsum ni/ sems can bde ba dang*/ bdag gi tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi ro myang ba la dmigs pa'o// btang snyoms gsum ni/ sems can gyi don bya ba la skal ba yod med la dmigs pa dang*/ tshogs rdzogs par bya ba la dus

(344) dang dus ma yin pa la dmigs pa dang*/ rnyed pa grags pa bstod pa bde ba bzhi dang*/ de las ldog pa bzhi ste/ lo ka'i chos brgyad la mnyam pa nyid du dmigs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs dang ldan pa la dmigs pa drug ste/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse// kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse// yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang*// log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song*// duḥkha yis non mun pas bsgribs// bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs// 'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan// zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen// lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa// lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i// sems can rnams la snying rje'o// zhes te/ 'dod khams kyi bde ba la chags pa dang*/ bdud kyis bar chad byas pa dang*/ duḥkhas zil gyis non pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa dang*/ rigs chad dang*/ mu stegs can dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la zhen pa dang*/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can dang*/ rigs ma nges pa theg dman la zhugs pa dang*/ byang sems tshogs ma rdzogs pa ste/ bcu la dmigs pa ste/ drug dang*/ bcur dbye ba gnyis snying rje'i dbye ba'o// 'bras bu la gnyis te/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ bsgoms pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnod sems dang*// rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang*// 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pas// nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg /ces te/ tshad med bzhi ma bsgoms na/ byams pa'i mi mthun phyogs gnod sems/ snying rje'i rnam 'tshe/ dga' ba'i mi dga' ba/ btang snyoms kyi gnod sems dang*/ 'dod chags kyis/ rang dang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod cing*/ mthong chos la tshul khrims nyams pa dang bcas pas bdag nyid 'gyod pa dang*/ gzhan gyis rnyed pa mi ster ba dang*/ lha dang ston pas smod pa

(345) dang*/ grags ngan 'byung ngo*// phyi ma la mi khom par skye'o// tshe 'di la thob pa'i yon tan dang*/ ma thob pa phyi mar thob pa kun nyams pas yid la duḥkha chen po thob ste/ nyon mongs rnams kyis bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms// nyams bcas rnyed pa dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas smad// rtsod bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khom gnas su skye// thob dang ma thob nyams pas yid la duḥkha chen po thob// ces so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gnas skabs kyi dang*/ gtso bor snying rje'i dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ tshangs pas gnas pas gnas pa yi// blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye// des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sems can rnams kyang yongs smin byed// kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral la// de yi mi mthun phyogs dang bral// bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen// mi zad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro// zhes te/ rgyu tshangs pa'i gnas de las gang 'dod pa'i gnas su skye ba rnam smin/ chos rdzogs par byed pa bdag 'bras/ sems can smin par byed pa skyes bu byed 'bras/ rtag tu de dang mi 'bral ba rgyu mthun/ mi mthun phyogs gnod sems sogs dang bral ba bral 'bras so// yang na/ sngar bshad pa'i nyes pa de dag med cing 'khor bar gnas kyang de'i skyon gyis ma gos pa yin no// nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la// legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste// nyon mongs can min sems can gyi// don du 'khor ba yongs mi gtong*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ snying rje'i rtsa ba/ bzod pa'i sdong po/ gzhan don bya bar sems pa'i yal ga smon lam gyi lo ma skye ba/ bzang po'i me tog sems can smin par byed pa'i 'bras bu ste/ snying rje dang ni bzod dang sems pa dang*// smon lam skye ba sems can yongs smin byed// dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan// 'di ni snying rje chen po'i ljon shing yin// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes (346) te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni/ snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung bas na/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu las byung ba yin/ thabs kyi mthar phyin pa yin no// zhes so// chos thams cad mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa'ang*/ byin drug gi dngos po thams cad la 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*/ ched du bya ba gsum dang*/ a bh+ya ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed sgom pa mi dmigs pa'i ched du byas te sgom zhes pa'o// zhing sna tshogs su 'gro ba sogs byed pa'i mngon par shes pa drug dang rnam mkhyen nyid dag la'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun spyir bstan pa dang*/ rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ de ltar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa byas pa la tshogs skye bas sgrub pa gsum pa byang chub dngos su sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa stan no// rtsa ba la/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ brtse ba snying rje dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang*/ sogs pa tshul khrims la sogs pa drug ste/ gong 'og tu dmigs bsal ma smos pa rnams de bzhin du shes par bya'o// zhi gnas ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lhag mthong shes rab dang bcas pa dang*/ de gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu bsod nams dang*/ phyogs mthun sogs lam dang*/ gzungs bzhi dang*/ rab dga' sogs sa bcu dang*/ gnyen po brgyad de/ bcu bdun po de'o// ji ltar na/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i rim pa yin par ro// 'grel pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig grangs nges gsum mo// ngo bo la/ sgrub ces drang ngo*// gang na/ theg pa chen po'i don sems bskyed sogs sam/ byang chub chen po mtha' dag go /ji ltar na/ don dam par sgrub pa med kyang yang dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du'o// gang gis na/

(347) bcu bdun po rnams mi dmigs par rtogs te sgrub pas so// bcu bdun po gang zhe na/ mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ go cha chen po bgos pa/ go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bgyi na/ ji ltar na/ sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bgyi ba lags zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ tshogs dang po bcu gsungs pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ni// mnyam par shes bya de bsam phyir// bsgrub phyir 'dod chags bral phyir dang*// mi dmigs phyir dang dag phyir ro// zhes te/ tshor ba gsum ga duḥkhar mnyam par rtogs pa dang*/ sems kyis snying rje ba dang*/ yongs skyob dang*/ 'tshe ba spangs pa dang*/ bdag gzhan snying rje gsum mi dmigs pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa'i phyir snying rje chen po ste/ mdo ni/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyi duḥkha rab tu bcil nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sgra brjod do// zhes so// sbyin pa'i phar phyin te/ mdo ni/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas zhes sogs so// tshul khrims ni/ mdo ni/ shī la'i phar phyin la gnas shing zhes sogs nas sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu 'god do// zhes sogs so// bzod pa'i phar phyin te/ mdo ni/ bzod pa'i phar phyin la gnas shing sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa'i phar phyin la sbyor zhing 'jog la rab tu 'god do// zhes sogs so// brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab gsum gyi mdo 'don pa bsgyur la bshad do// yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin// zhes pas ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sems la sems 'jog pa'i tshul gyis gzhan don dang*/ phar phyin la rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas te/ mdo ni/ rnam (348) mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas shing sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed de zhes so// chos rab tu 'byed pa'i lhag mthong ste/

mdo ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha bgos par rig par bgyi'o zhes so// shes rab dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i lam ste/ mdo ni/ ma bcings ma grol ba de'i rnam mkhyen nyid du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// de nas theg pa chen po gang lags zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ lnga gsungs te/ sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs bya dang*// sems can rnams yongs smin bya dang*// myur thob bya ba 'grub pa dang*// lam rgyun mi gcod pa la mkhas// byang chub sems dpa'i sa kun la// thabs ni mtshungs pa med pa ste// thabs mkhas de la brten nas ni// de dag don kun sgrub par byed// ces pas/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang*/ bshags pa rjes su yi rang ba gsol ba bsngo ba bzhi dang*/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo gnyis dang*/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das te/ thabs lnga po la mkhas pas don thams cad sgrub pa ste/ mdo ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po yongs su gtong ste/ de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla med byang chub tu mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo'o// zhes so// 'og nas ston pa'i ye shes te/ mdo ni/ theg chen ni/ 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid sogs so// bsod nams mang po skye ba'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin no// mdo ni/ theg pa chen po ni/ 'di lta ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang sogs so// mthong ba dang*/ sogs pa sgom pa la sogs pa'i lam ste/ mdo ni/ theg pa chen po ni/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang sogs so// tshig dang*/ sogs pa don dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ bzod pa'i rgyu'i gzungs te/ mdo ni/ a zhes bya ba ni/ ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o// zhes sogs te/ 'di la gsum/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ byed las so// dang po bzod pa'i (349) gzungs ni/

a ra pa tsa la sogs pa'i yi ge'i don de bzhin nyid du sgro btags nas bsgoms pas sgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa na/ yi ge'i de'i don don dam pa la bzod pa skye ste/ dper na/ a skye ba med pa'i don du sgro btags te bsgoms pas sgom pa rdzogs pa na/ chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa'i bzod pa skye ste/ de ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sgo ste/ thabs yin no// gzhan yang i ṭi mi ṭi la sogs pa'i sngags de dag gi brjod bya gang yin bsam pas/ de la brjod bya gang yang mi mthong ngo*// de nas brjod bya dang bral ba nyid de'i brjod bya yin no// snyam zhing*/ de brjod bya dang bral bar mos te/ chos thams cad kyang rjod pa dang brjod par bya ba'i rang bzhin dang bral ba/ brjod du med par bsgoms pas chos thams cad kun btags kyis stong par mthong ngo*// de mthong na chos thams cad brjod du med par rtogs pas dga' ba chen po skye ste/ de ni gzungs te/ rgyu'o// de nas de ma thag tu sa dang po'i ye shes dang mthun pa'i don dam pa'i chos rnams la bzod pa'i bzod pa skye'o// de ni/ gzungs kyi bzod pa yin la/ sbyor lam na yod do// tshig gi gzungs ni/ sa thob nas sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyis bstan pa'i chos ming dang tshig dang yi ge'i tshogs tshad med pa rnams rim pa de nyid kyis ma brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang shes rab ste/ ming gzhan chos kyi gzungs zhes bya'o// don gyi gzungs ni/ sngar bzung ba'i chos rnams kyi don tshad med pa rnams dus dpag tu med par mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang shes rab bo// gsang sngags kyi gzungs ni/ byang sems ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pas sngags kyi yi ge rnams byin gyis rlob ste/ sngags kyi yi ge 'di rnams cho ga 'di lta bus sems can rnams kyi yams dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/

'khrugs pa thams cad zhi ba'i ched du (350) dang*/ sdig pa thams cad dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad zad pa'i ched du grub par gyur cig ces de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas don de rnams cho ga'i khyad par des 'grub ste/ de ltar byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes de sngags mtshan nyid pa/ de'i dmigs par bya ba yin pa yi ge de dag btags pa ba yin no// gzhan yang*/ man+t+ra'i sgras ye shes dang snying rje ni/ de nyid shes pa dang*/ 'gro ba skyob pas gsang sngags so// de nyid ma rig pa spong zhing*/ rig pa skyed pas rig sngags zhes kyang bya'o// de nyid rnam mkhyen gyi gzhi yin pas/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi zhes bya'o// yi ge rnams de'i 'bras bu yin pas der btags pa'o// gnyis pa la/ sngon gyi rnam smin las byung ba dang*/ tshe 'dir mang du thos pa las byung ba gnyis chung ngu dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa chen po yin la/ de'ang sa la ma zhugs pa'i chung ngu*/ zhugs la ma dag pa sa bdun pa man chad kyi 'bring*/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi chen po ste/ rnam smin thos la goms pa dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs dag ni// chung ngu dang ni chen po ste// chen po de yang rnam pa gsum// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ chos gzhan la ston pa dang*/ rang gis 'dzin pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dang yang*// de la yang dag brten nas ni// rtag tu dam pa'i chos dag kyang*// ston cing rab tu 'dzin par byed// ces so// sa dang gnyen po gnyis 'og nas 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/ sam+bha ra ni/ tshogs yin la/ saṃ ni/ yang dag par 'grub pa/ bha ni/ ngo bo/ ra ni/ 'dzin pa ste/ sngar ltar bsgrubs pas na/ snying rje dang*/ sogs pa phyin drug la sogs pa 'di dag gis/ 'grub pa chen po'i ngo bo byang chub chen po thob par byed pa'i ngo bos sgrub cing 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir na/ snying rje la sogs pa bcu bdun ni/ byang chub kyi rgyu'i tshogs rdzogs par byed pas na/

tshogs yin pas tshogs kyi sgrub pa'o// 'di dag chos mchog gi 'og na'ang yod mod ce na/ tshogs tsam zhig yod kyang (351) nus pa mthu can du gyur pas byang chub la mngon sum du sbyor ba'i tshogs khyad par can chos mchog chen po nas yod kyi/ de man chad na med do// gsum pa ni/ tshogs sgrub chos can/ rnam pa bcu bdun du nges so// de bas mang mi dgos/ nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ye shes dang*/ sa dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ yul can ye shes kyi sa mtshams dang*/ yul stong nyid bstan pa gnyis so// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ stong nyid nyi shu po sbyor lam du spyi'i tshul du rtogs/ mthong lam du mngon sum gyis gsar du rtogs/ sgom lam du rtogs zin sgom/ sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su rdzogs kyi/ nyi shu po 'di yod med kyi khyad par med do// zhe na/ mthong lam na chos can/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa dang*/ rang byung nyid yod par thal/ ye shes tha ma gsum yod pa'i phyir ro// khyab pa yod de/ 'grel chen las/ stong pa nyid gsum po 'di dag ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i rten yin pa'i phyir dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i rten nyid yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang byung nyid yin pa'i don gyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la yin par shes par bya'o// zhes pas so// 'dod na/ mthong lam du 'gal lo// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs sgrub gzhan bsal ba de la/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ yul stong pa nyid nyi shu yod pa'i bye brag gis ye shes nyi shu yod pa las/ nang dang sogs la stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes zhes kun la sbyar te bshad pa ni/ dang po nang dang phyi dang phyi nang gnyis ka gsum ni/ sbyor lam spyi na'o// a bh+ya ni/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas brtsams te yod do// zhe'o// stong pa nyid ni/
chos mchog

(352) na yod de/ des stong nyid du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spong ba'i phyir ro// chen po ni/ kun tu 'gro ba'i don gyis sa dang po la'o// don dam pa ni/ mchog gi don gyis sa gnyis pa la'o// 'dus byas ni/ rgyu mthun pa'i don gyi mchog gis sa gsum pa la'o// 'dus ma byas ni/ yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don gyis sa bzhi pa na'o// mtha' las 'das pa ni/ rgyud tha dad med pa'i don gyis sa lnga pa na'o// thog ma dang tha ma med pa ni/ nyon mongs dang rnam byang med pa'i don gyis sa drug pa na'o// dor ba med pa ni/ tha dad med pa'i don gyis sa bdun pa na'o// rang bzhin dang chos thams cad gnyis ni/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i don dang*/ zhing yongs su dag pa la dbang ba'i rten yin pas sa brgyad pa na'o// rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs pa gnyis ni/ ye shes la dbang ba'i rten yin pas sa dgu pa na'o// dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ dngos po gnyis ni/ las la dbang ba'i rten yin pas sa bcu pa na'o// dngos po med pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo gsum ni/ nyon sgrib dang*/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i rten dang*/ rang byung yin pas sangs rgyas kyi sa na'o// 'di dag a bh+ya dang 'grel chen nas bshad pa ltar bris pa yin no// yod med ni/ gtso che bar yod med do// gsum pa la/ sa dang po la bden bzhi stong nyid du rtogs pa med par thal/ 'dus byas 'dus ma byas stong nyid du rtogs pa med pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ rtogs tsam med pa'i rtags ma grub la/ gtso cher med pa la khyab pa ma grub bo// yang stong nyid nyi shu po spyi'i tshul du rtogs sam/ mngon sum du rtogs/ dang po ltar na/ sbyor lam na kun yod par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gcig kyang med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rjes thob la de dang de la nges pa skyed nus su rtogs pa'am/ de'i spang bya spong nus kyis 'jog pas skyon med do// gnyis pa ni/

stong nyid nyi shu po gang zhe na/ lan 'dir smras pa ni/ nang (353) gi skye mched dbang po drug ni/ de la yod pa'i rang bzhin mi dmigs pas tshogs par gnas pa med la/ de la skye ba dang 'jig pa'ang med pas dang*/ phyi rol gzugs sogs yul gyi skye mched rnams de lta bu'i rang bzhin yin pas dang*/ sems kyis zin pas nang yin la/ dbang pos ma bsdus pas phyi yin pa gnyis ka ni/ dbang po'i rten gyis bsdus pa rnams rang bzhin de lta bu yin pas dang*/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i dngos po ni/ stong pa nyid yin la/ de nyid de'i rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir dang*/ phyogs bcu ni/ dbyibs che bas chen po/ de nyid ni/ des stong pas dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ni/ don dam pa/ da ni bral ba tsam yin pas de'i rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i khams gsum ni/ 'dus byas/ da ni yongs su mi grub pas de nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dus byas las gcig shos te/ gzhan skye 'gag gnas 'gyur bzhi dang bral ba 'dus ma byas/ de nyid der gdags pa'i rgyu skye sogs med pas de'i rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa ni/ mthar 'jog byed dbus ma grub pas de'i rang bzhin gyis stong pas dang*/ 'khor ba thog ma dbus dang tha ma rnams chos nyid kyi rjes su skyes pas mtha' med pa'i phyir de nyid kyis stong pas dang*/ dge phyogs spang pa dang btang ba las ldog pa dor ba med pa de ni/ der gdags pa'i rgyu dor ba ma grub pas de'i ngo bos kyang stong pa dang*/ 'phags pa thams cad kyis ma byas pa ni/ rang bzhin/ de nyid 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi rnam par 'gyur mi 'gyur dang bral bas de'i ngo bos stong pas dang*/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos kun phan tshun ltos pas gzhag gi yongs su grub pa med pa de thams cad rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir dang*/

chos skye ba dang*/ sogs pa 'gag pa sogs spyi dang*/ gzugs su rung ba sogs khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi (354) mtshan nyid/ de dag btags pa tsam yin pas de'i ngo bos stong pas dang*/ 'das pa dang*/ sogs pa da ltar ba la sogs pa rnams phan tshun bzlog na mi dmigs pas mi dmigs pa/ dus gsum gyi ngo bo btags pa tsam yin pas de'i ngo bos stong pas dang*/ ldan pa ste/ sbyor ba las byung ba'i tshogs pa ni/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir bden pa'i dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de ni tshogs pa tsam gyi ngo bo yin pas des stong pas dang*/ gcig shos te/ gzhan nye bar len pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phung po ni/ ngo bo ste/ dngos po spungs pa ni/ med pa'i don yin pa des stong pas so// dngos med nam mkha' la sogs pa ni/ dngos po'i chos med pa tsam la btags pa'i phyir de'i ngo bos stong pas dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyis shes pa dang mthong bas ma byas pas na/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang*/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid byed pa po don gzhan gyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pas so// rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir ni/ thams cad la sbyar zin to// rgyu mtshan de dag gis 'phangs pa'i rgyu mtshan can nang stong pa nyid do// zhes sogs kun la sbyar ro// stong pa nyid ni nyi shur nges par/ chos can nyi shur nges pa'i dbang gis 'dod do// gnyis pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa zhes pa/ phyi rol chos can gyis bsdus pa 'byung ba sa dang*/ rang ris kyi sdes bsdus pa thos pa'i sa lta bu dang*/ spang bya gtso che ba khams gsum sa dgu lta bu dang*/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i sa la sogs pa yod pa las/ 'di la bdag med rtogs pa gang zhig nyan thos kyi lam gyi rten byed pa dang*/ rang rgyal lam gyi rten byed pa gnyis nyan rang gi sa yin la/ dbye na/ dkar po rnam par mthong ba la sogs lnga'am/ drug go /byang sems kyi sa ni/

phal pa dad pa dang mos spyod kyi sa dang*/ khyad par can 'phags pa'i sa'o// 'di la gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pa gang zhig rdzogs pa'i (355) byang chub kyi rten tu gyur pa'o// bye brag tu sa dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig stong pa nyid mchog gsar du rtogs pa zhes sogs/ stong pa nyid ni mchog rtogs nas/ zhes pa nas/ sa yi mtshan nyid shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis sa bcu gcig gi mtshan nyid bshad mod kyi/ mang bas 'jigs pas ma bris so// mtshon bya ni/ 'byung po dpag med 'jigs med phyir// dpag tu med pa de dag la// phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir// de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do// zhes so// bhu mi zhes pa sa yin la/ de la bhu las/ bhu ta ni/ 'byung po ste/ sems can/ mi la/ a mi ta zhes sbyar na/ dpag tu med pa/ bhu la a bh+ya zhes sbyar na/ 'jigs pa med pa/ yang*/ a mi ta ni/ dpag tu med pa ste/ yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sa la/ yang bhu la/ bhu ya bhu ya zhes bsgyur na/ phyi phyir te/ yang nas yang du/ yang mi la/ ga mi ni/ 'gro ste/ mdor na/ sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi 'jigs pa thams cad spang bar bya ba'i phyir re re la'ang yon tan dpag tu med pa dag dang ldan pa'i sa de dag la yang yang sa gong mar 'gro ba dang ldan pas sa'o// dge ba sgrub pa sna tshogs la// dga' bas rtag par thams cad du// gnas phyir byang chub sems dpa' yi// sa rnams gnas pa yin par 'dod// ces te/ dge ba sgrub pa rnam pa sna tshogs la dga' bas rtag par gnas pas na/ sa de dag la gnas pa zhes bya'o// mtshan gzhi la/ dbye ba dngos dang*/ phye ba'i khyad par gnyis so// dang po la/ dbye gzhi/ byang sems 'phags pa'i sa tsam mo// dbye ngo*/ bcu'o// tha dad/ dngos po tha dad yin te/ rgyu 'bras yin pas so// grangs nges ni/ sbyong byed kyi chos kyi khyad par bcu yod pas sbyang bya sa bcur nges te/

'grel chen nas/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom pa'i lam la yongs su sbyong ba'i chos kyi dbye ba sa rab tu dga' ba (356) la sogs pa'i sa bcur rnam par bzhag go zhes so// gnyis pa la/ rtags dang*/ yon tan dang*/ skye ba dang*/ slob tshul dang*/ spang bya dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ spangs rtogs dang*/ 'bras bu'i khyad par dang brgyad do// dang po la/ zhugs pa dang*/ rmi ltas kyi rtags gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snang dang bcas dang mos pa dang*// ma zhum pa dang mi dman nyid// gzhan dring mi 'jog bdag nyid dang*// thams cad rab tu rtogs pa dang*// kun la sems ni mnyam pa dang*// dkri dang rjes su chags med dang*// thabs shes 'khor du skye ba ni// kun la rtags su 'dod pa yin// zhes te/ sa gang la zhugs pa de la snang ba dang*/ ma zhugs pa de la mos pa dang*/ zab cing rgya che ba la ma zhum pa dang*/ dka' spyad la sems mi dman pa dang*/ rang gi sa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang*/ sa thams cad sgrub pa la mkhas pa dang*/ bdag gzhan mnyam par rtogs pa dang*/ snyan pa dang mi snyan pa'i sgras dkrir mi btub pa dang*/ rgyal srid sogs kyi phun tshogs la chags pa med pa dang*/ mi dmigs par sangs rgya ba'i thabs shes pa dang*/ rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du skye ba ste/ bcu po 'di sa la zhugs pa'i rtags so// gnyis pa ni/ gser 'od dam pa las/ byang sems kyi sa dang po'i snga ltas ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su gang bar mthong ngo*// zhes so// de bzhin du sbyar te/ gnyis pa'i/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i lo ka'i khams lag mthil lta bur gyur pa la rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas legs par brgyan pa mthong ngo*// gsum pa'i/ bdag nyid dpa' zhing lag cha dang go cha sra ba thogs nas phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'dul ba mthong ngo*// bzhi pa'i/ phyogs bzhi nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhis thams cad dang ldan pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor la me tog sna tshogs mngon par

(357) 'thor ba mthong ngo*// lnga pa'i/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bud med kyi mgo la me tog tsam pa ka'i phreng ba 'dogs par mthong ngo*// drug pa'i/ rdzing them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ rnyog pa med cing dang la/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba la me tog ut+pa la dang*/ ku mu ta dang*/ pad+ma dkar pos brgyan pa'i chu mthong ste/ de la bdag nyid rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur yongs su spyod pa mthong ngo*// bdun pa'i/ phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis na sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa mthong ste/ de las bdag nyid ma rmas ma nyams par slar ldog par mthong ngo*// brgyad pa'i/ phrag pa gnyis na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod pan thogs pas gcan gzan phra mo thams cad skrag par byed cing 'dug par mthong ngo*// dgu pa'i/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mthong ste/ skye bo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas la/ mgo'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gdugs dkar po 'dzin pa mthong ngo*// bcu pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mthong ste/ kha dog gser lta bu/ 'od 'doms gang pa/ tshangs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston pa mthong ngo*// zhes de dag rmi ltas su bshad do// 'o na/ drod nas gnyid la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lnga zad par bshad pa la/ sa thob nas rmi ltas 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'jug pa rang dbang med par sdud pa'i bdag nyid/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyid med kyang de las ldog pa'i dge ba'i gnyid yod pas rmi ltas mi 'gal lo// skabs ma yin par rmi ltas 'di dag la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams byung na/ sngags kyi mthu'am/ bdud kyi byin gyi rlabs su shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa

(358) rnams kun la rnam kun tu// blo ldan rnams kyi phan yon ni// zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis ka la// lnga po'i bdag nyid dag tu 'dod// ces te/ skad cig re re la gnas ngan len zad pa dang*/ sna tshogs kyi 'du shes dang bral ba'i chos kyi dga' ba ste/ zhi gnas kyi gnyis dang*/ yongs su ma chad pa'i chos kyi snang ba rtogs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i rgyu mtshan phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la sogs pa rtogs pas ma rtogs pa dag mthong ba ste/ gnyis ni/ lhag mthong gi'o// chos sku rdzogs shing dag pa'i rgyur phar phyin drug yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ gnyis ka'i 'o// gnyis pa ni/ sa dang po la/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis te/ a bh+yas/ skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin brgya so sor thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba dang*/ de rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs kyang shes pa dang*/ lo ka'i khams brgya g.yo bar byed cing*/ snang bar yang byed pa dang*/ zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang*/ sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ bskal pa brgyar gnas shing*/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ lus brgya ston par byed pa dang*/ lus dang lus la'ang byang sems kyi 'khor brgya dang ldan pa ston par byed do// zhes pa ltar ro// de bzhin du bsgres te/ sa gnyis pa sogs la rim pa bzhin du stong dang*/ 'bum dang*/ khrag khrig dang*/ khrag khrig stong phrag dang*/ khrag khrig 'bum phrag dang*/ bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dang*/ stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa la sogs so// gsum pa ni/ blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni// gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni// ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor pa'i//

(359) dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin// zhes pas/ mos spyod pa rnams las kyi dbang gis 'dod par skye ba dang*/ sa thob pa rnams dud 'gro la sogs par skye ba smon lam dang*/ bsam gtan pa rnams ldog nas 'dod khams su skye ba ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sprul pas dga' ldan na gnas pa sogs dbang 'byor ba'i dbang gis skye ba ste/ bzhi ni/ dbang gis skye ba'o// rnam par smin pa'i skye ba ni/ sa bcu la gnas pa rnams rim pa bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling dang*/ gling bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ 'thab bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po dang*/ stong gi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ stong gnyis kyi bdag po dang*/ stong gsum gyi bdag po gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i rgyal po rnams su phal cher skye'o// bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir// lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag sems dang*// lhag pa'i shes rab la rjes slob// ces te/ sa dang por chos nyid de bzhin nyid rtogs nas sa gnyis par tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ gsum pa la sems kyi bslab pa dang*/ bzhi par byang chub kyi phyogs mthun la mkhas pa dang*/ lnga par bden gnyis la mkhas pa dang*/ drug par rten 'brel la mkhas pa ste/ gsum du shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob bo// de ltar bslab pas sa bdun par mtshan ma med cing mngon par 'du byed pa'i ye shes/ brgyad par mtshan ma dang 'du byed gnyis ka med cing zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ dgu par sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ bcu par gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams 'grub pa'i 'bras bu ste/ 'bras bu dam pa 'di bzhi ni// sa bzhi po la yang dag brten// zhes so// de nyid zag med kyi phung po lnga sbyong ba'ang yin te/ sa dang por chos nyid rtogs nas/ gnyis par tshul

(360) khrims dang*/ gsum par ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bzhi pa lnga pa drug par shes rab kyi phung po sbyong ba/ de las gzhan bzhi la 'bras bu bzhi'i sgrib pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la thogs pa'i sgrib pa sbyong bas rim pa bzhin rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes sbyong ste/ chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir// tshul khrims kyi ni phung po sbyong*// de yi 'og tu ting 'dzin dang*// shes rab phung po rnam par sbyong*// de las gzhan pa dag la ni// sgrib rnam bzhi dang thogs pa yi// sgrib pa las ni rnam grol dang*// grol ba'i ye shes rnam par sbyong*// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ sa la 'jug pa las/ yan lag bcu gcig rdzogs gyur pas// rab dga' la sogs sa bcu gcig /rmongs gnyis gnas ngan len gcig ste// mi mthun phyogs ni tha dad do// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang bcu gcig la/ rang rang gi gnas ngan len mi mthun phyogs re re ste/ bcu gcig dang*/ shin tu rmongs pa gnyis gnyis te/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// de la rmongs pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du gang zag dang chos la mngon par zhen pa'i dang*/ ngan song ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dang*/ ltung ba phra mo'i 'khrul pa'i dang*/ las kyi 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'i dang*/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi dang*/ thos pa'i gzungs yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i dang*/ snyoms 'jug la sred pa'i dang*/ chos la sred pa'i dang*/ 'khor ba la phyir phyogs pa dang mngon du phyogs pa dang*/ myang 'das la phyir phyogs pa dang mngon du phyogs pa'i dang*/ 'du byed 'byung ba mngon sum du gyur pa'i dang*/ gzugs sogs mtshan ma mang du 'byung ba'i dang*/ mdo la sogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma phra mo 'byung ba'i dang*/ rab tu mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa'i thabs la dang mtshan ma med pa la sgrib pa'i dang*/ mtshan ma dag la dbang thob pa la sgrib pa'i dang*/ chos ston pa tshad med pa dang chos kyi tshig dang yi ge tshad

(361) med pa dang*/ gong nas gong du shes rab dang spobs pa dang gzungs kyi dbang thob pa la sgrib pa'i dang*/ spobs pa la dbang 'byor ba la sgrib pa'i dang*/ mngon shes chen po thob pa la sgrib pa'i dang*/ gsang ba phra mo la 'jug pa'i dang*/ shes bya thams cad la ma chags pa dang ma thogs pa la sgrib pa'i dang*/ rab tu phra ba'i chags pa dang thogs pa'i 'o// shin tu rmongs pa dang zhes kun la sbyar ro// de ni/ dgongs pa nges 'grel nas bshad do// drug pa la/ spyad bya dngos dang*/ de'i sgrib pa dang*/ khyed las dang*/ gtso che chung gi khyad par te/ bzhi las/ dang po ni/ phar phyin bcu ste/ de skad du/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan dang ni shes rab thabs// smon lam stobs dang ye shes dang*// 'di dag pha rol phyin bcu'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ phar phyin bcu'i 'bras bu la sgrib pas na/ sgrib pa bcu ste/ sbyin pa'i 'bras bu/ phyug po dang*/ bdag po dang*/ tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu/ bde 'gro dang*/ bzod pa'i 'bras bu/ sems can yongs su mi gtong pa dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi 'bras bu/ skyon yon 'bri zhing 'phel ba dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu/ gdul bya lam la 'dzud pa dang*/ sher phyin gyi 'bras bu/ rnam par grol bar byed pa dang*/ byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba thabs yin la/ de'i 'bras bu/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba mi zad pa dang*/ pha rol du phyin pa la spyod par skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi 'bras bu/ tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba dang*/ so sor brtags pa dang*/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi non pa'i 'bras bu/ dge ba de nyid nges par 'byed pa dang*/ thos pa'i don sgra ji bzhin pa min pa la sogs pa shes pa'i ye shes kyi 'bras bu/ bdag gzhan (362) chos la longs spyod pa dang*/ yongs su smin par byed pa'o// la sgrib pa dang zhes kun la sbyar ro// de skad du/

phyug po dang ni bde 'gro dang*// sems can mi gtong sgrib pa dang*// nyes pa dag dang yon tan rnams// 'bri dang 'phel dang 'dzud pa dang*// grol bar byed dang mi zad dang*// dge ba rgyun mi chad pa dang*// nges par 'byed dang chos rnams la// longs par spyod dang yongs smin byed// ces so// gsum pa ni/ phar phyin bcu'i byed las bcu ste/ rim pa bzhin du sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa dang*/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byed pa la bzod pa dang*/ yon tan 'phel bar byed pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pas gzhan mgu bar byas te lam la 'dzud pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i gdams ngag byin pas grol bar byed pa dang*/ byang chub chen por bsngos pas mi zad par byed pa dang*/ tshe rabs thams cad du sangs rgyas mnyes par byed cing phar phyin drug la rtag tu 'jug pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi non pas phar phyin la phes par 'jug pa dang*/ chos la sgra ji bzhin gyi rmongs pa dang bral bas sher phyin gyi dbang du byas pa'i chos la longs spyod pa myong zhing sems can rnams yang smin par byed pa'o// de skad du/ las ni rjes su 'dzin byed dang*// gnod mi byed dang de la bzod// yon tan 'phel dang 'dzud nus dang*// rnam par grol bar byed pa dang*// mi zad pa dang rtag 'jug dang*// nges par longs spyod smin par byed// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ sa bcu la phar phyin bcu rim pa bzhin du re re gtso che la gzhan phal pa'i tshul du spyod do// de skad du/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni// sa bcu dag tu shes par bya// zhes so// bdun pa la/ sa bcu'i mnyam gzhag na chos nyid rtogs pa la khyad par yod dam med/ yod na/ snga mas chos nyid ma rtogs par thal lo// med na/ spangs pa khyad med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ de ston pa ni/ 'grel chen nas/ (363) chos thams cad bdag med pa'o zhes bsgoms pas cha med pa nyid kyis chos kyi dbyings bdag nyid thams cad kyis rtogs su zin kyang nges pa skyed pa la ltos nas kun tu 'gro ba'i don gyis so sor rtogs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don bshad de bstan pa ni/

mnyam gzhag tu chos nyid tsam mngon sum du rtogs par khyad par med par bstan pa dang*/ nges pa skyed pa la ltos nas khyad par yod par bstan pa dang*/ rtsod spang dang gsum mo// dang po la/ sa dang po yan chad kyi mnyam gzhag chos can/ chos nyid tsam mngon sum du rtogs par khyad med de/ mthong lam du chos nyid tsam mngon sum du rtogs pa de nyid sgom pa'i phyir ro// de'i rgyu mtshan/ chos nyid cha shas med pa gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi stong pa nyid// ces sam/ 'jam dpal/ chos kyi dbyings gcig yang dag pa'i mtha' gcig yin na/ zhes pas so// khyab pa yod de/ cha shas med pa gcig la mngon sum du rtogs mi rtogs mi 'thad de/ rnam 'grel las/ don gyi rang gi ngo bo gcig /bdag nyid mngon sum yin pa la// tshad ma rnams kyi brtag bya gang*// ma mthong cha gzhan ci zhig yod// ces so// des na sgom lam thams cad kyang mthong lam gyis mthong zin sgom pa ste/ 'phags pas/ ji ltar mthong ba'i dngos po la mngon du phyogs par byed pas dngos po tha dad pa med pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ a bh+yas/ mthong ba kho na rgyun du shes pa sgom pa yin la zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mnyam gzhag na chos nyid tsam rtogs par khyad par med kyang nges pa skyed tshul lam/ spang bya spong tshul lam/ dri mas dag pa rtogs pa'i khyad yod de/ 'di ltar/ sa dang por chos nyid de bdag gzhan thams cad la khyab pa kun tu 'gro ba'i don du rtogs so// de bzhin du/ gnyis pa la chos nyid de sgrib pa (364) thams cad spang du rung bar rtogs pas mchog gi don dang*/ gsum par theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i don gyi mchog tu dang*/ bzhi par chos la sred pa med pas yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don dang*/ lnga par sems dang bsam pa rnam dag mnyam pa nyid bcus rtogs te/

bdag gzhan thams cad chos nyid du gcig par rtogs pas rgyud tha dad med pa'i don dang*/ drug par rten 'brel gyi chos nyid la nyon mongs rnam dag gi chos gang yang med par rtogs pas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par dag pa min pa'i don dang*/ bdun par mdo la sogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma tha dad mi 'byung bas tha dad med pa'i don dang*/ brgyad par mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas kun byang bri gang med par rtogs pas bri med 'phel ba med pa'i don dang*/ nyon yid gnas gyur pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes shin tu dag pa la dbang ba dang*/ dbang shes lnga yul dang bcas pa gnas gyur pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin ston pa/ zhing dag pa la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du dang*/ dgu par so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pas ye shes la dbang ba dang*/ bcu par ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas las la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs te/ dbang de gnyis yid shes gnas gyur pa las byung ngo*// de ltar chos nyid bcu la sgrib pa bcu yang grangs bzhin du spong ngo*// de skad du/ kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don// rgyun mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang*// yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang*// rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang*// nyon mongs rnam dag mig don dang*// tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang*// bri med 'phel ba med don dang*// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas// chos kyi dbyings la ma rig pa// nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// sa bcu'i mi mthun phyogs rnams kyi// gnyen po dag ni sa yin no// (365) zhes so// dbang bzhi de ltar yin par yang*// yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog /gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog dang*// zhing dang ye shes las dag la// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yin no// dbang de mi g.yo la sogs pa'i// sa gsum la ni rnam bzhi ste// gcig la rnam gnyis de las gzhan// dbang re re ni 'dod pa yin// zhes so// yang klu sgrub la sogs bzhed pa ltar/

sa bcu'i mnyam gzhag rnams chos dbyings spros bral la blos mtha' bzhi gang du'ang 'dzin pa med pas khyad par ci yang med do// rjes thob sbyor ba dang rjes kyi gnas skabs na khyad par yod pas sa'i khyad par 'thad do// ye shes zhabs kyis kyang*/ gal te 'o na ni/ rab tu dga' ba'i gnas skabs kho nar phar phyin thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir sa gzhan de dag don med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ bden te/ sa thams cad ni/ mtshan nyid gcig pa'i phyir lo ka las 'das pa'i gnas skabs la ltos nas khyad par ci yang med do// dag pa lo ka pa'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan ni/ kha cig mthong ba'i skad cig mas bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ kha cig sgom pas bsgrub par bya ba yin no// sa'i khyad par rnam par bzhag pa'ang de la ltos pa'i phyir nyes pa med do// zhes so// gsum pa la/ chos nyid cha med pas gcig rtogs pa na thams cad rtogs na/ mthong lam pa chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du mthong bar thal/ chos nyid mtha' dag rtogs pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ thogs med kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma thob par sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i mtshan nyid/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings rtogs pa mngon sum du byed par mi 'thad do// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ 'di la/ kha cig na re/ 'dod pa yin te/ byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi mnyam gzhag khyad med do// zhes 'dod (366) na/ de mi 'thad de/ thogs med kyis/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags rnams kyis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags// bcom ldan 'das khyod chos sku rnam dag blo gros mtha' yas pa// shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong*// zhes drangs pa dang 'gal lo// des na/ ngo bo nyid sku'i ngo bo chos nyid tsam zhig mthong bar thal zer na/ 'dod de/ ār+ya de bas/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba// de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*// zhes pas mthong lam gyi yul de bzhin nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid/

dri ma ma lus pa dag pa na ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin la/ de gnyis kyi ngo bo chos nyid tha dad med pa'i phyir ro// mdo las/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po cung zad mthong ngo*// zhes so// ngo bo nyid sku'i khyad par ma lus pa mthong bar thal zer na/ khyab pa med de/ de ni glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pas dben pas phye ba yin la/ de mthong lam gyi yul la cha med du ma grub bo// mthong lam pa chos can/ mchog gi don la sogs pa la sgrib pa rnams spangs par thal/ chos nyid de dag rtogs pa'i phyir zer na/ rtogs pa tsam yin pa la khyab pa med/ gsal zhing nges pa skyed nus su rtogs pa'i rtags ma grub ste/ sa dang por kun tu 'gro ba'i don gsal zhing nges pa skyed nus su rtogs pa sogs kyi khyad yod la/ gang goms pa gsal zhing nges pa skyed nus pa de'i sgrib pa spong gi mthong ba tsam gyis spong mi nus te/ dper na/ bum pa dang*/ skad cig ma mthong bar khyad par med kyang bum pa ma yin du 'dzin pa sel gyi/ rtag 'dzin bsal mi nus pa bzhin no// a bh+yas/ cha gang goms pa gsal ba nyid la sogs pas sgro btags pa'i rnam pa sel bar nus pa de kho na la (367) de'i gegs kyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i phyir tshad ma nyid yin gyi/ gzhan la ma yin te/ skad cig ma nyid la sogs pa bzhin no// de ltar na/ 'phags pa rnams so so'i skye bo rnams las khyad par ci yod ces kyang brjod par mi bya ste/ rnam pa ji tsam zhig gsal bar byas na/ de rnams kyi shes pa 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bral ba tsam gyis de rnams khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gzhan yang mthong spang rnams chos nyid mthong bas spong gi sgom spang ni/ chos nyid mthong ba tsam gyis spang mi nus so// nyan rang mthong lam pa chos can/ chos kyi bdag med mthong bar thal/ gang zag gi bdag med mthong ba'i phyir ro// zhe na/

klu sgrub la sogs pa 'dod pa yin te/ 'on kyang rjes thob kyi thabs kyi khyad par yod do// zhe'o// yang na/ chos nyid cha shas med pa gcig la blo ma 'khrul ba gcig gis mthong ma mthong cha gnyis med kyi/ de dag gi yul mi rtag sogs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid cha shas med par ma grub cing*/ shes pa de'ang spros bral la ltos te ma 'khrul ba min no// phyin ci log tu zhugs pa nyid kyis shes pa dang*/ mdo myang 'das las/ nyan thos rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ma mthong ste/ ting nge 'dzin shas che ba'i phyir dang*/ shes rab shas chung ba'i phyir ro// byang sems rnams kyis mthong mod kyi/ mi gsal te/ shes rab shas che ba'i phyir dang*/ ting nge 'dzin shas chung ba'i phyir zhes pas so// gal te mi gsal ba'i don ci/ mi gsal bar snang ba yin nam/ ma nges pa yin/ dang po mi 'thad de/ mnyam gzhag na snang ba gtan med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ltar na/ spang bya sa bon spong byed min par thal lo// gzhan yang 'grel chen nas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa

(368) nyid du mngon sum du byed pa'i shes pa shin tu gsal ba skyes pa de'i tshe byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam thob bo// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ gsal bar bshad pa ni/ mthong spang gi sgrib pa spangs pas de bzhin nyid mngon sum du mthong ba la dgongs la/ mi gsal ba ni/ sgom spang gi dri mas ma dag pas chos nyid mthong ba mi gsal ba ste/ dar las chod pa'i bum pa mthong ba bzhin no// de lta min na/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro// a bh+yas/ shin tu gsal ba nyid du khas len na/ rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa med pa'i phyir da ltar kho na rtogs pa thams cad rdzogs pas na/ sangs rgyas nyid rtogs par 'gyur la zhes so// des na/ ma nges pa'i mi gsal ba yin yang spang bya sa bon spong byed du mi 'gal te/ sa bon gang spong ba'am spangs pa de la ltos te mi gsal ba min pa'i phyir ro// phyogs dang po la/ slob dpon 'di dang chos bshes la sogs pas mnyam gzhag na snang ba yod par 'dod de/ kun rdzob tu dngos por snang ba 'di/ don dam par dpyad na rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu yin la/ de nyid pad 'dab ltar ma 'dres par mthong ba de'i dus su yod med gang du'ang mi 'dzin pa sgro skur dang bral ba'i mi rtog pa skye'o// des na mig btsum pa ltar ci'ang mi mthong ba mthong lam min gyi/ sna tshogs mthong yang sgro skur dang bral ba mthong lam yin no// 'o na mdo las/ ci yang mthong ba med pa ni/ don dam pa mthong ba'o// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ de ni/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du sgro skur ci yang mi mthong ba zhes ma yin dgag tu gzung ngo*// sa brgyad pa yan chad du sna tshogs 'di dag rdul phran tsam yang mi snang la med par yang mi rtog pa'o// zhes so// gzhan ni/ de mi 'thad de/ yul de la shes pa mi skye ba'i don ni/ mthong ba med pa yin la/

mthong ba med pa kho na'i sgom pa ni/ mthong ba yin te/ dper na/ (369) ka ba sogs ma mthong ba la nam mkha' mthong zhes zer ba bzhin du/ gzugs sogs btags pa'i chos gang yang ma mthong ba ni/ don dam pa mthong ba'o// ye shes zhabs kyis/ yum ni/ 'dus byas la sogs pa la dmigs pa dang 'gal bas rnam pa thams cad du dben par spyod yul gcig pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis ni/ chos thams cad nam mkha'i ngos dang 'dra bar thugs su chud do// rjes la thob pas ni/ chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu'i bar du gzigs so// zhes pa dang*/ a bh+yas/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i gnas skabs na/ rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa mtha' dag ldog pa na dmigs pa la sogs pa ci yang med do// zhes so// yang mi gsal na ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa min par 'gyur te/ chos nyid gsal mi gsal gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro// zhe na/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo dri mas dag ma dag gis gsal mi gsal du bzhag ste/ nam mkha' dag pa la mig dag ma dag gis gsal mi gsal du bzhag pa bzhin no// de lta min na/ khyed gsal bar 'dod pa la'ang der 'gyur ro// brgyad pa ni/ sa phyi ma gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od yin no// gnyis pa la/ mtshams sbyar dang*/ sa'i tshogs dngos bshad pa gnyis so// dang po la/ gsungs zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa gsum mo// gang la na/ rtogs pa phyi ma dang de la brten pa'i yon tan gyi rten sa'i tshogs la'o// gang gi phyir na/ thabs gang gis sa bcu yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ba'i chos gang dag yin pa de dag bstan pa'i phyir/ ji tsam gyis na/ theg chen la yang dag par zhugs pa lags zhes zhus (370) pa'i lan du'o// 'o na/ sa thob zin sbyong ngam/ ma thob pa sbyong zhe na/ rang gi sa de thob zin khyad par sbyong zhing sa gong ma'i yon tan thob pa'i rgyur yang ngo*// 'grel chen nas/

sa gang gi yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ba'i chos gang yin pa rnams ji srid ma rdzogs pa de srid du sa de yin la/ rdzogs nas ni/ sa gzhan yin par shes par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyong dang*/ 'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid gnyis so// dang po la/ sa dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa'i yongs sbyong dang dgu las/ dang po la/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa gnyis las/ rtsa ba la/ sbyong byed thabs dang*/ sbyong tshul shes rab gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thob 'gyur te zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sa dang po ni'o// gang gis na/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa bcu yis so// bcu gang zhe na/ dge ba sgrub pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ sems can la phan pa'i dngos po theg chen gyi chos 'dzin pa dang*/ sems can rnams la sems mnyam pa nyid kyi tshad med bzhi sgrub pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum mi dmigs pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ de dag byed pa'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ theg dman la mi ltos par dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa ma lus tshol ba dang*/ rtag tu khyim nas khyim med par nges par 'byung ba'i sems nyid dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi skur rtogs pa ste/ mthong na dga' ba yid la byed pa dang*/ gzhung kha cig las/ skur gtod ces 'byung ste/ de la sems gtod pa'am/ skur gyur na dga' ba ste/ saṃ skṛ ta la ga ta zhes 'byung bas so// sems can smin byed kyi chos ston pa dang*/ dam bca' rdzogs par byed pa bden pa'i tshig ni/ bcu pa yin par 'dod do// gnyis pa ni/ sbyong byed bcu po 'di dag rang rang gi rang bzhin mi dmigs pa nam mkha' sgyu ma lta bur rtogs te (371) bsgoms pas/ sa dang po yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya'o// mdo las/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis yongs su sbyong ba bcu po 'di dag bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su sbyong ba dang sogs so// 'grel pa ni/

'thob pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byang chub la ni nye ba dang*// sems can don sgrub mthong ba la// rab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur te// de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do// zhes pa'am/ sngon ma byung ba'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i dga' ba skyes pas na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'o// gang gis na/ thabs shes gnyis las/ thabs ni/ sems bskyed pa ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub kyi gzhi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rang don yid la byed pa'i gya gyu med pa'i bsam pa dang*/ rang gi dgos pa chos sku dang*/ gzhan gyi dgos pa 'phrin las la phan pa theg chen gyi chos 'dzin cing rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes don du gnyer ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la sems rtse gcig pa'i byams pa sogs te/ bsam pa gsum dang*/ gzhan zang zing gis sdud pa'i sbyor ba bdog pa phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs par yongs su gtong ba dang*/ chos nyan pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen la 'god pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas mgu bar byed pa dang*/ brjod bya theg pa gsum du gtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa ma lus pa 'dod cing tshol ba dang*/ rgyud ma smin pas khyim na gnas pa la mngon par mi dga' zhing tshe rabs thams cad du rab tu 'byung ba lus srung ba dang rtag tu bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku sgrub par 'dod pa dang*/ sems can smin pa'i don du thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pa la mi skyo ba dang*/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin byed pa bden par smra ba nyid ces bya ba de lta bu'i (372) mtshan nyid kyi chos bcus so// bcu ci dgos zhes na/ sa dang po'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad du rdzogs par bskyed par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyu'i khyad par bcu po rang rang gi ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis khyad par du byas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yongs su sbyong ba dag kho nas so// gnyis pa la gnyis las/

rtsa ba ni/ sa gnyis par tshul khrims gtso che bas tshul khrims gsum dang*/ de byams pas spel bas byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba dang*/ sems can gyi nyes pa la mi lta bas bzod pa dang*/ sems can gyi rgyud snod du rung ba'i gzhan don la rab tu dga' ba dang*/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems can la snying brtse che ba dang*/ gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir bla ma la bkur sti gdan stob sogs dang*/ yon tan gyis lci bas bla ma la gus pas nyan cing don sgrub pa dang*/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir tshul khrims nas bgrangs pa'i brgyad pa sbyin pa la sogs pa la brtson pa yid la byed pas sa gnyis pa sbyong ngo*// mdo ni/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis chos brgyad yid la bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pa dang zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ thob pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir// dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya// zhes pas tshul khrims 'chal ba dang*/ theg dman yid la byed pa'i dri ma med pas na/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa'o// thabs gang gis na/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bya ba dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pas nyan rang gi yid byed spangs pa dang*/ gzhan gyis phan pa cung zad cig byas pa'ang dran pas chung bar mi brtsi zhing mi brnyas par drin du gzo ba dang*/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa dang*/ sogs par duḥkha dang chos zab mo la bzod pa dang*/ sems (373) can yongs su smin par bya ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la 'gyod pa med pa dang*/ skye bo thams cad la byams pas sems can re re'i phyir yang yun ring por dmyal par gnas par spro ba dang*/ nye bar lung 'bogs pa mkhan po dang*/ sogs pa slob dpon la sogs pa la 'dud pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes byas nas des bstan pa'i chos ji lta ba bzhin sgrub pa dang*/

las gzhan med par sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phyin drug la brtson zhing spro bas sgrub pa zhes bya ba de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong ba brgyad kyis so// shes rab ji lta bus na/ snga mas dang por bstan pa bzhin du mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i yongs su sbyong ba byas pa'i khyad par rnam pa brgyad kyis so// brgyad ci dgos zhes na/ sa gnyis pa'i yon tan rdzogs par bskyed pa la brgyad dgos te/ snga ma bzhin zhes don gnyis su drang ste/ 'og ma rnams kyang de bzhin no// gsum pa la/ rtsa ba ni/ rang gzhan gyi shes rab sbyong ba mang du thos pas mi ngom pa nyid dang*/ zang zing gi rnyed pa 'dod pa med par chos sbyin pa gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snod bcud kyi zhing kun sbyong ba dang*/ bya dka' ba'i spyod pa sbyong ba 'khor ba'i nyes pas yongs su mi skyo ba dang*/ theg chen gyi sems sbyong ba ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa zhes bya ba rnams la rlom pa med pa'i bdag nyid de/ rnam lngas sa gsum pa sbyong ngo*// mdo ni/ byang sems sa gsum pa la gnas pas chos lnga la gnas par bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mang du thos pas mi ngom zhing*/ de la'ang mi dger mngon par ma zhen pa dang sogs so// 'grel pa la/ rtog pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ chos kyi snang ba chen po ni// byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa// zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis rang gzhan la chos (374) kyi snang ba byed pas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa'o// gang gis na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos nyan pas ngom mi shes par 'dzin pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang*/ sogs pa bkur sti la sogs pa la mi lta ba'i sems kyis dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pa dang*/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rten snod dang*/ brten pa sems can kun tu sbyong ba'i dge ba bskyed cing*/ der bsngo ba dang phan btags pa'i sems can rnams de dang mi mthun pa gnod pa byed pa dang drin du mi gzo ba la sogs pa 'khor ba'i nyes pa mthong bas gzhan don la yongs su mi skyo ba dang*/

rang la ltos nas mi dge ba'i chos mi byed pa/ ngo tsha shes pa/ gzhan la ltos nas mi dge ba'i chos mi byed pa/ khrel yod pa/ nyan rang gi yid byed spangs pa zhes bya ba de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa lnga pos so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du ngo bo nyid du mi rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas yongs su sbyong ba byas pas so// bzhi pa la/ rtsa ba ni/ nags te/ dben par gnas pa dang*/ rang don byang chub kyang mi 'dod pa 'dod pa chung ba dang*/ chung ngus chog shes pa dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan rtogs pa yang dag par sdom pa/ chos la nges rtog gi bzod pa mi gtong bar bsten cing bsnyen pa dang*/ bslab pa gsum yongs su mi gtong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la smod pa dang*/ chos thams cad la mngon par 'du byed pa med cing mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol ba dang*/ lus la sogs pa bdog pa kun gtong ba dang*/ dge ba la sems mi zhum pa dang*/ dngos por lta ba med pa ste/ bcus sa bzhi pa gnon no// mdo ni/ byang sems chen po sa bzhi pa la gnas pas chos bcu po 'di dag yongs su gtang bar mi bya'o// bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dgon par gnas pa dang zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ gnon pa yin no zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ 'di (375) ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos// rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu// de dang ldan phyir sa de ni// gnyis po sreg pas 'od 'phro can// zhes pas/ byang chub phyogs mthun gyi shes rab kyis sgrib gnyis sreg pa'i me yin pas sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba can no// gang gis na/ nyan rang gi yid la byed pas dben pa'i dgon par gnas pa dang*/ rnyed pa ma thob pa la thob par mngon par 'dod pa med pa dang*/ rnyed pa dngos po khyad par can thob pa la de bas lhag pa don du gnyer ba dang*/ thob pa la rlom pa med pa dang*/ zas bzang po dang*/ yang yang za ba dang*/ len pa la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir bsod snyoms pa nyid dang*/

sogs pa stan gcig pa dang*/ phyis mi len pa ste/ zas kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ gos bzang po dang*/ 'jam po dang*/ mang po la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ phying pa dang*/ chos gos gsum pa ste/ gos kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ gnas 'du 'dzi can dang*/ steng g.yogs can dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ gnas kyi sbyor ba la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir dgon pa pa/ bla gab med pa/ shing drung pa/ dur khrod pa ste/ gnas kyi dbang du byas pa bzhi/ nyal sogs dang*/ 'dug sa spong ba la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir cog bu pa dang*/ gzhi ji bzhin pa ste/ spyod lam gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis te/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par sdom pa dang*/ gzhan don du bslab pa blangs pa/ srog dang*/ sogs pa longs spyod pa la sogs pa'i phyir yang yongs su mi gtong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gzugs sdug sogs la nyes dmigs su lta bas smod cing 'dod pa'i sems mi bskyed pa dang*/ gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par rtag 'dzin bzlog pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol zhing 'das par byed pa dang*/ bdog pa nor dang*/ gnyen sdug dang*/ lus srog thams cad yongs su gtong ba chung ngu

(376) 'bring*/ chen po gsum dang*/ dge ba sgrub pa la sems mi zhum zhing spro ba dang ldan pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad la don dam par cir yang mi lta ba dang zhes bya ba de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong pa bcus so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma lta bu rnam pa bcus so// lnga pa la/ rtsa ba ni/ 'thob ces drang ngo*// gang na/ sa lnga pa ni'o// ji ltar na/ yang dag par te/ rdzogs par ro// gang gi tshe na/ khyim pa sogs dang 'dris pa dang*/ sbyin bdag gi khyim la 'khren pa ste/ ser sna byed pa dang*/ phyi nang gi 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas su gnas sogs dang*/ bdag gi yon tan brjod de bstod pa dang*/ gzhan skyon brjod de brnyas pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyang yin la ngan song du 'gro ba'i lam yang yin pa bcu dang*/ nga rgyal gyi rlom pas khengs pa dang*/ blang dor phyin ci log tu zhen pa dang*/ blo gros ngan pa yid gnyis dang*/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum bzod cing 'dod pa ste/ bcu po 'di ni rnam par spangs pa na'o// mdo ni/ byang sems sa lnga pa la gnas pas chos bcu yongs su spang par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba bsten pa yongs su spang bar bya ba dang zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ thob pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sems can rnams yongs smin byed cing*// rang gi sems kyang bsrung ba'i phyir// blo ldan rnams kyis sbyang dka' ba// de phyir sbyang dka' zhes bya'o// zhes pas sems can smin pa dang*/ sems can gyi log sgrub kyis rang gi sems nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba ste/ bya dka' ba gnyis byed pa sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba'o// gang gis na rnyed pa dang*/ sogs pa bkur sti'am/ grags sogs kyi don du rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ sogs pa khyim pa la sogs pa dang 'grogs shing 'dris pa dang*/ gzhan la dad pa can gyi khyim nye bar mi ston cing rnyed pa thob pa la ser sna byed pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi skye bo mang po'i grong dang*/

sogs (377) pa rang don gyi 'du 'dzi nyan rang gi yid la byed pa dang*/ rnyed sogs kyi phyir bdag la bsngags pa dang*/ phrag dog gis gzhan la smod pa dang*/ srog gcod sogs mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu dang*/ thos pa dang*/ sogs pa tshul khrims sogs kyis mkhas shing btsun par rlom pas bshes gnyen gzhan la mi 'dud pa dang*/ dge ba las ldog ste mi dge ba/ mi dge ba las ldog ste dge bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ log par lta ba dang*/ sogs pa the tshom la sogs pa blo gros ngan pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ sogs pa gti mug sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad la sems mngon du phyogs par byed pa zhes bya ba de lta bu'i spang bya'i mtshan nyid kyi chos bcu rnam par spong zhing ldog pa gnyen po'i chos don te/ spang bya'i shugs kyis 'phangs pa yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa bcus so// 'di dag phal cher mthong lam gyis spangs zin to// zhe na/ rags pa rnams spangs kyang 'dir phra ba'am gnas ngan len spong ba yin no// sa bdun pa la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du'o// drug pa la/ rtsa ba ni/ 'thob ces drang ngo*// gang na/ sa drug pa ni'o// ji ltar na/ yang dag par ro// gang gis na/ lam bskyed pa drug dang*/ lam min spangs pa drug gis te/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab ste/ phyin drug rab tu rdzogs pas so// mdo ni/ byang sems chen po/ sa drug pa la gnas pas chos drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ phyin drug go /zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma nyan thos dang*/ bse ru rang rgyal gyi sa la dga' ba'i sems spangs pa dang*/ stong nyid la skrag pa'i sems spangs pa dang*/ mgo sogs bslangs na mi zhum pa dang*/ bdog pa ma lus pa kun btang yang mi dga' (378) ba med pa dang*/ rang nyid dbul yang slong ba po lag stong du mi spong ba ste/
