drug gis so// mdo ni/ gzhan yang*/ chos drug yongs su spang bar bya ste/ drug gang zhe na/ nyan thos kyi sems yongs su spang bar bya'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ kun shes par 'gyur ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'da'// gnyis 'dir mngon du gyur pa'i phyir// mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bshad// ces pas/ yum la brten nas 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i phyir 'khor 'das mngon du gyur pas sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'o// gang gis na/ phyin drug rdzogs pa dang*/ de'i rgyus spang bya drug spangs pa ste/ rang don gyi yid byed spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ gzhan don la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i bsam gtan gyi phar phyin rdzogs pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la dga' zhing mngon par 'dod pa'i sems spong ba dang*/ chos zab mo la bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa la skrag pa'i sems spong ba dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pas sbyin pa la dang por 'jug pa'i gegs slong ba pa'i skye bos/ nor la sogs pa bslangs na ser snas zil gyis non nas zhum pa'i sems spong ba dang*/ byin pa la spro dga'i brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin rdzogs pas rab tu sgrub pa'i gegs bdog pa thams cad rang gi ngang gis gtong bar zhugs pa la mi dga' ba'i sems spong ba dang*/ thabs mkhas yum rdzogs pas mthar phyin pa'i gegs zas nor gyis bkren yang slong ba'i skye bo thob pa med par spong ba'i sems spong ba ste/ sems spong ba kun la sbyar te/ de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong ba bcu gnyis kyis so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du'o// bdun pa la/ spang bya spangs pa dang*/ spong byed gnyen po'i khyad par gnyis las/ dang po la/ rtsa ba ni/ 'thob ces drang ngo*// gang na/ sa bdun pa ni'o// gang gis (379) na/ 'dzin pa zhes pa/

dang po bcu bzhi dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la sbyar te/ nga rgyal gyi gzhir gyur pa'i bdag dang*/ zhum pa'am 'jig pa'i bdag nyid can sems can dang*/ skal ba mnyam pa'i ris yongs su rdzogs kyi bar du gnas pa srog dang*/ 'gro bar yang yang gnas pas gang zag dang*/ sngon byung ba da ltar med pa chad pa dang*/ yod pa med par mi 'gyur bas rtag pa dang*/ blang dor gyi mtshan ma dang tha dad pa'i rgyu dang*/ ming gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ sa bon 'dzin pa khams dang*/ skye sgo 'byed pa skye mched dag dang*/ 'dod khams dang gzugs khams gzugs med khams te/ khams gsum po la rtog pas bden par 'dzin cing gnas pa dang*/ de la blang dor du 'dzin cing chags pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen thob mi nus zhes sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang*/ gzugs sku dang rjod byed dang gang zag la dkon mchog gsum du dang*/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen po la tshul khrims la'o// der lta ba'i mngon par zhen pa dang zhes bzhi ga la sbyar ro// chos thams cad stong pa nyid la the tshom za bas rtsod pa dang*/ de dang 'gal ba dngos por 'dzin pa ste/ nyes pa nyi shu ni rgyud gang la rnam par chad pa ste/ spangs pa de yis so// mdo ni/ byang sems sa bdun pa la gnas pas chos nyi shu mi 'byung ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ kun shes par 'gyur ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ bgrod gcig lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir// ring du song ba'i sar 'dod do// zhes pas sa bdun pa bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang 'brel bas mtshan mar 'dzin pa las ring du song ba'o// gang gis na/ phung po la sogs bdag dang sems can gyi mtshan mar dang*/ srog la blang byar dang*/ gang (380) zag gcig tu dang*/ gzhan don rgyun chad par dang*/ rang don 'gyur med rtag pa dang*/ 'khor 'das la blang dor gzugs sogs kyi mtshan ma dang theg pa gsum gyi rgyu rigs tha dad du dang*/

phung po skye 'jig tu dang*/ khams rang gi nyer spyod 'dzin par dang*/ phyi nang gi skye mched tha dad du dang*/ khams gsum la dang por rtogs pas gnas pa dang*/ rgyun du yongs su 'dzin pas chags pa dang*/ gzhan don sgrub mi nus zhes sems kun tu zhum pa dang*/ gzugs sku la sangs rgyas dang*/ yan lag bcu gnyis la chos dang*/ skyes bu zung bzhi la dge 'dun dang*/ dge ba rgyun chags la tshul khrims su lta ba'i mngon par zhen pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la the tshom za nas rtsod pa dang*/ stong nyid dang 'gal bar brjod pa dngos por zhen pa ste/ 'dzin pa zhes bcu drug la sbyar te/ de dag yongs su spangs te nyes pa de lta bu nyi shu dang bral nas ldog pa'i chos don nam/ shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa nyi shus so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du'o// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ spang bya'i don gyis 'phangs pa'i chos gnyen po nyid bstan pa'i phyir ston no// rtsa ba ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo ngo bos stong pa dang*/ rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang*/ 'bras bu la smon pa med pa ste/ gsum shes pa dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i dge ba bcu sgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa nyid dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ dngos por rlom pa med pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi tshul gcig tu shes pa dang*/ chos thams cad mi skye bar shes pa dang*/ chos zab mo la bzod pa shes pa dang*/ phyi nang gi skye mched kyi chos rnams gnyis med par rnam pa gcig tu ston pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang*/ mtshan mar 'du shes dang*/ lta ba lnga dang*/ nyon mongs (381) chags sogs spong ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen la rtse gcig pa zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang*/ lhag mthong thabs shes rab la mkhas pa dang*/ rtog pa'i sems 'dul ba 'gog lam shes pa dang*/

gzugs sogs thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang*/ gzhi ma grub pas chags shing zhen pa'i sa'am/ gnas min par shes pa dang*/ rang gar te/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du mnyam ste/ gcig car 'gro ba dang*/ zhing kun tu bdag gi ngo bo ste/ lus ni/ ji ltar gdul bya dang mthun par sprul zhing ston pa nyid dang grangs nyi shu'o// mdo ni/ byang sems chen po sa bdun pa la gnas pas chos nyi shu po 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sa bdun pa'o// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du'o// gang gis na/ phung po sogs bdag gis dben pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ sems can sogs mtshan ma med pa dang*/ srog sogs 'bras bu la smon pa med pa yang dag par shes pas bdag dang sems can dang srog tu 'dzin pa spong ngo*// srog mi gcod pa sogs dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gsad par bya ba'i gang zag dang*/ gsod pa'i gang zag dang*/ des de'i srog gcod pa gsod pa mi dmigs pa dang*/ sogs pa mi rku ba la sogs pa la sbyar te/ des gang zag tu 'dzin pa spong ngo*// skye bo duḥkha can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying brtse bas chad 'dzin spong ngo*// sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su rdzogs pa nas dngos po thams cad la dmigs pa'i rlom pa med pas rtag 'dzin spong ngo*// 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad blang dor gyi rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid (382) du rtogs pas mtshan 'dzin spong ngo*// theg pa gsum gyi rigs mthar thug theg pa chen po'i rigs su gcig tu rtogs pas rgyur 'dzin pa spong ngo*// ming gzugs gdod nas mi skye bar yongs su shes pas phung por 'dzin pa yongs su spong ngo*// khams rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i chos zab mo la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa khong du chud pa ste/

mngon sum du rtogs pas khams su 'dzin pa spong ngo*// shes bya phyi nang gi skye mched thams cad theg pa chen po'i thabs gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi sgo nas rab tu ston cing rtogs pas skye mched du 'dzin pa spong ngo*// gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad gcod pa'i gnyen pos khams gsum la gnas par 'dzin pa spong ngo*// gzugs sogs kyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa med pa dang*/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang*/ sogs pa log lta la sogs pa lnga 'dor ba dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ sogs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa nyon mongs pa spong ba dang gsum gyis chags 'dzin spong ngo*// gzhan don du rnam mkhyen la rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas bsgoms pas zhum 'dzin spong ngo*// stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems mi 'gong ba la sogs pa'i thabs la mkhas par byed pas sangs rgyas su dang*/ chos bdag med pa bsgoms pas sems nye bar zhi bas chos su dang*/ bden gnyis la brten nas gzugs la sogs pa la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas kyi spyan thob pas dge 'dun dang*/ chags shing mngon par zhen pa'i gnas ma yin pa'i ye shes thob pas tshul khrims su lta ba'i mngon zhen spong ngo*// chos rab tu 'byed pa'i don du rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dus mnyam du ste/ gcig car sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro bas na/ stong pa nyid la rtsod par 'dzin pa spong ngo*// dmigs pa la zhen pa'i sems can 'dul ba'i phyir gdul bya dang mthun par zhing thams cad du bdag gi lus (383) rgyal po sogs su rab tu ston pas 'gal bar brjod pa'i 'dzin pa spong ba zhes bya ba yongs su spyod pa gnyen po rnam pa nyi shu po 'dis kyang ngo*// kyang ni/ snga ma 'ba' zhig tu ma zad ces pa'o// spang gnyen sbyor tshul 'di ni/ 'grel chen ltar bris pa yin no// gser gling pa dang*/ bod kyis mi 'dra ba byas pa kun 'thad par ma mthong ngo*// brgyad pa la/

rtsa ba ni/ bshad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ las te/ yongs spyod rnam pa 'di brgyad ni'o// gang las na/ mdo las so// brgyad ni/ sems can kun gyi yid kyi spyod pa ji lta bar shes pa dang*/ zhing sna tshogs su rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas rtse ba dang*/ snod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po sgrub pa dang*/ chos yongs su brtag pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ sems can gyi dbang po dang*/ bag la nyal dang*/ khams sogs shes pa dang*/ bcud kyi rgyal ba'i zhing sbyong ba dang*/ rnam smin las skyes pa'i sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzhan don du bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba len pa dang brgyad do// mdo ni/ byang sems chen po sa brgyad pa la gnas pas chos bzhi po 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems khong du chud par bya ba dang zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ chos bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa dang sogs te/ bzhi phrag gnyis so sor byas pa ni/ gang yang rung bas sa de yongs su sbyong bar shes pa'i don du yin no// zhes 'phags pas so// de ni/ drug bdun la'ang mtshungs so// zhes sems so// 'grel pa la/ nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo phyir// mi g.yo ba zhes nges par brjod// ces pas sa brgyad pa mtshan ma la rtsol ba dang*/ mtshan ma med pa la rtsol ba'i 'du shes

(384) gnyis kyis mi g.yo ba'i 'o// gang gis na/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa chags pa yod med sogs ji lta ba bzhin du mngon sum du shes pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i lo ka'i khams su snang mi snang du byed pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes du mas rtse ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rten snod kyi lo ka gser dang*/ sogs pa dngul la sogs pa'i ngo bo la baiḍūr+yas mig mang ris su bris pa la sogs pas yongs su bsgyur ba dang*/ gzhan don du rnam pa thams cad du chos yongs su brtag pa ste/ de la sems shing dpyod pas sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa'i lha'i mig skyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brten pa sems can gyi nyes pa med par yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ ldang 'jug thams cad du sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa mi 'pho zhing*/ nyams pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rgyal por skyes na/ sems can mang po'i don du 'gyur bar mthong nas des gzhan don bya'o// zhes blo sngon du btang nas de lta bu'i skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yongs su sbyong ba'i chos de lta bu rnam pa brgyad kyis so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du'o// dgu pa la/ rtsa ba ni/ spyir phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu smon lam dag ni mtha' yas pa dang*/ bye brag tu chos ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu tshig la dbang thob pa lha la sogs pa'i skad shes pa dang*/ zil gyis mi non pa spobs pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu dang*/ bdag po phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu lam skyon med kyi mngal du 'jug pa'i mchog dag rigs bzang po dang*/ btsun par grags pa'i rus dang*/ byang sems byung byung ba'i cho 'brang ste/ rgyud dang*/ bsgo ba nyan pa'i 'khor dang*/ mngal nas mi skye ba'i skye ba dang drug go /mngon par 'byung ba phun sum tshogs ni/ khyim med par nges par 'byung ba dang*/ gnas byang chub kyi shing rnams dang*/

'bras bu yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin no// (385) mdo ni/ byang sems chen po sa dgu pa la gnas pas chos bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ smon lam mtha' yas pa yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ mngon du byed pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ so so yang dag rig blo bzang*// sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin// zhes pas sa dgu pa chos ston pa la mkhas pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i blo gros bzang po thob pas na/ legs pa'i blo gros so// gang gis na/ phar phyin rdzogs pas bsam pa ltar 'grub pa'i smon lam mtha' yas pa dang*/ lha dang*/ sogs pa klu la sogs pa sems can thams cad rang rang gi brda skad shes pa nges tshig so so yang dag pa dang*/ rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa bkod ma'i chu bo ltar mi zad pa dang*/ skye bo dam pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa bud med kyi skyon so gnyis sogs dang bral ba'i ma'i mngal du 'jug pa dang*/ rigs bzhi las rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs pa thub pa lta bu'am/ sogs pa byams pa lta bu bram ze'i rigs su gnas pa dang*/ dang po ma'i mngal du ma btsas par nyi ma dang*/ sogs pa bu ram shing la sogs pa las skyes pa'i rus nyi ma'i gnyen la sogs pa dang*/ ma dang*/ sogs pa pha dang legs par 'brel pa'i gnyen bdun brgyud tshun chad du lo ka pa'i nyes pas ma gos shing dam pa 'ba' zhig byung ba'i cho 'brang dang*/ rang gi smin par byas pas rang dbang ba'i 'khor 'dun pa'am/ lnga sde lta bu dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ sogs pa tshangs pa la sogs mngon par bstod par skye ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa byang sems kyis/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// zhes sogs mdo las byung ba'i tshigs bcad kyis bskul te nges par 'byung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas (386) pa'i rten yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing*/

ston pa 'di yi a shat+tha dang*/ sogs pa byams pa'i klu shing la sogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yon tan stobs bcu la sogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba de lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa bcu gnyis pos so// ji lta bus na/ snga ma bzhin du mi dmigs pas zin pa'i yongs su sbyong ba byas pa'i khyad par dag gis so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ bshad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do// gang gi sgo nas na/ sa 'og ma thams cad kyi spangs rtogs yon tan yar ldan du bsdu ba'i sgo nas so// gang gi tshe na/ rgyu'i sa dgu po rnams kyi yongs su sbyong ba thabs shes rab zung 'brel de ltar nges par bstan zin nas so// ji ltar na/ sa dgu pa'i 'bras bu'i sa bcu pa nyid du yongs sbyong de dag ma bshad par ro// de yang sa dgu pa man chad kyi yongs sbyong rdzogs pas sa bcu pa'i las mngal du 'jug pa la sogs kyang 'grub pas de dag las rigs gzhan med pa la dgongs so// rtsa ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu la zhugs pa'i sar gnas pa de ni chos can/ byang sems kyi sa bcu pa yin par shes par bya'o// nyan rang rtogs pa'i sa brgyad dang*/ byang sems kyi sa dgu po byang sems kyi sa gcig ste/ de ltar sa dgu la yon tan yar ldan du thob cing 'das nas/ las la dbang ba'i rten nyid la sogs pa slob pa'i ye shes gang gis gnas pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ rigs kyi sa dang*/ brgyad pa'i sa dang*/ mthong ba'i sa dang*/ bsrabs pa'i sa dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang*/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang*/ nyan thos kyi sa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang*/ byang sems kyi sa las yang dag par 'das te/ rab 'byor/ de ltar byang sems chen po sa dgu pa las yongs su (387) 'das nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas pa ste/ rab 'byor/

de ni byang sems kyi sa bcu pa'o// zhes so// 'grel pa ni/ shes par bya ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa de la gnas pa de ni'o// ji ltar na/ sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i chos// khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin// zhes te/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo gnyis kyis thos pa'i chos kyi rten la gnas pa nam mkha' lta bu la khyab cing chos kyi char 'bebs pas byang sems kyi sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin yin par ro// 'o na/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gal lo// zhe na/ sa bcu pa la ni byang sems sangs rgyas la zhugs pa yin pas sangs rgyas kho nar brjod par bya'i/ stobs la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su ma rdzogs pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni ma yin no// zhes nyi khri las 'byung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sar 'thad de/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor/ byang sems chen po sa bcu pa la gnas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du brjod do zhes so// rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ tshul de ltar sa dgu 'das nas byang chub chen po ma thob kyang smon lam gyi mthus dga' ldan gyi gnas na gnas pa la sogs pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis sangs rgyas pa'i sbyor ba shes pa gang gis gnas pa'i phyir ro// 'o na/ sa dgu gang zhe na/ don dang ming go rim bzhin du sbyar te bshad pa ni/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rigs dang ldan pa chos mchog gi gnas skabs rigs kyi sa dang*/ 'bras bu dang po rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu la zhugs pa ni/ dgra bcom ma 'bras gnas nas bgrangs na brgyad pa la 'bab pas na/ brgyad pa'i sa dang*/ rgyun du zhugs pa 'bras gnas ni/ de kho na mthong bas mthong ba'i sa dang*/ lan gcig phyir 'ong 'bras gnas ni/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sogs drug spangs te srab mor byas pas bsrabs pa'i sa dang*/ phyir mi 'ong (388) ba 'bras gnas ni/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang gnod sems spangs pas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang*/

dgra bcom pa ni/ lam gyi bya ba byas par rtogs pas byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang*/ tshul lam theg pa gsum gsal bar rnam par gzhag par dgongs pas 'bras bu lhag ma gsum la zhugs pa gsum gcig tu bsdu ba ni/ khyad par gyi tshig med pas nyan thos kyi sa dang*/ rang rgyal bse ru lta bu dang*/ tshogs spyod rnams kyi ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams dang*/ sngar ji skad bshad pa byang sems kyi sa rab dga' la sogs dgu po ni/ byang sems kyi sa zhes gcig kho nar bgrang ste/ de ltar te/ de'i phyir dgu'o// gsum pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gnyen po'i tshogs gsal bar ston pa la bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs so// rtsa ba la bzhi las/ dbye gzhi ni/ mthong lam dang*/ goms pa ste/ sgom pa'i lam dag go /dbye ngo ni/ de la spang bya'i gnyen po rnam pa brgyad du shes par bya'o// tha dad ni/ phal cher tha dad de/ dus snga phyi yod pa'i phyir ro// grangs nges ni/ gzung rtog gzhi dang*/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog bzhi ste/ brgyad yod pas de rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sgom pa'i gnyen po brgyad du nges so// 'grel pa la/ dbye gzhi ni/ lam gnyis las logs na gnyen po med pas mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis po kho na'i mnyam gzhag gi gnas sdabs kyi khyad par ro// dbye ngo ni/ gzung bar rnam par rtog pa la/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po tsam gyi rten can dang*/ gnyen po'i rten can te/ gzung rtog gnyis dang*/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa la/ gang zag rdzas su yod pa'i rten can dang*/ skyes bu btags par yod pa'i rten can te/ 'dzin rtog gnyis te/ bzhi po mthong sgom so sor te/ tha dad du mthong ba'i lam la spong bas mthong spang gnyen po bzhi ste/ mdo ni/ theg pa de gang nas nges par 'byung (389) bar 'gyur zhes zhus pa gsum pa'i lan du/ rim pa bzhin du gang mtshan nyid med pa'i chos rnams nges par 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni zhes pa/

bzhi ga la sbyar te/ chos kyi dbyings nges par 'byung bar 'dod du zad do// sbyin pa'i phar phyin nges par 'byung bar 'dod du zad do// dgra bcom pa nges par 'byung bar 'dod du zad do// ming nges par 'byung bar 'dod du zad do// zhes sogs so// yang kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po'i rnam pa la brten pa dang*/ gnyen po'i rnam pa la brten pa ste/ gzung rtog gnyis dang*/ gang zag rdzas su yod pa'i rnam pa la brten pa dang*/ skyes bu btags par yod pa'i rnam pa la brten pa ste/ 'dzin rtog gnyis te/ bzhi po so sor te/ sgom pa'i lam la spong bas sgom spang gnyen po bzhi ste/ mdo ni/ rim pa ltar theg pa de gang du gnas par 'gyur zhes zhus pa bzhi pa'i lan du/ theg pa de gang du gnas par 'gyur ba med de zhes sogs dang*/ zhus pa lnga pa/ theg pa des su zhig nges par 'byung bar 'gyur zhes pa'i lan du theg pa des su'ang nges par 'byung ba med do// shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir rgyun du zhugs pa mi dmigs pas rgyun du zhugs pa dmigs su med do// mtha' las 'das pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mi dmigs pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dmigs su med do// zhes sogs so// grangs nges ni/ spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgyad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sgom pa mthong spang gnyen po kun rdzob/ sgom spang gnyen po don dam ste/ bden pa gnyis ka'i rnam pa la brten nas mngon du ste/ rtogs par bya ba mi mthun pa'i phyogs spang bya brgyad yod pa'i rab tu dbye bas gnyen po'ang brgyad du nges so// sgom spang gi skabs su rnam pa la brten zhes gsungs pa ni/ mthong spang bas sgom spang phra (390) bar ston pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ de ltar de bzhin du bsod nams ye shes kyi dpung gi tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang spang bya'i g.yul las ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba'i nges par 'byung ba thob pas sgrub pa bzhi pa nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ston no// rtsa ba ni/

shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ yul gyi dbye ba rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'di'o// ji ltar na/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin par ro// brgyad gang zhe na/ dmigs su med pas nges par 'byung ba zhes thams cad la sbyar te/ ched du bya ba gsum ste/ mdo ni/ theg chen po 'das lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i lo ka zil gyis mnan te 'byung ba yin no// zhes so// shes rab kyis chos thams cad mnyam nyid du rtogs pa ste/ mdo ni/ theg pa de ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o// zhes so// snying rjes sems can gyi don byed pa ste/ mdo ni/ theg chen 'di la'ang sems can gzhal du med/ tshad med/ grangs med pa'i go skabs yod do// zhes so// mtshan ma med pas 'bad med lhun grub ste/ mdo ni/ theg chen po 'di la'ang 'ong ba'am 'gro ba'ang mi mthong*/ gnas pa'ang mi mthong ngo*// zhes so// sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' las 'das par nges par 'byung ba ste/ mdo ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la bslab cing rnam mkhyen nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ste zhes so// 'phags pa rnams kyi rtogs pa thob pa gtan du ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi nges 'byung ste/ mdo ni/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i byang sems chen po rnams kyis theg pa chen po 'di la bslab nas rnam mkhyen nyid thob par gyur to// thob bo// 'thob bar 'gyur zhes so// shes bya dang shes pa ro gcig tu gyur pa rnam mkhyen nyid do// 'dir nges 'byung zhes bris pa ni/ rgya dpe la med pa'i phyir ma dag pa'o// mdo ni/ sems can (391) byang chub yin pa de'i phyir byang sems zhes bya'o// byang chub des kyang chos thams cad kyi rnam pa shes te zhes so// rnam mkhyen thob par byed pa'i lam gyi spyod yul can gyi nges 'byung ste/ mdo ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin ni/ lo ka pa'ang yod/ lo ka las 'das pa'ang yod ces sogs so// nges 'byung yod med ni/

sdeb sbyor gyi dbang yin gyi/ don yod par gcig go /'grel pa la gsum las/ dbye gzhi ni/ chos thams cad mi dmigs par rtogs pa nyid kyis ched du bya ba la sogs par nges par te/ gdon mi za ba kho nar 'byung ba'i sgrub pa tsam ni'o// dbye ngo ni/ ched du bya ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad do// grangs nges ni/ gang nges par 'byung bar bya ba'i gzhi rnam pa brgyad yin pas gang gis nges par 'byung byed sgrub pa brgyad du nges pas dbye ba yul gyis bzhag cing*/ go rim snga ma rnams phyi ma la 'brel bas bstan pa'i go rim mo// gzhi brgyad gang zhe na/ thog mar gtso bo yin pas ched du bya ba sems chen po sogs sngar ji skad bshad pa dang*/ de yang mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa med na mi 'byung bas/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin gang yang med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ de yang sems can gyi don byas te bsod nams bsags pa las byung bas sems can gyi don khyad par te/ rgya chen po'am mtha' yas par rtag tu rgyun mi chad par byed pa dang*/ 'bad pa dang bcas pas sems can gyi don ma lus pa mi 'grub pas 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma med par sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa nyid kyis 'gro 'ong gnas gsum mi dmigs pa'i lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ de yang mtha' las 'das par rtogs pa med na mi 'byung bas/ rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i ngo bo/ dus gsum stong nyid du rtogs pa'i gnas skabs

(392) kyi khyad par dang*/ de rdzogs pa'ang theg pa gsum ga'i rtogs pa thob pa med par mi 'byung bas/ thob bya thob byed de gnyis kyi 'brel pa dgag pa'i tshul gyis theg pa gsum gyi don spangs rtogs thams cad thob pa dang*/ de yang rnam mkhyen ma rtogs par mi 'byung bas/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid dang*/ de yang lam med par mi 'byung bas/ rnam mkhyen de'i khyad par gyi lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no// 'byung gzhi gzhan yang yod do zhe na/ ma grub ste/ gang nges par 'byung bar bya ba'i gzhi de lta bu dag las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gzhan shes bya la med pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ las zhes bya ba ni/ nges par gzung ba'am yul gyi bdun pa'o// skabs ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi dbang du byas pas na/ skabs te/ le'u'o// 'og ma rnams kyang des shes par bya'o// dang po ni/ gnyis pa la ltos pa'am/ yang na mchog gi don gyis dang po ste/ rnam mkhyen ni/ skabs ma lus pa bsdus pa'i phyir mchog go /'o ni/ slar sdud pa ste/ rdzogs pa'i tshig go /yang na/ 'og gi rdzogs so// zhes bya ba'i sgra le'u thams cad la sbyar ro// zhes bha wa bha dra gsung ngo*// //rten dang smin byed de 'bras thob pa dag /rigs la brten nas chos rnams la dmigs te// 'bras bu gsum gyi sgrub tshul rnam pa bzhi// rgyu dang bcas pa'i rnam mkhyen legs par bshad// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa la 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar dang*/ lam shes kyi chos rgyas bshad/ skabs bsdu ba dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen nyid rtogs pa ste/ thob pa ni/ rgyu lam shes nyid yongs su shes pa med na/ rnam mkhyen med cing ldog pas de'i rgyu gnyen po lam shes nyid 'chad do// gnyis pa la/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gyi lam shes so// dang po la/ rtsa ba/ (393) 'grel pa gnyis las rtsa ba ni/

rten/ yul/ theg pa/ ngo bo/ byed las kyi khyad par dang lnga'o// rten ni/ mdzad ces drang ngo*// gang gis na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis so// ji ltar na/ lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por ro// don gang gi ched du na/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i bu rnams lam shes skyer rung bar bya ba'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyi drung na/ lha de rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i 'od de ni/ lham me ma yin/ lhan ne ma yin/ lhang nge ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od 'ba' zhig rab ces bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lam shes skye ba'i yul/ sems bskyed dang ldan pa la skye bar nges pa ste/ mdo ni/ lha'i bu gang dag gis bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa de dag gis kyang bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o// gang yang dag pa'i skyon med par zhugs par gyur pa de dag la ni/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthu med do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gis 'khor ba'i rgyud kyi mtshams bcad pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ theg pa gsum ga'i gang zag gis sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du lam shes bsgom pas khyab pa ste/ mdo ni/ gal te de dag bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ de dag la ngas rjes su yi rang bar bya'o// zhes so// 'o na/ mthu med pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ mthu med pa ni/ re zhig snod min pa la dgongs nas byis pa rnams skrag pa spang ba'i phyir drang don du gsungs la/ 'di ni nges don no// bzhi pa nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rang bzhin te/ mdo ni/ kho bo ni/ de dag gi dge ba'i phyogs la bar chad mi byed do// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ rang bzhin de'i byed las sems can smin par byed pa ste/ mdo ni/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i (394) chos rnams las mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos rnams thob par bya'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la lnga ste/

'gal rkyen spang ba'i rten/ mthun rkyen tshang ba'i yul/ mthar thug theg chen gyis khyab pa/ nyon mongs mi spong ba'i ngo bo/ gzhan don byed pa'i las so// dang po ni/ sngon byung ba brjod pa dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ des 'phangs pa'i don gsum mo// dang po ni/ mdzad ces drang ngo*// nam gyi tshe na/ rnam mkhyen bshad pa'i rjes su lha rnams 'khor du lhags pa'i tshe'o// gang gi don du na/ 'dod pa'i lha drug ni/ rim pa bzhin du lo ka skyong ba dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ lha ma yin dang 'thab mi dgos pa dang*/ byams pa bzhugs pa dang*/ rang gi sprul pa la longs spyod pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sprul pa la longs spyod pa dang*/ gzugs khams pa rnams bsam gtan thob pa dang*/ thun mong du lus kyi 'od kyi nga rgyal yod pa de bsal nas lam shes nyid skye ba'i snod du rung ba nyid du bsgrub pa'i phyir du'o// gang gis na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis so// gang zhig ji ltar du na/ lha dang*/ sogs pa lha min nam/ dri za la sogs pa'i zag bcas kyi dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin las skyes pa'i 'od mog mog por te/ dri ma can lta bur ro// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mdzad pa ni/ rjes 'jug gi skye bo thams cad kyang nga rgyal bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la lam shes kyi rtogs pa skye bas lam shes rgyud la skye bar 'dod na/ nga rgyal spang dgos so// zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir mdzad de/ nga rgyal gegs kyi gtso bo yin pas smos kyi/ chags sdang dang zhum pa la sogs ma smos kyang don gyis spang dgos par mtshon no// gsum pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi che ba bstan pa'i tshig zur gyis lam shes kyi rten brjod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ lam shes de chos can/ (395) skye ba'i yul so sor nges pa yin no// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa kho na la skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro// yang ni/

nga rgyal bcom par ma zad sems bskyed pa'ang dgos so// gsum pa khams gsum pa las sems 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom dang*/ de las gcig shos kyi rnal 'byor pa byang sems chos can/ des sangs rgyas nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir lam shes nyid bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab pa yin no// skye bo thams cad mthar thug bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug bar 'gro ba can yin pa de'i phyir ro// te ni/ gzhan 'dren pa/ kyang ni/ rim pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// 'di'i mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ phyi rol pa na re/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams rtag pa'i phyir dang*/ spong byed kyi thabs med pa'i phyir dang*/ yod kyang mi shes pa'i phyir dri ma spangs pa'i sangs rgyas mi srid do// zhe na/ rnam 'grel las/ rgyu yod phyir dang rgyu yi ni// gnyen po goms pas mdzad pa'i phyir// rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa yis// de shes pa yang 'grub pa yin// zhes pas dri ma rnams chos can/ rtag pa min te/ rgyu bdag lta las skyes pa'i phyir// nyes pa'i rnam pa thams cad dag /'jig tshogs lta las skyes pa yin// zhes so// khyab pa yod de/ rgyus bskyed pa'i 'bras bu rtag par 'gal bas so// thabs med pa min te/ rgyu bdag lta'i gnyen po bdag med goms pas 'bras bu dri ma mdzad de/ de'i rgyu mdzad pa'i phyir ro// gnyen po mi shes pa'ang min te/ bdag lta'i yul phung po bdag med du lung rigs kyis nges pa'i phyir ro// yang kho na re/ thog mar dri ma can la bsgoms pas dri med du 'gro ba bzhin du dri med kyang dri ma can du 'gyur ro// zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ bdag med rtogs pa de zlog pa'i 'bad pa byed pa (396) med pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bad kyang zlog mi nus pa'i phyir ro// 'tshe ba med dang yang dag don// ngo bo nyid la phyin log gis// 'bad du zin kyang mi zlog ste// blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro// zhes de rnams rnam 'grel las so// rang lugs bzhag pa la/

'khor ba mtha' yod med du bzhed pa gnyis las/ dang po a bh+ya la sogs pa ni/ 'khor ba la thog ma med de/ sngar med pa'i sems can skye ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ thog ma yod na/ de rgyu med du 'gyur bas so// skye ba rgyu la rag las pas rgyu zad pa las tha ma ni yod de/ rgyu rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs yod cing*/ rkyen sangs rgyas dang byang sems re res kyang sems can tshad med pa mya ngan las zlo ba'i phyir ro// sbyor ba ni/ a bh+yas/ gang gnyen po dang phrad pa na 'bri ba'i chos can de rnams/ gnyen po'i phyogs shin tu 'phel ba na shin tu mdzad pa'i chos srid pa yin te/ gser gyi dri ma la sogs pa bzhin no// 'khor ba yang bdag med pa nyid la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gnyen po'i phyogs la mngon du phyogs pa yod na 'bri ba'i chos can yin no zhes so// ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes so// thogs med kyis/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyir 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni/ 'os ma yin pa ste/ gang gi phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis khyad par med par sems can thams cad la rnam par dag par rung ba nyid yod pa la dgongs nas/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa// rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can ni// thog med sbubs kyis phyir bsgribs mi mthong ste// ji ltar gser gyi gzugs ni bsgribs pa bzhin// zhes gsungs so// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'ga' zhig 'khor ba la mtha' med de/ rigs yod kyang sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur te/ gnyen po sgom pa la ltos pa'i phyir ro// 'grel chen nas/ (397) de lta na'ang 'khor ba la zad pa med pas mtha' yas pa'i phyir nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ ri bo la sogs pa'i sgrib g.yogs du ma yod na'ang nam mkha' la ni yongs su zad pa med do// zhes so// de ltar min na/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang byang sems rgyun chad par 'gyur te/

don bya yul sems can med pa'i phyir ro// mtha' yod par bshad pa ni/ bye brag rigs sad pa la dgongs shing*/ sangs rgyas re res kyang sems can mang po smin par byed kyang zad par mi 'gyur te/ mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro// 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par bshad pa ni/ gdul bya la ltos te khyab par bshad de/ gsum gis khyab pa bzhin no// zhes bzhed do// de la phyogs dang po ltar na/ skye bo thams cad ni/ sems can thams cad du bshad do// sdud 'grel las/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur te zhes so// gnyis pa ltar na/ 'phags pa'i skye bo thams cad ces bshad do// klu sgrub kyis/ byang chub dam pa gnyis thob nas// srid pas skrag yid de dag ni// tshe zad la dgag mya ngan 'das// 'das thob 'du shes can du 'gyur// de la mya ngan 'das yod min// 'on kyang srid gsum khams gsum ni// skye ba'ang de la yod ma yin// zag med dbyings gnas de dag kyang*// mi shes nyon mongs min spangs phyir// phyis ni sangs rgyas kyis bskul nas// byang chub tu ni tshogs bsags te// de yang lo ka 'dren par 'gyur// zhes so// mdor na khyab pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyis khyab pa yin no// rtsod pa spang ba ni/ nyan thos kyi rigs kyi gang zag zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad brtson pa dang ldan par gyur kyang byang chub kyi snying po la bzhag ste bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya bar mi nus so// zhes dgongs pa nges 'grel (398) las bshad pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ skyon med de/ re zhig sangs rgyas mi thob pa la dgongs pa yin gyi/ mthar thug ni/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba kho na ste/ lang gshegs las/ blo gros chen po/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams/ nyan thos kyi theg pas grol ba ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang de dag ni theg pa chen po'i mthar thug pa yin no// zhes pas so// gal te/

kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang*// gzhan yang kun tu gzung ba'i phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// ma nges rnams la theg gcig bstan// zhes nyan rang rigs ma nges pa theg chen du drang ba dang*/ theg chen rigs ma nges pa gzung ba'i phyir theg gcig drang don du bshad kyi/ nges don du theg pa gsum po tha dad do// zhe na/ min te/ theg pa gsum du rnam par gzhag pa ni/ dgongs pa can yin te/ dgongs gzhi/ dus re zhig nyan thos kyi rigs su nges pa la dgongs/ dgos pa/ byis pa 'ga' zhig skrag pa spang ba'i phyir gsungs kyi/ mtshan nyid pa ni min no// zhes nyi khri sogs las 'byung ba'i phyir/ lang gshegs las kyang*/ sems ni yongs su gyur pa na// theg pa gsum du ngas bstan te// theg pa gzhan rnams yod ma yin// byis pa rnams ni yongs drang phyir// theg pa tha dad ngas bstan no// zhes so// des na/ nyan rang dgra bcom yang lhag bcas lhag med kyi myang 'das gnyis thob nas thabs shes rab dang bral bas 'khor ba la skrag pa'i yid can/ myang 'das mtshan nyid pa thob pa med kyang*/ tshe zad pa na mar me shi ba ltar mya ngan las 'das pa zhes ming du byas pa/ khams gsum pa'i skye ba las 'das pa rnams ni/ 'chi 'pho ba'i sems kyi de ma thag tu zag med kyi dbyings la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa kho nar dag pa'i zhing du pad+ma'i sbubs su skye'o// de nas 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer gyis shes sgrib spang pa'i don du sad par mdzad pas langs pa na/ sangs rgyas (399) dang byang sems rnams kyi log las 'das pa'i 'byor pa mthong ste/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sprul pa'i skye bas thar pa'i gnas skabs na dmyal ba la sogs par rgyu ba bzhin du 'khor bar 'gro zhing tshogs bsags te sangs rgyas thob par byed do// klu sgrub kyis/ ji srid sangs rgyas kyis ma bskul// de srid ye shes lus dngos can// ting 'dzin myos pas brgyal bar 'gyur// bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni// sems can don la chags gyur cing*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags nas// sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes so// bzhi pa la/

dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig na re/ byang sems kyis nyon mongs spong mi nus/ spang mi dgos/ spangs na skyon du 'gyur ro// zhe na/ byang sems chos can/ nyon mongs pa ma lus pa spangs pa'i rnam grol gyi lam thob par 'gyur ba mi srid par thal/ nyon mongs spong nus kyi gnyen po med pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ sangs rgyas thob mi srid par thal lo// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni chos can/ srid par skye ba'i rgyu nyon mongs pa chags pa phra mo ched du gtad nas rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa ste/ spong ba ma yin pa zhes bya ba rang bzhin yin no// gdul bya'i 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du skye ba blangs te sems can gyi don byed par 'dod pas zhugs pa'i slob lam pa yin pa nyid kyi phyir ro// 'dis nyan rang gi rtogs pa las rang gi ngo bo khyad par du 'phags par bstan no// nyon mongs pa de'ang khams gsum du skye bar byed pas nyon mongs pa zhes bya la/ tshogs rdzogs shing shes sgrib spong ba la nye bar mkho zhing sems nye bar nyon mongs par byed pa ma yin pas nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed do// mdo las/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ gang dag gis byang sems kun tu sbyor bar byed kyang

(400) nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa ni/ 'di dag go /bcom ldan 'das/ gang gi tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba lags na/ de rgyu ci'i slad du nyon mongs pa zhes bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di ltar de lta bu'i rang bzhin gyi nyon mongs pa 'di dag gis byang sems khams gsum par kun tu sbyor la khams gsum pa yang nyon mongs pa las byung ba yin no// de la byang sems ni/ thabs la mkhas pa dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs bskyed pas bsam bzhin du khams gsum du kun tu sbyor te/ des na dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o// ji srid khams gsum par kun tu sbyor ba yin gyi/ sems nye bar nyon mongs pa ni ma yin no// zhes pa dang*/ 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud// de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud// de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams skyed la phan// zhes pa dang*/ 'od srung*/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ sngags dang sman gyis yongs su zin pa'i dug gis ni log par 'chi bar byed mi nus so// de bzhin du byang sems rnams kyi nyon mongs pa shes rab kyis yongs su zin pas kyang log par ltung bar byed mi nus so// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ gal te nyon mongs pa de dag mtshan nyid pa yin nam/ btags pa ba yin/ dang po ltar na/ byang sems kyis gzhan don du skye ba blangs pa de chos can/ duḥkha mtshan nyid par thal/ nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ duḥkha ma yin la duḥkha ru snang zhing*/ zhes thogs med kyis bshad pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa ltar na/ 'phags pas/ bag la nyal ba thams cad du med pa ni/ ma rig pa dang lta ba'i zag pas bsdus pa'i bag la nyal ba (401) yin gyi/ byang sems ni/ bsam bzhin du srid pa len pa'i phyir 'dod pa dang srid pa'i zag pas bsdus pa ni ma yin no// zhes pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/

so skye'i dus su nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pas 'phags pa dang mi 'gal zhing*/ duḥkhar thal ba 'dod pa yin no// 'phags pa'i dus su nyon mongs kyi mtshan nyid sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa dang mi ldan pas duḥkha skyed pa'i nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ nyon mongs gtan ma yin la nyon mongs su btags pa'ang ma yin pas nyon mongs pa rjes mthun pa'am phra mo ste/ des khams gsum du sbyor bar byed pas so// de nyid tshogs rdzogs pa'i rgyur yang 'gyur te/ thogs med kyis/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la// srid pa'ang zhi ba'i bdag nyid dang*// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur// de phyir rgyal sras bsam mi khyab// ces so// des na 'phags pas sbyor lam pa la dgongs shing*/ thogs med kyis dbang thob pa la dgongs pas lung dang mi 'gal lo// yang*/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa theg chen du zhugs nas skye ba len pa la nyon mongs de yod dam med/ yod na/ byang sems kyi khyad chos yin pa nyams la/ byams pa/ de'i skye ba las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye bar ni nga mi smra'o// de'i skye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ yongs su bsgyur ba'o zhes nga 'dogs so zhes pa dang 'gal lo// med na/ skye ba len pa la nyon mongs dgos pa nyams so// zhe na/ nyan rang de dag gi lam gyi dus su nyon mongs ched du gtad de spong zhing*/ dgra bcom pa na nyon mongs pa las grol yang*/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi bag chags kyi rten ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ma spangs par yod do// de'i rkyen can mtshan ma'i spros pa kun tu spyod pa phra mos kun nas bslangs pa'i zag med kyi las la (402) brten nas yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung po 'byung ngo*// de la ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ni nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa bzhin no// zag med kyi las ni/ las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa bzhin no// yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus 'grub pa ni/

skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa bzhin no// de'i rkyen gyis bsam gyis mi khyab par yongs su bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho ni rga shi bzhin no// dpal phreng seng ge'i nga ror/ bcom ldan 'das/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa'i rkyen gyis zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ dbang thob pa'i byang sems rnams kyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum 'byung ste/ zhes so// des na/ nyon mongs rjes mthun pa'am bag chags yod pas skye ba len la/ nyan rang gi dus su ched du gtad nas spong gi byang sems ni/ ched du gtad nas mi spong bar zil gyis gnon cing shes sgrib spangs pa'i zhar la spangs pas sangs rgyas thob bo// lnga pa ni/ rang bzhin de'i 'og tu rnam pa de lta bu'i rang bzhin can gyi las ni/ rang don yang dag pa'i mtha' myang 'das mngon du mi byed pa dang*/ lhag mthong shes rab dang*/ gzhan don gyi thabs la mkhas pas sems can sbyin pas yongs su ma bsdus pa yongs su sdud pa dang*/ sogs pa gdams ngag gis smin pa dang*/ shes rab kyis grol bar byed pa yin pas des nyan rang las byed pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// yum gyi tshul brgya lnga bcu pa las/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni// mkhas mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i tshe// de srid mtshungs med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems kyi lam shes gsum mo// dang po la/ 'bras bu lam shes kyi rang bzhin/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun no// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sngar bshad pa de ltar lam shes kyi rten dang*/ sogs pa yul la sogs pa brjod nas lam (403) shes nyid kyi skabs su theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad rdzogs par bya dgos pas thog mar nyan thos kyi lam dang lam shes ston no// rtsa ba la/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ nyan thos kyi lam 'di'o// gang gi sgo nas na/

duḥkha sogs 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag gi rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so// mdo ni/ byang sems kyi yum gang zhe na/ 'di la byang sems chen pos rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs ni mi rtag pa nyid du yid la bya'o// zhes sogs so// gang du na/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ste/ skabs su ni'o// 'di'i mtha' dpyad pa la/ nyan thos kyi lam/ de byang sems kyis shes pa'i tshul/ mdo dang bstan bcos su bstan tshul gsum mo// dang po la/ lam lnga las/ tshogs lam ni/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes pas tshul khrims la brten nas nyan thos kyi sde snod la thos bsam byas te/ lung rigs kyis bde bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug shes par byas nas dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi sgom mo// sbyor lam drod rtse bzod mchog bzhir yang dag spong bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga rim pa bzhin yod do// de yang drod rtse gnyis/ bzod pa chung ngu dang gsum du khams gsum gsum gyi bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug mtshungs par sgom mo// 'bring nas dang po lam gyi bzhi dor nas bcu gnyis sgom/ de nas 'gog pa'i bzhi dor/ de nas kun 'byung gi bzhi dor/ de nas duḥkha'i gcig dang gnyis dor nas gnyis sgom pa'i bar ni/ 'bring yin la/ gnyis po sred pa shas che na/ le lo dang nga rgyal gyi gnyen por mi rtag duḥkha gnyis/ lta ba shas che na/ bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i gnyen por (404) bdag med dang stong pa gnyis sgom mo// de nas bzod chen dang chos mchog 'dod khams kyi duḥkha phung po lnga la dmigs pas skad cig re re ste/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ de las dro bar gyur pa 'byung*// de ni bden bzhi'i spyod yul can// rnam pa bcu drug dro la las// rtse mo de yang de dang 'dra// gnyis ka chos kyis rnam pa gtod// gzhan dag gis kyang 'phel bar byed// de las bzod pa yang skye ste// rnam gnyis de bzhin bzod pa ni// thams cad chos kyis 'phel bar byed// chen po 'dod gtogs duḥkha yul// de ni skad cig gcig de bzhin// chos mchog thams cad phung po lnga// zhes so// mthong lam ni/

chos mchog gi rjes su 'dod khams kyi duḥkha'i chos nyid rtogs pa bar chad med kyis bsdus pa chos bzod/ de nyid rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa chos shes/ de'i rjes su khams gong gi duḥkha rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gnyis ni/ rjes bzod rjes shes so// de bzhin du bden pa gzhan gsum la'ang sbyar bas sems kyi skad cig bcu drug gi dang po bco lnga mthong lam yin la/ thams cad kyang chos mchog dang sa gcig go /dbyig gnyen gyis/ lo ka pa yi chos mchog las/ chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med// 'dod duḥkha la de nas ni// de nyid chos shes de bzhin yang*// duḥkha lhag la rjes bzod shes// bden pa gsum la de bzhin no// de ltar bden pa mngon rtogs 'di// sems bcu drug go rnam gsum ste// mthong dmigs bya ba zhes bya'o// de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /bzo dang shes la go rim bzhin// bar chad med dang rnam grol lam// de las skad cig bco lnga ni// ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// zhes so// sgom lam ni/ 'dod khams dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi ste/ sa dgu po re re la sgom spang gi nyon mongs pa dgu dgu gya gcig de dag gi gnyen por gyur pa ste/ (405) dbyig gnyen gyis/ sa dang sa na nyes rnams dgu// de bzhin du yang yon tan rnams// chung dang 'bring dang che rnams kyi// chung ngu la sogs tha dad phyir// zhes te/ rim gyis pa la gya gcig gcig char ba la ni khams gsum gyi nyon mongs dril nas spong bas dgur skye'o// mthong sgom gnyis ni/ 'phags lam brgyad dang*/ byang chub yan lag bdun yin no// dbyig gnyen gyis/ sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin// las ni dang po ba dag dang*// nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang ni// sgom dang mthong la rab tu dbye// zhes so// kha cig ni/ go rim bzhin 'dod pa'ang yod do// mi slob lam ni/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu pa zad pa thob cing shes pa na yin no// dbyig gnyen gyis/

de zad thob dang de zad shes// de tshe de mi slob dgra bcom// zhes so// de yang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du lhag bcas/ shi nas lhag med kyi myang 'das su shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lam de dag thabs shes zung 'brel du shes te/ theg pa gsum gyi lam bstan pa la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir sbyor ba sems bskyed kyis kun nas bslangs/ dngos gzhi cir yang mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa/ rjes la dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du shes so// rang rgyal gyi lam shes tshul yang de bzhin no// gsum pa la/ lo tsā ba sogs na re/ bstan bcos 'dir nyan rang rang rgyud pa'i lam bstan no// zhe na/ de mi rigs te/ sems bskyed shes rab bsngo ba gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis zhes pas so// 'dir yul lam gsum dngos su bstan pas yul can lam shes gsum shugs la bstan te/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu rtogs pa'i (406) sgo nas nyan thos kyi lam/ sems bskyed cing de mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas lam shes/ khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang rgyal gyi lam/ sems bskyed cing yar ldan du bsdus pa'i sgo nas lam shes/ de dag kyang byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i lam gnyis bstan par shes par bya'o// 'grel pa la/ yongs su shes par bya'o// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ bden pa bzhi la dmigs pa'i rnam pa bcu drug gam/ so gsum po rnams so// gang gis na/ byang sems kyis so// gang du na/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs su'o// gang gi sgo nas na/ sems bskyed cing rnam pa rnams ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so// ji ltar na/ nyan thos rnams kyi lam yin par thabs shes zung 'brel de ltar ro// rnam pa rnams gang zhe na/

sdug kun so so ba'i rnam pa brgyad/ thun mong du bcu bzhi/ 'gog bden gyi bdun/ lam bden gyi bzhi'o// chos mngon pa nas 'byung ba dang tha snyad mthun par gsungs pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa/ mi mthun par gsungs pa ni/ rnam grangs kyi rnam pa yin pas ci rigs par go bar bya ste/ dang po duḥkha'i bzhi ni/ bden pa bzhi yod pa de la duḥkha'i bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ skye zhing 'jig pas mi rtag pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas shing 'phags pa thams cad dang mi mthun pas duḥkha ba dang*/ don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong pa dang*/ stong pa'i ngo bor gyur pa bdag med pa ste/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ rang nyid bdag ma yin pas zhi ba/ rnam grangs kyi rnam pa ste/ bzhi dag go /dang ni/ thams cad bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa kun 'byung ba'i bden pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa duḥkha'i rgyu'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid/ rnam grangs kyi rnam pa nad lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ duḥkha kun 'byung bas 'bras dang*/ duḥkha drag tu rab tu skye ba'i rkyen yin pas zug rngu dang*/ duḥkha brgyud nas skyed pa'i rkyen yin pas bde ba'i dge ba 'joms pa sdig pa'i rnam pa rnams so// gsum pa ni/ nyan rang mthong lam skyes (407) pa'i tshe sdug kun gyi mtshan nyid rtogs pas sdug kun la yid 'byung ba dang*/ sgom lam du sdug kun la 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang*/ mi slob lam du sdug kun 'gog pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin zhes/ lung las 'byung ba'i phyir duḥkha dang kun 'byung gi bden pa gnyis po de dag nyid/ so so ste/ re re la yid 'byung ba'i rnam pa de dag gi mtshan nyid de/ rang bde 'joms pa'i dgrar gyur pas pha rol dang*/ 'di la gnod byed yod na 'jig pa'i chos can gyi rnam pa'i ngo bo nyid dag yid 'byung ba'i dmigs par 'gyur ro// 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa dag gi ngo bo ste/ dmigs pa/ rang gi ngo bor mi gnas pas g.yo ba dang*/

rgyu la ltos med du 'jig pas rab tu 'jig pa'i rnam pa dag dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa'i rang gi ngo bo nyid dmigs pa 'di dang gzhan gyis gnod pa'i gnas su gyur pas 'jigs pa dang*/ srin po la sogs pas gnod pas nad 'go ba dang*/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa dang thog 'bab pa la sogs pa'i gnas su gyur pas tshe ba'i rnam pa rnams so// bzhi pa la/ 'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa la ma rig pa 'gog pa rang gi ngo bo/ rnam grangs kyi rnam pa bdag 'dzin gyi nyon mongs med pa dang*/ duḥkha zhi ba dang*/ bde zhing gtsang bas gya nom pa'i bdag nyid duḥkha dang mi gtsang bas dben pa dang*/ ji ltar nges par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid rnam thar gyi sgo ngo bos stong pa nyid dang*/ rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang*/ 'bras bu la smon pa med pa gsum dang*/ gang nges par 'byung ba slar 'khor bar mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam pa rnams so// lnga pa lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa myang 'das kyi grong khyer du phyin byed lam dang ma lus par rtogs pas rigs pa dang*/ rtogs par byed pas sgrub pa dang*/ mngon zhen

(408) med par 'gro ba nges par 'byin pa ste/ rnam pa zhes kun la sbyar ro// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ 'chad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang gi tshe na/ nyan thos kyi lam brjod nas de'i rjes su'o// gang na/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun no// 'chad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bden pa bzhi mngon sum du yongs su shes pa ni/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun rtogs shing thob pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas so// rtsa ba ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi sbyor lam la bzhi las/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga stong pa nyid la dmigs nas rnam pa don dam par rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir gzugs sogs dang byang sems kyi stong pa nyid rnams don la tha dad med cing blos kyang dbyer med par rtogs te sgom pas dro ba ste/ mdo ni/ ko'u shi ka gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo*// zhes so// gzugs sogs stong pa de dag cir yang mi dmigs par rtogs pas rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod do// mdo ni/ ko'u shi ka 'di la byang sems kyis dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs la gnas par mi bya'o// zhes so// gzugs sogs stong pa de la rtag pa dang*/ sogs pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams so// mdo ni/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs rtag ces bya bar gnas par mi bya'o// zhes so// byang sems kyis sa bcu la sogs pa dag la brtsams nas ni dmigs pa'i tshul gyis mi gnas par rgyas par bstan pa yis chos mchog tu 'gyur bar mdo las bshad do// de dag la dmigs pas gnas par mi bya ba ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis yod med ma lus pa mkhyen nas chos rnams don dam par cir yang ma gzigs pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sa dang po la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas par mi bya'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ gang gis dmigs pa'i rnam pa/ gang la dmigs pa'i yul/ blo'i ngo bo dang gsum mo// dang po la/

(409) drod kyi rnam pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po rang rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir gzugs dang tshor ba sogs kyi stong pa nyid rnams phan tshun te/ gzhan dang gzhan du tha dad pa med pa dang*/ rtse mo'i ni/ gzugs la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir gzugs sogs su mi dmigs pa dang*/ bzod pa'i ni/ mi dmigs pa de bzhin du gzugs la sogs pa la rtag pa yang ma yin/ mi rtag pa yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma yin/ duḥkha yang ma yin no// zhes dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas shing zhen pa bkag pa dang*/ chos mchog gi ni/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas don dam par chos rnams cir yang ma gzigs pa zhes bya ba/ ji skad du/ yod med dngos po mkhyen pa po// kun mkhyen pas kyang gang ma gzigs// zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis mkhyen brtse tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bus chos thams cad ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'thad pa ste/ lung gi tshad mas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang sogs pa gnyis pa dri ma med pa la sogs pa la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis mi gnas par rgyas par mdo las ji skad bstan pa bzhin sgom pa zhes bya ba'i rnam pa bzhi po de rnams kyis so// gnyis pa ni/ bden pa bzhi'i dmigs pa la'o// gsum pa ni/ go rim bzhin du nges 'byed cha mthun drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi skye'o zhes bya ba yin no// gnyis pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ skyes bu rigs ldan gang zhig rang bzhin gyis dbang po 'bring du gyur pa/ rang rgyal gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la brten nas rang byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye ba shul du gyur pa/ rang rgyal lam gyi mtshan nyid do// mtshon bya ni/ smon lam la sogs pa'i rkyen (410) gyi mthus rtogs pas rkyen rtogs/ bdag nyid gcig bu'i don du 'gyur bar byas nas rang nyid sangs rgyas pas rang sangs rgyas so// mtshan gzhi la/

lam gyi dbye ba nyan thos dang mthun no// gang zag gi dbye ba la/ bse ru lta bu/ tshogs dang spyod pa chen po dang*/ chung ngu dang gsum mo// dang po la/ sgrub pa po gang zag sgrub pa lam/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu'i khyad par gsum mo// dang po la/ nyan thos pas dbang po rno la/ byang sems pas rtul ba rang bzhin gyis dbang po 'bring ste/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can/ de'i nang nas dbang rnon skyo shas che zhing*/ snying rje shas chung ba/ bse ru ltar gcig bur gnas pa la dga' ba'o// gnyis pa la/ tshogs gsog pa'i khyad par/ lam bgrod pa'i khyad par gnyis so// dang po la/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus// zhes pas/ bskal pa brgya'i bar du nges 'byung gi tshul khrims dang*/ nyan thos kyi sde snod la thos bsam byas pas thar pa cha mthun rdzogs pa na/ da dung skye ba len par shes nas der rang byung thob par bya ba'i phyir sde snod gsum gyi don phung po/ khams/ skye mched/ bden pa/ rten 'brel/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa ste/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par sbyangs te/ 'chi 'pho khar/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing stong par skye bar gyur cig der yang gzhan la ltos pa med par rang gis thob pa'i shes rab kyis lam bgrod par gyur cig byang chub thob pa na gdul bya la lus kyis snying brtse bar byed kyi/ ngag gis snying brtse bar byed par ma gyur cig ces bya ba'i smon lam gyis tshogs gsog go /gnyis pa ni/ de nas shi 'phos te sangs rgyas nyan thos med pa'i zhing stong par gling gsum gyi skyes pa/ dmangs rigs min pa zhig tu skyes te/ khyim nas khyim med par rang byung gis rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas dur khrod du phyin te/ rus pa 'di ci las (411) byung bsam pas/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu rtogs pa'i don/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas bsgoms pas sbyor lam/

mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam rnams tshe gcig la mngon du byed do// de yang mthong spang nyon sgrib dang*/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ngo*// sgom spang khams gsum gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog khams gong gi nyon sgrib dgur dril te spang ngo*// 'dod khams kyi nyon mongs ni/ lo ka pa'i sgom lam gyis mthong lam gyi sngar spangs zin te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir ro// des na lo ka las 'das pa'i sgom lam gyis spang mi dgos so// dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston dang bse ru byang chub par// bsam gtan mtha' brten gcig la kun// de yi sngon du thar cha mthun// zhes so// rtsa sher/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mi bzhugs shing*// nyan thos rnams kyang zad gyur par// rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// rten pa med par rab tu skye// zhes so// gsum pa la/ rang don gnas pa dang*/ gzhan don rgyu ba'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ sku bse ru ltar gcig pur 'dug pa/ gsung smra bcad dam po/ thugs bden bzhi/ rten 'brel/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can yin pas kham gyi zas kyis 'tsho dgos pas grong du bsod snyoms la gcig pur rgyu zhing*/ log par sgrub pa rnams rdzu 'phrul bstan nas 'gyod pa skyed cing sdig pa dag par byed la/ gdul bya chos don du gnyer ba byung na sgra med lus kyis chos ston par byed do// gnyis pa la gsum sngar bzhin las/ dang po ni/ rigs de nyid kyi dbang po 'bring po/ zla bcas la dgyes pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis kyi tshogs ni/ bskal pa brgya'i sum gnyis (412) tsam du tshogs bsags pas bzod pa 'bring man chad bskyed nas mkhas par byed cing smon lam 'debs so// gnyis pa ni/ ma nyams na bzod chen nas bskyed pas chog la/ nyams na drod nas bskyed dgos so// gsum pa la/ gnas pa dang*/ rgyu ba gnyis ka zla bcas yin la/

gzhan thams cad sngar bzhin no// gsum pa la gsum las/ gang zag dbang po 'bring po'i rtul po/ tshogs bskal pa brgya'i sum cha tsam du bsags pas mthong lam gyi bar thob nas mkhas pa dang smon lam sbyangs te lam lhag ma bgrod cing*/ gzhan thams cad tshogs spyod chen po pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ nyan thos las khyad zhugs par bstan pa/ khyad par can rang rgyal gyi lam rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun no// dang po la ye shes zab par bstan pa dang*/ zab mo la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ 'chad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ nyan thos las rang rgyal khyad zhugs pa nyid du sgrub pa'o// gang gi tshe na/ re zhig nyan thos kyi lam gyi mjug thogs su'o// de'i rgyu mtshan/ bskyed rim bzhin byas na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi ngo bo brjod par rigs mod kyi/ nyan thos rnams las rang sangs rgyas de dag ji ltar lam bgrod pa dang chos ston pa na khyad par du 'phags na/ khyad par gang gis na/ rang sangs rgyas de dag gi lam nyan thos las gzhan yin snyam pa'i dogs pa bsus nas de'i lan gdab par bya ba'i phyir du'o// rtsa ba la/ bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni chos can/ lam bgrod pa'i tshe nyan thos pas zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod do// srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyis bstan mi dgos par 'dod khams su byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ rang byung sangs rgyas bdag nyid kyi smon lam la sogs pa'i mthus byang chub rtogs pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ chos thams cad kyang sprul (413) pa lta bu yin te/ de la sus kyang bstan pa med do// zhes so// yang gi sgras rang rgyal chos can/ chos ston pa nyan thos pas zab ste/ sgra med par chos ston nus pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ 'phags pa rab 'byor 'di ni/ yum gsal bar byed pa ste/ zab pa bas kyang shin tu zab pa ston par byed/ phra ba bas kyang shin tu phra ba ston par byed pa'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la/

gang las khyad zhugs pa/ nyan thos kyi lam de las khyad par du byed pa'i byed chos gnyis so// dang po la/ 'byung zhes drang ngo*// gang las na/ nyan thos kyi lung las so// gang na/ nyan thos rnams kyi lam bgrod pa dang*/ chos ston tshul ni'o// ji ltar na/ 'dod khams su srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe'ang slob dpon gzhan gyi bstan pa la ltos nas nyan thos rang gi byang chub rtogs par 'gyur la/ gdul bya gzhan dag kyang ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i chos bstan pas dge ba bcu la 'jug par byed do// zhes so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam bgrod pa dang*/ chos ston pa'i tshe khyad zhugs par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bstan mi dgos so// zhes drang ngo*// gang la na/ rang rgyal de dag la'o// gang gis na/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa nyan thos la sogs pas so// de'i rgyu mtshan/ ma bstan yang lam bgrod pa de'i phyir/ de ston pa ni/ mngon par rtogs par 'gyur te zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rang rgyal rang gi byang chub bo// gang gis na/ rang rgyal bdag nyid kyis so// rgyu gang las na/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni sngon thos pa dang*/ sogs pa smon lam la sogs pa mngon par 'dus byas pa'i rgyu las so// ji ltar na/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyis bstan pa la mi ltos par rtogs so// zhes bya ba ni/ khyad zhugs pa gcig yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal de dag gi ye shes chos can/ ngag 'bras bu'i rtags kyi rjes dpag gis mi rtogs pa nyid do// sgra med (414) lus kyis chos ston pa de'i phyir ro// de ni nyan thos las khyad zhugs pa gnyis pa yin no// rtags grub ste/ rang rgyal de dag ni/ gzung rtog spangs pas/ rang gis thob pa'i ye shes dang*/ sogs pa smon lam la sogs pa'i mthus sgra med par lus kyis chos bstan pas gdul bya gzhan dge ba bcu dang*/ sogs pa phyin drug la sogs pa la 'jug par byed pas so// khyab pa 'dod de/

'chad pa pos sgrar brjod pa'i chos bstan pa'i sgo nas nyan pa po rnams kyis 'chad pa po'i shes pa'i rtsal te/ blo nus khong du chud cing rtogs par byed pa yin na/ 'dir sgra med pas de la brten nas rtogs pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ yang rang rgyal chos can/ ji ltar chos ston te/ ston pa med par thal/ sgra med pa'i phyir ro// snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu bar ro// rtsa ba la/ snang zhes drang ngo*// gang la na/ bden bzhi la dmigs nas rnam par mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dge sdig la dmigs nas rnam pa blang dor/ rten 'brel la dmigs nas rnam pa lugs 'byung lugs ldog rtogs par don gnyer gyi slob ma gsum po gang dang gang*/ dmigs yul gyi don ni gsum po gang dang gang la/ rnam pa gsum po ji ltar ji ltar nyan cing rtogs par 'dod pa'i slob ma gsum po de dang de la'o// gang na/ dmigs yul gsum po'i don de dang de'o// ji ltar na/ ngag gi sgra med kyang lus la brtan nas ji ltar rtogs par 'dod pa de dang de ltar ro// 'grel pa la/ sgra med par chos ston tshul/ chos ston pa'i sgra don bstan pa gnyis so// dang po la/ snang bar 'gyur zhes drang ngo*// gang la na slob ma gang zhig dmigs yul gyi don gang la rnam pa ji ltar nyan cing rtogs par 'dod pa'i gang zag de'i rnam par shes pa la'o// gang na/ don de'i rnam pa'o// ji ltar na/ don du mi 'gyur ba'i tshig spangs pas rags pa la rnam par ma brtags/ phra ba la rnam par ma dpyad par tshig tu mi smra ba'i phyir dang*/ rtog dpyod byas (415) te brjod pa'am yid kyi brjod pa rtog dpyod ni/ rnam g.yeng yin la/ de yang rgyud 'khrug par byed pa yin pas ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs yin pas spang ba'i phyir ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med kyang*/ dper na/ byang sems kyis 'di ltar bdag sangs rgyas su gyur nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar brjod pa med par sems can gyi don byed cing chos ston par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas sangs rgyas pa na/

brjod pa med par chos ston pa de bas na/ sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i phyir rang sangs rgyas nyid kyi gnas skabs na'ang ston kyi smon lam dang*/ sogs pa ye shes la sogs pa'i mthus ngag gi sgra med kyang rtogs par 'dod pa'i rnam pa de kho na ltar ro// de bas na/ sgra med par chos ston pa zhes bya ste'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos ston pa'i sgra'i don 'di ltar/ brjod par bya ba'i chos yul nyan pa po'i rnam par shes pa la nges par rtogs par 'gyur bar shin tu skrun cing skyed pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ de 'di la'ang yod do// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sngar bstan pa de ltar rang rgyal gyi lam nyan thos las khyad zhugs pa brjod nas khyad zhugs pa rnams kyi lam ni/ nyan thos las khyad par du 'phags pa'i byed chos kho na yin pas khyad gzhi rnal ma ste/ dkyus ma rang sangs rgyas kyi lam ston no// rtsa ba la/ bsdus par shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ bse ru lta bu'i lam mo// gang gis na/ gzung rtog spangs pa dang*/ 'dzin rtog ma spangs pa dang*/ rten gyi khyad par gyis so// dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi slob lam chos can/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden par rtog pa spang ste/ spong ba'i gnyen po gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro// 'dis rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa nyan thos las khyad par du byas so// mdo ni/ gzugs ni/ zab pa ma yin/ phra ba ma yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal gyi lam chos can/ des 'dzin pa bden par rtog pa mi spong ste/ 'dzin pa rang

(416) bzhin med par ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro// 'dis rang rgyal gyi lam theg chen las dman khyad dam/ de las theg chen gyi rtogs pa khyad par du byas so// mdo ni/ lha'i bu dag gzugs kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o// zhes so// gal te 'dzin rtog spangs par thal/ gzung rtog spangs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ gzung ba med na des 'dzin med// ces pas so// zhe na/ ma nges te/ gzung ba med pa la der 'dzin med pas khyab cing*/ gzung med rtogs pa la 'dzin med rtogs pas ma khyab pas so// 'dzin pa bden smra'i rang rgyal dang*// gzung 'dzin gnyis med don dam du// smra ba'i rnam rig grub pa'i mtha'// mtshungs par shes pa'i mkhas pa mtshar// bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do// gsum pa ni/ lam pa gang zag dang*/ chos nyid rigs kyi rten gnyis las// dang po ni/ phyir mi ldog pa sbyor lam pa dang*// shes rab 'bring dang ldan pas bden pa mthong ba dang*/ mthong spang spangs pas mchod 'os mthong lam dang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa tshogs lam pa ste/ snga ma gsum rim pa bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i rigs/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i rigs/ rang byang chub tu nges pa'i rigs kyi gang zag gi rten gyis so// mdo ni/ yum 'di chen por byed pa su dga' 'byung bar 'gyur zhes dris pas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems chen po rnams sam/ bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag gam/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa'i dbang du byas pa'am/ sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag gam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dag len par 'gyur te zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i me tog rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu yul dus rang bzhin so sor snang ba bzhin du dngos por gyur pa'i rten med kyang rtogs pa so sor nges pa thob pa'i rten gyis khyad par du 'phags so// mdo ni/

lha (417) rnams kyis mngon par gtor ba'i me tog 'di dag ni/ bdag gis sngon chad lha'i gnas thams cad na'ang yod par ma mthong ste/ me tog 'di dag ni/ sprul pa'o// zhes so// ji ltar na/ yang dag par ro// 'dis kyang dngos su yul rang rgyal gyi lam bstan nas shugs la de mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i lam shes mtshon no// 'grel pa la/ lam dang*/ lam shes gnyis so// lam ni/ khyad par du 'phags zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam/ gang las na/ nyan thos dang theg chen las so// gang gis na/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa bcu drug sgom pa kho na dang*/ gzugs sogs kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs skye ba med pa sogs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pas rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog sgom pas go rim bzhin du gzung ba'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa spangs pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i don gyi rnam rtog ma spangs pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas bsdus pa'i chos sgrub pa'am rtogs pa'i gzhi ste/ rten byed pa'i rigs kyi khyad par dang gsum gyis so// gnyis pa ni/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa'i chos rang rgyal gyi lam mo// gang gi na/ byang sems kyi'o// ji ltar na/ de dag mi dmigs pa rtogs shing khong du chud par bya ba'i lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam pa thams cad shes shing mngon du bya ba ni ma yin no// zhes bya ba ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang*/ lam shes so// gsum pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi rtogs pa thob na/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i lam skye bas lam de'i sngon du 'gro ba nges 'byed cha mthun ston no// rtsa ba la/ chos thams cad btags pa tsam la dmigs nas rnam pa don dam par na gzugs sogs su btags pas stong pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar ston pa'i rnam pa dro bar gyur pa (418) ste/ mdo ni/ btags pa dang yang mi 'gal la/

chos nyid kyang ston no// zhes so// kun rdzob tu dmigs pa gzugs la sogs pa la rnam pa don dam par skyon 'grib pa dang*/ sogs pa yon tan 'phel ba la sogs pa med par brtags te slob pas rtse mor gyur par phye'o// mdo ni/ gzugs 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir mi slob/ yongs su 'grib par bya ba'i phyir mi slob/ ces so// dmigs pa gzugs nas sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar la rnam pa nang stong pa nyid dang*/ sogs pa phyi stong pa la sogs pa'i phyir cir yang gzung du med pa la blos kyang cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i phyir bzod pa'o// mdo ni/ gzugs yongs su gzung du med do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi phyir zhes so// dmigs pa gzugs sogs la/ rnam pa don dam par skye ba med pa dang*/ sogs pa 'gag pa med pa can chos mchog go /mdo ni/ gzugs kyi skye ba mi mthong*/ 'gag pa dang blang ba zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ rnam pa/ dmigs pa/ blo'i ngo bo gsum las/ dang po la/ drod kyi ni/ gzugs la sogs par brda sbyar ba las byung ba'i chos/ btags pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar rab tu ston pa dang*/ rtse mo'i ni/ gzugs la sogs pa la don dam par 'grib pa/ 'bri ba dang*/ 'phel ba gsog pa dang*/ sogs pa yongs su gzung bar bya ba dang med par bya ba med pa'i don du slob pa dang*/ bzod pa'i ni/ gzugs la sogs par/ dod nas ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid kyi phyir nang dang phyi dang*/ sogs pa gnyis ka la sogs pa/ stong pa nyid yin pa nyid kyis cir yang yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang*/ chos mchog gi ni/ gzugs la sogs pa gsar du skye ba dang*/ sngar yod 'gag pa dang*/ sogs pa blang dor kun byang sogs med par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rnam pa rnams kyis so// drod sogs bzhi/ go rim bzhin du dmigs sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ bden pa bzhi'i dmigs pa sgyu ma lta bu la'o// gsum pa ni/

nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi rim pa bzhin du skye (419) ba yin no// gsum pa la/ mtshams sbyar dang*/ lam bshad pa gnyis so// mtshams sbyar ni/ skabs rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi mjug thogs su/ ngo bo byang sems kyi mthong sgom gyi lam rnams gtan la phab ste 'chad do// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mthong lam shes pa phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ sgom lam shes pa byed pa dang bcas pa'o// dang po la gnyis las/ mdor bstan la/ rtsa 'grel gnyis so// rtsa ba ni/ bshad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam 'di phyi gnyis kyi phan yon dang bcas pa 'di'o// skabs gang du na/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs su/ gang gis na/ sdug bden kun 'byung dang*/ 'gog pa lam bden la bzod pa dang shes pa'i skad cig rnam pa bzhi bzhi yis so// mdo ni/ yum ni/ rab 'byor gyi le'u las btsal bar bya'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ brjod do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byang sems kyis bsgom par bya ba dang*/ tshe 'dir phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ tshe gzhan la skye ba dran pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ mthong ba'i lam phan yon nam/ 'bras bu chen po dang bcas pa'o// gang du na/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs su'o// ji ltar na/ chos ni/ rnam pa mi rtag la sogs pa bcu drug gam/ so gnyis so// shes pa ni/ sbyor lam du chos de rnams la rnam par dpyod pa'i shes pa'o// bzod pa ni/ sngar rnam par dpyad pa'i dbang du byas nas so sor rang la bden pa mngon sum du gyur kyang mi skrag go /shes pa lhag ma rnams sbyor lam min no// chos shes pa dang*/ snga ma dang rjes su mthun par chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ rjes su shes pa zhes bya ba/ bzod pa dang*/ shes pa'i skad cig ma bzhi po so sor duḥkha dang*/ sogs pa kun 'byung la sogs pa'i bden pa dang 'brel pa dag dang ldan par ro// rgyas bshad la gsum las/ snga 'grel (420) ni/ skad cig bcu drug po rnam pa ji lta bur bsgom par bya zhe na/

rtsa ba ni/ duḥkha'i rnam pa bzhi ni/ don dam par de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag phan tshun gcig la gcig rten dang brten par med pa'i phyir phan tshun rnam grangs gzhan gyis gnas par khas mi len pa ste/ rjes su ma rtogs pa ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa mi dmigs so// de bzhin gshegs pa la'ang gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid mi dmigs so// zhes so// gzugs sogs don dam par skye 'jig gnas gsum gyis stong pas chen po ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs chen po nyid yin pa'i phyir byang sems kyi phar phyin chen po nyid de zhes so// 'jal byed kyi tshad mas dmigs su med pa dang bcas pa ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs la tshad ma med pa'i phyir byang sems kyi phar phyin 'di ni/ tshad ma med pa'o// zhes so// gzugs can gyi tshad rdul phra rab kyi mthar thug pa la brten pa'i dbyibs/ gzugs med kyi tshad mtshan nyid de dag med pa dang ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs tshad med pa'i phyir byang sems kyi phar phyin 'di ni tshad med pa'o zhes so// 'grel chen las/ gzugs can min pa la ni/ mtshan nyid tshad yin zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pas/ gzugs can ma yin pa rnams la tshad kyi mtshan nyid yod pa ma yin no// zhes pa 'gyur gyi khyad de/ don snga mar mngon no// de ltar bzhis chos thams cad la dmigs pa na/ go rim bzhin/ duḥkha la chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes bzhi skye'o// kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi ni/ rtag chad dam/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' med pa ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang sems kyi phar phyin 'di ni mtha' yas so// zhes so// mthong lam yul de la ma rtogs pa'i don rtogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'dzin pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum 'di dang ma bral bar gyur pa ni/ de bzhin (421) gshegs pa nyid du gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes so// chos thams cad la blang ba med/

dor ba med pa dang*/ sogs pa bar chad kyis glags mi rnyed pa'i tshul gyis yum 'dzin pa sogs byed pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum 'di ni gzugs mi len mi 'dor ba'i tshul dang*/ zhes so// byams pa dang*/ sogs pa snying rje la sogs pa rnal 'byor srung ba'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya ba ste/ mdo ni/ de ma dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi drung du byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// rnam pa de bzhis chos thams cad la dmigs pa na/ go rim bzhin du kun 'byung la chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes bzhi skye'o// 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bzhi ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid do// mdo ni/ nang stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// chos dbyings su bsngo ba'i dge ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa yin no// zhes pa ste/ mdo ni/ bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi skur mngon par sprul cing zhes so// yum gyis gnyen po rnam byang kun ma lus par yongs su bsdus pa'o// mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di yongs su bzung na/ phyin drug po thams cad yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// mthong lam yum nyid kyis phyi'i 'tshe ba me sogs kyis nyam nga ba dang*/ nang gi 'tshe ba nad dang gdon la sogs pa kun sel ba ste/ mdo ni/ yum 'di nyan pas rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis nges par byung nas duḥkha mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de ltar bzhis chos thams cad la dmigs pas 'gog pa la chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes bzhi rim pa bzhin skye'o// lam gyi rnam pa bzhi ni/ yum bsgoms pas dug gsum nas mya ngan las (422) 'das par 'dzin pa'i bar gyi mngon zhen zhi ba nyid do// mdo ni/ mya ngan las 'das par 'dzin pa nye bar zhi bar byed de/ rnam par 'phel bar byed pa ma yin no// zhes so// yum 'dzin pa sogs la 'jug pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa rnams kyis lhas byas pa'i gnod pa las bsrung*/

sogs pa 'byung bas byas pa'i gnod pa las bskyab pa/ nang gi gnod pa las sba ba byed par 'gyur ba ste/ mdo ni/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag la rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba byed par 'gyur ro// zhes so// yum gyis yongs su bzung ba'i stobs kyis rang nyid srog mi gcod pa dang*/ sogs pa ma byin len spong ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni bdag nyid gnas te/ sems can gzhan dag de la 'god par bya ba ste/ mdo ni/ bdag kyang srog gcod pa spong bar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs so// sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba gzhan don du mi dmigs par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// zhes pa ste/ mdo ni/ sbyin pa yongs su btang ba gang yin pa de'ang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bla na med pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// de ltar bzhis chos thams cad la dmigs na/ go rim bzhin lam la chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes bzhi skye ste/ de dag ni/ lam shes nyid kyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug go /'grel pa la gnyis/ mthong lam rnam pa'i sgo nas bshad pa dang*/ rnam pa ma bshad par 'dod pa dgag pa'o// dang po la/ sdug kun 'gog lam gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ duḥkha la chos bzod kyi rnam pa ni/ yul de bzhin nyid dang*/ de rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun rdzob tu rten dang brten pa yin yang*/ don dam pa'i tshul nyid kyis de dag la de bzhin nyid rten dang*/ sangs rgyas brten pa'i dngos por med (423) pa de'i phyir de dag phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i rnam grangs gzhan gyis gnas par khas mi len cing ma rtogs pa'o// chos shes kyi ni/ gzugs la sogs pa sngon dang dbus dang phyi ma'i mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyis chen po nyid dang*/

rjes bzod kyi ni/ snga ma de bzhin du gzugs sogs de dag 'jal ba'i tshad ma med pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi ni/ snga ma chos shes kyi rnam par bstan pa bzhin du nam mkha'i tshad dmigs su med pa nyid kyis gzugs sogs de dag tshad med pa zhes bya ba de lta bu ni/ duḥkha'i bden pa'i rnam pa de ltar rtogs pa ye shes skad cig bzhi dag yin no// gnyis pa la/ kun 'byung la chos bzod kyi rnam pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa la mtha' dang dbus mi dmigs pa'i phyir sgyu ma ltar ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyis rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' nyid dang*/ sogs pa sngon dang phyi mtha' med pa dang*/ chos shes kyi ni/ kun 'byung la chos shes pa'i yum la gnas pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid du gcig par rtogs pa nyid kyis gzugs la sogs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin nyid du nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes bzod kyi ni/ de bzhin du ste/ de ltar chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa de la gnas pa ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad la blang dor med par sgom pa dang*/ sogs pa 'dzin 'chang klog sogs dang*/ rjes shes kyi ni/ chos thams cad snang yang ngo bo nyid med par lhag par mos pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dmigs med kyi tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa de ltar rtogs pa ye shes skad cig bzhi dag yin no// gsum pa la/ 'gog pa la chos bzod kyi rnam pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo gnyug ma ste/ gdod ma nas rang bzhin kho nas stong pa nyid dang*/ chos shes kyi ni/ chos kyi dbyings su bsngos pas de dang mnyam

(424) pa ste/ ro gcig tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa nyid thob pa dang*/ rjes bzod kyi ni/ mthong lam sher phyin du gnyen po rnam byang gi rigs rnams rnam pa thams cad du ma lus par bsdus pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi ni/ yum de nyid kyis phyi nang gi 'tshe ba ste/ gnod pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba de lta bu bzhi dag ni/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa de ltar rtogs pa ye shes skad cig bzhi dag yin no// bzhi pa la/ lam la chos bzod kyi rnam pa ni/ ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i yum bsgom pa kho nas gzugs la sogs pa dang*/ lhag bcas lhag med kyi mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon par zhen pa'i mthong spang zhi ba dang*/ chos shes kyi ni/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i chos shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ gzhan don gyi thabs mkhas pa la zhugs pa la lha dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis rang dang*/ sems can gzhan dang*/ sems can min pa'i rkyen las byung ba gsum mam/ mthong chos dang*/ skyes nas myong 'gyur dang*/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las las byung ba'i gnod pa gsum la rim pa bzhin du bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba dag mdzad pa dang*/ rjes bzod kyi ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas nyid thob par mngon par 'dod pas bdag nyid srog gcod pa spong ba dang*/ sogs pa mi tshangs spyod spong ba la sogs pa rnam mkhyen nyid kyi rgyu la gnas nas/ lam de nyid la gdul bya gzhan dag 'god pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba mi zad par byed 'dod pas gzhan du mi dmigs par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni/ lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa de ltar rtogs pa ye shes skad cig bzhi dag yin te/ rnam pa de lta bu ni/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyi byang sems kyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi rnam pa dag yin no// gnyis pa la/
