rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang zhes pa nas byang chub rin po che sbyin par byed pa'o// zhes so// sgrib gnyis spong ba'i rgyur rnam par dag pa sgom pa/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba'o// mdo ni/ yum ni/ chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phung po lags so// zhes so// rin po che la bar chad mang ba'i dpes dus tshigs bcad nas myur du sgrub pa/ sa mtshams dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba'o// mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di bri na yang myur du bri bar bya'o// zhes so// de ltar na/ sbyor ba de ni nyi shu'o// 'grel la pa/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga dang*/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga gnyis so// dang po la/ ming don grangs bzhin du sbyar te bshad na/ sbyar bya gzugs la sogs pa la ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyis de la mi gnas par sgom pa/ gzugs la sogs pa la mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gzugs sogs de dag la de kho nar mi sbyor ba nyid sbyor ba'am sgom pa yin pa'i phyir mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa de dag nyid don dam par gnas pa mi dmigs pa'i don gyis de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gzhi shes kyi skabs su zab bo// zhes de ltar rtogs pa/ zab pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rnyog pa med pa'i don gyis lam shes kyi skabs su gzugs sogs gting dpag dka' sbyor dang*/ gzugs sogs kyi mtha' mi dmigs pa'i don gyis rnam mkhyen gyi skabs su tshad med pa zhes bya ba de ltar rtogs pa/ tshad med pa'i sbyor ba ste/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga ni/ tshogs lam (521) nas yod cing*/ ngo bo gcig pa dang tha dad ci rigs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ don ming go rim bzhin du sbyar la/ sogs kyi sgra dang*/ sgrub pa dang ldan pa zhes pa/ gong ma thams cad la sbyar te bshad pa ni/ yum zab gting dpag dka' tshad med pa la dngangs pa dang*/ skrag pa dang*/ kun tu skrag pas zin par 'gyur srid pa'i sgrub ldan ni/

tshegs chen pos yun ring mo zhig nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i sbyor ba ste/ 'di tshogs lam nas yod de/ 'phags pas las dang po par bshad pas so// yum la mi dngangs/ mi skrag cing*/ thos nas kyang gong nas gong du 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i sgrub pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gam/ gnyis mi 'da' bar lung bstan pa thob pas lung bstan pa'i sbyor ba'o// 'di drod nas yod de/ 'di chos nyid la mi skrag par bshad la/ de drod nas yod par/ zab mo'i don la som nyi med// ces so// yum thos nas yang dag par 'dzin pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ yum las phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba ste/ 'di rtse mo na yod de/ chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*// zhes so// thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad kyi chos 'khor ba dang nyan rang gi yid la byed pa spong ba'i sgrub ldan ni/ bdag las nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba'o// 'di bzod pa nas yod de/ lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la// bdud ces nges par rtogs pa dang*// zhes so// ri shing gi mtshan ma med pa na/ rgya mtshor nye ba bzhin du rtag tu rgyun mi chad par chos sgom pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba ste/ 'di chos mchog na yod do// de tshe bar chad med pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la myur du reg /ces so// zag pa med pa'i chos lo ka las 'das pa'i ye shes gsar pa skye ba'i rten nam/ gzhir (522) gyur pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la nye ba'i sbyor ba'o// 'di mthong lam nas yod de/ lo ma gsar pa skyes pas dga' ba bzhin du byang chub la nye bar shes pas dga' ba skye ba'i phyir ro// slob lam gyi 'bras bu chos sku dang*/ longs sku sogs mngon par 'grub pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba'o// 'di sa bdun pa nas yod de/

sbrum ma bzhin du myur du sku 'byin pa'am lung ston pas so// skye bo la dus gsum du phan 'dogs shing gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing gzhan yang bskul ba'i sgrub ldan ni/ gzhan gyi don gyi sbyor ba'o// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar 'phel pa gsog pa dang*/ 'grib pa 'bri bar mi dmigs shing mi mthong ba'i sgrub ldan ni/ 'phel ba dang 'grib pa med pa'i sbyor ba'o// chos dang chos min/ dus gsum/ dge mi dge 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ 'dod pa'i/ khams sogs khams gsum/ phar phyin nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar du mi dmigs pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ chos dang*/ chos ma yin pa dang*/ sogs pa 'das pa sogs mi dmigs pa'i sbyor ba'o// gzugs la sogs pa rtog ge'i blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par rlom pa'am/ 'du shes pa med pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ gzugs la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa 'gog pa'i sbyor ba'o// mtshan gzhi gzugs dang*/ de'i mtshan ma ste/ mtshan nyid dang*/ gzugs de'i ngo bo mtshon bya nyid du rnam par mi rtog cing*/ rnam mkhyen gyi bar du mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum du mi rtog pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos por rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba ste/ 'di lnga ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa sa brgyad pa nas yod do// sbyor ba ngo bo gcig nyid/ gzhan don byed pa/ 'phel 'grib med par rtogs pa/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa/ (523) chos nyid du mi rlom pa/ chos can du mi rtog pa'i cha nas lngar phye la/ de dag sa brgyad pa nas yod de/ rnam kun don yod shes par bya// zhes pa dang*/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i don dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba'i rten yin pa'i phyir ro// 'bras bu dang po mthong ba'i sa dang*/ gnyis pa bsrabs pa'i sa la sogs pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ 'bras bu rin po che rgyun zhugs sogs sbyin pa'i sbyor ba'o// 'di sa dgu pa nas yod gsung yang*/

de'i gong du'ang yod par mngon no// gzugs nas gzhi shes kyi bar du rnam par dag pa'i sgrub ldan ni/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba ste/ rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do// yum bri ba sogs lo skor du mngon par brtson pa mi 'dor ba dang*/ sogs pa zla ba dang*/ zhag la sogs par bcad nas/ brtson pa mi 'dor ba'i sgrub pa dang ldan pa ni/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba ste/ lo skor smos pa ni/ de tsam gyis dus tshigs la sogs pa'i rkyen tshogs pa'i phyir ro// 'di sa bdun pa man chad na yod do// sa mtshams 'di dag bud+dha shrīs bshad pa bzhin yin no// lo ts+tsha ba dang po brgyad tshogs lam du thob par bzhed pa ni/ mdzes par ma mthong ngo*// de ltar na/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba rnam pa bco lnga ste/ bsdoms na sbyor ba nyi shu yin no// shān+ti pa nyer gsum du bzhed do// bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ yon tan shes pas len pa dang*/ skyon shes nas 'dor ba dang*/ mtshan nyid shes pa dang*/ thar pa'i cha mthun shes pa sngon du 'gro ba'o// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sbyor ba'i 'bras bu yon tan mthong ba sngon du btang nas 'bras bu don gnyer gyi rtog ldan/ rgyu sbyor ba rnams la shin tu goms par byed pas/ sbyor ba bshad zin pa'i 'og tu sbyor ba de dag gi yon tan 'chad do// rtsa ba ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang*/ sogs pa nges par

(524) thob pa'i bar sbyor ba'i yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o// 'di dag cung zad tsam tshogs lam du'ang ldan mod kyi/ khyad par can drod yan chad du ldan no// gzhon nu dpal na re/ sbyor lam bzhi dang sa bcu la rim pa bzhin yod lo// 'grel pa la/ 'og ma rgyur gyur pa'i yon tan bcu bzhi dang*/ gong ma 'bras bur gyur pa'i yon tan bcu bzhi grangs bzhin du sbyar te bshad pa ni/ sbyor ba sgom pa'i gnas skabs su zhes pa kun gyi gong du/ sbyor ba'i yon tan zhes pa mjug tu sbyar te/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pas bdud kyi mthu nyams te sbyor ba ma nyams pa bdud kyis mthu bcom pa'i 'o// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi mthus bdud sdig to can gyis bar chad bya bar mi nus so// zhes so// sangs rgyas kyis dgongs pas mos pa brtan pa skyes nas bdud 'jug pa'i skabs med pa ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum du sangs rgyas kyis dgongs shing mkhyen pa'o// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyis gzung bar rig par bya'o// zhes so// sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te/ spyan lngas gzigs pa la brten nas sbyor ba ma nyams tsam las lhag pa nyan pa sogs dgos pa khyad par can gzhan thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyis mngon sum du mdzad pa'o// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis ye shes kyis mkhyen to// zhes so// de bzhin nyid kyi don la rtogs pa brtan pas byang chub la nye bar gyur pas 'bras bu byang chub skyed pa'i nus pa khyad par can skyes pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la nye bar gyur pa'o// mdo ni/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur to// zhes so// de lta bu'i nus pa ma thob kyang bri ba sogs kyi phan yon chen po thob pas sangs rgyas dang mi 'bral bas don chen po nyid dang*/ sogs pa bde 'gror 'gro bas phan yon che ba/ sangs rgyas 'bras bu che ba/ mya ngan las 'das nas kyang gzhan

(525) don la 'jug pas rnam par smin pa che ba'o// mdo ni/ don che ba dang*/ phan yon che ba dang*/ 'bras bu che ba dang*/ rnam par smin pa che bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// bstan pa'i bya ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa byed pa'i stobs kyis bstan pa gang du dar ba'i yul dang*/ der yum la spyod pa rnams bde 'gror skye zhing myang 'das thob pa'i rgyu dpyad pa'o// mdo ni/ yum 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du dar bar 'gyur te/ zhes so// mi dngangs pa la sogs pas phyin drug la sogs pa gnyen po dkar po'i chos yongs su rdzogs pas/ mthong lam sogs zag pa med pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'o// mdo ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs kyis rnam mkhyen nyid kyi gtam brjod pa'am rnyed pas/ tshe rabs thams cad du bdag nyid chos smra ba'i skyes bu nyid du 'gyur ba'o// mdo ni/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub las brtsams te de lta bu nyid brjod par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pas grogs dang mgon skyabs mdzad pa thob pas bdud dam/ gzhan gyis yum las mi phyed pa'o// mdo ni/ byang chub las ldog par mi nus so// zhes so// theg chen la dmigs te lo ka las 'das pa'i chos tshol ba'i dga' ba/ dkon mchog gsum la brten pa'i dang ba/ dge ba la sems 'jug pa'i mgu ba rgya chen po bskyed pa thob pas/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa skye bo mang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba skye ba'o// mdo ni/ dge ba'i chos la skye bo mang po 'god par byed do// zhes so// byang sems de'i dam bcas pa'i tshig la bsam pa dag par mkhyen nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gis rjes su yi rang ba mdzad pa thob pas byang sems (526) kyis dam bcas pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa'o// mdo ni/

de dag la ngas rjes su yi rang bar mdzad do// zhes so// theg chen gyi chos zab mo dang*/ rgya chen po la mngon par 'dod cing lhag par mos pas/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sogs 'bras bu rgya chen po yongs su 'dzin pa'o// mdo ni/ rnam par smin pa rlabs po che yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro// zhes so// phyi nang gi 'bras bu dang bcas pa ster zhing lhag par bsten pas/ sems can gyi don byed pas gong nas gong du sems can gyi don sgrub pa'o// mdo ni/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par 'god par 'gyur ro// zhes so// yum tshig don tshang zhing rdzogs par rnyed pas tshe rabs gzhan du'ang phyin drug tshang bar nges par 'thob pa'o// mdo ni/ skye ba brjes nas kyang phar phyin drug po 'di dag rnyed par 'gyur ro// zhes so// bcu bzhi po de dag phyin ci ma log pa'i spyod pa nyi shu la mngon par dga' ba'i gang zag la 'bras bu'i yon tan bcu bzhi 'byung zhing*/ rgyu'i yon tan bcu bzhi 'thob pas rjes su mthun par bslab par bya bas yon tan grangs bcu bzhi yin no// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ yon tan bshad zin pa de'i 'og tu skyon gang zhig yongs su spangs nas sbyor ba rnams bsgom par bya dgos pa la skyon shes dgos pas sbyor ba'i bar chad byed pa'i skyon gang dag cig yin zhe na/ sbyor ba de dag gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i skyon 'chad do// rtsa ba ni/ sbyor ba'i skyon bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa'i drug ste/ zhe drug tu nges par rtogs par bya'o// 'di dag tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar na yod cing*/ gtso cher tshogs sbyor na yod do// gzhon nu dpal ni/ bcu tshan bzhi tshogs lam drod rtse bzod pa na/ drug chos mchog na yod lo// 'grel pa la/ bsal bya skyon gyi dbye ba/ de sel byed gnyen po'o// dang po la/

'gal rkyen nye bar gnas pa (527) nyer gsum/ mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum mo// dang po la/ rang la brten pa spobs pa gnyis/ gnas ngan len gsum/ theg chen spong ba'i rgyu bdun/ rnam g.yeng brgyad do// gzhan la brten pa tha ma gsum mo// gnyis pa la/ dpon slob gang rung la brten pa bcu bzhi/ rang la brten pa gnyis/ gnyis ka la brten pa bdun no// sbyor ba'i dus su zhes/ thams cad kyi gong du sbyar te bshad pa la/ dus yun ring mo nas yum la shes pa skye ba phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyud la tshegs chen pos spobs pa thob pa dang*/ de kho na ma rtogs par log pa'i spobs pa ha cang myur bar skyes pa ni/ yum las nyams pa'i rgyu ste/ sngon dang phyi mtha' ma brtags pas mi brtan pas so// sdud par/ 'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang*// yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las// zhes so// glal ba/ rgod pa/ steg cing 'dre ba lus kyi gnas ngan len dang*/ sems g.yeng ba/ chags pa/ dran pa ma thob pa'am/ 'di'i ro mi myong ngo*// snyam pa sems kyi gnas ngan len dang*/ rigs pa ma yin pa lus kyi gsum gyis bskyed pa'i kha ton byed pa la sogs dang*/ sogs pa sems kyi gsum gyis 'dzin pa sogs dang*/ bdag lung ma bstan pa yum las phyir phyogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag tu 'dzin pa ste/ sdud par/ 'di bshad tshe na kha cig som nyi za 'gyur te// 'dren pas 'dir ni bdag gi ming yang yongs ma brjod// rigs dang sa dang rus kyang yongs su ma brjod ces// 'di ni nyan par mi 'gyur spong 'gyur bdud kyi las// zhes so// chos thams cad rtogs shing yon tan thams cad thob pa'i rgyu yum bor nas nyan rang gi sde snod las de tshol na/ rgyu la mngon par zhen pas nyams pa ste/ rtsa ba bor nas yal ga tshol ba bzhin no// (528) 'bras bu mchog gam/ gya nom pa bde ba'i phar phyin gyi ro mi myong bar rang don thob pas tshim pa yum gyi ro myang ba las nyams pa ste/

jo bo'i zan bor nas las mi la zan tshol ba'i khyi bzhin no// rnam pa thams cad du theg pa'i mchog 'bras bu'i theg chen kun tu 'dzin pa'i rgyu yum rnyed pa bor nas nyan rang gi sde snod las thob par 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi lam mchog las nyams pa ste/ sdud par/ glang po rnyed nas glang po'i rjes ni tshol ba ltar// shes rab pha rol phyin thos mdo tshol de bzhin no// zhes so// rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yum rnyed pa bor nas bkar 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyan rang gi sde snod las de tshol na/ rtag tu rnam mkhyen gyi ched du bya ba las nyams pa ste/ rmig rjes kyi chu la nor bu tshol ba bzhin no// bcu tshan dang po'o// rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yum la rgyur ma shes shing*/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las kyang snying rje sogs bstan pas de rnam mkhyen gyi rgyur 'dzin pa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu 'bral pa nyams pa ste/ nyi zla'i tshad kyis rnam rgyal khang bzang byed pa'i phywa mkhan bzhin no// gong na med pa chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'i rgyu yum bor nas snying rje sogs bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyan thos kyi sde snod las thob par 'dod na/ sku gsum gyi rgyu las nyams pa ste/ rim pa ltar/ mkhar gyi rgyal phran dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bskrun pa dang*/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zas rnyed nas zhag drug cu pa'i 'bras chan tshol ba dang*/ nor bu 'ching bu dang baiḍūr+ya mnyam par sems pa bzhin no// gzugs sgra la sogs yul rnam pa mang po la rnam rtog gi spobs pa 'byung zhing 'phro ba dang*/ lam 'bras la rnam g.yeng yi ger 'bri bzhin pa la sher phyin du mngon par zhen pa dang*/ gsum ga'i rnam g.yeng dngos po med pa la yum du mngon par zhen pa dang*/ lam 'bras la rnam g.yeng yi ge nyid la yum du mngon par zhen pa dang*/ gzhung la (529) rnam g.yeng yi ge med pa la yum du mngon par zhen pa dang*/ chags sdang gi mtshan ma yul dang*/

sogs pa grong nas la gcan la sogs pa yid la byed pa dang*/ rin po che sogs rnyed pa dang*/ dpal gyi dar dpyangs 'ching ba sogs bkur sti dang*/ snyan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i ro myang zhing brkam pa dang*/ yum dor nas bdud kyis gtad pa'i mdo sde las thabs mkhas tshol na/ thabs mkhas kyi lam ma yin pas thabs la mkhas pa tshol ba zhes pa ni/ bcu tshan gnyis pa'o// 'jug pa'i bar chad rnams bshad nas/ la sogs pa'i dang por dpon slob tshogs pa dang bral ba'i bar chad ni/ grangs bzhin du nyan pa po snga ma 'chad pa po phyi ma dang mngon par 'brel na nyes pa che bas de ltar sbyar ro// gang yang rung bas de las ldog na'ang nyes par bstan no// nyan po 'dun pa che la/ 'chad po snyoms las sam/ le lo che bas tshogs pa las nyams pa dang*/ gcig yul 'dir nyan 'dod la gcig gzhan du 'chad 'dod na/ 'dun pa'i yul tha dad pas tshogs pa las nyams pa dang*/ nyan po 'dod chen chung zhing chog shes la/ 'chad po rnyed pa sogs gtsor byed pas 'dod chen chung ba ma yin pa nyid kyis tshogs pa las nyams pa dang*/ nyan pa po sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa dang*/ 'chad po de dang mi ldan pa dag dang*/ nyan po dad pa sogs dge ba'i chos can dang*/ 'chad pa srog gcod sogs dge ba ma yin pa'i chos nyid can dang*/ nyan po yo byad gzhan la gtong ba dang*/ 'chad po ser sna byed pa dang*/ nyan po zang zing sbyin 'dod pa dang*/ 'chad po de mi len pa dang*/ nyan po chos kyi mgo smos pas thams cad go la/ 'chad po rnam par spros pas go ba dang*/ nyan pos mdo'i sde dang*/ sogs pa dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa (530) sogs te/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de bzhin byung skyes rabs// rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la phab// ces bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad de/ de lta bu'i gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis mngon par shes pa dang*/

'chad pos de dag mngon par mi shes pa nyid dang*/ nyan po sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin drug dang ldan pa dang*/ 'chad po de dag dang mi ldan pa zhes bya ba bcu tshan gsum pa'o// snga phyi'i rim pa sngar gyi de kho na bzhin du nyan po sangs rgya ba'i thabs la mkhas/ 'chad po thabs ma yin pa la mkhas pa dang*/ nyan po mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa dang*/ 'chad pos gzungs ma thob pa dang*/ nyan po yum yi ger 'bri 'dod pa dang*/ 'chad po yum yi ger 'dri mi 'dod pa dang*/ nyan po 'dod pa'i yon tan la 'dun pa dang*/ des mtshon nas gnod sems sogs sgrib pa lnga dang bral ba dang*/ 'chad po de dang ma bral ba nyid ces bya ba bzhi'o// gzhan don du ngan song gi 'gro bar skye ba la yid phyir phyogs pa dang*/ rang don du bde 'gro mtho ris dang rgyun zhugs sogs su 'gro ba la yid bde ba ste/ gnyis dang*/ bar chad go rim ma nges par bstan pa'i phyir grangs bzhin du 'chad pa po snga ma dang*/ nyan pa po phyi ma gang yang rung ba dang 'brel bas 'chad pa po gcig pu la dga' ba dang*/ nyan pa po 'khor la mngon par dga' ba nyid dang*/ 'chad pa pos nyan pa po phyi bzhin rjes su 'brangs pa'i go skabs mi 'byed pa dang*/ nyan pa po phyi bzhin rjes su 'brel par 'dod pa dang*/ 'chad po zang zing cung zad tsam 'dod pa dang*/ nyan po de sbyin par mi 'dod pa dang*/ 'chad po srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs su 'gro ba dang*/ nyan po srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs su mi 'gro ba zhes bya ba bzhi ste/ bcu tshan bzhi pa'o// rim pa de bzhin du 'chad po mu ge byung ba'i phyogs su 'gro (531) la/ nyan po mi 'gro ba dang*/ 'chad po chom rkun dang*/ sogs pa gdol ba la sogs pas dkrugs pa'i phyogs su 'gro la/ nyan po mi 'gro ba dang*/ 'chad po mdza' bo la sogs kyi khyim gyi bde blta bas/ nyan po de la yid mi bde ba zhes bya ba gsum ste/

bdun no// yum ni/ nged kyi mdo sder byung ba bzhin yin gyi/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las byung ba ni ma yin no// zhes zer ba bdud kyis 'byed pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mi rtag la sogs ston pa bcos ma nye bar sgrub pa dang*/ bcos ma bstan pa'i phyir bdud de bzhin gshegs pa'am byang sems chen por sprul pa la/ dad cing gus pa yul ji lta ba bzhin ma yin pa la dga' ba bskyed pa zhes bya ba gzhan rnam pa gsum ste/ de ltar spyir bsdoms na/ yum shes pa la sogs par rung ba'i sems sun 'byin pa'i skyon grangs zhe drug yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rin po che la dgra mang ba'i dpes bar chad du ma yod kyang de sel byed gnyen po dkar chos yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu ste/ bu mang po yod pa'i ma'i dpes phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang sems rnams kyis srung ba'i phyir ro// des na rgyu bzhi dang ldan pa la bar chad kyis mi tshugs te/ sdud par/ rgyu rnam bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan// bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te// stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang*// ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can// zhes so// gsum pa la/ spyi gzhung gnyis so// dang po la gnyis te/ shes bya mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon tshul dang*/ de shes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la gsum las/ gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ lo tsā ba na re/ shes pas yul du byas pa'i rang bzhin shes

(532) pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhe na/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid chos can/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid du thal/ shes pas yul du byas pa'i phyir ro// bzad pa na re/ gzhung gi dgongs pa mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ shes byed skyed pa'i rgyur mtshon/ shes byed skyed pa'i nus pa mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi mthong lam mtshan gzhi/ nyan rang mthong lam las khyad 'phags su mtshon/ bsam mi khyab sogs bcu drug mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ shes byed skyed pa'i nus pa'i ngo bo nyid du mtshon/ sbyor ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa mtshan nyid do// 'on kyang shes byed skyes pa'i nus pa mtshan nyid dngos yin la/ ngo bo dang khyad par mtshan nyid btags pa ba yin no// zhes so// gzhung gi dgongs pa shes byed skyed pa'i nus pa/ mtshan nyid dngos ma yin te/ shes pa dang byed pa rang mtshan nyid du bshad pas so// shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis tshul bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin mtshon zhes sogs bshad pas so// dngos btags kyi khyad par yang mi rigs te/ thams cad btags pa bar mtshungs pas so// rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ sbyor ba nyi shu po lam shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par mtshungs mod kyi/ 'on kyang bsgom par bya ba'i yul mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du 'gyur ro// yang na/ zab gting dpag dka' chad med pa'i sbyor ba'i dbang gis gsum mo// de dag gi 'bras bu shes pa/ khyad par/ byed pa rnams mtshan nyid yin no// mtshan nyid 'bras bu de dag gis/ mtshan gzhi mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba de dag 'bras bu de dag skyed byed du mtshon pa yin no// 'di'i mtha' dpyad pa la/ 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dang*/ rgyu'i mtshan nyid dang*/ 'bras bu mtshon tshul gsum mo// dang po la/ longs sku mtshan gzhi/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mtshon (533) pa la/ skyes bu gang zhig bzhed don phun sum tshogs pa mthar thug pa dang ldan pa'o// de la gnyis las/

rang don mthar thug gi mtshan nyid/ rang gi bzhed don mthar phyin pa'o// de la gnyis las/ spangs pa mthar thug gi mtshan nyid sgrib pas dag pa mthar phyin pa ste/ mtshan brjod las/ bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa// zhes so// rtogs pa mthar thug la gsum ste/ shes pa/ khyad par/ ngo bo nyid do// dang po la gsum las/ sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba las gzhi'i mtshan nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa ste/ mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas yum 'di nyid la brten te gzugs mkhyen te/ zhes so// 'on kyang gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba shes pa sogs bcu drug ni/ gzhi shes kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa sangs rgyas pa'i lam shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba las lam gyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'o// 'on kyang lam shes kyi sbyor ba la brten nas stong pa nyid shes pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ lam shes kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid do// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba la brten nas rnam pa'i mtshan nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ste/ 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba la brten nas gnas pa shes pa la sogs bcu drug go /gnyis pa ni/ lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba la brten nas gzhi shes las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos phul du phyin par nges pa ste/ des lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba de gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba las khyad par 'phags par mtshon no// 'dir mthong lam bsam mi khyab sogs bcu drug gis khyad (534) par du 'phags par dngos su bstan pas sgom lam dang rnam mkhyen khyad par du 'phags par shugs la mtshon no// gsum pa ni/ mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ste/ 'dir nyon mongs kyis dben pa sogs bcu drug go /gnyis pa gzhan don phun tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/

gzhan don gyi rgyu sbyor ba dang mkhyen pa las gzhan don gyi thabs phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa'o// de la gzhi shes las gzhan don sgrub pa phan bde skyob pa gsum/ lam shes las gzhan don sgrub pa skyabs sogs bdun/ rnam mkhyen las gzhan don sgrub pa rten gyi mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba nyi shu po mtshan gzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyur mtshon/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung rung ldan pa mtshan nyid do// mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa'i rgyur mtshon/ de skyed nus ldan mtshan nyid de/ bu skyed nus ldan gyis bu'i rgyur mtshon pa bzhin no// lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ de kho na gzhi shes las khyad par du byed chos skyed byed du mtshon/ de kho na gzhi shes las khyad par du byed chos skyed pa'i nus ldan mtshan nyid do// des lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba las khyad 'phags su mtshon/ gzhi shes las khyad 'phags skyed pa'i nus ldan mtshan nyid du bstan no// mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ gzhan don byed pa'i rgyur mtshon/ gzhan don byed pa skyed pa'i nus ldan mtshan nyid do// mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid du mtshon/ sbyor ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa mtshan nyid do// gsum pa la gnyis te/ byed sgrub dang*/ las sgrub bo// dang po la gsum ste/ shes pa/ khyad par/ byed pa'o// dang po la/ shes pa yang yin/ mtshan nyid kyang yin pas sam/ shes pa skyed byed (535) du mtshon pas shes pa'i mtshan nyid do// gang na/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba rnams so// sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ces bshad pas so// gang gis na/ shes pa bcu drug pa gsum gyis te/ bye brag bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/ shes pa de dag sbyor bas byas par shes pa na/ sbyor ba rnams shes pa'i rgyur mtshon pa yin te/

mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas yum 'di nyid la brten te gzugs mkhyen to// zhes so// yum ni/ sbyor ba yin la/ gzugs mkhyen pa shes pa yin pas/ sbyor ba shes pa'i rgyur rtogs te/ dper na/ zas la brten te 'grangs par nges pas zas 'grangs pa'i rgyur go ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ gang na/ lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'o// gang gis na/ bsam mi khyab sogs gzhi shes las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos kyis so// ji ltar na/ lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba de/ gzhi shes las khyad 'phags skyed byed du mtshon te/ des de byas pa'i phyir ro// de gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba las khyad 'phags su yang mtshon no// gsum pa ni/ gang na/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'o// gang gis na/ byed pa bcu gcig gis so// ji ltar na/ sbyor ba la brten nas byed pa byung bar nges pas sbyor ba de byed pa skyed byed du mtshon no// gnyis pa ni/ gang na/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'o// gang gis na/ nyon mongs sogs kyis dben pa sogs bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/ sngar gyi mtshan nyid de dag gis mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi lta bur ro// rtsod pa spang ba la gsum ste/ 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid la dang*/ rgyu'i la dang*/ 'bras bu mtshon tshul la rtsod spang ngo*// dang po ni/ bzhed don phun tshogs mthar thug pa'i skyes bu sangs rgyas ma yin te/ 'jig pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ mdo ni/ nga la 'jig tshogs kyi skur (536) ma lta bar chos sku yongs su rdzogs par ltos shig ces pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ de rang snang rkyang pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir gzhan snang dang tshogs pa'i dbang du byas pas so// gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung rung dang ldan pa mtshan nyid min te/ de bzhin gshegs pa yod med rjes su 'gro ldog byas pa yin pas so// zhe na/ de gnyis don gcig pas skyon med do// gsum pa ni/ shes pa khyad par sogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid min te/

bdag mi gcig pas so// zhe na/ mtshan nyid dngos min kyang de dag la brten nas sbyor ba de dag gi rgyur mtshon pas mtshan nyid du brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba sgom pa po ni/ shes pa/ khyad par/ byed pa rnams don du gnyer la/ sbyor ba shes byed kyi rgyur rtogs pa ni/ rtog ldan sbyor ba sgom pa'i sngon du 'gro ste/ sman la nad zhi byed kyi nus pa yod par shes pa sman bsten pa'i sngon du 'gro ba bzhin no// gnyis pa la gsum gyi dang po mdor bstan la/ gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ 'chad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sbyor ba de dag gi mtshan nyid/ gang du na/ skyon gyi 'og tu'o// de'i rgyu mtshan go rim bzhin du yon tan blang ba dang skyon dor bas sbyor ba rnams bsgom par bya ba ni/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid de shes pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pa'i phyir ro// rtsa ba la gnyis te/ byed sgrub dang*/ las sgrub bo// dang po ni/ shes par bya zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rgyu mtshan gang gis mtshon par byed pa de'o// ji ltar du na/ mtshan nyid du'o// de la du yod ce na/ 'dis mtshon par byed pa byed sgrub kyi mtshan nyid de'ang rnam pa gsum ste/ shes pa'i bdag nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong min pa'i chos khyad par gyi dang*/ gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa byed pa'i mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ mtshon par bya ba'i ngo bo nyid gang yin pa de yang las su (537) sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya'o// 'grel pa la/ shes par bya'o// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni'o// ji ltar na/ rnam pa bzhir ro// bzhi po gang zhe na/ byed par sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid 'dis sbyor ba rnams mtshon par byed pa yin pas na/ mtshan nyid de/ shes pa dang*/ khyad par dang*/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang gsum dang*/ las su sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sbyor ba de rnams mtshan nyid kyis mtshon par bya ba yin pas ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid bzhi'o// rgyas bshad la bzhi ste/

shes pa dang*/ khyad par dang*/ byed pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi shes dang*/ lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid do// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ mtshan nyid bzhi yod pa de la/ dang por shes pa'i mtshan nyid la'ang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi dbye bas mtshan nyid tha dad pa gsum yod pa las/ re zhig thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sgo nas shes pa'i mtshan nyid ston no// rtsa ba la/ bsdus pa yin zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang po bcu drug ni'o// gang gis na/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs kyis so// bcu drug po gang na/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba la brten nas zhes/ thams cad kyi gong du sbyar/ bar gyi rnam par mngon sum gyis shes zhes pa de/ bdun pa'i mtha' can gyi bsdu ba yin pas thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar la/ yum las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung zhing skyed pa'i 'o// mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa skyed pa'o// zhes so// phung po lnga'i lo ka skad cig dang rgyun gyis 'jig pa yang dag par med pa'i bdag nyid dang*/ mdo ni/ yum 'di ni/ phung po 'di dag 'jig par ston pa ma yin no// zhes so// sems can thams (538) cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa tshad med pa dang*/ sems de dmigs pa la nang du bsdus pa dang*/ phyir bltas te rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ nam mkha' bzhin du gzhal du med cing mi zad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang bcas pa dang*/ sogs pa chags sogs dang bral ba dang*/ chos nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yin pas sems rgya chen po dang*/ thams cad la khyab pas sems chen por gyur pa dang*/ sems rten med pas tshad med pa dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid med pas rnam shes 'di'o zhes bstan du med pa dang*/ sems de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan lngas kyang bltar med pa dang*/ shes pa de g.yo ba ste/ yul la sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang*/

sogs pa bcu gsum pa dgag pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa ste/ bdag dang lo ka rtag pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis min par 'dod pa sngon gyi mtha' la brten pa dang*/ bdag dang lo ka mtha' dang ldan pa dang*/ mi ldan pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis ka min pa ste/ phyi ma'i mtha' la brten pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa grongs nas 'byung ba dang*/ mi 'byung ba dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis ka min pa ste/ myang 'das la brten pa dang*/ lus de nyid srog go /zhes pa dang*/ srog kyang gzhan la lus kyang gzhan no// zhes pa lus srog la brten pa ste/ dang po rnams/ grangs can gyi lta ba g.yo ba/ gnyis pa rnams rgyang 'phan gyi lta ba 'du ba/ gsum pa rnams/ gcer bu pa'i lta ba bkram pa/ bzhi pa rnams/ gnas ma'i bu pa rnams kyi lta ba bcum pa ste/ lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi po ni/ sgyu ma lta bu'i phung po la brten nas skye'i/ de dag gi yul ni/ med do// zhes bya ba dang*/ mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas yum 'di la brten te/ sems can pha rol po rnams dang*/ gang zag pha rol po rnams kyi sems g.yo ba dang*/ 'du ba dang*/ bkram pa dang*/ bcum pa yang dag pa ji lta (539) ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// zhes so// sems g.yo ba sogs dang*/ de las gzhan yang phung po lnga po de dag ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par mngon sum du shes pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid tha mi dad pa de/ thub pas rtogs shing khong du chud de gzhan la ston par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di thams cad sbyor ba nyi shu pos byas par shes par bya'o// 'grel pa la/ bsdus pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis so// gang na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid de mtshon zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams so// gang gis na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs 'di rnams kyi rnam pa mngon sum du shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/

'bras bu bcu drug yod pa'i tshul bzhin du gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba rnams shes pa bcu drug skyed byed kyi rgyur mtshon te/ mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon pa ji lta ba bzhin no// bcu drug po gang na/ rnam pa mngon sum du shes zhes thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar la/ stobs sogs skyed pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ lo ka de kho nar ngo bo med cing stong pas 'jig pa med pa dang*/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar du mi dmigs pas sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa dmigs su med pa dang*/ sems nang du bsdus pa dang*/ phyir sems rnam par g.yeng pa gnyis chos nyid kyi ngo bor mi dmigs pa dang*/ bsdus g.yeng gi sems 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ spong ba rnams kyi mi zad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa dang*/ sogs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rtsa bar sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa sems 'dod chags dang bral (540) ba la sogs pa sems kyi ngo bo nyid min pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pas sems rgya chen po dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sems chen por gyur pa dang*/ sems 'jal byed kyi tshad ma med pa dang*/ dbang po'i yul min pas sems bstan du med pa dang*/ de sems med pas spyan lngas kyang bltar med pa dang*/ sems g.yo ba dang*/ sogs pa 'du ba la sogs pa dang*/ phung po lnga dang*/ g.yo ba la sogs pa de bzhin nyid gcig nyid kyi rnam pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos nyid de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de/ gdul bya gzhan la bstan cing brda btags pa zhes bya ba rnams so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid bshad zin pa de'i 'og tu lam shes nyid kyi sgo nas shes pa'i mtshan nyid 'chad do// rtsa ba la/ bsdus pa yin zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid bar pa bcu drug go /gang gis na/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni'o// bcu drug po gang na/

lam shes kyi sbyor ba la brten nas zhes thams cad kyi gong du sbyar/ rnam pa mngon sum du shes zhes mjug tu sbyar ba ni/ rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis ka la shes par byas la/ yum ngo bos stong pa nyid dang*/ rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'bras bu la smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang*/ don dam par rgyu las skye ba med pa dang*/ 'gag pa 'jig pa med pa dang*/ sogs pa kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa sogs drug go /mdo ni/ yum ni/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// zhes sogs so// chos nyid lha la sogs pas rnam par 'khrug cing bskyod pa med pa ste/ mdo ni/ mtshan nyid de dag ni/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i lo kas dkrugs par mi nus so// zhes so// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyis 'du mi byed pa ste/ mdo ni/ mtshan

(541) de dag ni/ gzugs kyis 'dus byas pa ma yin no// zhes so// zag pa yod med sogs su rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ mdo ni/ nam mkha' la mtshan nyid cung zad kyang ma mchis so// zhes so// stong pa nyid sogs mtshan nyid kyi rab dbye ste/ mdo ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad kyi rab tu dbye ba mdzad pa ngo mtshar che'o// zhes so// rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid med pa nyid de/ mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi ye shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mngon sum ste/ de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas mtshan nyid med par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ bsdus pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ lam shes nyid kyis so// gang na/ mtshon par byed pas na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid de/ mtshan gzhi'o// gang na/ lam shes nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams so// gang gis na/ stong nyid sogs 'di rnams kyi rnam pa mngon sum du shes pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/ mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa bcu drug gi rgyur ro// bcu drug po gang na/ kun btags pas stong pa nyid dang*/ yongs grub la mtshan ma med pa dang*/ gzhan dbang la smon pa med pa dang*/ skye ba med pa dang*/ 'gag pa med pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa/ chags sogs kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ dad sogs rnam byang med pa dang*/ 'dus byas kyi dngos po med pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin med pa dang*/ gnas pa'i rten med pa dang*/ spros bral nam mkha'i mtshan nyid drug dang*/ chos nyid sgro skur gyis rnam par 'khrug pa med pa dang*/ mtshan nyid de gzugs sogs kyis 'du mi byed pa dang*/ chos nyid 'dus ma byas pas mtshan nyid gang du'ang rnam par (542) mi rtog pa dang*/ mtshan nyid med par sangs rgyas nas mtshan nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba ston pa dang*/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid gzugs su rung ba nas rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid chos thams cad mngon sum du byed pa'i bar med pa zhes bya ba rnams so// gsum pa la gsum las/

snga 'grel ni/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid de'i 'og tu rnam mkhyen nyid kyi sgo nas shes pa'i mtshan nyid 'chad do// rtsa ba la/ bshad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang du na/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni'o// gang na/ shes pa tha ma bcu drug go /ji ltar na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya bar ro// bcu drug po gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba la brten nas zhes gong du dang*/ rnam pa mngon sum du shes pa zhes rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis ka'i mjug tu sbyar la/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi chos de skyed pa'i rgyu yum la brten nas gnas pa dang*/ mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam yum 'di la brten cing gnas so// zhes so// sgo gsum gyis yum la gus par bya ba dang*/ yum yon tan gyis lci ba'i bla ma nyid du bya ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par bya ba dang*/ yum de la me tog la sogs pas mchod par bya ba ste/ mdo ni/ chos la rim gror mdzad/ bsti stang du mdzad do// zhes so// chos thams cad la byed pa po med pa'o// mdo ni/ byed pa po med pa'i phyir chos thams cad ma byas pa zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes so// shes bya kun tu ye shes 'jug par mkhyen pa gang yin pa ste/ mdo ni/ chos thams cad la 'jug pa med pa'i brdas 'jug ste/ zhes so// yum nyid de bzhin gshegs pa la gzugs sogs ci yang ma mthong ba nyid don dam mthong bar ston par mdzad pa ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs ni/ mthong ba med pa'i phyir ston par byed pa'o// zhes so// yum nyid de bzhin gshegs pa la phung po lnga'i lo ka (543) stong pa nyid kyi rnam par ston pa dang*/ yang dag par bsdus pa'i gdul bya la lo ka stong pa nyid du rjod par mdzad pa'o// mdo ni/ phung po lnga'i lo ka stong ngo*// zhes bya bar rjod par mdzad do// zhes so// yongs su smin pa la lo ka stong pa nyid du shes par mdzad pa ste/

mdo ni/ yum ni/ lo ka stong zhes bya bar shes par mdzad do// zhes so// rnam par grol ba la lo ka stong pa nyid du mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka stong zhes bya bar ston par mdzad do// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka bsam gyis mi khyab par ston pa'o// mdo ni/ yum 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya bar ston no// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka zhi ba nyid du ston pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka zhi zhes bya bar ston no// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka zag bcas kyi dngos po 'gog pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka stong pa nyid ces bya bar ston no// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di dang pha rol gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes 'gog pa ste/ la ni/ bdun pa'o// mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di'ang de bzhin gshegs pa la lo ka 'di'i 'du shes dang*/ lo ka pha rol gyi 'du shes su mi 'gyur ba de ltar lo ka ston no// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ bsdus pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyis so// gang na/ mtshon par byed pas na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid tha ma bcu drug ste/ mtshon zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams so// gang gis na/ gnas pa la sogs pa 'di rnams kyi rnam pa mngon sum du shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/ mtshon (544) bya mtshon pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ shes pa bcu drug gi rgyur ro// bcu drug po gang na/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rang nyid kyi chos yum la mngon par brten pa mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa dang*/ yon tan dang ldan par gzung ba gus par bya ba dang*/ chen po'i gnas su bzhag pa bla mar bya ba dang*/ kun dga' bar byed pa mnyes par bya ba dang*/

rdzas dang bsnyen bkur gyis mchod par bya ba nyid du mdzad pa dang*/ byed pa po'i rgyu med pas ma byas pa nyid dang*/ yul thams cad du ye shes 'gro ba dang*/ 'ga' yang ma mthong ba'i don de kho na mthong bar ston pa dang*/ yum nyid de bzhin gshegs pa la spyir lo ka stong pa nyid kyi rnam par ston pa dang*/ phyogs gcig la zhugs pa la lo ka stong pa nyid du brjod pa dang*/ ched du bya ba la zhugs pa la lo ka stong pa nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang*/ mngon sum du zhugs pa la lo ka stong pa nyid du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ bsam pa las 'das pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ston pa dang*/ spros pa'am/ nyon mongs zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ lo ka'i dngos po 'gog pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes 'gog pa zhes bya ba rnams so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gsungs gzhi'o// gang na/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid do// gang gis na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pas so// gang du na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu'o// de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngar bshad pa de ltar bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad dgus shes pa'i mtshan nyid mkhyen gsum gyi spyi'i ngo bo nyid du brjod nas shes pa'i rnam pa tha dad du yongs su bcad pa gsum po rnams kyis khyad par shes par bya dgos pas so// rtsa ba la/ bshad pa yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid do// gang gis na/ bsam mi khyab pa dang*/ sogs pa mi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi (545) mtshan nyid kyis theg dman las khyad zhugs pa bden pa bzhi'i spyod yul can gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gis so// 'grel pa la/ mtshon par byed pas na/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid yin pas mtshon zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ lam shes pa nyid dang*/ sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba dag kho na'o// gang gis na/ bcu drug gis mtshon pa khyad par gyi mtshan nyid kyis te/

khyad par du byas zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ duḥkha la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi'i yul can chos bzod bzhi/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa bzhi/ chos shes bzhi/ rjes su shes pa bzhi ste/ skad cig bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni'o// gang las na/ nyan thos mthong lam las so// gang gis na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang*/ sogs pa gzhal ba las 'das pa la sogs pa'i khyad par bcu drug gis so// 'dir mthong lam khyad par du 'phags par dngos su bstan pas/ sgom lam dang rnam mkhyen khyad par 'phags par shugs la mtshon no// ji ltar na/ khyad 'phags skyed byed du mtshon zhing gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba las khyad 'phags su'ang mtshon no// rgyas bshad la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ yang ni/ brnan pa'o// bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gang zhe na/ de ston byed bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gsum mo// rtsa ba la/ khyad par du 'phags zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byang sems gang gi mthong lam 'di'o// gang las na/ gzhan nyan rang gi lam dag las so// gang gis na/ khyad par bcu drug gi bdag nyid kyis so// bcu drug po gang na/ bsam pa las 'das pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mnyam pa las 'das pas mi mnyam pa nyid dang*/ tshad mas gzhal ba las 'das pa dang*/ grangs kyis bgrang ba (546) las yang dag par 'das pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'am/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rgyur gnas pa bzhi ni/ duḥkha'i skad cig bzhi ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang*/ gzhal du med pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o// zhes so// 'phags pa'i gang zag kun gyi yon tan thams cad sdud pa ste/ sdud par/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang du'ang mi 'gro la// sangs rgyas sa yi yon tan gang yin thams cad sdud// ces so// ji lta ji snyed pa'i don la mkhas pa yis rig par bya ba ste/ mdo ni/ yum ni/ zhi ba/ phra ba/ mdzangs pa/

mkhas pa rnam par shes pas rig par bgyi ba ste/ zhes so// nyan rang dang thun mong min pa nyan rang spangs rtogs thams cad yar ldan du shes pa nyid de/ mdo ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ spangs pa gang yin pa de ni/ byang sems chen po mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i bzod pa'o// zhes so// mngon shes dang myang 'das myur du thob pa ste/ kun 'byung gi skad cig bzhi'i khyad par ro// mdo ni/ shin tu myur bar mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod par bya zhes so// don dam par bri ba dang*/ gang ba med pa dang*/ mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di 'grib pa'am 'phel bar yang 'tshal bar mi gda'o// zhes so// ba drus ma'i dpes phyin drug mos pas sgrub pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di thos ma thag tu mos par 'gyur ro// zhes so// tshogs gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di thos ma thag tu mos par 'gyur ro// zhes so// chos thams cad mi rtag par dmigs pa ste/ gru chag pa'i shing 'dzin pa bzhin no// mdo ni/ bar mdor byang chub nyams par mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// 'gog bden skad cig bzhi'i khyad par ro// bum pa'i dpes lam gyi rten byang sems dang (547) bcas pa dang ngo*// mdo ni/ nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar bar ma dor nye zhor mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// bcos legs byas pa'i gru'i dpes thabs shes sogs lam gyi tshogs pa mtha' dag tshang ba ste/ mdo ni/ byang sems de ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar mi ltung ngo*// zhes so// thabs shes rab kyis srid zhi las yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ rgas pa skyes bus bzung ba bzhin no// mdo ni/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi gnas der phyin par nus so// zhes so// gzugs sogs la zhen pa'i ro myang ba med pa ste/ mdo ni/ sbyin pa de thams cad bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shig ces so// lam bden skad cig bzhi'i khyad par te/

de dag kyang de dang de rtogs pa dang*/ de dang de ldan pa dang*/ de dag gi rgyu byed pa ci rigs su go bar bya'o// khyad par 'phags pas na/ khyad par gyi lam zhes pa sgra don no// 'grel pa la/ khyad zhugs zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ byang sems dang*/ sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi lam shes nyid dang*/ sogs pa rnam mkhyen gnyis khyad par gyi lam yin par ro// gang las na/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i lam las/ gang gis na/ khyad par bcu drug gis so// bcu drug po gang na/ byang sems de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa byang sems la sogs pas legs par yongs su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis rtog ge'i blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid dang*/ mi mnyam pa nyid dang*/ tshad mas gzhal ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang*/ grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang bzhi ni/ duḥkha'i bden pa'i chos nyid mthong ba'i ye shes skad cig ma bzhi'i khyad par te/ ye shes bzhi'i rgyu byed pas so// blon (548) po'i dpes 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi yon tan sdud pa dang*/ skyes bu mkhas pa blo sbyangs pa dang*/ bden pa mthong bas rig par bya ba shes par byed pa dang*/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa yul dus kyis chod pa'i dngos po phra mo'am chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes pa dang*/ theg chen rang gi lugs la ltos pa'i mngon par shes pa slob pa gzhan gyis bskal pas kyang mi 'grub pa de shin tu myur bar sgrub cing nges par 'byung ba shes pa dang bzhi ni/ sogs pa kun 'byung skad cig bzhi'i khyad par ro// kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brten nas chos thams cad bri ba med pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa la brten nas chos thams cad gang ba med pa'i ngo bo mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyis sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin brtson 'grus chen pos drag tu rab tu sgrub pa dang*/

yang dag pa'i sbyor bas bskal pa du mar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu bsod nams dang ye shes yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ chos thams cad la cir yang rnam par mi rtog par dmigs pa dang bzhi ni/ 'gog pa'i skad cig bzhi'i khyad par ro// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang sems kyi lam gyi rten rigs dang*/ smon lam dang*/ sogs pa ye shes la sogs pa'i phar phyin yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu thams cad tshogs pa dang*/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis thabs mkhas kyis srid zhi las yongs su bzung ba dang*/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la 'dod cing mngon par zhen pa'i ro myang ba med pa zhes bya ba lam bden gyi khyad par te/ de ltar bcu drug gi bdag nyid do// bcu drug po des khyad zhugs pa de'i phyir nyan thos kyi lam de dag ni/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i khyad par bcu drug dang bral ba'i 'khor 'das la mngon par zhen pa skye ba dang*/ (549) sogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa med pa la sogs pa sngar las ldog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shugs kyis go sla ba'i phyir dngos su ma bshad do// gsum pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid kyis khyad par rnam par bcad pa rnams kyi gzhan don byed pa'i 'phrin las gang yin zhe na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis kyis byed pa'i mtshan nyid ston no// rtsa ba la/ mi rnams kyis mtshon pa gdul bya rnams la zhes pa/ thams cad kyi gong du sbyar/ sgrub par mdzad ces kun gyi mjug tu sbyar te/ tshe phyi ma la phan pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ gtan gyi duḥkha las skyob pa dang*/ bde ba thob cing duḥkha las thar par byed pa skyabs dag dang*/ bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan zhing duḥkha'i rgyu dang bral bar byed pa gnas dang*/ srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes thob par byed pa dpung gnyen dang*/ gnyis ka'i don 'grub pa'i rten rnam grol gyi gling dang*/ 'gro ba nyes pa'i gnas nas yon tan gyi gnas su yongs su 'dren pa dang*/

gnyis don 'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub pa ste/ gzhi shes kyi byed pa dgu po thams cad ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa ston pa'i don gyis gsungs pa'o// theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nges par 'byung zhing*/ de'i 'bras bu yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid lam shes kyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa tha ma rnam mkhyen gyi chos thams cad ston par byed pa'i lo ka'i rten sgrub par mdzad pa zhes bya ba bcu gcig po 'di ni/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// sdud par/ de ltar spyod pa legs 'tsho smra ba'i zla ba rnams// 'gro ba'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang ni gnas yin te// rten dang blo dang gling dang yongs 'dren don 'dod pa// gsal byed sgron ma chos mchog smra ba mi 'khrugs yin// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ mtshon pa'i chos

(550) bzhi ste/ gang*/ gang gis/ ji ltar/ mtshon byed mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ byed pa'i rgyu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba dag go /gnyis pa ni/ gong gi de ltar na/ byed pa'i rnam pa bcu gcig po dag gis so// gsum pa ni/ ji lta ba bzhin du ste/ byed pa bcu gcig gi rgyur ro// bzhi pa la gsum ste/ gzhi shes dang*/ lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi byed pa'o// dang po la/ nye bar sgrub ces drang ngo*// gang la na/ gzhi shes kyi gdul bya la'o// gang gis na/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor bas so// gang na/ sems can rnams rgyud lnga las 'don zhing myang 'das la 'god pa ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa dang*/ duḥkha dang yid mi bde ba las bkrol nas myang 'das la 'god pa tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i duḥkha skyob cing yang mi skyed par byed pa duḥkha med pa'i rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i chos nyid nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis thams cad shes pa nyid kyi phan pa dang*/ sogs pa bde ba/ skyob pa'i byed pa gsum mo// sngar dgur bshad pa ni/ 'phags pa'i lugs so// gnyis pa la/ nye bar sgrub ces drang ngo*// gang la na/ lam shes kyi gdul bya la'o// gang gis na/ lam shes kyi sbyor bas so// gang na/ lam shes nyid kyi skyabs dang*/ sogs pa gnas la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun po 'di rnams so// bdun po gang na/ skye rga na 'chi las bsgral nas lhag med la 'god pa gtan du phan pa nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis skyabs dang*/ chos thams cad 'dres pa med par chos ston pas duḥkha'i rgyu ldog pas gnas dang*/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das tha dad du rtogs pa med par mnyam nyid du rtogs pas dpung gnyen dang*/ sred pa zad pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ myang 'das ston pa dang*/ ye shes kyi snang ba byed pa dang*/ gling du phyin par byed pas rang gzhan gyi don rtogs pa'i rten (551) gyi ngo bos gling dang*/

skye ba med pa sogs kyi chos bstan pas gzhan gyi don sgrub pas yongs 'dren dang*/ mngon par 'du byed pa med pas sems can gyi don lhun grub tu 'jug pas lhun grub dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nges par 'byung ba'i 'bras bu/ smin rdzogs ma sbyangs par mngon sum du mi byed pa zhes bya ba rnams so// ji ltar na/ phan gdags pa'i dus la bab pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par ro// gsum pa ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i chos thams cad bstan pa nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis rnam mkhyen nyid kyi sbyor ba la ni lo ka'i rten gyi mdzad pa gcig ste/ bcu gcig po de sbyor ba dang ldan pas byang sems kyi gnas skabs sam/ sangs rgyas nas chos bstan pas sgrub pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ 'chad do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// gang gis na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gsum gyis so// ci'i don du na/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi byed las shes par byas pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ de'i lan du'o// rtsa ba la/ bzhed pa yin zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo nyid bcu drug gi bdag nyid ni'o// ji ltar na/ mtshan nyid bzhi pa las sgrub kyi mtshan nyid du'o// de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mtshan nyid kyis 'di mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi lta bur mtshon pas na'o// bcu drug po gang na/ nyon mongs pa'i ngo bos dben pa dang*/ mdo ni/ 'dod chags rnam par bsal bas dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur zhes so// nyon mongs kyi 'bras bu rtags kyis dben pa dang*/ mdo ni/ 'dod chags kyi rtags kyis dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro// zhes so// nyon mongs pa'i mtshan ma'am rgyus dben pa dang*/ mdo ni/ 'dod chags (552) kyi mtshan mas dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro// zhes so// spang bya mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po rnam byang du rtogs pa'i shes sgrib kyis dben pa dang*/

mdo ni/ 'dod chags dang 'dod chags med pas rnam par dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur zhes so// bya dka' ba'i go cha gyon pa dang*/ mdo ni/ sems can yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya'o// zhes go cha 'di bgos pa de dag ni dka' ba byed par 'gyur ba'o// zhes so// bsgoms pas mtha' gcig tu nges par sangs rgya ba dang*/ mdo ni/ nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung ba'i gnas dang skabs ma mchis so// zhes so// rnam mkhyen gyi don du go cha gyon pa ched du bya ba ma 'khrul ba ste/ mdo ni/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes kyi don du go cha bgos so// zhes so// gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa ste/ mdo ni/ sus kyang sgom par mi bgyid/ cir yang sgom par mi bgyid/ ji ltar yang sgom par mi bgyid/ ces so// lam shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa yum la mngon par zhen pa bkag pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di la mngon par zhen par mi byed do// zhes so// rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sgom pa de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa ste/ mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid la gzhol ba'i bsam pas yum zab mo 'di la brtag par bya'o// zhes so// zab pas lo ka thams cad dang mi mthun pa ste/ mdo ni/ lo ka thams cad dang mi mthun pa'o// zhes so// ji snyed pa la ye shes thogs pa med pa ste/ mdo ni/ gzugs la thogs pa ma mchis so// zhes so// gzugs sogs de la rten nam/ gzhi med pa ste/ mdo ni/ chos 'di gzhi ma mchis pa'o// zhes so// rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i rjes su skyes pas de bzhin nyid 'gro ba med pa ste/ mdo ni/ gnas brtan rab 'byor (553) gyis de bzhin nyid kyang ma 'ongs ma song ba ste/ zhes so// lam shes kyi rnam pa'i rjes su skyes pas gzugs sogs kyi rjes su skye ba med pa ste/ mdo ni/ skye bar 'gyur ba'i chos de dag med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gzugs sogs mi dmigs pas de'i de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa ste/

mdo ni/ gzugs dang gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa ste zhes so// zhes bya ba gang yin pa rnams kyi mjug tu ngo bo nyid ces sbyar ro// 'grel pa la gnyis te/ mtshon byed mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang*/ des mtshon tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ gzhi shes kyi ngo bo nyid bzhi/ lam shes kyi lnga/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdun no// dang po ni/ gzhi shes nyid mnyam gzhag tu 'dod chags dang*/ sogs pa zhe sdang gti mug sogs nyon mongs pa mngon gyur stong zhing dben pa nyid kyis gzhi shes nyid kyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang po'o// stong pa nas ngo bo nyid kyi bar kun la sbyar te/ nyon mongs pa de'i rtags lus dang ngag gi gnas ngan len srog gcod/ rdzun tshig sogs stong pa gnyis pa/ nyon mongs de'i rgyu'i mtshan ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar 'dzin pa sogs dang*/ sogs pa rdzun gyi rgyu phra rgyas dang bcas pa stong pa gsum po 'dod chags dang 'dod chags med pa dang*/ sogs pa zhe sdang dang zhe sdang med pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang gnyen po dag stong zhing dben pa ste/ bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ don dam par sems can med cing kun rdzob tu grangs med pa'i sems can mya ngan las 'da' bar bya dka' ba'i don du go cha gyon pa dang*/ go cha gyon pa de 'khor ba'am nyan rang gi theg pa gzhan du mi ltung ba'i mtshan nyid kyis mtha' gcig tu sangs rgya bar nges pa dang*/ yun ring po bskal pa grangs med (554) pa nas bsgrub par bya ba'i mchog rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes nyid kyi ched du bya ba dang*/ bsgom par bya ba yum dang*/ sgom pa po gang zag dang*/ sgom pa'i chos mi dmigs pa dang*/ 'khor 'das la blang dor gyi dngos por mngon par zhen pa mtha' dag bkag pa zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni/ lam shes nyid kyi ngo bo nyid do// zhes kun gyi mjug tu sbyar ba lnga'o// gsum pa ni/ gzhi shes nyid dang*/

lam shes nyid kyis bsdus pa yul yul can gyi dngos po'i khyad par sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa dang*/ lo ka'i sgrub pa'am spyod pa 'dzin pa dang*/ sogs pa mi 'dzin pa la sogs pa las ldog ste/ gzung mi gzung las 'das pa'i zab par bstan pas lo ka thams cad dang mi mthun pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa thams cad la ye shes kyi chos thogs pa med par shes pa dang*/ yul shes bya dang*/ yul can shes pa mi dmigs par mnyam pas gzugs sogs kyi rten nam/ gzhi med pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong med pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo yin pas 'gro zhing song ba med pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid med pas de'i rjes su skye ba med pa dang*/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa dang*/ sogs pa gnyis ka yin pa'am/ min pa'i phung po gsum gyi ngo bo de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ces pa thams cad la sbyar te/ grangs bdun no// gnyis pa ni/ mtshon par byed pa de lta na/ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du bzhed do// mtshan gzhi'o// gang na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi spyod pa dag go /gang gis na/ sngar bshad pa de ltar na/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo nyid bcu drug gis so// ji ltar na/ ji lta ba bzhin du ste/ ma nor bar sbyor ba 'di mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mtshan gzhi bzhin du ste/ 'gyur snying (555) las/ mtshan gzhi lta bur mtshon pas na// zhes so// don bsdu ni/ shes pa zhe brgyad/ khyad par bcu drug byed pa bcu gcig ngo bo nyid bcu drug yod pa de ltar na/ spyir mtshan nyid thams cad gcig tu bsdoms na mtshan nyid go gcig tu 'gyur ro// bzhi pa la/ thar pa cha mthun gyi ngo bo// de'i khyad par ro// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag kho na la sngar ji skad bshad pa'i sbyor ba yongs su shes shing sgom pa 'byung bas na/

sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro thar pa cha mthun ston no// rtsa ba la/ 'dod ces drang ngo*// gang na/ shes rab kyis mtshan ma med par rtogs nas thabs kyis rab tu sbyin pa dang*/ sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rang gi rgyud la yang dag par bskyed cing sgrub pa la mkhas pa ni'o// gang du na/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa 'di la'o// ji ltar na/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun par ro// mdo ni/ thog ma sems bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste rnam mkhyen gyi sems dang ma bral bar sbyin pa gtong ba dang zhes pa nas rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar du bsgom zhing mtshan mar mi byed do// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ 'dod do// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar du mtshan ma med par dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i rnam pas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin nas stobs la sogs pa rnam mkhyen nyid la thug pa rnams rang gi rgyud la skyed par mkhas pa'i thabs shes rab ni'o// gang du na/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba ston pa'i skabs 'di la'o// ji ltar na/ thar pa'i cha mthun yin par ro// gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ skyed par mkhas pa de gang yin zhe na/ de dang che 'bring gi dbye ba (556) bstan pa'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis smos so// rtsa ba la/ mkhas pa'i khyad par dang*/ che 'bring gi khyad par gnyis so// dang po ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs pa de rnams kyi tshul khrims la sogs pa la dmigs pa'i dad pa ste/ mdo ni/ yum dang thabs mkhas pa dang ma bral bar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams yid la sems te mtshan mar mi byed do// zhes so// spyod yul sbyin sogs drug la dmigs pa'i brtson 'grus so// mdo ni/ mtshan ma dang bral ba'i sems kyis sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ zhes so// yum dang thabs mkhas dang ma bral ba'i bsam pa phun tshogs la dmigs pa'i dran pa ste/

mdo ni/ yum dang thabs la mkhas pa dang ma bral ba'i bsam pa can gang yin pa de'i bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni/ the tshom ma mchis so zhes so// gzugs sogs su rnam par mi rtog pa la mkhas pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ mdo ni/ thabs mkhas pa dang ma bral bar bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes so// chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du rtogs par yang bya la/ de dag mi dmigs par shes pa'i shes rab ste/ mdo ni/ chos thams cad ni/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// de ltar na mkhas pa rnam pa lnga'o// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen dad sogs lnga po chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs shing thob par sla ste/ dbang po rnon po'i dad sogs yin pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ byang sems chen po bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar sla'o// zhes so// theg dman dad sogs lnga chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs dka' zhing thob mi nus par bzhed de/ dbang po rtul po'i dad sogs yin pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ rnam grangs des bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ni/ dka'o// zhes so// 'grel pa la/ (557) mkhas pa dang*/ che 'bring gi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas sogs kyi sgra dang yul zhes sbyar/ dad pa sogs la khyad par can sogs sbyar ba yul yul can grangs bzhin du sbyar te bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi tshul khrims sogs kyi yul la dmigs nas stong pa sogs su sems pa yi dad pa khyad par can dbang po'i don rnam byang la dbang byed pa med pas dbang po'i ngo bor ma gyur pa dang*/ sbyin sogs phyin drug la brtson 'grus dang*/ mi dge ba mtha' dag spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa'i thabs shes kyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa la dran pa dang*/ 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad yongs su shes par yang bya la de dag kyang mi dmigs pa'i shes rab ste/

yul rnam pa lnga la dmigs pa'i mkhas pa lnga yin no// gnyis pa la/ dngos bstan/ shugs bstan gnyis so// dang po la/ dad sogs lnga yin pa de lta mod kyi/ thar pa cha mthun thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pas khyab pa ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar/ dad pa dang*/ sogs pa brtson 'grus la sogs pa chen po dbang po rnon pos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa byang chub rtogs shing thob par sla la/ dad sogs kyi dbang po de dag nyid chung ngu'am/ rtul pos ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par dka'o// zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa yin pas dgag tu med do// gnyis pa ni/ de dngos su bstan pa'i shugs kyis na/ dad sogs kyi dbang po 'bring po rnams kyis ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rtogs la/ dad sogs kyi dbang po chung ngu rnams kyis ni/ nyan thos kyi byang chub rtogs so// zhes bya ba 'di 'phangs pa yin (558) no// gnyis pa la/ rgyud yongs su smin pa nges 'byed cha mthun/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun/ yan lag srid zhi mnyam nyid/ nye ba'i yan lag zhing dag sbyor/ gzhan yongs su 'dzin pa'i rgyu thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang lnga'o// dang po la/ dngos dang*/ zlos spang gnyis so// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'brel ni/ thar pa cha mthun skyes pa'i gang zag gzhan don la spro ba can la 'dir smos nges 'byed cha mthun 'byung bas de ston no// rtsa ba la/ dmigs pa ni/ dro ba dang*/ rnams kyi sgras mtshon nas rtse mo la sogs pa rnams kyi dmigs pa ni/ rnam kun gyi skabs 'dir sems can thams cad la dmigs pa yin par mdo las bsngags shing brjod do// rnam pa la bzhi ste/ drod rtse bzod mchog go /drod la gsum las/ chung ngu ni/ sems can de dag nyid la sems mnyam pa nyid dang byams pa'i sems te/ mdo ni/ sems can rnams kyi drung du sems mnyam pa nyid gnas par bya'o// zhes so// 'bring ni/

phan pa sogs gsum ste/ mdo ni/ sems can rnams kyi drung du phan pa'i sems bskyed par bya'i/ gnod pa'i bskyed par mi bya'o// zhes so// chen po ni/ pha dang ma'i sems sogs lnga ste/ rnam pa bcur mdo las bshad do// mdo ni/ sems can rnams kyi drung du ma'i sems bskyed par bya'o// zhes so// rtse mor gyur pa chung ngu ni/ bdag nyid sdig pa mi dge ba las ldog cing*/ gdul bya gzhan sdig pa las ldog pa de dag la ni 'god pa dang*/ zhugs tsam la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ ma bskul bar zhugs pa la mthun par dga' bar bya ba nyid do// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang srog gcod pa las ldog par bya zhes so// 'bring ni/ bdag nyid sbyin sogs phar phyin drug la gnas pas gang zag gzhan sbyin sogs la gnas pa de dag la ni 'god pa sogs sngar bzhin no// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang sbyin pa sogs

(559) phar phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par zhes so// chen po ni/ sogs pa bdag nyid nang stong nyid sgom sogs la gnas/ gzhan de la 'god sogs te/ mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang nang stong pa nyid bsgom par bya zhes so// bzod pa ni/ rtse mo la rang gzhan la brten pa'i dmigs rnam gyi dbye ba yod pa de bzhin du rang sdug bden shes/ kun 'byung spong*/ 'gog pa mngon sum du byed/ lam sgom pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god sogs chung ngu'o// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang duḥkha yongs su shes par bya'o// zhes so// 'og gi sogs kyi sgra 'dir sbyar te/ sogs pa rang nyid shes rab kyis theg dman gyi 'bras bu shes pa mngon du byed pa'i phyir sgom zhing*/ thabs kyis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa la gnas nas gzhan de la dgod sogs 'bring ngo*// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir shes pa bskyed de/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi bya zhes sogs so// chen po ni/ rang byang sems kyi skyon med pa la 'jug pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god sogs te/ mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang byang sems kyi skyon med pa la 'jug par bya zhes so// chos mchog ni/ rang gzhan gyi rten gyi dbye ba sngar gyi de bzhin du rang sems can rnams smin par byed sogs la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god sogs chung ngu'o// mdo ni/ bdag gis sems can rnams yongs su smin par bya zhes so// sogs pa rang mngon shes khyad par can la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god sogs 'bring ngo*// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang byang sems kyi mngon par shes pa bskyed par bya zhes so// chen po ni/ rang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes skyed pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god sogs kyis shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ bdag nyid kyang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed par bya (560) zhes so// 'di dag 'phags pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i bshad pa'o// 'grel pa la/

drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi las/ drod ni/ sbyor ba dang ldan pa rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i skabs 'di la tshul ngan pa med pas mnyam pa dang*/ da ltar phan pa'i don sems pas byams pa dang gnyis ni/ tshe 'dir gzhan la mi 'tshe bas chung ngu'o// ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa sems pas phan pa dang*/ nga rgyal bcom nas gzhan bde ba la khong khro ba med pa dang*/ mtho mi 'tsham pas rnam par 'tshe ba med pa'i sems kyi rnam pa gsum ni/ tshe phyi mar phan pas 'bring ste/ lnga dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med rang bas rgan pa rnams la pha dang ma'i sems dang*/ mnyam pa rnams la spun dang sring mo'i sems dang*/ gzhon pa la bu dang bu mo'i sems dang*/ yid brtan pa'i bshes dang*/ phan 'dogs pa'i grogs kyi sems dang*/ rus gcig pa'i gnyen dang*/ mi gcig pa'i snag gi gnyen mtshams kyi sems kyi rnam pa/ chung 'bring las gzhan gnyis gnyis gcig tu byas pa lnga ni/ chen po ste/ 'di phyi gnyis kar gzhan gyi 'dod pa sgrub pas so// de ltar bcus sems can la dmigs pa ni/ dro bar gyur par bzhed do// rtse mo'i rnam pa ni/ mdor bsdus na/ srog gcod sogs mi dge ba la grangs bzhin du spong bar 'dod pa'i sgo nas mi dge ba las ldog pa'i bdag nyid can la rang gnas te/ de'i sgo nas gdul bya gzhan rnams sdig pa las ldog pa dag la sbyor ba chung ngu dang*/ sbyin sogs dge ba la len par 'dod pa'i sgo nas dge ba la zhugs shing gnas pa'i bdag nyid can/ de'i sgo nas gzhan rnams dge ba la gnas pa dag la sbyor ba'i rnam pa ni/ 'bring ste/ gnyis gang*/ rang gis bskul ba las gzhan ma bskul bar bdag nyid dge sdig la 'jug ldog ma nor ba de bzhin du zhugs pa rnams la/ yon tan bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ (561) dga' zhing mthun par byed pa rnam pa gnyis po chen po ste/ sbyar bya dang*/ sbyor po dang*/ sbyor yul gyi chos kyi rab tu dbye ba byas na ni/

rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ste/ rnam pa de rnams kyi dmigs yul sems can la dmigs pa ni/ rtse mor gyur pa'i dmigs rnam yin no// rtse mo bzod pa gnyis kyi bshad pa ni/ chos bshes kyis bshad pa bzhin yin no// yang na/ rtsa ba bzhin kho nar bya'o// bzod pa ni/ rtse mor gyur pa la 'god byed rang dang*/ 'god bya gzhan gyi rten gyi dbye ba/ dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa dag gi dbye ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chung ngu'i rnam pa/ rang gnas nas gzhan de la sbyor ba dang*/ 'bring gi rnam pa/ zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ chen po'i rnam pa/ legs par zhugs pa la dga' bas mthun par byed pa nyid kyi rnam pa gsum po rnams kyi dmigs pa/ rang duḥkha shes/ kun 'byung spong*/ 'gog pa mngon du byed/ lam sgom pa la gnas shing*/ gzhan gyi rten can yang duḥkha la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi shes spong mngon du byed sgom pa la dmigs pa ni/ bzod pa yin no// 'dir bzod pa chen po'ang skad cig du mar blta'o// 'dir bod rnams na re/ gang la sbyor ba'i yul ngos ma bzung*/ shes pa'i 'grel pa chad/ bden pa dmigs par bshad pa nor zer ro// bzhi pa ni/ snga ma rtse mor bstan pa bzhin du rang sems can rnams dge rtsas smin par byed pa dang*/ shes rab kyis grol bar byed pa la gnas nas gzhan gyi rten can kho na yang de la 'god sogs chung ngu dang*/ sogs pa rang mngon shes khyad par can la gnas nas gzhan 'god sogs 'bring dang*/ rang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes skyed pa la gnas nas gzhan 'god sogs chen po'i rnam pa dag gis/ yul sems can la dmigs pa ni/ chos (562) kyi mchog yin te/ dmigs rnam gyi tshul de ltar na/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi rjes thob kyi dmigs rnam yin no// 'o na/ chos mchog che 'bring gsum yod na/ chos mchog skad cig gcig tu bshad pa dang 'gal lo// zhe na/ de ni nyan thos rang don sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/

'di gzhan don sgrub pa na/ rim gyi gnas skabs yod pas che 'bring 'thad do// gnyis pa rtsod pa ni/ skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan drug ston pa'i gzhung zlos par thal/ brjod bya sbyor mthong sgom gsum du khyad med pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ lan la gnyis te/ skabs dang po gsum gyi lam gsum mtshan nyid par bstan/ 'og ma gsum gyi lam gsum btags par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ skabs dang po gsum du sbyor mthong sgom gsum ston pa'i gzhung yang zlos so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ rnam pa thams cad skye med du rtogs te rnam par sgom pa'i dbye bas go rim bzhin du rnam mkhyen nyid dang*/ lam thams cad skye med du rtogs te sgom pa'i dbye bas sogs pa lam shes nyid dang*/ gzhi thams cad skye med du rtogs te sgom pa'i dbye bas gzhi shes kyi ste/ mngon par rtogs pa rnam pa gsum la lo ka'i nges 'byed cha mthun mtshan nyid pa rtogs shing shes pa'i don du sbyor lam bstan la/ sbyor lam de rtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ de'i 'bras bu la lo ka las 'das pa'i mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam mtshan nyid pa rtogs shing shes pa'i rgyur mthong sgom bshad pa yin no// la ni/ mtshams sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa dang*/ sogs pa rtse sbyor dang*/ mthar gyis pa ste/ mngon rtogs gsum gyi skabs la ni/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ sogs pa mthong lam sgom lam gyi ming gis btags pa'am tha snyad du gsungs (563) pa yin par shes par bya'o// tha snyad du btags gzhir bya'o// gang la na/ spangs rtogs gang zag gi yon tan rnam pa thams cad du khyad par 'phags pa'i khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes sgrib gnyis kyi zag pa med pa sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum gyi ye shes chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po gsum la'o// gang gis na/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi ming gis so// 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/

rim gyis skye ba yin par chos mthun pas so// de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ gnas skabs kyi khyad par sgom pa gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir ro// btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ khyad par du zag med kyi ye shes thams cad gcig car skye ba'i dogs pa dgag pa'i phyir ro// der bo dong pa na re/ gzhung 'di slob dpon gyi phyogs snga yin gyi/ bzhed pa min no// zer pa ni/ mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyis gzhung gang du'ang de ma bkag pa'i phyir dang*/ sdud 'grel du 'di dang mthun par sbyor bzhi'i sa mtshams bzhag pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang skabs 'og ma gsum gyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum btags pa bar mi 'grub ste/ dngos la gnod byed med pa'i phyir ro// rtags ma grub ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed par nges pa la rang gnas nas gzhan 'god pa sogs dang*/ bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*/ zhes pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par bshad pas so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa zhes gsungs kyi/ skyed par nges pa zhes bshad pa med pas so// ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal 'joms pa dang*/ bzod pa thob pa tsam drod nas kyang yod pas so// des na/ 'phags pa la sogs pa'i dam pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs te skabs 'og ma gsum du bstan pa'i lam gsum yang mtshan nyid (564) pa nyid du smra'o// gnyis pa la gsum gyi mdor bstan la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems kyi dge 'dun la rtogs pa sngar ji skad bshad pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun 'byung bas/ de'i phyir phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems kyi dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid 'chad do// rtsa ba la gsum las/ gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ bzad pa na re/ bdag chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin te/ mnyam rjes kyi spangs rtogs khyad par can la gnas pa'i phyir/ dper na/ skyes bu gzhan pa 'di bzhin/

zhes khyab pa gzhan gyi steng du nges nas rang gi steng du tha snyad byar rung sgrub bo// zhe na/ de mi 'thad de/ gzhan rgyud la phyir mi ldog pa mngon sum gyis grub na/ rang la ma grub par 'gal lo// rjes dpag gis sgrub na rang gzhan gnyis ka rtsod gzhir song bas mthun dpe mi rnyed do// slob dpon gyis kyang ji ltar gzhan yid ches par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin no// zhes gzhan phyir mi ldog tu sgrub par bshad pas so// tha snyad sgrub kyang mi 'thad de/ de dag la don nges nas tha snyad la rmongs pa mi srid pas so// rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ rtags 'gog tshul sgrub bo// dang po ni/ sbyor lam nas bzung ste phyi rol mi ldog tu sgrub pa ni/ byang sems gang dag nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa dbang rnon chos can/ de 'dir rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin te/ rtags nyi shu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ mthong lam la gnas pa dbang po 'bring chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog ste/ rtags bcu drug dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// sgom pa'i lam la khyad par can dag la gnas pa chos can/ dbang po rtul yang phyir mi ldog ste/ zab mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// tshogs ni/ dge 'dun no// gnyis pa la/ phyogs chos mngon sum gyis grub ste/ mnyam gzhag gi 'bras bu lus ngag gi tha snyad rnams rtags (565) yin la/ de mngon sum gyis grub pas so// khyab pa ni/ rang gi steng du lus ngag gi tha snyad la/ phyir mi ldog gi rgyu mnyam gzhag gi spangs rtogs khyad par can gyis khyab pa nges pa yin no// chos bcu par/ du ba las ni mer shes dang*// chu skyar las ni chu shes ltar// byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi// rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes// zhes so// rtsod spang la/ blo gong mas rjes dpag gis sgrub mi dgos/ 'og mas sgrub mi nus pas blo mnyam pas sgrub na/ mthong lam pa la sgra don snang ba'i rtog pa yod na/

mthong bar 'gal/ med na rjes dpag skye bar 'gal lo// zhe na/ mthong lam mnyam gzhag pa la rjes dpag skye ba'ang med/ rtog pa'ang med do// rjes thob na rjes dpag skye ba yod kyang rtog pas khyab pa med do// yang sa brgyad pa yan chod na yid shes rnam rtog yod par thal/ rjes dpag skye ba'i phyir zhe na/ sgra don snang ba'i yid shes rtog pa yod par thal zer na/ khyab pa ma grub/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa yod par thal ba 'dod pa yin no// yid shes gnas gyur par bshad pa ni/ ma lus par gyur pa la dgongs pa min no// yang*/ blo 'og ma zhig gis gong ma'i rtags nges/ khyab pa sangs rgyas kyi lung gis grub pas rjes su dpog pas skyon med do// 'grel pa la/ 'khor ba'i g.yul zlog pa'i dpa' bo gang dag nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba la gnas pa'i byang sems de dag ni/ rim pa bzhin dbang po rno 'bring rtul po rnams chos can/ slob pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun yin no// rtags nyi shu dang*/ bcu drug po de dang*/ zab mo brgyad po de rtogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i phyir ro// rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum pa phyir mi ldog tu (566) sgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ dge 'dun gsum pa de rnams kyi phyir mi ldog gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa gang yin zhe na/ 'chad ces drang ngo*// gang na/ nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog gi mtshan nyid do// gang du na/ re zhig ste/ gsum gyi thog mar ro// gang gis na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gis so// rtsa ba ni/ nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog ste/ gzugs la sogs pa las ldog pa dang*/ sogs pa the tshom med pa sogs rnam pa nyi shu dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// khyab pa yod de/

nyi shu po de phyir mi ldog gi mtshan nyid du brjod pa yin pas so// 'grel pa la/ shes par bya ba yin no// zhes drang ngo*// gang na/ nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid do// gang gis na/ gzugs la sogs pa las ldog pa dang*/ the tshom med pa dang*/ sogs pa mi khom pa zad pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa nyi shus so// rgyas bshad la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ yang*/ gzugs sogs las ldog pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid nyi shu po de dag gang yin zhe na/ mtshan nyid de dag bstan pa'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad bcu drug gis 'chad do// rtsa ba la bzhi ste/ drod rtse bzod mchog gi mtshan nyid do// dang po ni/ drod la gnas pa byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog ste/ rtags bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bcu gcig po gang zhe na/ gzhan du zhes kun gyi gong du sbyar te/ gzugs la sogs par rtog pa las phyir ldog pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ gzugs las phyir ldog pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o// zhes so// srid zhir ltung ba las skyob pa'i skyabs gsum la the tshom zad pa'i phyir ro// sdud par/ dge sbyong dag dang bram ze (567) gzhan la brten mi byed ces so// mi dal ba brgyad du skyed pa'i rgyu zad pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ log par lta bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// bdag nyid dge ba 'byung ba nas shing gzhan dag de la 'god pa sngags mthun pas dga' ba'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la yang dag par bskul zhing spyod do// zhes so// sems can gzhan gyi rten can la dmigs te sbyin sogs phyin drug sgom zhing 'dod pa sgrub pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhes so// zab mo'i don bden gnyis kyi rnam pa la som nyi med pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/

chos zab mo la dogs pa dang*/ yid gnyis dang*/ the tshom med do// zhes so// sems can thams cad la byams pas zin pa'i lus dang*/ sogs pa ngag dang yid kyi las dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ byams pa'i lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi las dang ldan pa yin zhes so// bslab pa gsum la sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang rgyun du mi 'grogs pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag dang lhan cig tu mi gnas te zhes so// ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal kun 'joms pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ bag la nyal ba thams cad kyi thams cad du med do// zhes so// 'gro 'ong la sogs pa'i spyod pa la dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ dran bzhin du 'gro zhes sogs so// chos gos dang*/ sogs pa longs spyod la sro ma sogs med pas gtsang ba'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ chos gos longs spyod pa la sro ma med cing smad du med pa yin zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rtse mo la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ byang chub las phyir mi ldog ste/ rtags drug dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// drug gang na/ lus la srin bu'i rigs rnams mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// mdo ni/ byang sems de'i
